b: Bapera paru.
source: Bapera paru.

b: Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, mare pawie Sóstenes
source: Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, mare pawie Sóstenes

b: Pao uwobe emugui Corinto bakurireu kejewuge ewogai, pemegagodure Cristo koiawuge eiamedu bogai, duwugere Pao makore ewogai tuwo tubemegado, jeture ia tuieda kejewuge eiamedu boe enogwamagudui Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.
source: Pao uwobe emugui Corinto bakurireu kejewuge ewogai, pemegagodure Cristo koiawuge eiamedu bogai, duwugere Pao makore ewogai tuwo tubemegado, jeture ia tuieda kejewuge eiamedu boe enogwamagudui Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.

b: Boe pemegareu, boe butugureu aregodui Pao pijiwu, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo pijiwu, makuduwo tagai.
source: Boe pemegareu, boe butugureu aregodui Pao pijiwu, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo pijiwu, makuduwo tagai.

b: Jii je ire tukutaido Paoji taigoia, o boe pemegareu makudui tagai Jesus Cristo koia du koia.
source: Jii je ire tukutaido Paoji taigoia, o boe pemegareu makudui tagai Jesus Cristo koia du koia.

b: Koiare ure tagoroe pemegareu kuricigodo boe ewadaru jamedu boe tabo, boe eerduwa jamedu boe tabo.
source: Koiare ure tagoroe pemegareu kuricigodo boe ewadaru jamedu boe tabo, boe eerduwa jamedu boe tabo.

b: Du inodu koiare o bataru metu rakare tagabo.
source: Du inodu koiare o bataru metu rakare tagabo.

b: Nowu inodu tabo, tabagai Jesus Cristo umode towadudo du bogai du tabo, boe pemegareu kurireu ia okwakare tagai.
source: Nowu inodu tabo, tabagai Jesus Cristo umode towadudo du bogai du tabo, boe pemegareu kurireu ia okwakare tagai.

b: Emare umode taroiwa rakado jii oto kae, duma tagiwo tagi rugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode jiwu meri keje ukawo boe pegado tai.
source: Emare umode taroiwa rakado jii oto kae, duma tagiwo tagi rugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode jiwu meri keje ukawo boe pegado tai.

b:
Pao kodure tuwadaru rekodaji, emare makore tawogai tameduiawo Onaregedu Pagimejera Jesus Cristoce.
Pao uwobe ei tuginoi tuginoidu.
source:
Pao kodure tuwadaru rekodaji, emare makore tawogai tameduiawo Onaregedu Pagimejera Jesus Cristoce.
Pao uwobe ei tuginoi tuginoidu.

b: Iwiemage, inogwamagudumode tai, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, taiamedu boe emearduwo pu meardae reore, takawo tado tuginoi tuginoi, taedudo tabemegai pui du tabo, tameardae, tagaidae mito du tabo.
source: Iwiemage, inogwamagudumode tai, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, taiamedu boe emearduwo pu meardae reore, takawo tado tuginoi tuginoi, taedudo tabemegai pui du tabo, tameardae, tagaidae mito du tabo.

b: Paga karega, iwiemage, Cleo uwobe ere iwie tagorigoduie pui duji.
source: Paga karega, iwiemage, Cleo uwobe ere iwie tagorigoduie pui duji.

b: Kodiba inagoino? Kodiba karega, ia tagi tagagore: Imire ionare Pauloji, imire ionare Apoloji, imire ionare Cefaji, imire ionare Cristoji.
source: Kodiba inagoino? Kodiba karega, ia tagi tagagore: Imire ionare Pauloji, imire ionare Apoloji, imire ionare Cefaji, imire ionare Cristoji.

b: Kode, Cristo kadodu kana jice woje tubiji? Paulona padudodure cruz keje tagai? Paulo ie tabo kana tagao pegododure?
source: Kode, Cristo kadodu kana jice woje tubiji? Paulona padudodure cruz keje tagai? Paulo ie tabo kana tagao pegododure?

b: Iegarere Paoji: ikare ia tagi ia tagi tagao pegodo, Crispo, Caio, epiji tu je.
source: Iegarere Paoji: ikare ia tagi ia tagi tagao pegodo, Crispo, Caio, epiji tu je.

b: Oino du tabo iaboe iaboe egomodukare tao pegododuie ikie tabo duji.
source: Oino du tabo iaboe iaboe egomodukare tao pegododuie ikie tabo duji.

b: Ire Estéfanas uwobe etao pegodo jamedu. Awuge epiji toro, iwiabutukare ii iage etao pegodo rakuduie.
source: Ire Estéfanas uwobe etao pegodo jamedu. Awuge epiji toro, iwiabutukare ii iage etao pegodo rakuduie.

b:
Cristo ure irojai, mare iwo boe etao pegodo du bogai karega, mare imagowo bakaru pemegareuji du bogai. Awu inodu tabo, imagokare ji boe ewadaru motureu tabo, ikawo Cristo o cruz barigududo pudui.
Awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa, mare Pao uwobe eerduwa.
source:
Cristo ure irojai, mare iwo boe etao pegodo du bogai karega, mare imagowo bakaru pemegareuji du bogai. Awu inodu tabo, imagokare ji boe ewadaru motureu tabo, ikawo Cristo o cruz barigududo pudui.
Awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa, mare Pao uwobe eerduwa.

b: Cruz jiwu bakaru pegajagu nure ure tuwogwadowuge etai, mare inorudodureuge pagai, Pao ro rakareu nure ema.
source: Cruz jiwu bakaru pegajagu nure ure tuwogwadowuge etai, mare inorudodureuge pagai, Pao ro rakareu nure ema.

b:
Atugododure oino: “Imode jorduwareuge eerduwa pegado, imode meardae rakareuge emeardae okwado” 
 (Is 29,14).
source:
Atugododure oino: “Imode jorduwareuge eerduwa pegado, imode meardae rakareuge emeardae okwado” 
 (Is 29,14).

b: Kaiba jorduwareu rakojere? Kaiba jorduware tuwadaru tumago jiwu rakojere? Kaiba awu moto kejewu unora kigodureu rakojere? Kode, Pao akokare awu moto kejewu mearduwareboe jorduwareboeie boe pegareu rema?
source: Kaiba jorduwareu rakojere? Kaiba jorduware tuwadaru tumago jiwu rakojere? Kaiba awu moto kejewu unora kigodureu rakojere? Kode, Pao akokare awu moto kejewu mearduwareboe jorduwareboeie boe pegareu rema?

b: Kode awu moto kejewu jorduwareboe mearduwareboe ekare boe pawuje Paoji tuiorduwareu tumearduwareu tabo; nowu inodu tabo Pao aidure tuwo meartorureuge einorudo to bataru matadureu cere kogado jitu tabo.
source: Kode awu moto kejewu jorduwareboe mearduwareboe ekare boe pawuje Paoji tuiorduwareu tumearduwareu tabo; nowu inodu tabo Pao aidure tuwo meartorureuge einorudo to bataru matadureu cere kogado jitu tabo.

b: Judeudoge enogwamagudure ia boe tuginoiwu kurireu tuguwo pudai du bogai; Grécia kejewuge eemarure jorduwareboe bogai.
source: Judeudoge enogwamagudure ia boe tuginoiwu kurireu tuguwo pudai du bogai; Grécia kejewuge eemarure jorduwareboe bogai.

b: Cegirema cereadodure Jesus padui cruz keje duji. Duwure judeudogere tumeardae pegareudo ema, judeukare emawuge ere iaboe matadureudo ema tuiegai.
source: Cegirema cereadodure Jesus padui cruz keje duji. Duwure judeudogere tumeardae pegareudo ema, judeukare emawuge ere iaboe matadureudo ema tuiegai.

b: Mare pemegareuge emedui judeudoge, gregodoge etadadu, Pao ro rakareu jorduwa rakareu rema etai.
source: Mare pemegareuge emedui judeudoge, gregodoge etadadu, Pao ro rakareu jorduwa rakareu rema etai.

b: Mare paga karega, Pao o matadureboe jorduwa rakareboe rema ime eerduwa kori, Pao o rorakakareboe emare rorakareboe rema ime ero raka kori.
source: Mare paga karega, Pao o matadureboe jorduwa rakareboe rema ime eerduwa kori, Pao o rorakakareboe emare rorakareboe rema ime ero raka kori.

b: Tagi, iwiemage, tagado ure tudo tadoda boeji: tadoda jorduwa rakareuge emagakare ime eegai, rorakareuge emagakare jamedu, ema remawugere emawuge bokware jamedu.
source: Tagi, iwiemage, tagado ure tudo tadoda boeji: tadoda jorduwa rakareuge emagakare ime eegai, rorakareuge emagakare jamedu, ema remawugere emawuge bokware jamedu.

b: Mare Pao ure awu moto kejewu boe matadureboe tawuje tuwo jorduwareuge eerduwa bokwado. Pao ure awu moto rakakareboe tawuje tuwo rorakareuge eroiwa bokwado jamedu.
source: Mare Pao ure awu moto kejewu boe matadureboe tawuje tuwo jorduwareuge eerduwa bokwado. Pao ure awu moto rakakareboe tawuje tuwo rorakareuge eroiwa bokwado jamedu.

b: Paore awu moto jekaiwu boe pegareu, boe barigodudodureu, boekare emawu, ure tawuje, uwo boe remaboe bokwado.
source: Paore awu moto jekaiwu boe pegareu, boe barigodudodureu, boekare emawu, ure tawuje, uwo boe remaboe bokwado.

b: Oinowo ia ime ia ime ekawo tojarodo pudui Pao jekai.
source: Oinowo ia ime ia ime ekawo tojarodo pudui Pao jekai.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare tamedure Cristo tada. Duwure Paore boe eerduwa rakareudo ema, boe jetororeudo ema, boe pemegareudo ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema pagai.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare tamedure Cristo tada. Duwure Paore boe eerduwa rakareudo ema, boe jetororeudo ema, boe pemegareudo ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema pagai.

b: Uwo nono bapera atugo reore: “Cewu ure tojarodo puduiwu umode tojarodo pudui Pagimejera tada” (Jer 9,23).
source: Uwo nono bapera atugo reore: “Cewu ure tojarodo puduiwu umode tojarodo pudui Pagimejera tada” (Jer 9,23).

b: Paulo uwadodui Corinto bakurireu kejedu.
source: Paulo uwadodui Corinto bakurireu kejedu.

b: Imi jamedu, iture tagae du keje, itukare tagae iwadaru makareu tabo du kare, iorduwa rakareu tabo du kare, iwo tawie Pao bataruji.
source: Imi jamedu, iture tagae du keje, itukare tagae iwadaru makareu tabo du kare, iorduwa rakareu tabo du kare, iwo tawie Pao bataruji.

b: Imeardaere iorduwakai iaboe boeji tadoda, mare tu Jesus Cristoji, mare Cristo padui cruz keje duji tu je.
source: Imeardaere iorduwakai iaboe boeji tadoda, mare tu Jesus Cristoji, mare Cristo padui cruz keje duji tu je.

b: Imugure tadoda iro rakareu bokwa tabo, imorora amagadui ii du tabo, ipagudu tabo.
source: Imugure tadoda iro rakareu bokwa tabo, imorora amagadui ii du tabo, ipagudu tabo.

b: Iwadaru inogituwa puredukare jorduwa rakareu ime ewadaruji; mare paci oino, mare Pao Utaroe, Pao o jorduwa rakareboe pawujeduwo, du jire imagore tawiegai,
source: Iwadaru inogituwa puredukare jorduwa rakareu ime ewadaruji; mare paci oino, mare Pao Utaroe, Pao o jorduwa rakareboe pawujeduwo, du jire imagore tawiegai,

b: Duma tameartorae aregodukawo ime eerduwa rakareu piji, mare tu Pao jorduwa rakareu piji.
source: Duma tameartorae aregodukawo ime eerduwa rakareu piji, mare tu Pao jorduwa rakareu piji.

b: Mare inogituware pemegareuge eiboe, boe eerduwa remawu rema; mare awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa karega, awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage eerduwa karega jamedu, duwuge etagedumode.
source: Mare inogituware pemegareuge eiboe, boe eerduwa remawu rema; mare awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa karega, awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage eerduwa karega jamedu, duwuge etagedumode.

b: Cewadodure Pao jorduware jiboeji, boe eremodukare toboe, boe emodukare pawujeboe jire cemagore. Pao ure awu inodudo oino, boe towujedumodedu otodai, paegareaece, pagaidaece.
source: Cewadodure Pao jorduware jiboeji, boe eremodukare toboe, boe emodukare pawujeboe jire cemagore. Pao ure awu inodudo oino, boe towujedumodedu otodai, paegareaece, pagaidaece.

b: Awu jorduwa rakareboe, awu moto kejewu iaboe iaboe boe eimejerage eerduwakare ji; boe eerduwamode inoduji ma, boe emodukare Pagimejera, boe pemegareu kurireu jeture apowu, bu cruz keje.
source: Awu jorduwa rakareboe, awu moto kejewu iaboe iaboe boe eimejerage eerduwakare ji; boe eerduwamode inoduji ma, boe emodukare Pagimejera, boe pemegareu kurireu jeture apowu, bu cruz keje.

b: Mare bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Boe eerduwakare jiboe, boe emeardukare jiboe Paore jetu otorogado cewu meardu kurire jiwuge ewogai.
source: Mare bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Boe eerduwakare jiboe, boe emeardukare jiboe Paore jetu otorogado cewu meardu kurire jiwuge ewogai.

b: Mare Pao ure inodu awadudo paegai Utaroe koia, paga karega, Aroe jorduware boe jamedu boeji, jamedu Pao o boe biareuji jamedu.
source: Mare Pao ure inodu awadudo paegai Utaroe koia, paga karega, Aroe jorduware boe jamedu boeji, jamedu Pao o boe biareuji jamedu.

b: Mare ioguduba jorduware ime tadaboeji? Kode, imedu utaroe metui tadadure jorduware tu ji rugadu. Du reorere iaboe iaboe eerduwakare Pao ogere emawugei, mare tu Pao Utaroe tu rugadu.
source: Mare ioguduba jorduware ime tadaboeji? Kode, imedu utaroe metui tadadure jorduware tu ji rugadu. Du reorere iaboe iaboe eerduwakare Pao ogere emawugei, mare tu Pao Utaroe tu rugadu.

b: Aró, kode, awu moto kejewu aroe makudukare pagai, mare u Pao Utaroe tu rugadu, duwu koiare ure paerduwado Pao o boe pemegareu makudui pagai duji.
source: Aró, kode, awu moto kejewu aroe makudukare pagai, mare u Pao Utaroe tu rugadu, duwu koiare ure paerduwado Pao o boe pemegareu makudui pagai duji.

b: Cere inodu kogado, mare boe ere ceerduwado jiwu boe ewadaru tabo karega, mare Aroere ceerduwado jiwu bataru tabo. Awu Aroe makore aroe jiboeji, aroe o bataru tabo.
source: Cere inodu kogado, mare boe ere ceerduwado jiwu boe ewadaru tabo karega, mare Aroere ceerduwado jiwu bataru tabo. Awu Aroe makore aroe jiboeji, aroe o bataru tabo.

b: Mare awu moto kejewu imedu aidukare aregodure Pao Utaroe pijiboeji, mare paga karega, nowu inodure matadureboe reoreboere ai, jamedu umodukare nowu inodu pawuje, mare paga karega, tu Aroe koiare ure boedo boe pawuje ji.
source: Mare awu moto kejewu imedu aidukare aregodure Pao Utaroe pijiboeji, mare paga karega, nowu inodure matadureboe reoreboere ai, jamedu umodukare nowu inodu pawuje, mare paga karega, tu Aroe koiare ure boedo boe pawuje ji.

b: Mare biapagare Aroe jiwu imedu, ure tugogado boe jamedu boeji, iaboe iaboe ukare tugogado ji.
source: Mare biapagare Aroe jiwu imedu, ure tugogado boe jamedu boeji, iaboe iaboe ukare tugogado ji.

b: "Ioguduba jorduware Pao meardaeji tuwo jorduwado?“ (Is 40,13). Pagirema pameardaere Jesus Cristo meardaeji.
source: "Ioguduba jorduware Pao meardaeji tuwo jorduwado?“ (Is 40,13). Pagirema pameardaere Jesus Cristo meardaeji.

b: Ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge emaragodae.
source: Ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge emaragodae.

b: Imi, iwiemage, iroiwakare imagowo tai biapagare Aroe jiwu ime eidu reore, mare imagore tai nono biapagare tugodu jiboe ei du reore, Cristo aiwu boe etore kugure ei du reore.
source: Imi, iwiemage, iroiwakare imagowo tai biapagare Aroe jiwu ime eidu reore, mare imagore tai nono biapagare tugodu jiboe ei du reore, Cristo aiwu boe etore kugure ei du reore.

b: Ire mokuru kurureboe maku tagai, mare tagiwa rakamodukare jiwu boe eke karega. Tagiwa rakakare ji, tagorogu kugudu kimore du koia.
source: Ire mokuru kurureboe maku tagai, mare tagiwa rakamodukare jiwu boe eke karega. Tagiwa rakakare ji, tagorogu kugudu kimore du koia.

b: Paga karega, tadoda tagorire pui, tarugodure pui, du kodire tawiapaga nure tagoduji kimo, tare nono awu moto kejewu ime ereore kimo.
source: Paga karega, tadoda tagorire pui, tarugodure pui, du kodire tawiapaga nure tagoduji kimo, tare nono awu moto kejewu ime ereore kimo.

b: Paga karega, tagagoi: ionare Pauloji, ionare Apoloji, oino du tabo, takare nono biapagare tugodu jiwu ime ereore?
source: Paga karega, tagagoi: ionare Pauloji, ionare Apoloji, oino du tabo, takare nono biapagare tugodu jiwu ime ereore?

b: Kode, kaboba Paulo rema? Kaboba Apolo rema? U! Boe karega ure emage, utugare boe nure tu emage. Eigoiare ere tameartoru maku tagai, Pao ui maku tu tu boe etai du reore.
source: Kode, kaboba Paulo rema? Kaboba Apolo rema? U! Boe karega ure emage, utugare boe nure tu emage. Eigoiare ere tameartoru maku tagai, Pao ui maku tu tu boe etai du reore.

b: Ire boe tugu, Apolore pegodo, Paorema ure ricodudo.
source: Ire boe tugu, Apolore pegodo, Paorema ure ricodudo.

b: Oino ure tuguwu boe karega, jamedu ure pegodowu boe karega jamedu, mare Pao tu rugadu, koiare ure ricodudo.
source: Oino ure tuguwu boe karega, jamedu ure pegodowu boe karega jamedu, mare Pao tu rugadu, koiare ure ricodudo.

b: Ure tuguwu, ure pegodowu ere nono pureore, mare mori makudumode etai nono emaragodae reore.
source: Ure tuguwu, ure pegodowu ere nono pureore, mare mori makudumode etai nono emaragodae reore.

b: Cegi cemaragodure Pao apo, tagire cere towujewu Pao o boepa nure tagi. Pao uwai nure tagi.
source: Cegi cemaragodure Pao apo, tagire cere towujewu Pao o boepa nure tagi. Pao uwai nure tagi.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai du rekodaji, ire bai oiagejewu bure tugu, ii bai mugudodu epa remawui imi du tabo, iare aogejewu towuje. Tagaiwodo tu tu inoba umode ao jiwu towuje.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai du rekodaji, ire bai oiagejewu bure tugu, ii bai mugudodu epa remawui imi du tabo, iare aogejewu towuje. Tagaiwodo tu tu inoba umode ao jiwu towuje.

b: Boe emodukare ia bai oiagejewu bure towuje pugeje, mare cewu bure tugudure tu rugadu, dure Jesus Cristo rema tu rugadu.
source: Boe emodukare ia bai oiagejewu bure towuje pugeje, mare cewu bure tugudure tu rugadu, dure Jesus Cristo rema tu rugadu.

b: Ia boe emode bai mugudo awu aogeje ia meriri ekureu tabo, ia meriri kigadureu tabo rabodu, ia tori motureu tabo rabodu, iarema ia ira tabo rabodu, ia boebutu tabo rabodu, ia bai tabo rabodu.
source: Ia boe emode bai mugudo awu aogeje ia meriri ekureu tabo, ia meriri kigadureu tabo rabodu, ia tori motureu tabo rabodu, iarema ia ira tabo rabodu, ia boebutu tabo rabodu, ia bai tabo rabodu.

b: Nowu inodu umode towadudo ia meriji nowu roinowuge etai. Nowu meriji, joru umode boe emaragodae udo towadudo, umode maragodureuge emaragodae bu tu tu ewugeje.
source: Nowu inodu umode towadudo ia meriji nowu roinowuge etai. Nowu meriji, joru umode boe emaragodae udo towadudo, umode maragodureuge emaragodae bu tu tu ewugeje.

b: Joru umodukare nowu bai kowu du keje, ure towu mori makudumode ai.
source: Joru umodukare nowu bai kowu du keje, ure towu mori makudumode ai.

b: Mare kodumode du keje, mori bokwamode ji, umode cinorudo, mare umode tuwu joru kajeje.
source: Mare kodumode du keje, mori bokwamode ji, umode cinorudo, mare umode tuwu joru kajeje.

b: Kode, taerduwakare Pao uwaie ure tagiduji? Taerduwakare Pao Utaroe muguie tadoda duji?
source: Kode, taerduwakare Pao uwaie ure tagiduji? Taerduwakare Pao Utaroe muguie tadoda duji?

b: Cewu umode Pao uwai pegadowu, Pao umode pegado jamedu, paga karega, Pao uwai, duwuge nure tagi, boe pemegareu rema.
source: Cewu umode Pao uwai pegadowu, Pao umode pegado jamedu, paga karega, Pao uwai, duwuge nure tagi, boe pemegareu rema.

b: Tagaba taekuri pagado tagaobiji. Ia tagi tamode taerduwa rakado tadoda awu moto kejeboe rekodaji ma, kode, tado nono ia matadureboe reore, duwo nono taerduwa rakaguragaiedu jiwore.
source: Tagaba taekuri pagado tagaobiji. Ia tagi tamode taerduwa rakado tadoda awu moto kejeboe rekodaji ma, kode, tado nono ia matadureboe reore, duwo nono taerduwa rakaguragaiedu jiwore.

b: Paga karega, awu moto kejewu jorduwa rakareboe matadureboe nure ema Pao jekai. Paga karega, atugododure oino: “Imode ikeragu jorduwa rakareugei emeardae pegareu koia” (Jo 5, 13).
source: Paga karega, awu moto kejewu jorduwa rakareboe matadureboe nure ema Pao jekai. Paga karega, atugododure oino: “Imode ikeragu jorduwa rakareugei emeardae pegareu koia” (Jo 5, 13).

b: Ia keje, atugododure oino jamedu: “Pagimejera jorduware jorduwa rakareuge emeardaeji, jorduware boe paga pagawuie ema duji”  (S1 93,11).
source: Ia keje, atugododure oino jamedu: “Pagimejera jorduware jorduwa rakareuge emeardaeji, jorduware boe paga pagawuie ema duji”  (S1 93,11).

b: Du kodire tagaba tameartoru bu ime ewugeje. Boe jamedu boe tago nure ema.
source: Du kodire tagaba tameartoru bu ime ewugeje. Boe jamedu boe tago nure ema.

b: Paulo, Apolo, Pedro, awu moto, jereboe, bireboe, awu meri jiboe, barogwatoboe, jamedu boe tago nure ema.
source: Paulo, Apolo, Pedro, awu moto, jereboe, bireboe, awu meri jiboe, barogwatoboe, jamedu boe tago nure ema.

b: Mare tagi, Cristo oge nure tagi. Pao o nure Cristoce.
source: Mare tagi, Cristo oge nure tagi. Pao o nure Cristoce.

b: Tu Paore umode tugogado maragodure pudaiwugei.
source: Tu Paore umode tugogado maragodure pudaiwugei.

b: Kode eiamedu boe emode cedo nono maragodure Cristo aiwuge ereore, jeture Pao o boe biareu pemegareu jiwuge ereore.
source: Kode eiamedu boe emode cedo nono maragodure Cristo aiwuge ereore, jeture Pao o boe biareu pemegareu jiwuge ereore.

b: Aró, kode, jeture boe jiwu jetoromode turo boeji.
source: Aró, kode, jeture boe jiwu jetoromode turo boeji.

b: Ipagudukare tadugui iiduji, ipagudukare boe eimejerage ei tugogado iiduji; imi jamedu imodukare ikogado ii itaobiji.
source: Ipagudukare tadugui iiduji, ipagudukare boe eimejerage ei tugogado iiduji; imi jamedu imodukare ikogado ii itaobiji.

b: Itadaboe umodukare ipogurudo ia iro keje. Mare inodu tabo, imagomodukare jetororeboeie ure imi duji. Pagimejera umode tugogado ii.
source: Itadaboe umodukare ipogurudo ia iro keje. Mare inodu tabo, imagomodukare jetororeboeie ure imi duji. Pagimejera umode tugogado ii.

b: Kode, tadugu kaba boei boe aregodukai pudae du otodai, mare tawudugugudo jii Pagimejera aregodu kae. Umode boe urugudo biadodure coreboe tadaboeji. Umode boe edo boe pawuje ime emeardaeji. Nowu inodu keje Pao mako pemegamode pai tu tu pareore.
source: Kode, tadugu kaba boei boe aregodukai pudae du otodai, mare tawudugugudo jii Pagimejera aregodu kae. Umode boe urugudo biadodure coreboe tadaboeji. Umode boe edo boe pawuje ime emeardaeji. Nowu inodu keje Pao mako pemegamode pai tu tu pareore.

b: Inagore nowu inodu jamedu boeji, iiboeji, Apolo jiboeji, taigoia: taerduwawo, tagodu kawo nowu bapera atugo ao kae, iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui, tuwiapagai jice woje cei.
source: Inagore nowu inodu jamedu boeji, iiboeji, Apolo jiboeji, taigoia: taerduwawo, tagodu kawo nowu bapera atugo ao kae, iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui, tuwiapagai jice woje cei.

b: Kakoduwu koiaba ure akurido? Ure akaboboe jamedu boe makudukare akai? Kode, makududodure akai ma, kodiba akojarore ai, makudu karega ure akai du kodiwore?
source: Kakoduwu koiaba ure akurido? Ure akaboboe jamedu boe makudukare akai? Kode, makududodure akai ma, kodiba akojarore ai, makudu karega ure akai du kodiwore?

b: Taguredure, tagoroe kuricigore, boe eimejerage nure tagi ceiageje. Ica, boe eimejerage jokodu remawugedo tagi, boe eimejeragewo cegi tagabo jamedu.
source: Taguredure, tagoroe kuricigore, boe eimejerage nure tagi ceiageje. Ica, boe eimejerage jokodu remawugedo tagi, boe eimejeragewo cegi tagabo jamedu.

b: Imeardaere Paoie apostolodoge cegi cedudo boe opo kejeduji, bimodeboe reore: Cedure moto keje boe eerdaece, boe eegai, tupadoge eegai jamedu.
source: Imeardaere Paoie apostolodoge cegi cedudo boe opo kejeduji, bimodeboe reore: Cedure moto keje boe eerdaece, boe eegai, tupadoge eegai jamedu.

b: Cristo jiboe koiare cere cedo nono matadureboe reore, tagirema taerduwa rakaguragare. Cegi ceragakare, tagirema taragare. Tagire boe eerdu kurire tai, cegirema boere cewarigodudo cei.
source: Cristo jiboe koiare cere cedo nono matadureboe reore, tagirema taerduwa rakaguragare. Cegi ceragakare, tagirema taragare. Tagire boe eerdu kurire tai, cegirema boere cewarigodudo cei.

b: Jii oino cemagudure cege boi kai, marenarure cegi, boe erorerure cei, cemuga kidagodureu bokwa.
source: Jii oino cemagudure cege boi kai, marenarure cegi, boe erorerure cei, cemuga kidagodureu bokwa.

b: Jii oino cemedugodure cemaragodui cegera tabo du tabo. Boe enogwaguru pegare cedabo du keje, cenogwaguru pemegare boe ebo, boe etonare cei du keje, cere cegiwa rakado; boe emago pegai cei du keje, cenogituwa pemegado boei.
source: Jii oino cemedugodure cemaragodui cegera tabo du tabo. Boe enogwaguru pegare cedabo du keje, cenogwaguru pemegare boe ebo, boe etonare cei du keje, cere cegiwa rakado; boe emago pegai cei du keje, cenogituwa pemegado boei.

b: Jii oino cere nono awu moto kejewu boe gigudu reore, boe eiamedu boere cebijido.
source: Jii oino cere nono awu moto kejewu boe gigudu reore, boe eiamedu boere cebijido.

b: Ire bapera atugodo awu inodu jamedu boeji, mare iwo tabogurudo du bogai karega, mare iwo taerduwado nono imeardu kurire jiwu itoreie ure tagi duji.
source: Ire bapera atugodo awu inodu jamedu boeji, mare iwo tabogurudo du bogai karega, mare iwo taerduwado nono imeardu kurire jiwu itoreie ure tagi duji.

b: Paga karega, umode taerduwadowuge emagaguragamode Cristo tada, mare taomage emagaguragakare; igoiare ire itoredo tagi Cristo tada, bakaru pemegareu koia.
source: Paga karega, umode taerduwadowuge emagaguragamode Cristo tada, mare taomage emagaguragakare; igoiare ire itoredo tagi Cristo tada, bakaru pemegareu koia.

b: Kodire inogwamagudu nure tai, tagoduwo iro rekodaji.
source: Kodire inogwamagudu nure tai, tagoduwo iro rekodaji.

b: Kodire ire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu Timóteo, upore Pao apowu, rojai tawogai. Ema umode tawia jetu ino boe eroiaguduji, imagai boe eerduwado ji Igreja jamedu boe keje du reore.
source: Kodire ire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu Timóteo, upore Pao apowu, rojai tawogai. Ema umode tawia jetu ino boe eroiaguduji, imagai boe eerduwado ji Igreja jamedu boe keje du reore.

b: Ia tagi tameardaere imodukae ikirimi tawogai pugeje duji, du koia enojarore pudui.
source: Ia tagi tameardaere imodukae ikirimi tawogai pugeje duji, du koia enojarore pudui.

b: Mare maigodu kuri je itumode tagae pugeje, Pao aidu keje. Nono, imode ikogado nowu ocarore puduiwuge ewadaruji karega, mare ero rakareu pemegareuji.
source: Mare maigodu kuri je itumode tagae pugeje, Pao aidu keje. Nono, imode ikogado nowu ocarore puduiwuge ewadaruji karega, mare ero rakareu pemegareuji.

b: Paga karega, boe ewadaru tada karega Pao o boe pemegareu mugure, mare boe ero pemegareu tada.
source: Paga karega, boe ewadaru tada karega Pao o boe pemegareu mugure, mare boe ero pemegareu tada.

b: Kode, kakoduwu jiba tagaidure? Ituwo tagae iwara tabo, iarema inogudureu tabo kana?
source: Kode, kakoduwu jiba tagaidure? Ituwo tagae iwara tabo, iarema inogudureu tabo kana?

b: Paulo korigodure Corinto tadawu Pao uwobei, ia ro pegareu meture etada kodi.
source: Paulo korigodure Corinto tadawu Pao uwobei, ia ro pegareu meture etada kodi.

b: Boe ego egore tadodaie iaboe ekera keadure, duwuge ero pega kodure ao pegokareuge ero pega kori. Ia tagi tadoda mugure tuo oreduje apo jamedu.
source: Boe ego egore tadodaie iaboe ekera keadure, duwuge ero pega kodure ao pegokareuge ero pega kori. Ia tagi tadoda mugure tuo oreduje apo jamedu.

b: Du inodu tabo tagojarore tai. Tagiarigodukare inodu koia, takare nowu roinowu tawujeduie tabiji.
source: Du inodu tabo tagojarore tai. Tagiarigodukare inodu koia, takare nowu roinowu tawujeduie tabiji.

b: Kode, imi boe jokodure, iragoje jaere tai, mare itaroe mugure tagabo. Itugure nowu roinowuji marigudu nono iragojei tadodadu kodiwore.
source: Kode, imi boe jokodure, iragoje jaere tai, mare itaroe mugure tagabo. Itugure nowu roinowuji marigudu nono iragojei tadodadu kodiwore.

b: Tado pui itaroe tabo, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro rakareu tabo, pawo pagogado ji.
source: Tado pui itaroe tabo, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro rakareu tabo, pawo pagogado ji.

b: Kode, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo awu imedu kodu makudumode maereboe ai, duma utaroedo cinorudo pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meriji.
source: Kode, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo awu imedu kodu makudumode maereboe ai, duma utaroedo cinorudo pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meriji.

b: Tagi tare tagojarodo tai paga tu je. Taerduwakare boe okoi puidu umode jamedu boe kugu jamedu pegado duji?
source: Tagi tare tagojarodo tai paga tu je. Taerduwakare boe okoi puidu umode jamedu boe kugu jamedu pegado duji?

b: Kode okore puiwu pegareu jaowu barigu tabiji, duma tawo nono ia boekugu maiwu pemegareure. Mare paga karega, tare nono amireu okokare puiwore. Mare paga karega, Cristore ceno Pascoa rema, dure bitodure.
source: Kode okore puiwu pegareu jaowu barigu tabiji, duma tawo nono ia boekugu maiwu pemegareure. Mare paga karega, tare nono amireu okokare puiwore. Mare paga karega, Cristore ceno Pascoa rema, dure bitodure.

b: Awu inodu tabo, pawo pago Páscoa parudo, mare okore puiwu codureu tabo karega, okore puiwu pegareu tabo karega, mare okokare puiwu amireu tabo, boe pemegareu tabo, boe rikireu tabo.
source: Awu inodu tabo, pawo pago Páscoa parudo, mare okore puiwu codureu tabo karega, okore puiwu pegareu tabo karega, mare okokare puiwu amireu tabo, boe pemegareu tabo, boe rikireu tabo.

b: Ia ino bapera atugo tada imagore tai tagawo tabodo poguru bokwareuge ebo.
source: Ia ino bapera atugo tada imagore tai tagawo tabodo poguru bokwareuge ebo.

b: Mare imagokare awu moto kejewu ro pegareboeji: okwa kidu ierikareuge, iwogu kigodureuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, awu moto ro pegareugei karega inagoino tawiegai; iarema tadu rumode awu moto piji kodi karega.
source: Mare imagokare awu moto kejewu ro pegareboeji: okwa kidu ierikareuge, iwogu kigodureuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, awu moto ro pegareugei karega inagoino tawiegai; iarema tadu rumode awu moto piji kodi karega.

b: Mare imagore tagaiagu tabodo cewu akore pawieie pudumi boe eegai, mare du inodu tabo rore boe pegareuji, iarema okwa kidu ierikare, iarema meartorure paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei, iarema ure tumedage ewarigodudo pudui tuwadaru tabo, iarema joku baibaire, iarema iwogu kigodure, du apo tagogwagekaba jamedu.
source: Mare imagore tagaiagu tabodo cewu akore pawieie pudumi boe eegai, mare du inodu tabo rore boe pegareuji, iarema okwa kidu ierikare, iarema meartorure paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei, iarema ure tumedage ewarigodudo pudui tuwadaru tabo, iarema joku baibaire, iarema iwogu kigodure, du apo tagogwagekaba jamedu.

b: Kode kodiba imode ikogado okwacere baawadu jaogwaiwugei? Tu tadodawuge eire tamode tagogado.
source: Kode kodiba imode ikogado okwacere baawadu jaogwaiwugei? Tu tadodawuge eire tamode tagogado.

b: Toro baawadu jaogwaiwuge, Pao umode tugogado ei. Aorareu tawuje tabiji.
source: Toro baawadu jaogwaiwuge, Pao umode tugogado ei. Aorareu tawuje tabiji.

b: Ao pegokareuge ekawo tugogado ao pegoreugei.
source: Ao pegokareuge ekawo tugogado ao pegoreugei.

b: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui du keje, kodiba tadumode ao pegokareuge etae ewo tugogado tai? Kodiba tadukare tamanamage ao pegoreuge etae?
source: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui du keje, kodiba tadumode ao pegokareuge etae ewo tugogado tai? Kodiba tadukare tamanamage ao pegoreuge etae?

b: Taerduwakare ao pegoreu pemegareuge emode tugogado awu moto kejewuge eiduji? Kode, tamode tagogado awu motoji ma, kode, tamodukare tarugadu tawo tagogado biegareboeji?
source: Taerduwakare ao pegoreu pemegareuge emode tugogado awu moto kejewuge eiduji? Kode, tamode tagogado awu motoji ma, kode, tamodukare tarugadu tawo tagogado biegareboeji?

b: Taerduwakare pamoduie pagogado tupadoge eiduji? Kode, awu moto kejewu boe biegareboe paroiwamodukana pawo pagogado ji?
source: Taerduwakare pamoduie pagogado tupadoge eiduji? Kode, awu moto kejewu boe biegareboe paroiwamodukana pawo pagogado ji?

b: Kode, tagorigodumode pui awu inodu keje, tageragu ia biegare tu Pao uwai tadawuji uwo tugogado tai.
source: Kode, tagorigodumode pui awu inodu keje, tageragu ia biegare tu Pao uwai tadawuji uwo tugogado tai.

b:
Inagore awu inoduji tai iwo tabogurudo. Boe eerdumodukare ia jorduwa rakare tadodawu ui mito tu je duji uwo tugogado tawiemagei?
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pegareu kai.
source:
Inagore awu inoduji tai iwo tabogurudo. Boe eerdumodukare ia jorduwa rakare tadodawu ui mito tu je duji uwo tugogado tawiemagei?
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pegareu kai.

b: Mare tadoda, ia uwiemage pujewuge ekorigodu nure pui, jamedu ao pegokareuge eegai.
source: Mare tadoda, ia uwiemage pujewuge ekorigodu nure pui, jamedu ao pegokareuge eegai.

b: Tamago pegai puidu, taro pegareu rema, kodiba takare tadurudo boe ekoriji? Kodiba tabemegakare boei turopegado tai du keje?
source: Tamago pegai puidu, taro pegareu rema, kodiba takare tadurudo boe ekoriji? Kodiba tabemegakare boei turopegado tai du keje?

b: Mare du inodu tabo, tagi rugadu boe korire tai, tare boe eekuri pagado, tarore awu inoduji tawiemagei jamedu.
source: Mare du inodu tabo, tagi rugadu boe korire tai, tare boe eekuri pagado, tarore awu inoduji tawiemagei jamedu.

b: Taerduwakare jetorokareuge emedukae Pao o boe pemegareu tadaduji? Tagaba tae kuri pagado: jerebarikareuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, areme ecebage,
source: Taerduwakare jetorokareuge emedukae Pao o boe pemegareu tadaduji? Tagaba tae kuri pagado: jerebarikareuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, areme ecebage,

b: Ure tudo nono areme eiwuge, meridoge, iwogu kigodureuge, jetorireuge, joku baibaireuge, bataru pegareuge, ukigodure boe ewidowuge, ia emage eiamedu emedumodukare Pao o boe pemegareu tada.
source: Ure tudo nono areme eiwuge, meridoge, iwogu kigodureuge, jetorireuge, joku baibaireuge, bataru pegareuge, ukigodure boe ewidowuge, ia emage eiamedu emedumodukare Pao o boe pemegareu tada.

b: Ia tagi tare nono nowuge ereore marigudu. Mare du inodu tabo tagabidure, tagagaru moture, taedorogodure tai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, Pao Utaroe koia.
source: Ia tagi tare nono nowuge ereore marigudu. Mare du inodu tabo tagabidure, tagagaru moture, taedorogodure tai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, Pao Utaroe koia.

b: Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare jamedu boe ukare turugadu inai. Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare imodukare iaboedo irodo taidu reore.
source: Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare jamedu boe ukare turugadu inai. Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare imodukare iaboedo irodo taidu reore.

b: Boe eke jare boe ekuri rema, boe ekurire boe eke ja rema, mare Paomode ui pobedu pegado. Boe ekodu boe ewiri ukare boe ero pegareu ai, mare Pagimejera ai, Pagimejerare pagodu kai.
source: Boe eke jare boe ekuri rema, boe ekurire boe eke ja rema, mare Paomode ui pobedu pegado. Boe ekodu boe ewiri ukare boe ero pegareu ai, mare Pagimejera ai, Pagimejerare pagodu kai.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera umode paewodudo bireuge epiji turo rakareu tabo nono tumagai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo du reore.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera umode paewodudo bireuge epiji turo rakareu tabo nono tumagai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo du reore.

b: Taerduwakare tagodu uie ure Cristo koduce duji? Kode imodukana aredu ropegareudo kodudo Jesus Cristo koduce? Iromodukare ino rugadu.
source: Taerduwakare tagodu uie ure Cristo koduce duji? Kode imodukana aredu ropegareudo kodudo Jesus Cristo koduce? Iromodukare ino rugadu.

b: Taerduware cewu ure tubodo ropegareu aredu apowu uie ure turedudo mitotu apo duji. Mare paga karega, atugododure oino: “Ei pobedu emode nono tureduie mitotu jedu kodiwore”  (Gen 2,24).
source: Taerduware cewu ure tubodo ropegareu aredu apowu uie ure turedudo mitotu apo duji. Mare paga karega, atugododure oino: “Ei pobedu emode nono tureduie mitotu jedu kodiwore”  (Gen 2,24).

b: Mare cewu ure tubodo Pao apowu umode aroedo mitotu pudumi apo.
source: Mare cewu ure tubodo Pao apowu umode aroedo mitotu pudumi apo.

b: Tarego tagodu ro pegareu piji, ia boe ero pegareu todure boe ekodu piji, mare ro pegare tugodu tabowu ure turedu pegado turo pegareu tabo.
source: Tarego tagodu ro pegareu piji, ia boe ero pegareu todure boe ekodu piji, mare ro pegare tugodu tabowu ure turedu pegado turo pegareu tabo.

b: Taerduware Aroe Pemegareu makudui tagai Pao iera pijiwu uwaie ure tagiduji. Taerduware taenakai tai pugeje duji.
source: Taerduware Aroe Pemegareu makudui tagai Pao iera pijiwu uwaie ure tagiduji. Taerduware taenakai tai pugeje duji.

b: Mare paga karega, akirododure tai mori kuricigoreboe tabo. Du kodire taegaredo Paoji taredu mitodu tabo.
source: Mare paga karega, akirododure tai mori kuricigoreboe tabo. Du kodire taegaredo Paoji taredu mitodu tabo.

b: Ure tugera maku puaiwuge eroiagudu.
source: Ure tugera maku puaiwuge eroiagudu.

b: Cewu tare bapera atugodo iwogai du kodiboe, imagomode tai imeardaere jiboeji: Imedu ukai tuburedo aredu jitu pemegare.
source: Cewu tare bapera atugodo iwogai du kodiboe, imagomode tai imeardaere jiboeji: Imedu ukai tuburedo aredu jitu pemegare.

b: Mare boe ero pegareu koia, ema remaure imedu umode tuwiredo, aredu umode tugogedo tu rugadu.
source: Mare boe ero pegareu koia, ema remaure imedu umode tuwiredo, aredu umode tugogedo tu rugadu.

b: Imedu umode aredu jonare pudui jiboe udo ai, du reorere aredu umode imedu jonare pudui jiboe udo ai jamedu.
source: Imedu umode aredu jonare pudui jiboe udo ai, du reorere aredu umode imedu jonare pudui jiboe udo ai jamedu.

b: Aredu jonakare pudui, mare paga karega, jonare toredu jitu koia. Du reorere imedu jonakare pudi, jonare toreduje jitu koia.
source: Aredu jonakare pudui, mare paga karega, jonare toredu jitu koia. Du reorere imedu jonakare pudi, jonare toreduje jitu koia.

b: Tagaba pu iera roto ta tai, mare tamagoi pui du keje, taroiwamode tawo tarodo boku pui ia kodiboe kae, tamagowo tabaru keje, dukeje tamode tagirimi puae pugeje, duma tamegikawo boe pegareu kae.
source: Tagaba pu iera roto ta tai, mare tamagoi pui du keje, taroiwamode tawo tarodo boku pui ia kodiboe kae, tamagowo tabaru keje, dukeje tamode tagirimi puae pugeje, duma tamegikawo boe pegareu kae.

b:
Imagore oino, mare imago karega ure tarowo ino, mare taromode ino du keje, pegakare jamedu.
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pega kai.
source:
Imagore oino, mare imago karega ure tarowo ino, mare taromode ino du keje, pegakare jamedu.
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pega kai.

b: Kode itaiduia taiamedu tabore tawo nono ireore, mare Pao pijiboere makudure tu tu ime etai.
source: Kode itaiduia taiamedu tabore tawo nono ireore, mare Pao pijiboere makudure tu tu ime etai.

b: Kowadureu boe, ukoge bokware pijiwu areme, uwire bokware pijiwu ime, ema remawure umode tugogedo, tuwiredo du rema.
source: Kowadureu boe, ukoge bokware pijiwu areme, uwire bokware pijiwu ime, ema remawure umode tugogedo, tuwiredo du rema.

b: Ema remawure boe ewo tugogedo, tuwiredo, mare boe ewo tuwarigu joruto dure ema karega.
source: Ema remawure boe ewo tugogedo, tuwiredo, mare boe ewo tuwarigu joruto dure ema karega.

b: Ukogereuge, uwirereuge ire imaguduiagu maku tagai, mare imi karega, Pagimejera akoino: Aredu ukawo tugera ra toredu piji, 11ukawo tumagu ia imedu ai, iarema umode tugirimi toredu ai tubemega tabo pugeje. Du reorere imedu ukawo tugera ra toreduje piji jamedu.
source: Ukogereuge, uwirereuge ire imaguduiagu maku tagai, mare imi karega, Pagimejera akoino: Aredu ukawo tugera ra toredu piji, 11ukawo tumagu ia imedu ai, iarema umode tugirimi toredu ai tubemega tabo pugeje. Du reorere imedu ukawo tugera ra toreduje piji jamedu.

b: Iagei, imagomode oino ei, mare Pao karega akoino, imi tu je: Ia imedu aopegokareu umode tuwiredo ia aredu aopegokareu apo du keje, kode nowu imedu ukaba tugera ra piji.
source: Iagei, imagomode oino ei, mare Pao karega akoino, imi tu je: Ia imedu aopegokareu umode tuwiredo ia aredu aopegokareu apo du keje, kode nowu imedu ukaba tugera ra piji.

b: Ia aredu aopegoreudo umode tugogedo ia aopegokareu imedu apo du keje, awu imedu aidumode tumuguwo apo du keje, kode nowu aredu ukaba tugera ra toredu piji jamedu.
source: Ia aredu aopegoreudo umode tugogedo ia aopegokareu imedu apo du keje, awu imedu aidumode tumuguwo apo du keje, kode nowu aredu ukaba tugera ra toredu piji jamedu.

b: Mare paga karega, oredu aopegokareu umode tubemegado toreduje aopegoreudo koia. Ia du keje etore eedoromodukare pudui, mare oino boe pemegareuge nure emage.
source: Mare paga karega, oredu aopegokareu umode tubemegado toreduje aopegoreudo koia. Ia du keje etore eedoromodukare pudui, mare oino boe pemegareuge nure emage.

b: Mare aopegokareu imedu aidumode tuwo tugera ra toreduje aopegoreudo piji ma, piji rugadu. Aopegokareu aredu, aidumode tuwo tugera ra toredu aopegoreu piji ma, piji rugadu. Nowu inodu keje, aopegoreu ure nono kowadureu reore pugeje; aopegoreudo umode nono kowadureudo reore pugeje jamedu. Mare paga karega, Pao makore tawogai boe pemegareu kae, boe butugureu kae.
source: Mare aopegokareu imedu aidumode tuwo tugera ra toreduje aopegoreudo piji ma, piji rugadu. Aopegokareu aredu, aidumode tuwo tugera ra toredu aopegoreu piji ma, piji rugadu. Nowu inodu keje, aopegoreu ure nono kowadureu reore pugeje; aopegoreudo umode nono kowadureudo reore pugeje jamedu. Mare paga karega, Pao makore tawogai boe pemegareu kae, boe butugureu kae.

b: Aki aredu, inoba aerduwamode amode akoredu inorudo duji? Aki, imedu, inoba aerduwamode amode akoreduje inorudo duji?
source: Aki aredu, inoba aerduwamode amode akoredu inorudo duji? Aki, imedu, inoba aerduwamode amode akoreduje inorudo duji?

b: Taedudo tu tu Pao aidu reore tamagai Pao makoi tawogai du reore. Oinore imago imagore Pao uwobe eiameduji.
source: Taedudo tu tu Pao aidu reore tamagai Pao makoi tawogai du reore. Oinore imago imagore Pao uwobe eiameduji.

b: Makore tawogai judeudogei tagi du reore, kode judeudogedo tagi rugadu: makore tawogai judeukare emawugei tagi du reore, kode, tagaba judeudo tagi rugadu.
source: Makore tawogai judeudogei tagi du reore, kode judeudogedo tagi rugadu: makore tawogai judeukare emawugei tagi du reore, kode, tagaba judeudo tagi rugadu.

b: Boe emode judeudo pudumi, boe emodukare judeudo pudumi, nowu inodu jamedu boe boe karega. Mare boe eroi Pao aidu reore dure ema remawu rema.
source: Boe emode judeudo pudumi, boe emodukare judeudo pudumi, nowu inodu jamedu boe boe karega. Mare boe eroi Pao aidu reore dure ema remawu rema.

b: Tamode nono tareore tu tu Pao makoi tawogai du keje.
source: Tamode nono tareore tu tu Pao makoi tawogai du keje.

b: Boe etugarere aki Pao makoi awogai du keje, awiapaga kaba nowu inoduji. Akinorudodumode rabodu, mare ica, amode apodo boe etugarei aki du tabo.
source: Boe etugarere aki Pao makoi awogai du keje, awiapaga kaba nowu inoduji. Akinorudodumode rabodu, mare ica, amode apodo boe etugarei aki du tabo.

b: Paga karega, Pao makore bogaiwu boe etugare, inorudodure Pao ai. Du reorere jamedu Pao makore bogaiwu boe etugarekare emawu, Cristo utugaremode ema.
source: Paga karega, Pao makore bogaiwu boe etugare, inorudodure Pao ai. Du reorere jamedu Pao makore bogaiwu boe etugarekare emawu, Cristo utugaremode ema.

b: Tagi akirododure tai tamori kuricigoreu tabo, tagaba ime etugaredo tagi pugeje.
source: Tagi akirododure tai tamori kuricigoreu tabo, tagaba ime etugaredo tagi pugeje.

b: Iwiemage, tado tu tareore Pao jekai, cewu Pao makoi tawogaidu otobiji du reore.
source: Iwiemage, tado tu tareore Pao jekai, cewu Pao makoi tawogaidu otobiji du reore.

b: Cewu kowadureuge eiboe, Pagimejera makokare ii iaboeji, mare inogituwamode ei, mare paga karega, Pao okudu oiagudu koiare boe emeartorure ii.
source: Cewu kowadureuge eiboe, Pagimejera makokare ii iaboeji, mare inogituwamode ei, mare paga karega, Pao okudu oiagudu koiare boe emeartorure ii.

b: Du kodire imeardaere uie turugadu imedu uwo tu pudumi rugadu, boe jokodu kadu modedu boe koia.
source: Du kodire imeardaere uie turugadu imedu uwo tu pudumi rugadu, boe jokodu kadu modedu boe koia.

b: Aki awirere marigudu ma, aemaru kaba akiwujeduwo piji. Awirekai du keje, aemaru kaba aredu bogai.
source: Aki awirere marigudu ma, aemaru kaba akiwujeduwo piji. Awirekai du keje, aemaru kaba aredu bogai.

b: Mare awiremode du keje, boe pegareu karega. Kowadureu aredu umode tugogedo ma, boe pegareu karega jamedu. Mare du inodu tabo emugumode togorii pudui du keje, awu inodu jire itaiduia ewo tuiaedo.
source: Mare awiremode du keje, boe pegareu karega. Kowadureu aredu umode tugogedo ma, boe pegareu karega jamedu. Mare du inodu tabo emugumode togorii pudui du keje, awu inodu jire itaiduia ewo tuiaedo.

b: Mare ica, imagomode oino tai: Boe raikare. Ema remawure uwirereu umode tudo nono tuwirekadu kodiwore.
source: Mare ica, imagomode oino tai: Boe raikare. Ema remawure uwirereu umode tudo nono tuwirekadu kodiwore.

b: Ema remawure uragudureuge emode nono uragudukareuge ereore, jekareuge emode tudo nono tuiegarekadu kodiwore. Ure akirodowuge emode tudo nono oroekarewuge ereore.
source: Ema remawure uragudureuge emode nono uragudukareuge ereore, jekareuge emode tudo nono tuiegarekadu kodiwore. Ure akirodowuge emode tudo nono oroekarewuge ereore.

b: Iera amagadure awu moto jiwuge emode tudo nono tugera amagadukai awu moto jitu kodiwore. Mare paga karega, awu moto kejeboe akedumode.
source: Iera amagadure awu moto jiwuge emode tudo nono tugera amagadukai awu moto jitu kodiwore. Mare paga karega, awu moto kejeboe akedumode.

b: Itaidure tamorora amagadu kawo rugadu. Cewu kowadureu jetumode Pao oeji, jemarumode tuwo Pao jekaredo.
source: Itaidure tamorora amagadu kawo rugadu. Cewu kowadureu jetumode Pao oeji, jemarumode tuwo Pao jekaredo.

b: Mare cewu uwirereu, morora amagadure awu moto kejeboeji, jemarure tuwo toreduje jekaredo, ure tudo pubiji.
source: Mare cewu uwirereu, morora amagadure awu moto kejeboeji, jemarure tuwo toreduje jekaredo, ure tudo pubiji.

b: Du reorere cewu okogekareu aredu, kowadureu aredu, eedumode Pao oeji, duma turedu jamedu boe pemegawo, tudaroe pemegawo jamedu. Mare ukogereu aredu jeture awu moto kejeboeji, jemarure tuwo toredu jekaredo.
source: Du reorere cewu okogekareu aredu, kowadureu aredu, eedumode Pao oeji, duma turedu jamedu boe pemegawo, tudaroe pemegawo jamedu. Mare ukogereu aredu jeture awu moto kejeboeji, jemarure tuwo toredu jekaredo.

b: Imagore awu inoduji tai, mare iwo taroiwa bokwado karega. Paci oino, itaidure taro pemegawo nono umode turugadu boei du rere, tabowo Pao apo rugadu.
source: Imagore awu inoduji tai, mare iwo taroiwa bokwado karega. Paci oino, itaidure taro pemegawo nono umode turugadu boei du rere, tabowo Pao apo rugadu.

b: Iaboe emeardumode ukae turugadu tonaregedu aredu ukai tugogedo duji, mare emeardaere ukogedoduwo o joru ui turugadu du keje ma, eromode taidu reore duji. Boe pegareu karega boemode ukogedodu rema.
source: Iaboe emeardumode ukae turugadu tonaregedu aredu ukai tugogedo duji, mare emeardaere ukogedoduwo o joru ui turugadu du keje ma, eromode taidu reore duji. Boe pegareu karega boemode ukogedodu rema.

b: Mare cewu aidu pemegare tudada, taobiji rugadu tonaregedu aredu koadureudo ukogedodukawo ma, ro pemegare jamedu.
source: Mare cewu aidu pemegare tudada, taobiji rugadu tonaregedu aredu koadureudo ukogedodukawo ma, ro pemegare jamedu.

b: Kodi icare cewu tonaregedu aredu ukogedowu ro pemega nure: Mare cewu ukare tonaregedu aredu ukogedowu, nowure icare ro pemega remawu nure.
source: Kodi icare cewu tonaregedu aredu ukogedowu ro pemega nure: Mare cewu ukare tonaregedu aredu ukogedowu, nowure icare ro pemega remawu nure.

b: Aredu upore tu tu toredu apo tui kimo otoi. Mare oredu bokwamode du keje, ure turugadu ji tuwo tugogedo ia taidure jiwu apo, mare Pao aidu reore.
source: Aredu upore tu tu toredu apo tui kimo otoi. Mare oredu bokwamode du keje, ure turugadu ji tuwo tugogedo ia taidure jiwu apo, mare Pao aidu reore.

b: Nowu inodu tabo, inogituwamode ji, boe pemega remawumode ji mugui ino jii je du keje. Imeardaere Pao Utaroe mugui itabo jamedu inogituwawo tai du bogai.
source: Nowu inodu tabo, inogituwamode ji, boe pemega remawumode ji mugui ino jii je du keje. Imeardaere Pao Utaroe mugui itabo jamedu inogituwawo tai du bogai.

b: Barogo kodu makudure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaidu jiboe.
source: Barogo kodu makudure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaidu jiboe.

b: Barogo kodu makudui paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaidu jiboe ure oino. Pagi paerduware inoba paromode duji, mare paga karega, paiamedu boe jorduwadodure. Mare boe eerduwadodu ure boe ewogwado, mare boe enogudu boe eiagudu ure boe epemegado.
source: Barogo kodu makudui paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaidu jiboe ure oino. Pagi paerduware inoba paromode duji, mare paga karega, paiamedu boe jorduwadodure. Mare boe eerduwadodu ure boe ewogwado, mare boe enogudu boe eiagudu ure boe epemegado.

b: Iaboe emeardaemode tuiorduwaie iaboe boeji ma, jorduwakare roga tuiorduwamode jiboeji.
source: Iaboe emeardaemode tuiorduwaie iaboe boeji ma, jorduwakare roga tuiorduwamode jiboeji.

b: Mare iaboe emeardu kurimode Paoji ma, Pao jorduware ji jamedu.
source: Mare iaboe emeardu kurimode Paoji ma, Pao jorduware ji jamedu.

b: Du kodire, cemagoi barogo kodu makudui paga pagawu aroe eiemejerage etaidu jitu keje, ceerduware cewu paga pagawu aroe eimejerage boe kaegae, paga karega, ia Aroe Eimejerakare pugeje mare tu Pao ure mito tu je.
source: Du kodire, cemagoi barogo kodu makudui paga pagawu aroe eiemejerage etaidu jitu keje, ceerduware cewu paga pagawu aroe eimejerage boe kaegae, paga karega, ia Aroe Eimejerakare pugeje mare tu Pao ure mito tu je.

b: U! Boe jokodu, iaboe emeardaere ia aroe eiemejerageie pugeje duji, moto keje rabodu, baru tada rabodu, du taboie aroe eimejerage, boe eimejerage emagaguragare.
source: U! Boe jokodu, iaboe emeardaere ia aroe eiemejerageie pugeje duji, moto keje rabodu, baru tada rabodu, du taboie aroe eimejerage, boe eimejerage emagaguragare.

b: Mare pagai, Aroe Eimejera ure mito tu je dure Pao rema, o nure boe jamedu boece; aire paere oino. Pagimejera mito tu je, dure Jesus Cristo rema, koiare boe jamedu boe jere oino, koiare ure paedo jamedu.
source: Mare pagai, Aroe Eimejera ure mito tu je dure Pao rema, o nure boe jamedu boece; aire paere oino. Pagimejera mito tu je, dure Jesus Cristo rema, koiare boe jamedu boe jere oino, koiare ure paedo jamedu.

b: Mare boe jamedu karega jorduware inoduji. Iage tumeartorui paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei kimo, ere barogo kodu kowuje nono makudui paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etai du kodiwore. Nono eerduwa rakakare du koia, ere tubegado taobiji.
source: Mare boe jamedu karega jorduware inoduji. Iage tumeartorui paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei kimo, ere barogo kodu kowuje nono makudui paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etai du kodiwore. Nono eerduwa rakakare du koia, ere tubegado taobiji.

b: Mare page koia karega ure paedo puredudo Paoji: pagogwage kadu tabo iaboe iaboe boe okwakare pagai, pagogwage tabo, iaboe iaboe mugukare pagabo.
source: Mare page koia karega ure paedo puredudo Paoji: pagogwage kadu tabo iaboe iaboe boe okwakare pagai, pagogwage tabo, iaboe iaboe mugukare pagabo.

b: Mare tameardu awadudo tai awu taroino tagaidu reoredu ukawo kugudu kimore puduiwuge epegado.
source: Mare tameardu awadudo tai awu taroino tagaidu reoredu ukawo kugudu kimore puduiwuge epegado.

b: Akire aerduwa rakaredu, iaboe eerdumode amugui ira keje akogwagewo paga pagawu aroe eimejerage ewai tada boeji ma, emodukare tugugudu kimoi du koiare makudure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaiwu barogo kodu kowuje jamedu?
source: Akire aerduwa rakaredu, iaboe eerdumode amugui ira keje akogwagewo paga pagawu aroe eimejerage ewai tada boeji ma, emodukare tugugudu kimoi du koiare makudure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaiwu barogo kodu kowuje jamedu?

b: Awu inodu tabo, aerduwa rakare du koia, are awie jorduwa rakakarewu butudo, du aire Cristo bitodure.
source: Awu inodu tabo, aerduwa rakare du koia, are awie jorduwa rakakarewu butudo, du aire Cristo bitodure.

b: Nowu inodu tabo, taro pegai tawiemageidu, tai jorduwa rakakareu tawiemage etaroe okorido du tabo, taro pega nure Cristoji.
source: Nowu inodu tabo, taro pegai tawiemageidu, tai jorduwa rakakareu tawiemage etaroe okorido du tabo, taro pega nure Cristoji.

b: Du kodire imode barogo kodu kowuje du koia imode iwie butudo ma, kode, imodukare kowuje, butukawo.
source: Du kodire imode barogo kodu kowuje du koia imode iwie butudo ma, kode, imodukare kowuje, butukawo.

b: Paulo ro.
source: Paulo ro.

b: Imire irore itaidu reore. Imi apóstolo nure imi. Iordure Pagimejera Jesus Cristoji. Tagire imaragodae nure tagi Pagimejera ai.
source: Imire irore itaidu reore. Imi apóstolo nure imi. Iordure Pagimejera Jesus Cristoji. Tagire imaragodae nure tagi Pagimejera ai.

b: Apostolomodukare imi iage etai, mare tagai apóstolo nure imi, mare paga karega, tagire apostoloi imidu kodiwore tagi Pagimejera tada.
source: Apostolomodukare imi iage etai, mare tagai apóstolo nure imi, mare paga karega, tagire apostoloi imidu kodiwore tagi Pagimejera tada.

b: Tagire iwadaru rema mako pegare iwuge ewadaru jipagi.
source: Tagire iwadaru rema mako pegare iwuge ewadaru jipagi.

b: Kode, cegikana ukare turugadu cenogwagewo, ceguduwo?
source: Kode, cegikana ukare turugadu cenogwagewo, ceguduwo?

b: Cegikana cemugumodukare ia aopegoreu aredu apo, nono ia apostolodoge ereore, Pagimejera uwiemege ereore, Pedro reore?
source: Cegikana cemugumodukare ia aopegoreu aredu apo, nono ia apostolodoge ereore, Pagimejera uwiemege ereore, Pedro reore?

b: Kode tu imi mare Barnabé cemodukare cedamudo?
source: Kode tu imi mare Barnabé cemodukare cedamudo?

b: Kakoduwu tugobaigareba kodumode turugodu kae mori bokwa tabo? Ioguduba umode boe tugu ia boepato ma, tukawo kowuje? Ioguduba jetumode tapiradogei togwagekai emoguru kuru jitu tabo?
source: Kakoduwu tugobaigareba kodumode turugodu kae mori bokwa tabo? Ioguduba umode boe tugu ia boepato ma, tukawo kowuje? Ioguduba jetumode tapiradogei togwagekai emoguru kuru jitu tabo?

b: Awu inodu ime eroia kanure tu je? Boro! Meture boe eroiagudu tada jamedu.
source: Awu inodu ime eroia kanure tu je? Boro! Meture boe eroiagudu tada jamedu.

b: Ica, Moisés o boe eroiagudu meture bapera tada. Tadare atugore oino: “Akaba tapira okwa kogudo ui trigo a ra tuwure tabo du tabo” (Deut 25,4). Pao makoi awu inodu jitu tabo, tapiradoge ei rugadukana akoino?
source: Ica, Moisés o boe eroiagudu meture bapera tada. Tadare atugore oino: “Akaba tapira okwa kogudo ui trigo a ra tuwure tabo du tabo” (Deut 25,4). Pao makoi awu inodu jitu tabo, tapiradoge ei rugadukana akoino?

b: Kode, pai karega ure tagodo oino awu inoduji? U! Paire atugododure oino. Maragodureu maragodumode tubaga tabo makudumode pudaiboe bogai. Jamedu, ure a rawujewu upagamode makudumode pudaiboe bogai jamedu.
source: Kode, pai karega ure tagodo oino awu inoduji? U! Paire atugododure oino. Maragodureu maragodumode tubaga tabo makudumode pudaiboe bogai. Jamedu, ure a rawujewu upagamode makudumode pudaiboe bogai jamedu.

b: Kode, cere boe pemegareu tugu tadoda, du koia cebagamodukana tawo awu moto kejeboe iaboe maku cenai?
source: Kode, cere boe pemegareu tugu tadoda, du koia cebagamodukana tawo awu moto kejeboe iaboe maku cenai?

b: Iage eona nure nowu inoduji tai, kode cegi karega, cegodukare ekori nowu inoduji? Mare cekare cenodo nowu inoduce jii oino, cere ceiwa remagu boe jamedu boeji, cekawo Cristo o bakaru pemegareu redugodudo pudui du bogai.
source: Iage eona nure nowu inoduji tai, kode cegi karega, cegodukare ekori nowu inoduji? Mare cekare cenodo nowu inoduce jii oino, cere ceiwa remagu boe jamedu boeji, cekawo Cristo o bakaru pemegareu redugodudo pudui du bogai.

b: Taerduwakare cewu maragodure Pao uwai tadawuge eemode tumaragodui to du koia duji? Taerduwakare cewu maragodure altar kejewuge, nowu altar kejeboe ia rogu emode kowuje duji?
source: Taerduwakare cewu maragodure Pao uwai tadawuge eemode tumaragodui to du koia duji? Taerduwakare cewu maragodure altar kejewuge, nowu altar kejeboe ia rogu emode kowuje duji?

b: Du reorere Pagimejera akore: “Cewu ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge eemode koia.
source: Du reorere Pagimejera akore: “Cewu ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge eemode koia.

b: Mare du inodu tabo imago kigodukare imaragodae mori bogai. Itagemore iwia nure nowu inodu piji. Iaboe iaboe umodukare itawuje awu iroinodu piji.
source: Mare du inodu tabo imago kigodukare imaragodae mori bogai. Itagemore iwia nure nowu inodu piji. Iaboe iaboe umodukare itawuje awu iroinodu piji.

b: Ikare ikurido ii awu bataru pemegareu kogado du koia, mare imaragodae nure ema. Marenarumode imi ikai Pao o bakaru pemegareu kogado du keje.
source: Ikare ikurido ii awu bataru pemegareu kogado du koia, mare imaragodae nure ema. Marenarumode imi ikai Pao o bakaru pemegareu kogado du keje.

b: Iromode nowu inoduji itaidu pemegareu tabo ma, mori makudumode inai, mare iromode ji ikiari tabo ma, imaragodae nure tu rugadu.
source: Iromode nowu inoduji itaidu pemegareu tabo ma, mori makudumode inai, mare iromode ji ikiari tabo ma, imaragodae nure tu rugadu.

b: Kode kakoduboeba morimode ema inai? Morimode ema inaiboe reo: Inure bataru pemegareu kogado morikai inai du tabo, inogwamagudukai ionare jiboe makuduwo inai ii bataru pemegareu kogadodu morice du tabo.
source: Kode kakoduboeba morimode ema inai? Morimode ema inaiboe reo: Inure bataru pemegareu kogado morikai inai du tabo, inogwamagudukai ionare jiboe makuduwo inai ii bataru pemegareu kogadodu morice du tabo.

b: Iaboe iaboe etugare karega ure imi. Mare du inodu tabo ire boe eiamedu boe etugaredo imi, iwo makareuge einorudo.
source: Iaboe iaboe etugare karega ure imi. Mare du inodu tabo ire boe eiamedu boe etugaredo imi, iwo makareuge einorudo.

b: Imire judeudo imi judeudoge etai, iwo judeudoge einorudo. Imugukai boe eroiagudu kuda du tabo, ire imugudo boe eroiagudu kuda iwo mugure boe eroiagudu kudawuge einorudo.
source: Imire judeudo imi judeudoge etai, iwo judeudoge einorudo. Imugukai boe eroiagudu kuda du tabo, ire imugudo boe eroiagudu kuda iwo mugure boe eroiagudu kudawuge einorudo.

b: Mare du inodu tabo, ire ido nono imugukai Pao o boe eroiagudu kuda, iwo nowu metukare Pao ui boe eroiagudu jiwuge einorudo. Mare iroiagudu bokware, imugure Cristo ui boe eroiagudu kuda du kodi.
source: Mare du inodu tabo, ire ido nono imugukai Pao o boe eroiagudu kuda, iwo nowu metukare Pao ui boe eroiagudu jiwuge einorudo. Mare iroiagudu bokware, imugure Cristo ui boe eroiagudu kuda du kodi.

b: Ire ipewukado ii nono upewukai puduiwuge ereore, iwo upewukare puduiwuge einorudo. Ire boe jamedu boedo imi boe eiamedu boe etai, iwo boe eiamedu boe einorudo.
source: Ire ipewukado ii nono upewukai puduiwuge ereore, iwo upewukare puduiwuge einorudo. Ire boe jamedu boedo imi boe eiamedu boe etai, iwo boe eiamedu boe einorudo.

b: Nowu inodu jamedu boe irore ino, bataru pemegareu koia, ionawo ia roguji.
source: Nowu inodu jamedu boe irore ino, bataru pemegareu koia, ionawo ia roguji.

b: Taerduwakare cewu boe eregodui boe eregoduia kejedu, eiamedu boe eregodure, mare morimode aiwu umode mito tu jeduji? Kode, tarego ma, mori makuduwo tagai.
source: Taerduwakare cewu boe eregodui boe eregoduia kejedu, eiamedu boe eregodure, mare morimode aiwu umode mito tu jeduji? Kode, tarego ma, mori makuduwo tagai.

b: Boadu kigodure tuwoadae jiwuge ekigaruru kigodure pudui mare mori akedumodewu makuduwo pudai du bogai tu je; cegirema cegigarurure cei mori akedu bokwareboe makuduwo cenai du bogai.
source: Boadu kigodure tuwoadae jiwuge ekigaruru kigodure pudui mare mori akedumodewu makuduwo pudai du bogai tu je; cegirema cegigarurure cei mori akedu bokwareboe makuduwo cenai du bogai.

b: Kode, iregodumode, mare ia kaeboe kae rugadu. Ire ikera to, mare paga tu je karega.
source: Kode, iregodumode, mare ia kaeboe kae rugadu. Ire ikera to, mare paga tu je karega.

b: Ire iredu okorido, ire itugaredo ireduce, duma ikawo iwogwado boeto ii bataru pemegareu kogado iagei du tonaji.
source: Ire iredu okorido, ire itugaredo ireduce, duma ikawo iwogwado boeto ii bataru pemegareu kogado iagei du tonaji.

b: Boe eregoduwo turo pegareu piji, Pao uobe eregodu magai Egito piji du reore.
source: Boe eregoduwo turo pegareu piji, Pao uobe eregodu magai Egito piji du reore.

b: Iwiemage, itaidure taerduwa bokwawo awu inoduji: Paomage eiamedu boe epadure boe tugu kuda; eiamedu boe ere pagado pobo maereu kajeje.
source: Iwiemage, itaidure taerduwa bokwawo awu inoduji: Paomage eiamedu boe epadure boe tugu kuda; eiamedu boe ere pagado pobo maereu kajeje.

b: Eiamedu boe ere tubodo Moisés apo boetugu kuda pobo maereu tada.
source: Eiamedu boe ere tubodo Moisés apo boetugu kuda pobo maereu tada.

b: Eiamedu boe ere aroereu boe eke kowuje.
source: Eiamedu boe ere aroereu boe eke kowuje.

b: Eiamedu boe ekudure pobojari aroereu mitoduce puapo. Ekudure kodure ebowu ia aroereu ri pijiwu poce, duwure Cristo rema.
source: Eiamedu boe ekudure pobojari aroereu mitoduce puapo. Ekudure kodure ebowu ia aroereu ri pijiwu poce, duwure Cristo rema.

b: Nowu inodu jamedu boe tabo, makareuge ekare Pao jekaredo, du inodu koia ewire toro boe matadu keje.
source: Nowu inodu jamedu boe tabo, makareuge ekare Pao jekaredo, du inodu koia ewire toro boe matadu keje.

b: Awu inodu jamedu boe ure tudo oinono pagaiwowo inoduji, duma pagagemo kawo boe pegareuji, etagemo magai boe pegareu jitu reore.
source: Awu inodu jamedu boe ure tudo oinono pagaiwowo inoduji, duma pagagemo kawo boe pegareuji, etagemo magai boe pegareu jitu reore.

b: Tameartorukawo paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei ereore, nono bapera atugo reore: “Boe ere tumugudo togwagewo, tuguduwo, icare ere turagojedo tuiegare pegawo pudui” (x 32,6).
source: Tameartorukawo paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei ereore, nono bapera atugo reore: “Boe ere tumugudo togwagewo, tuguduwo, icare ere turagojedo tuiegare pegawo pudui” (x 32,6).

b: Pakawo pamagu pabegareu kai nono emagai tumagu tubegareu kai du reore, du koiare bireuge ere vinte e tres mil tu meri mitoduji.
source: Pakawo pamagu pabegareu kai nono emagai tumagu tubegareu kai du reore, du koiare bireuge ere vinte e tres mil tu meri mitoduji.

b: Parokogadodukawo Pagimejeraji nono ia emage erokogadodu magai jitu reore, dukoia awague ere ewido.
source: Parokogadodukawo Pagimejeraji nono ia emage erokogadodu magai jitu reore, dukoia awague ere ewido.

b: Tamago pega kaba Paoji nono ia emage emago pega magai Pao jitu reore, dukoia ure eeda kedodo, ure ewido.
source: Tamago pega kaba Paoji nono ia emage emago pega magai Pao jitu reore, dukoia ure eeda kedodo, ure ewido.

b: Nowu inodu jamedu boere oino, Pao okituwawo pai nowu inodu tabo. Nowu inodu jamedu boe atugododure paerduwadodu epace, icare pagaregodure oto pa kae kodi.
source: Nowu inodu jamedu boere oino, Pao okituwawo pai nowu inodu tabo. Nowu inodu jamedu boe atugododure paerduwadodu epace, icare pagaregodure oto pa kae kodi.

b: Kode, cewu meardaere turagoje kimoieuredu jiwu, meardu awadumode pudui, tuwudukawo.
source: Kode, cewu meardaere turagoje kimoieuredu jiwu, meardu awadumode pudui, tuwudukawo.

b: Boe erokogadodu kodui ime eraga koriwu aregodumodukare tai. Pao pemega remawu nure, umodukare rokogadodureboedo tai tabewu rakai tai du kori, mare rokogadodureboe umode tai, mare Pao umode tabewu rakado, taginorudoduwo nowu inodu piji.
source: Boe erokogadodu kodui ime eraga koriwu aregodumodukare tai. Pao pemega remawu nure, umodukare rokogadodureboedo tai tabewu rakai tai du kori, mare rokogadodureboe umode tai, mare Pao umode tabewu rakado, taginorudoduwo nowu inodu piji.

b: Du kodire, imeardu kurire jiwu iwiemage, tarego paga pagawu aroe eimejerage epiji.
source: Du kodire, imeardu kurire jiwu iwiemage, tarego paga pagawu aroe eimejerage epiji.

b: Oino imago nure jorduwareuge tai: tagi rugadure tamode taeku tugu awu inagoino jiboeto.
source: Oino imago nure jorduwareuge tai: tagi rugadure tamode taeku tugu awu inagoino jiboeto.

b: Cere bataru pemegareu kuo kejewu cálice toboe, du karega Cristo ku rema pagai? Cewu cere kadowu amireu, Pagimejera kodu karega ure ema pageje?
source: Cere bataru pemegareu kuo kejewu cálice toboe, du karega Cristo ku rema pagai? Cewu cere kadowu amireu, Pagimejera kodu karega ure ema pageje?

b: Amireu ure mito tu je, du koia pare mito tu je jamedu, pamaga inodu tabo, mare paga krega, pagogwagere amireu mito tu je duji.
source: Amireu ure mito tu je, du koia pare mito tu je jamedu, pamaga inodu tabo, mare paga krega, pagogwagere amireu mito tu je duji.

b: Tagaiwodo inoba boere awu moto kejewu Israeldoge ei duji: Enogwagere bitodureu barogo koduji altar keje, du koia epore altar tabo tuiamedu tabo jamedu.
source: Tagaiwodo inoba boere awu moto kejewu Israeldoge ei duji: Enogwagere bitodureu barogo koduji altar keje, du koia epore altar tabo tuiamedu tabo jamedu.

b: Mare inoba inagomode? Makududodure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaiboe boe karega ure ema. Paga pagau aroe eimejerage boe karega ure emage jamedu.
source: Mare inoba inagomode? Makududodure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etaiboe boe karega ure ema. Paga pagau aroe eimejerage boe karega ure emage jamedu.

b: Ao pegokareuge ere bitoboe maku Aroe pegareu  ai, mare Pao ai karega. Itaidukare tawo tabodo Aroe pegareu  apo.
source: Ao pegokareuge ere bitoboe maku Aroe pegareu  ai, mare Pao ai karega. Itaidukare tawo tabodo Aroe pegareu  apo.

b: Tagudumodukare pagimejera kuce  Aroe pegareuge eke kuru tabo. Tagogwagemodukare Pagimejera koduji,  Aroe pegareuge eke tabo.
source: Tagudumodukare pagimejera kuce  Aroe pegareuge eke kuru tabo. Tagogwagemodukare Pagimejera koduji,  Aroe pegareuge eke tabo.

b:
Cedaidukana ure cewo Pao imaredudo cewugeje? Cegikana cebewu rakare Pao kori?
Boe enogwagere jiboe jitu.
source:
Cedaidukana ure cewo Pao imaredudo cewugeje? Cegikana cebewu rakare Pao kori?
Boe enogwagere jiboe jitu.

b: Paroiwamode parowo boe jamedu boeji, mare boe jamedu karega ure turugadu. Paroiwamode parowo boe jamedu boeji, mare boe jamedu karega pemegare.
source: Paroiwamode parowo boe jamedu boeji, mare boe jamedu karega ure turugadu. Paroiwamode parowo boe jamedu boeji, mare boe jamedu karega pemegare.

b: Ia tagi ia tagi tagaiwokaba tagaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, mare tagaiwodo iage etaiwu boe pemegareu bogai.
source: Ia tagi ia tagi tagaiwokaba tagaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, mare tagaiwodo iage etaiwu boe pemegareu bogai.

b: Tagogwagedo boere akirodo tabo boe jameduji, mare tanorakaba kaboba.
source: Tagogwagedo boere akirodo tabo boe jameduji, mare tanorakaba kaboba.

b: Pagimejera ore awu motoce, ore moto kejeboe jamedu boece jamedu.
source: Pagimejera ore awu motoce, ore moto kejeboe jamedu boece jamedu.

b: Ia aopegokareuge egomode tagogwageiagu pudabo, tagaidumode taduwo etae ma, ere maku tagaiboe jamedu boe kowuje, mare tanorakaba kaboba.
source: Ia aopegokareuge egomode tagogwageiagu pudabo, tagaidumode taduwo etae ma, ere maku tagaiboe jamedu boe kowuje, mare tanorakaba kaboba.

b: Mare iaboe egomode oino: -  Awu makududodure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etai  oino du keje, tagaba ko, takawo nowu akoinowu butudo.
source: Mare iaboe egomode oino: -  Awu makududodure paga pagawu aroe eimejerage etai  oino du keje, tagaba ko, takawo nowu akoinowu butudo.

b: Mare aigoia karega, mare cewu koia. Paga karega, iage emeardae umodukare tugogado imeardaeji.
source: Mare aigoia karega, mare cewu koia. Paga karega, iage emeardae umodukare tugogado imeardaeji.

b: Imode kowuje, ii Pao ie kurido du tabo ma, kodiba boe emago pegamode ii, ii kowuje iegarei Pao jitu tabo?
source: Imode kowuje, ii Pao ie kurido du tabo ma, kodiba boe emago pegamode ii, ii kowuje iegarei Pao jitu tabo?

b: Ica, kode, tagogwagemode, tagudumode, taromode iaboe boeji du keje, tarodo jamedu boeji tawo Pao jekaredo. -
source: Ica, kode, tagogwagemode, tagudumode, taromode iaboe boeji du keje, tarodo jamedu boeji tawo Pao jekaredo. -

b: Tagaba aopegokareuge, judeudoge, Pao uwobe, etaora pegado.
source: Tagaba aopegokareuge, judeudoge, Pao uwobe, etaora pegado.

b: Tarodo nono iro reore: Boe jamedu boe keje iemarure iwo boe eiamedu boe eegaredo, iemarukare inaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, mare u makareuge etaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, ewo cinorudo.
source: Tarodo nono iro reore: Boe jamedu boe keje iemarure iwo boe eiamedu boe eegaredo, iemarukare inaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, mare u makareuge etaiwu boe pemegareu bogai, ewo cinorudo.

b: Aremei aroia bu taogajejedu.
source: Aremei aroia bu taogajejedu.

b: Tarodo nono iro reore, iro magai Cristo ro reore du reore.
source: Tarodo nono iro reore, iro magai Cristo ro reore du reore.

b: Iwiemage, iegarere tagabo, mare paga karega, boe jamedu boe keje tawia jeture ii, tagera otorogare ire toroiagu jiboe tabo, nono imagore jitu reore, du koia.
source: Iwiemage, iegarere tagabo, mare paga karega, boe jamedu boe keje tawia jeture ii, tagera otorogare ire toroiagu jiboe tabo, nono imagore jitu reore, du koia.

b: Mare itaidure taerduwawo awu inoduji: ime eiamedu boe etaorare Cristo rema. Aredu aorare imeduce. Cristo aorare Paoce.
source: Mare itaidure taerduwawo awu inoduji: ime eiamedu boe etaorare Cristo rema. Aredu aorare imeduce. Cristo aorare Paoce.

b: Cewu okwamagudure baruto Pao jiwu imedu, okituware boei, boe rorii taora jitu tabowu imedu, unure taora barigududo pudui.
source: Cewu okwamagudure baruto Pao jiwu imedu, okituware boei, boe rorii taora jitu tabowu imedu, unure taora barigududo pudui.

b: Cewu okwamagudure barutowu aredu, cewu okituware boeiwu aredu, tukai boe rorido taora joki du tabowudo, unure taora barigududo pudui jamedu, ure nono tuie ure tao ra du kodiwore.
source: Cewu okwamagudure barutowu aredu, cewu okituware boeiwu aredu, tukai boe rorido taora joki du tabowudo, unure taora barigududo pudui jamedu, ure nono tuie ure tao ra du kodiwore.

b: Mare ia aredu umodukare ia aroia arudugodu bu tao keje ma, umode tao rawuje. Boe epoguraemode aredui tao rawujedu iarema to biri cadodu ma, umode aroia arudugodu bu tao keje.
source: Mare ia aredu umodukare ia aroia arudugodu bu tao keje ma, umode tao rawuje. Boe epoguraemode aredui tao rawujedu iarema to biri cadodu ma, umode aroia arudugodu bu tao keje.

b: Imedurema umodukare boe bu taora keje, mare paga karega, ema Pao uredu rema du koia: Ema Pao jekareae nure ema. Mare aredurema, imedu jekareae nure ema.
source: Imedurema umodukare boe bu taora keje, mare paga karega, ema Pao uredu rema du koia: Ema Pao jekareae nure ema. Mare aredurema, imedu jekareae nure ema.

b: Paga karega, imedu tawujedukare aredu piji, mare aredu tawujedure imedu piji.
source: Paga karega, imedu tawujedukare aredu piji, mare aredu tawujedure imedu piji.

b: Jamedu imedu towujedukare aredu ai, mare aredu towujedure imedu ai.
source: Jamedu imedu towujedukare aredu ai, mare aredu towujedure imedu ai.

b: Du kodire aredu umode aroia bu taora keje, tupadoge eigoia.
source: Du kodire aredu umode aroia bu taora keje, tupadoge eigoia.

b: Nowu inodu jamedu boe tabo, imedu umodukare aredu boekimo tabo, aredu jamedu umodukare imedu boekimo tabo.
source: Nowu inodu jamedu boe tabo, imedu umodukare aredu boekimo tabo, aredu jamedu umodukare imedu boekimo tabo.

b: Mare paga karega, aredu tawujedure imedu piji, mare du inodu tabo, imedu boture aredu piji, ei pobedu aregodure Aroe Eimejera piji.
source: Mare paga karega, aredu tawujedure imedu piji, mare du inodu tabo, imedu boture aredu piji, ei pobedu aregodure Aroe Eimejera piji.

b: Tagi rugadu tamode tagogado nowu inoduji. Umode turugadu areduwo tumagowo Paoji aroia padukai taora keje du tabo?
source: Tagi rugadu tamode tagogado nowu inoduji. Umode turugadu areduwo tumagowo Paoji aroia padukai taora keje du tabo?

b: Jamedu imedu ao raimode tadoda ma, unure tuwarigodudo pudui, tagi taroiakare ema du kodi.
source: Jamedu imedu ao raimode tadoda ma, unure tuwarigodudo pudui, tagi taroiakare ema du kodi.

b: Awurema karega, aredu jekareaere tao rairedu rema, makudure ai nono ia aroia arudugodu reore kodi.
source: Awurema karega, aredu jekareaere tao rairedu rema, makudure ai nono ia aroia arudugodu reore kodi.

b:
Mare iaboe etaidumode nowu inoduwo tuginoi ma, mare ia ceroia karega; Pao uwobe ia eroia karega.
Pao uwobe enogwage pemegareu.
source:
Mare iaboe etaidumode nowu inoduwo tuginoi ma, mare ia ceroia karega; Pao uwobe ia eroia karega.
Pao uwobe enogwage pemegareu.

b: Oino inogituwamode tai, mare iegaremodukare tai, tare tado pui du kodiboe koia. Mare paga karega, nowu tare tado puidu ukare boe pemegareudo tai, mare unure boe pegareudo tai.
source: Oino inogituwamode tai, mare iegaremodukare tai, tare tado pui du kodiboe koia. Mare paga karega, nowu tare tado puidu ukare boe pemegareudo tai, mare unure boe pegareudo tai.

b: Imeardure ji boetojiboe ure oino: Tare tado pui du keje kuri je, tagorigodure pui. Iakeje imeartorure.
source: Imeardure ji boetojiboe ure oino: Tare tado pui du keje kuri je, tagorigodure pui. Iakeje imeartorure.

b: Ema remawure tamode tado puibiji tu je du rema, boe eerduwo kakoduwu pemegare tadoda.
source: Ema remawure tamode tado puibiji tu je du rema, boe eerduwo kakoduwu pemegare tadoda.

b: Oino tare tado pui, mare tagogwagewo Pagimejera koduji du bogai karega.
source: Oino tare tado pui, mare tagogwagewo Pagimejera koduji du bogai karega.

b: Mare paga karega, tare tamugudo iraji kuri je du keje, ia tagi akere tai tawo tageragu kuri ia tageji; nowu inodu tabo, ia tagi taguredure, ia tagi tage boire tai kimo.
source: Mare paga karega, tare tamugudo iraji kuri je du keje, ia tagi akere tai tawo tageragu kuri ia tageji; nowu inodu tabo, ia tagi taguredure, ia tagi tage boire tai kimo.

b: Kode, tawaikare tagogwagewo, taguduwo? Iarema tagaidure tawo Pao uwobe barigodudo pudui, tawo oroe bokwareuge epogurudo? Kode, inoba inagomode tai? Iegarekana umode tai? Boro, nowu inodu keje iegaremodukare tai.
source: Kode, tawaikare tagogwagewo, taguduwo? Iarema tagaidure tawo Pao uwobe barigodudo pudui, tawo oroe bokwareuge epogurudo? Kode, inoba inagomode tai? Iegarekana umode tai? Boro, nowu inodu keje iegaremodukare tai.

b: Pao pijire awu bakaru makudure inai dure icare ire maku tagai oino: Pagimejera Jesus, boe emode maku kejewu boecoji, ure tugeragu amireuji,
source: Pao pijire awu bakaru makudure inai dure icare ire maku tagai oino: Pagimejera Jesus, boe emode maku kejewu boecoji, ure tugeragu amireuji,

b: Ure tuwadaru pemegareu bu keje du tabore ure kado, akore: - Ica, ikodu reo, du makudumode tabaru tabo; oinore taromode, tawiabutuwo iwugeje.
source: Ure tuwadaru pemegareu bu keje du tabore ure kado, akore: - Ica, ikodu reo, du makudumode tabaru tabo; oinore taromode, tawiabutuwo iwugeje.

b: Du reorere, togwage akedu keje, ure tugeragu caliceji, akore: -Bakaru maiwu jiwu iku tabowu cálice reo. Tagudui tu tu ce du keje tawiabutudo iwugeje.
source: Du reorere, togwage akedu keje, ure tugeragu caliceji, akore: -Bakaru maiwu jiwu iku tabowu cálice reo. Tagudui tu tu ce du keje tawiabutudo iwugeje.

b: Kode tai awu amireu kowuje du keje, tagudui awu clice tadaboece du keje, tawiabutumode Pagimejerai tuiwodo duji, jii aregodumode mato pugeje du kae.
source: Kode tai awu amireu kowuje du keje, tagudui awu clice tadaboece du keje, tawiabutumode Pagimejerai tuiwodo duji, jii aregodumode mato pugeje du kae.

b: Kode, cewu  ure awu amireu kowuje, kudure awu cálice tadaboece, turo pega tabowu, ro pega nure Pagimejera koduji, kuji.
source: Kode, cewu  ure awu amireu kowuje, kudure awu cálice tadaboece, turo pega tabowu, ro pega nure Pagimejera koduji, kuji.

b: Taeku tugu tadodawu tameardae taerdae boeto, tamode awu amireu kowuje, tagudumode awu cálice tadaboece du otodai.
source: Taeku tugu tadodawu tameardae taerdae boeto, tamode awu amireu kowuje, tagudumode awu cálice tadaboece du otodai.

b: Cewu ure Pao kodu kowuje, kudure Pao kuce tubega tabowu, okwage nure, kudu nure tuiwo pegareuce.
source: Cewu ure Pao kodu kowuje, kudure Pao kuce tubega tabowu, okwage nure, kudu nure tuiwo pegareuce.

b: Du kodire kogodureuge, upewukare puduiwuge, bireuge emagaguragare tadoda.
source: Du kodire kogodureuge, upewukare puduiwuge, bireuge emagaguragare tadoda.

b: Pamode paeku tugu padodawu paerdae, pameardaeto ma, boe pegamodukare pai.
source: Pamode paeku tugu padodawu paerdae, pameardaeto ma, boe pegamodukare pai.

b: Mare Pao ure tugogado pai du keje, unure paedorodo, duma pawarigudukawo boe pegareuto awu moto tabo.
source: Mare Pao ure tugogado pai du keje, unure paedorodo, duma pawarigudukawo boe pegareuto awu moto tabo.

b: Du kodire. iwiemage, tamode tado pui tagogwage pemegareu kae du keje, tawudugugo pu bogai.
source: Du kodire. iwiemage, tamode tado pui tagogwage pemegareu kae du keje, tawudugugo pu bogai.

b: Ia tagi tage boimode tai ma, tagogwagedo tawai keje, nowu inodu tabo, tai tado puidu umodukare boe redugodudo tai. Itumode tawogai du keje, imagomode tai iaboe boeji pugeje.
source: Ia tagi tage boimode tai ma, tagogwagedo tawai keje, nowu inodu tabo, tai tado puidu umodukare boe redugodudo tai. Itumode tawogai du keje, imagomode tai iaboe boeji pugeje.

b: Aroe Pemegareu ui toroe awadu maku Pao uwobe etai tu tu jedu.
source: Aroe Pemegareu ui toroe awadu maku Pao uwobe etai tu tu jedu.

b: Iwiemage, itaidukare taerduwakawo Aroe Pemegareu emaboeji.
source: Iwiemage, itaidukare taerduwakawo Aroe Pemegareu emaboeji.

b: Tagi tagao pegokare du keje, tare boedo tarego bataru bokwareu aroe eimejerage etae, paga karega, oinore tamegire kaeboere kodi.
source: Tagi tagao pegokare du keje, tare boedo tarego bataru bokwareu aroe eimejerage etae, paga karega, oinore tamegire kaeboere kodi.

b: Kodire inagomode tai: Pao Utaroe koiare umode iaboe emagodo ma, mako pegamodukare Jesusji. Jamedu iaboe iaboe egomodukare Pagimejeraie Jesusce, mare tu Aroe Pemegareu koiare umode akomode oinowu akodo tu oino.
source: Kodire inagomode tai: Pao Utaroe koiare umode iaboe emagodo ma, mako pegamodukare Jesusji. Jamedu iaboe iaboe egomodukare Pagimejeraie Jesusce, mare tu Aroe Pemegareu koiare umode akomode oinowu akodo tu oino.

b: Aroe Pemegareu oe padure makaguragare pumekeje, mare Aroe Pemegareu remawu ure mito tu je.
source: Aroe Pemegareu oe padure makaguragare pumekeje, mare Aroe Pemegareu remawu ure mito tu je.

b: Boe epadu makaguragare turo tabo tu tu je, mare Pagimejerare mito tu je.
source: Boe epadu makaguragare turo tabo tu tu je, mare Pagimejerare mito tu je.

b: Paromode jiboe makaguragare jamedu, mare ure boe ero maku boe etaiwu Aroe Eimejerare mito tu je.
source: Paromode jiboe makaguragare jamedu, mare ure boe ero maku boe etaiwu Aroe Eimejerare mito tu je.

b: Aroe Pemegareu makudure tu tu boe etai boe pemegareuwo boe eiamedu jitu bogai.
source: Aroe Pemegareu makudure tu tu boe etai boe pemegareuwo boe eiamedu jitu bogai.

b: Ia ai, Aroe Pemegareu ure bataru iwareu maku; ia ai, ure jorduwa rakareboe maku.
source: Ia ai, Aroe Pemegareu ure bataru iwareu maku; ia ai, ure jorduwa rakareboe maku.

b: Ia ai, ure meartoru rakareboe maku; ia ai, ure jorduware ciogowo boeiboe maku.
source: Ia ai, ure meartoru rakareboe maku; ia ai, ure jorduware ciogowo boeiboe maku.

b: Ia ai, ure ro kurireu pemegareu towujedu maku; ure ia makodo umode tudowuje boeji; ure ia jorduwado aroedogei; ure ia jorduwado boe ewadaru padui pumekejedu boeji; ure ia jorduwado tuwo boe ewadaru tawuje pu bataru kae.
source: Ia ai, ure ro kurireu pemegareu towujedu maku; ure ia makodo umode tudowuje boeji; ure ia jorduwado aroedogei; ure ia jorduwado boe ewadaru padui pumekejedu boeji; ure ia jorduwado tuwo boe ewadaru tawuje pu bataru kae.

b: Mare Aroe Pemegareure mito tu je du koiare ure nowu inodu pedo nowu boe eiamedu boe etai, nono taidu reore.
source: Mare Aroe Pemegareure mito tu je du koiare ure nowu inodu pedo nowu boe eiamedu boe etai, nono taidu reore.

b: Imedu burere, ierare, aorare, jokure, biajare; mare uredu mito tu je. Du reorere Cristore.
source: Imedu burere, ierare, aorare, jokure, biajare; mare uredu mito tu je. Du reorere Cristore.

b: Judeudoge, gregodoge, boe etugarege, boe eimejerage, paiamedu boe pagao pegododure Aroe Pemegareu mitodu tada, duma paiamedu boe pawo mito tu je. Paiamedu boe pagudure Aroe mitoduce.
source: Judeudoge, gregodoge, boe etugarege, boe eimejerage, paiamedu boe pagao pegododure Aroe Pemegareu mitodu tada, duma paiamedu boe pawo mito tu je. Paiamedu boe pagudure Aroe mitoduce.

b: Boe eredu makare tuwure tabo, tugera tabo, tuioku tabo, tuwiaja tabo oino tu tu.
source: Boe eredu makare tuwure tabo, tugera tabo, tuioku tabo, tuwiaja tabo oino tu tu.

b: Mare boe ewure akomode boe ekera kaeie ure pudumi du koiaie boe eredukae pudumi ma, du kodi kana boe eredukare ema?
source: Mare boe ewure akomode boe ekera kaeie ure pudumi du koiaie boe eredukae pudumi ma, du kodi kana boe eredukare ema?

b: Jamedu boe ewia akomode: - Boe eeku karega ure imi  oino ma, kode, du kodi kana boe eredumodukare ema?
source: Jamedu boe ewia akomode: - Boe eeku karega ure imi  oino ma, kode, du kodi kana boe eredumodukare ema?

b: Kode, boe eredu umode tuiokuce mito tu je ma, kode kaiba boe ewia jetumode? Jamedu boe eredu jamedu umode tu boe ewia ma, kode, kaiba boe ekeno jetumode?
source: Kode, boe eredu umode tuiokuce mito tu je ma, kode kaiba boe ewia jetumode? Jamedu boe eredu jamedu umode tu boe ewia ma, kode, kaiba boe ekeno jetumode?

b: Mare Pao ure boe eredu towuje, ure boe eredu pemegado tu taidu reore.
source: Mare Pao ure boe eredu towuje, ure boe eredu pemegado tu taidu reore.

b: Boe ewuremode mitotu tuginoi, boe ekeramode mitotu tuginoi ma, kaiba boe eredu mugumode?
source: Boe ewuremode mitotu tuginoi, boe ekeramode mitotu tuginoi ma, kaiba boe eredu mugumode?

b: Du kodire boe ewure, boe ekera, boe eeku, boe ekeno, boe ewia, ia pugeje, ere tuginoi tu tu je, mare ere etodui puidu ere boe eredudo mito tu je.
source: Du kodire boe ewure, boe ekera, boe eeku, boe ekeno, boe ewia, ia pugeje, ere tuginoi tu tu je, mare ere etodui puidu ere boe eredudo mito tu je.
