b: Boekimorema, Aroe pegareure tudawuje Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji, tuiogwari kuricigo tabo. Jamedu meru bokwareu, pogora bokwareu makareuge epemegagodure jamedu.
source: Boekimorema, Aroe pegareure tudawuje Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji, tuiogwari kuricigo tabo. Jamedu meru bokwareu, pogora bokwareu makareuge epemegagodure jamedu.

b:
Du kodi icare boe eegare kuricigore nowu bakurireu tada.
Bari Simão.
source:
Du kodi icare boe eegare kuricigore nowu bakurireu tada.
Bari Simão.

b: Nonore ia imedu iei Simão cedu, mugure nono, dure turo rakareu to to bakurireu tada, du koiare Samaria kejewuge eebogodure roji, du ure nono ia bari ro rakareure.
source: Nonore ia imedu iei Simão cedu, mugure nono, dure turo rakareu to to bakurireu tada, du koiare Samaria kejewuge eebogodure roji, du ure nono ia bari ro rakareure.

b: Biegareuge, ricoreuge eiamedu boe ewiapagare ji, egore: - Awu imedu ure nono Aroe Eimejera iei Kuirireu cedu ro rakareboere.
source: Biegareuge, ricoreuge eiamedu boe ewiapagare ji, egore: - Awu imedu ure nono Aroe Eimejera iei Kuirireu cedu ro rakareboere.

b: Emeartorure ji, paga karega, marigudu ure eekuri paga pagado turoi bidugudugu jitu tabo eegai.
source: Emeartorure ji, paga karega, marigudu ure eekuri paga pagado turoi bidugudugu jitu tabo eegai.

b: Mare emeardure Filipe makoi Pao o boe pemegareuji, Jesus Cristo akaruji, du rekodajire icare emeartorure bataruji, icare ime, arema, etaidure tuwo tao pegodo.
source: Mare emeardure Filipe makoi Pao o boe pemegareuji, Jesus Cristo akaruji, du rekodajire icare emeartorure bataruji, icare ime, arema, etaidure tuwo tao pegodo.

b: Icare nowu Simão jamedu meartorure, icare ao pegododure. Icare ukare tuiaedo Filipeji, tuiebogodui ro pemegareu, ro kurireu makareuji.
source: Icare nowu Simão jamedu meartorure, icare ao pegododure. Icare ukare tuiaedo Filipeji, tuiebogodui ro pemegareu, ro kurireu makareuji.

b: Apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tadadu, emeardure Samaria kejewuge ei tugeragu Pao bataru jituji, icare ere Pedro mare João etudo toro etae.
source: Apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tadadu, emeardure Samaria kejewuge ei tugeragu Pao bataru jituji, icare ere Pedro mare João etudo toro etae.

b: Awuge etaregodure toro du kejere icare enogwamagudure Paoji nowu meartorure maiwuge eparu tabo, Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.
source: Awuge etaregodure toro du kejere icare enogwamagudure Paoji nowu meartorure maiwuge eparu tabo, Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.

b: Awurema karega, nowu du kodi Aroe Pemegareu makudukare ia etai ia etai roga, mare etao pegododure Jesus ie tabo tu je.
source: Awurema karega, nowu du kodi Aroe Pemegareu makudukare ia etai ia etai roga, mare etao pegododure Jesus ie tabo tu je.

b: Du kodi icare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu ere tugera bu etaora keje Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai du bogai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu ere tugera bu etaora keje Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai du bogai.

b: Icare cewu Simão jordure Aroe Pemegareu makudui etai Apostolodoge ei tugera bu etaora keje du tabo duji, icare akore tumoduie diiero maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: -
source: Icare cewu Simão jordure Aroe Pemegareu makudui etai Apostolodoge ei tugera bu etaora keje du tabo duji, icare akore tumoduie diiero maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: -

b: Awu taro raka maku inai jamedu ma, imode ikera bu aora kejewu jamedu boe Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.
source: Awu taro raka maku inai jamedu ma, imode ikera bu aora kejewu jamedu boe Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.

b: Icare Pedro akore bataru jipagi: - Ako diiero okwawo pi tuku akabo, ameardaere Pao o boe pemegareu akomoduie diiero morice du koia.
source: Icare Pedro akore bataru jipagi: - Ako diiero okwawo pi tuku akabo, ameardaere Pao o boe pemegareu akomoduie diiero morice du koia.

b: Awu Pao maragodae ia koborogu makudukare akai rugadu, paga karega, awabo rorogodure Pao jekai kodi.
source: Awu Pao maragodae ia koborogu makudukare akai rugadu, paga karega, awabo rorogodure Pao jekai kodi.

b: Akodorogado ai awu aro pegareuji, akogwamagududo Paoji, boe jokodu kare kare, awu aro pegareu okwawo.
source: Akodorogado ai awu aro pegareuji, akogwamagududo Paoji, boe jokodu kare kare, awu aro pegareu okwawo.

b: Mare paga karega, itaiwo nure ai, jirireboe kuricigoreu tadare amugure, boe pegareu ure akogudo.
source: Mare paga karega, itaiwo nure ai, jirireboe kuricigoreu tadare amugure, boe pegareu ure akogudo.

b: Icare nowu Simão akore: - Tagogwamagududo Paoji iparu tabo ma, tamagore jiboe iaboe iaboe ekawo tudowuje ii.
source: Icare nowu Simão akore: - Tagogwamagududo Paoji iparu tabo ma, tamagore jiboe iaboe iaboe ekawo tudowuje ii.

b:
Icare apostolodoge ereadodure Pao bataruji, tui tuiodo keje turo pemegareu tabo du tabo, du keje icare ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Ere Pao bataru kogado Samaria kejewuge eno moto kao.
Etiópia kejewuge eimejerago utugare kurireu.
source:
Icare apostolodoge ereadodure Pao bataruji, tui tuiodo keje turo pemegareu tabo du tabo, du keje icare ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Ere Pao bataru kogado Samaria kejewuge eno moto kao.
Etiópia kejewuge eimejerago utugare kurireu.

b: Icare Pao o tupa aregodure Filipe ae, akore ji: - Aragojedo, atudo woje cebegi, ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu nowu moto biororeu iei Gaza cedu kaewu awaraji.
source: Icare Pao o tupa aregodure Filipe ae, akore ji: - Aragojedo, atudo woje cebegi, ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu nowu moto biororeu iei Gaza cedu kaewu awaraji.

b: Icare Filipe ure turagojedo, uture toro. Boekarema, ia Etiopia kejewu ia eunuco imedu, duwure Etiopia kejewuge eimejerago iei Candace cedu utugare kurireu rema, jeture oroe jamedu boeji, du uture Jerusalemto togwamaguduwo Pao uwai tada.
source: Icare Filipe ure turagojedo, uture toro. Boekarema, ia Etiopia kejewu ia eunuco imedu, duwure Etiopia kejewuge eimejerago iei Candace cedu utugare kurireu rema, jeture oroe jamedu boeji, du uture Jerusalemto togwamaguduwo Pao uwai tada.

b: Icarema unure tugirimi to imaridoreu tabo, du tabore makore profeta Isaias o baperaji.
source: Icarema unure tugirimi to imaridoreu tabo, du tabore makore profeta Isaias o baperaji.

b: Icare Aroe Pemegareu makore Filipeji, akore: - Apuredu pemegado nowu imaridoreuji.
source: Icare Aroe Pemegareu makore Filipeji, akore: - Apuredu pemegado nowu imaridoreuji.

b: Icare Filipe ure tuburedo ji, meardure cewu eunuco makoi profeta Isaias o bapera 1atugoji. Icare unorare ji akore: - Are boe pa amagoi bapera jituji? Aerduware ji?
source: Icare Filipe ure tuburedo ji, meardure cewu eunuco makoi profeta Isaias o bapera 1atugoji. Icare unorare ji akore: - Are boe pa amagoi bapera jituji? Aerduware ji?

b: Akore: - Inoba iorduwamode, boekai inodu kogado iwiegai du tabo?  Icare makore Filipeji rutuwo uwo tumugudo tumegi.
source: Akore: - Inoba iorduwamode, boekai inodu kogado iwiegai du tabo?  Icare makore Filipeji rutuwo uwo tumugudo tumegi.

b: Boekare, padure bapera kejeboe reo: “Ere reko bitoduwo umagai ia barogo rogu ureore, umagai mako bokwareu ia cordeiro rogu du ere bu rogu kado du reore, du reorere ukare togwa jado.
source: Boekare, padure bapera kejeboe reo: “Ere reko bitoduwo umagai ia barogo rogu ureore, umagai mako bokwareu ia cordeiro rogu du ere bu rogu kado du reore, du reorere ukare togwa jado.

b: Ure tuwiegado du koiare ere pegado, Ioguduba umode ore eremagu? Paga karega bimode du kodi”. (Is 53,7s).
source: Ure tuwiegado du koiare ere pegado, Ioguduba umode ore eremagu? Paga karega bimode du kodi”. (Is 53,7s).

b: Icare nowu eunuco akore Filipeji: - Areadodudo iwiegai ioguduba jiba profeta akoino? pudumi na? ia tumeduiaji na?
source: Icare nowu eunuco akore Filipeji: - Areadodudo iwiegai ioguduba jiba profeta akoino? pudumi na? ia tumeduiaji na?

b: Du kodi icare readodure. Ure tuwadaru paru tawuje nowu padure bapera kejewu bataru piji, icare readodure biegai Jesus jiboeji.
source: Du kodi icare readodure. Ure tuwadaru paru tawuje nowu padure bapera kejewu bataru piji, icare readodure biegai Jesus jiboeji.

b: Eture todobiji, du tabore etaregodure ia pobo ja kae, icare nowu eunuco akore: - Pobo reo. Kodiba umodukare turugadu itao pegododuwo?
source: Eture todobiji, du tabore etaregodure ia pobo ja kae, icare nowu eunuco akore: - Pobo reo. Kodiba umodukare turugadu itao pegododuwo?

b: Icare Filipe akore: - Ameartorumode awabo jamedu tabo du keje, umode turugadu. Icare akore: - Imeartorure Pao Onaregedui Jesus Cristo ceduji.
source: Icare Filipe akore: - Ameartorumode awabo jamedu tabo du keje, umode turugadu. Icare akore: - Imeartorure Pao Onaregedui Jesus Cristo ceduji.

b: Ure imaridoreu buredo, icare ei pobedu ere turawuje pobo kae, icare Filipere nowu eunuco ao pegodo tu je.
source: Ure imaridoreu buredo, icare ei pobedu ere turawuje pobo kae, icare Filipere nowu eunuco ao pegodo tu je.

b: Ere tudawuje pobo piji kuri je du kejere icare Pao o Aroe Pemegareu ure tugeragu Filipeji pi tuku toro eunuco joku piji. Icare nowu eunuco uture todobiji tadawaraji, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.
source: Ere tudawuje pobo piji kuri je du kejere icare Pao o Aroe Pemegareu ure tugeragu Filipeji pi tuku toro eunuco joku piji. Icare nowu eunuco uture todobiji tadawaraji, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.

b:
Du tonajire Filipe rekodudodure Azoto kae. Icare uture toro kujebiji, ure Pao bataru kogado bakurireuge eiamedu tada, jii taregodui Cesaréia moto kae du kae




. Saulo meartorui Pagimejera bataru jidu.
source:
Du tonajire Filipe rekodudodure Azoto kae. Icare uture toro kujebiji, ure Pao bataru kogado bakurireuge eiamedu tada, jii taregodui Cesaréia moto kae du kae




. Saulo meartorui Pagimejera bataru jidu.

b: Icare Pedro ure tugera raido iera kae, ure turagojedo. Icare makore tuwiemage ewogai, nowu ukoge bokwareuge ewogai jamedu, ure maku etai jewodu tabo.
source: Icare Pedro ure tugera raido iera kae, ure turagojedo. Icare makore tuwiemage ewogai, nowu ukoge bokwareuge ewogai jamedu, ure maku etai jewodu tabo.

b: Awu akaru ure tumaedo Jope jameduji, du kodi icare makareuge emeartorure Paoji.
source: Awu akaru ure tumaedo Jope jameduji, du kodi icare makareuge emeartorure Paoji.

b: Pedro mugure Jope tada meri makaguragare, ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada.
source: Pedro mugure Jope tada meri makaguragare, ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada.

b: Judeukare emawu meartorure Pagimejeraji boetojiwu ia tugobaigarege eimejera iei Cornlio cedu.
source: Judeukare emawu meartorure Pagimejeraji boetojiwu ia tugobaigarege eimejera iei Cornlio cedu.

b: Nowu du kodi ia imedu iei Cornélio cedu, mugure Cesaréia keje, duwure ia Itália pijiwu tugobaigarege eimejera nure ema,
source: Nowu du kodi ia imedu iei Cornélio cedu, mugure Cesaréia keje, duwure ia Itália pijiwu tugobaigarege eimejera nure ema,

b: Rore nono Pao aidu reore. Meartorure Paoji tuwobe eiamedu tabo. Ure toroe maku makudu kuricigodo marenarue etai, okwamagudure jii je Paoji.
source: Rore nono Pao aidu reore. Meartorure Paoji tuwobe eiamedu tabo. Ure toroe maku makudu kuricigodo marenarue etai, okwamagudure jii je Paoji.

b: Ia meri keje, meri jogodu tabo, awu imedu jordu awadure ia Pao o tupai tuburedo pudui duji, akoi: - Cornélio, Cornélio. oino pudui duji.
source: Ia meri keje, meri jogodu tabo, awu imedu jordu awadure ia Pao o tupai tuburedo pudui duji, akoi: - Cornélio, Cornélio. oino pudui duji.

b: Icare Cornélio ure tuioku kidudo ji tubagudui ce du tabo, akore: - Kaboba, Ikimejera?  Nowu Pao o tupa akore: - Akogwamagudure bogaiboe, are maku marenarue etaiboe, aregodure Pao jekai du kodire biapagare ai.
source: Icare Cornélio ure tuioku kidudo ji tubagudui ce du tabo, akore: - Kaboba, Ikimejera?  Nowu Pao o tupa akore: - Akogwamagudure bogaiboe, are maku marenarue etaiboe, aregodure Pao jekai du kodire biapagare ai.

b: Du kodire amode ia ime etudo Jope bakurireu kae, emagowo ia imedu iere Simão cedu bogai, du ie bio Pedro rema, utuwo mato.
source: Du kodire amode ia ime etudo Jope bakurireu kae, emagowo ia imedu iere Simão cedu bogai, du ie bio Pedro rema, utuwo mato.

b: Emare mugure ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada. Uwai mugure pobo maereu okwai.
source: Emare mugure ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada. Uwai mugure pobo maereu okwai.

b: Icare Pao o tupa uture piji du kejere, makore tudugarege ei pobedu ewogai, makore ia tugobaigare mugure pudabowu, meartorure Pao jiwu bogai.
source: Icare Pao o tupa uture piji du kejere, makore tudugarege ei pobedu ewogai, makore ia tugobaigare mugure pudabowu, meartorure Pao jiwu bogai.

b:
Icare readodure ewiegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boeji, icare ure etudo Jope bakurireu kae.
Pedro jordure jiboe.
source:
Icare readodure ewiegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boeji, icare ure etudo Jope bakurireu kae.
Pedro jordure jiboe.

b: Nowu meri rekodaji, emeru kimoi puredu tu nowu bakurireu jitu tonaji, meri pagaia keje, Pedro ruture bai ao boareu kae tuwo togwa kurido.
source: Nowu meri rekodaji, emeru kimoi puredu tu nowu bakurireu jitu tonaji, meri pagaia keje, Pedro ruture bai ao boareu kae tuwo togwa kurido.

b: Icare uke boire ji, icare aidure togwagewo. Mare ere uke pemegado du tonaji, ure tunuiao pemegado taci je.
source: Icare uke boire ji, icare aidure togwagewo. Mare ere uke pemegado du tonaji, ure tunuiao pemegado taci je.

b: Icare jordure barui tuiado duji, iaboe ure nono ia aroia kurireu ui turawuje baru piji moto kae, oto kogure pobe puibiji duji.
source: Icare jordure barui tuiado duji, iaboe ure nono ia aroia kurireu ui turawuje baru piji moto kae, oto kogure pobe puibiji duji.

b: Nowu aroia tadare barege eiamedu, kiege eiamedu, awague eiamedu meture tada.
source: Nowu aroia tadare barege eiamedu, kiege eiamedu, awague eiamedu meture tada.

b: Icare iaboe emagore ji: - Pedro, aragojedo, awo bito, awo kowuje.
source: Icare iaboe emagore ji: - Pedro, aragojedo, awo bito, awo kowuje.

b: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukare ino, Ikimejera! Ikare boe pegareu kowuje jii je rugadu.
source: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukare ino, Ikimejera! Ikare boe pegareu kowuje jii je rugadu.

b: Icare nowu boe emago akore ji pugeje: - Amago pega kaba Paore pemegado boeji, akagokaba pegaie.
source: Icare nowu boe emago akore ji pugeje: - Amago pega kaba Paore pemegado boeji, akagokaba pegaie.

b: Awu inodure tuguwo pobe pugeje. Du kejere nowu aroia kurireu todure baruto pugeje.
source: Awu inodure tuguwo pobe pugeje. Du kejere nowu aroia kurireu todure baruto pugeje.

b: Pedrore tumeardaedo nowu jordure jiboeji, kabobao? Du tonajire icare nowu Corneliore etudo torowu ime eragojere baiporo keje tuiemarui Simão uwai bogai.
source: Pedrore tumeardaedo nowu jordure jiboeji, kabobao? Du tonajire icare nowu Corneliore etudo torowu ime eragojere baiporo keje tuiemarui Simão uwai bogai.

b: Ere tugera to baiporoji, enorare boei Simão iei Pedro cedu mugu rakuduie nono du bogai.
source: Ere tugera to baiporoji, enorare boei Simão iei Pedro cedu mugu rakuduie nono du bogai.

b: Pedro meardu nure tuiordure jiboeji du tonajire icare Aroe Pemegareu akore ji: - Ica, imei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu eemaru nure awogai, duwuge emugure nono.
source: Pedro meardu nure tuiordure jiboeji du tonajire icare Aroe Pemegareu akore ji: - Ica, imei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu eemaru nure awogai, duwuge emugure nono.

b: Aragojedo, arawuje, atudo ebo apagudu bokwa tabo, inure etudo mato awogai du kodi.
source: Aragojedo, arawuje, atudo ebo apagudu bokwa tabo, inure etudo mato awogai du kodi.

b: Icare Pedrore turawuje, jordure nowu imei, icare akore ei: - Imireo. Taemarure bogaiwu imireo. Kaboba bogaiba taroino?
source: Icare Pedrore turawuje, jordure nowu imei, icare akore ei: - Imireo. Taemarure bogaiwu imireo. Kaboba bogaiba taroino?

b: Icare egore: - Tugobaigarege eimejera Cornélio, imedu pemegareu, meartorure Pao jiwu, duwure judeudoge eiamedu jordu pemegare ji, emare jordure Pao ia o tupaji, duwure akore ji makoiagu awogai, mearduwo awadaruji.
source: Icare egore: - Tugobaigarege eimejera Cornélio, imedu pemegareu, meartorure Pao jiwu, duwure judeudoge eiamedu jordu pemegare ji, emare jordure Pao ia o tupaji, duwure akore ji makoiagu awogai, mearduwo awadaruji.

b:
Icare Pedro makore ei ewo turemo. Icare ure emugudo tuwai tada, enuduwo nono. Barogwatore icare uture ebo, ia Jope kejewu uwiemage ebo jamedu.
Pedro rakojei Cesaréia kejedu.
source:
Icare Pedro makore ei ewo turemo. Icare ure emugudo tuwai tada, enuduwo nono. Barogwatore icare uture ebo, ia Jope kejewu uwiemage ebo jamedu.
Pedro rakojei Cesaréia kejedu.

b: Nowu meri rekodajire icare etaregodure Cesaréia kae. Nowu Cornélio upaga nure ewogai. Makore tuwobei, makore tumeardu kurire jiwu tumedagei, ure ewie, du kodire emugure uwai tada tubaga tabo ewogai.
source: Nowu meri rekodajire icare etaregodure Cesaréia kae. Nowu Cornélio upaga nure ewogai. Makore tuwobei, makore tumeardu kurire jiwu tumedagei, ure ewie, du kodire emugure uwai tada tubaga tabo ewogai.

b: Pedrore tuiagu turemo du kejere Cornélio ure tudawuje tuwo tugeragu ji, icare ure tubujodo Pedro bure paru tuwo tubujodo ji.
source: Pedrore tuiagu turemo du kejere Cornélio ure tudawuje tuwo tugeragu ji, icare ure tubujodo Pedro bure paru tuwo tubujodo ji.

b: Boekimorema, Pedrore rakojedo taci je, akore ji: - Pao Kurireu karega ure imi, imedu nure imi jamedu, aragojedo.
source: Boekimorema, Pedrore rakojedo taci je, akore ji: - Pao Kurireu karega ure imi, imedu nure imi jamedu, aragojedo.

b: Icare, makoi jitu tabore icare, Pedrore turemo uwaito, jordure boe makareuge eedui nonoduji, akore ei: -
source: Icare, makoi jitu tabore icare, Pedrore turemo uwaito, jordure boe makareuge eedui nonoduji, akore ei: -

b: Taerduware ukae turugadu ia judeu uwo tumeduiado ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu imeduji, iarema uwo turemo uwaito, macare Paore iorduwado ukae turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewarigu cebiji.
source: Taerduware ukae turugadu ia judeu uwo tumeduiado ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu imeduji, iarema uwo turemo uwaito, macare Paore iorduwado ukae turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewarigu cebiji.

b: Du kodire itaregodure mato kuri je, boe emagore iwogai du keje. Kode, kodiba tagagoino iwogai?
source: Du kodire itaregodure mato kuri je, boe emagore iwogai du keje. Kode, kodiba tagagoino iwogai?

b: Icare Cornélio akore ji: - Merire pobe puibiji du otodaire, imugure iwai tada imagoi Pao jitu tabo, meri jogodu tabo, du tonajire icare ia aroia kigadureu meture jiwu imedu ure towadudo iegai, akore ii:
source: Icare Cornélio akore ji: - Merire pobe puibiji du otodaire, imugure iwai tada imagoi Pao jitu tabo, meri jogodu tabo, du tonajire icare ia aroia kigadureu meture jiwu imedu ure towadudo iegai, akore ii:

b: Cornélio, akogwamagudure bogaiboe aregodure Pao ae, Pao biabuture are maku marenarue etaiboe bukeje.
source: Cornélio, akogwamagudure bogaiboe aregodure Pao ae, Pao biabuture are maku marenarue etaiboe bukeje.

b: Du kodi icare amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae, makowo ia Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai, utuwo mato. Mugure ia barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu uwai tada, pobo maereu okwai.
source: Du kodi icare amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae, makowo ia Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai, utuwo mato. Mugure ia barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu uwai tada, pobo maereu okwai.

b: Du kodi icare ire boedo tumagowo awogai kuri je, atuwo mato, icare iegarere atui mato duji. Oinore icare, cegireo cedui pui Pao jekai, cemearduwo Paore amagodo cewiegaiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Du kodi icare ire boedo tumagowo awogai kuri je, atuwo mato, icare iegarere atui mato duji. Oinore icare, cegireo cedui pui Pao jekai, cemearduwo Paore amagodo cewiegaiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Icare Pedrore tuwadaru parudo, akore: - Boe jokodu iorduware Pao ukae iaboe iaboe kurido iaboe biegado pugori duji.
source: Icare Pedrore tuwadaru parudo, akore: - Boe jokodu iorduware Pao ukae iaboe iaboe kurido iaboe biegado pugori duji.

b: Mare boe eeda jamedu boe keje aidu pemegare meartorure jiwugei, ro pemegareuge eiamedu boeji.
source: Mare boe eeda jamedu boe keje aidu pemegare meartorure jiwugei, ro pemegareuge eiamedu boeji.

b: Paore tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etae, ure boe pemegareu, boe butugureu readodudo ewiegai Jesus Cristo okwabiji, dure boe eiamedu boe eimejera nure ema.
source: Paore tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etae, ure boe pemegareu, boe butugureu readodudo ewiegai Jesus Cristo okwabiji, dure boe eiamedu boe eimejera nure ema.

b: Taerduware awu jamedu boe ui tudowuje Judéia keje, tui paru tugu Galiléia piji, João o boe etaimodu rekodaji.
source: Taerduware awu jamedu boe ui tudowuje Judéia keje, tui paru tugu Galiléia piji, João o boe etaimodu rekodaji.

b: Taerduware Paoi Jesus Nazaré kejewu kurido Aroe Pemegareu tabo, turo raka tabo duji, du koiare ro pemegare, ure Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epemegago, Pao mugure apo du koia.
source: Taerduware Paoi Jesus Nazaré kejewu kurido Aroe Pemegareu tabo, turo raka tabo duji, du koiare ro pemegare, ure Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epemegago, Pao mugure apo du koia.

b: Cegire ceerdure, cereadodure, ure towuje Judéia keje boeji, Jerusalém tada boeji. Du kejere ere bito, ere tugu i padui pugajejedu keje.
source: Cegire ceerdure, cereadodure, ure towuje Judéia keje boeji, Jerusalém tada boeji. Du kejere ere bito, ere tugu i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Mare Paore jewodudo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, ure udo towadudo.
source: Mare Paore jewodudo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, ure udo towadudo.

b: Mare eiamedu eegai karega, mare tu Pao aidure jiwuge eegai, ceegai, duwuge cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo, jewoduredu rekodaji.
source: Mare eiamedu eegai karega, mare tu Pao aidure jiwuge eegai, ceegai, duwuge cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo, jewoduredu rekodaji.

b: Ure cemagodo tuwadaruji boe etae, ure cereadodu pemegado Pudumie Paore jereuge, bireuge eimejerado Pudumi duji.
source: Ure cemagodo tuwadaruji boe etae, ure cereadodu pemegado Pudumie Paore jereuge, bireuge eimejerado Pudumi duji.

b: Jire profetadoge eiamedu emagore meartorumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegareu okwadodumoduie ie tabo.
source: Jire profetadoge eiamedu emagore meartorumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegareu okwadodumoduie ie tabo.

b: Boekarema, Pedro akoinodu tonaji, Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje meardure bataru pemegareu jiwuge eiamedu boe ewugeje.
source: Boekarema, Pedro akoinodu tonaji, Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje meardure bataru pemegareu jiwuge eiamedu boe ewugeje.

b: Aregodure Pedro apowu meartorureu judeudoge eebogodu kuricigore tuiordui Aroe Pemegareu o boe pemegareu ui turorido biri kadodukareuge ewugeje jamedu jituji.
source: Aregodure Pedro apowu meartorureu judeudoge eebogodu kuricigore tuiordui Aroe Pemegareu o boe pemegareu ui turorido biri kadodukareuge ewugeje jamedu jituji.

b: Emeardure emagoi ia boe ewadaru tuginoiwu jituji, ei Pao kurido duji.
source: Emeardure emagoi ia boe ewadaru tuginoiwu jituji, ei Pao kurido duji.

b: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukana turugadu awuge etao pegododuwo? Awurema karega, Aroe Pemegareu makudure etai ui nono makudure cenai du reore.
source: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukana turugadu awuge etao pegododuwo? Awurema karega, Aroe Pemegareu makudure etai ui nono makudure cenai du reore.

b: Icare ure boedo etao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo. Du kodi icare enogwamagudure ji emuguwo pudabo biegatu kimo.
source: Icare ure boedo etao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo. Du kodi icare enogwamagudure ji emuguwo pudabo biegatu kimo.

b: Pedro ui tuwiemage Jerusalém kejewuge edo boe pa turoinoduji.
source: Pedro ui tuwiemage Jerusalém kejewuge edo boe pa turoinoduji.

b: Du kejere icare apostolodoge, Judéia kejewu meartorureuge emeardure biri kadodukareuge ei tugeragu Pao bataruji jamedu duji.
source: Du kejere icare apostolodoge, Judéia kejewu meartorureuge emeardure biri kadodukareuge ei tugeragu Pao bataruji jamedu duji.

b: Du Kodi icare Pedro ruture Jerusalémto, du kejere icare enogituware ji.
source: Du Kodi icare Pedro ruture Jerusalémto, du kejere icare enogituware ji.

b: Egore: - Kodiba are aremo biri kadodukareuge ewaito, icare, akogwagere ebo?
source: Egore: - Kodiba are aremo biri kadodukareuge ewaito, icare, akogwagere ebo?

b: Macare Pedro readodure ewiegai ure tudowuje jamedu boeji, tagoi oino du tabo: -
source: Macare Pedro readodure ewiegai ure tudowuje jamedu boeji, tagoi oino du tabo: -

b: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji Jope bakurireu tada, icare ire ido ikinoi, du tabore iordure aroeji: iaboe ui nono aroia kurireu reore, oto kogure pobe puibiji, ure tudawuje baru piji puredu tu ii.
source: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji Jope bakurireu tada, icare ire ido ikinoi, du tabore iordure aroeji: iaboe ui nono aroia kurireu reore, oto kogure pobe puibiji, ure tudawuje baru piji puredu tu ii.

b: Itaiwo birigodure ji, icare iordu awadure barege, awague, kiege barege, emedui tada duji.
source: Itaiwo birigodure ji, icare iordu awadure barege, awague, kiege barege, emedui tada duji.

b: Icare imeardure ia boe emagoi iwiegai oino duji: Pedro, aragojedo awo bito, awo kowuje.
source: Icare imeardure ia boe emagoi iwiegai oino duji: Pedro, aragojedo awo bito, awo kowuje.

b: Imirema, inagore: Umodukare ino, Ikimejera, iaboe iaboe pegareu ukare turemo iiagi jii je.
source: Imirema, inagore: Umodukare ino, Ikimejera, iaboe iaboe pegareu ukare turemo iiagi jii je.

b: Icare cewu boe emago akore iwiegai baru piji pugeje, akore: Amagokaba Paore pemegado boeji akagokaba pegaie.
source: Icare cewu boe emago akore iwiegai baru piji pugeje, akore: Amagokaba Paore pemegado boeji akagokaba pegaie.

b: Awu inodu ure tudowuje pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, du kejere jamedu boe todure baruto pugeje.
source: Awu inodu ure tudowuje pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, du kejere jamedu boe todure baruto pugeje.

b: Du kejere icare ia ime ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu etaregodure nowu imugure tadawu bai kae, duwugere boere etudo iwogai Cesaréia piji.
source: Du kejere icare ia ime ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu etaregodure nowu imugure tadawu bai kae, duwugere boere etudo iwogai Cesaréia piji.

b: Boekimorema, Aroe Pemegareu akore ii ikoduwo ebo ipagudu bokwa tabo. Awu cewiemage ei ikera awubodure mito taci jedu ekodure itabo jamedu. Icare cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito.
source: Boekimorema, Aroe Pemegareu akore ii ikoduwo ebo ipagudu bokwa tabo. Awu cewiemage ei ikera awubodure mito taci jedu ekodure itabo jamedu. Icare cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito.

b: Emare icare readodure cewiegai tuiorduie ia Pao o tupa ui towadudo tuiegai akoi pudui oinodu jituji: Amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae tumagowo Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai.
source: Emare icare readodure cewiegai tuiorduie ia Pao o tupa ui towadudo tuiegai akoi pudui oinodu jituji: Amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae tumagowo Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai.

b: Emare makomode ai bakaru pemegareuji du koiare amode akinorudo, awobe eiamedu tabo.
source: Emare makomode ai bakaru pemegareuji du koiare amode akinorudo, awobe eiamedu tabo.

b: Icare ire iwadaru paru tawuje du tonajire kuri je Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje ure nono ure turawuje pawugeje marigu du reore.
source: Icare ire iwadaru paru tawuje du tonajire kuri je Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje ure nono ure turawuje pawugeje marigu du reore.

b: Du tabore icare iwiabuture Pagimejera akoino du keje: Joãore boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, tagirema tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
source: Du tabore icare iwiabuture Pagimejera akoino du keje: Joãore boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, tagirema tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo.

b: Kode makudure meartorure jiwuge cenaiwu Pao o boe pemegareu mitodu makudure etai jamedu ma, ioguduba imiba iwo ituu Pao Aroe Eimejera aidu kuda?
source: Kode makudure meartorure jiwuge cenaiwu Pao o boe pemegareu mitodu makudure etai jamedu ma, ioguduba imiba iwo ituu Pao Aroe Eimejera aidu kuda?

b:
Emeardure awu bataru jitu kejere icare emago bokware ji pugeje, ere Pao jekaredo, egore: - Kode, biri kadodukareuge etai jamedu Paore ero pegareu kiarigodae maku etai, etaregoduwo boe eerewo kae. 
Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe eparu ui tudowujedu.
source:
Emeardure awu bataru jitu kejere icare emago bokware ji pugeje, ere Pao jekaredo, egore: - Kode, biri kadodukareuge etai jamedu Paore ero pegareu kiarigodae maku etai, etaregoduwo boe eerewo kae. 
Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe eparu ui tudowujedu.

b: Du tonajire nowu ure taodo boe jamedu boe kaowuge, cewu brae etonare pudui boe keje, Estêvão o meri keje, etaregodure Fenícia kae, Chipre kae, Antioquia kae, tui Pao bataru kogado tu judeudoge ewiegai du tabo.
source: Du tonajire nowu ure taodo boe jamedu boe kaowuge, cewu brae etonare pudui boe keje, Estêvão o meri keje, etaregodure Fenícia kae, Chipre kae, Antioquia kae, tui Pao bataru kogado tu judeudoge ewiegai du tabo.

b: Mare ia Chipre kejewuge, ia Cirene kejewuge, enogore ekaodu, etaregodui Antioquia kae du keje, emagore gregodoge ei jamedu, ere Pagimejera o bakaru kogado ewiegai jamedu.
source: Mare ia Chipre kejewuge, ia Cirene kejewuge, enogore ekaodu, etaregodui Antioquia kae du keje, emagore gregodoge ei jamedu, ere Pagimejera o bakaru kogado ewiegai jamedu.

b: Pagimejera mugure ebo du kodire icare boe makareuge emeartorure, ere tugirimi Pao ae.
source: Pagimejera mugure ebo du kodire icare boe makareuge emeartorure, ere tugirimi Pao ae.

b: Awu boe jamedu boe akaru aregodure Jerusalém tadawu meartorureuge ewiegai. Du kodire ere Barnabé utudo Antioquia kae.
source: Awu boe jamedu boe akaru aregodure Jerusalém tadawu meartorureuge ewiegai. Du kodire ere Barnabé utudo Antioquia kae.

b: Aregodure toro du kejere jekarere tumeardui Pao o boe pemegareu jitu koia, icare makore ei emugu kiduwo Pao apo, turo raka tabo.
source: Aregodure toro du kejere jekarere tumeardui Pao o boe pemegareu jitu koia, icare makore ei emugu kiduwo Pao apo, turo raka tabo.

b: Paga karega, emare imedu pemegareu rema, meartoru kuricigore, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo. Du kodire ia boe makareuge ere tumeduiado Paoce.
source: Paga karega, emare imedu pemegareu rema, meartoru kuricigore, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo. Du kodire ia boe makareuge ere tumeduiado Paoce.

b: Kuri je du keje icare Barnabé uture toro Tarso kae, tuiemaruwo Saulo bogai, icare jordure ji, ure reko Antioquia kae.
source: Kuri je du keje icare Barnabé uture toro Tarso kae, tuiemaruwo Saulo bogai, icare jordure ji, ure reko Antioquia kae.

b: Joru mito tu jedu oto kae, etu eture meartorureuge ere tudo puiwo kae tu tu tu je, ere makaguragareuge eerduwado. Du kodire Antioquia kejere nowu meartorure Cristo jiwuge eiere cristãodoge oino boetoji.
source: Joru mito tu jedu oto kae, etu eture meartorureuge ere tudo puiwo kae tu tu tu je, ere makaguragareuge eerduwado. Du kodire Antioquia kejere nowu meartorure Cristo jiwuge eiere cristãodoge oino boetoji.

b: Nowu kodiboe keje ia profetadoge ere turawuje Jerusalém piji Antioquia kae.
source: Nowu kodiboe keje ia profetadoge ere turawuje Jerusalém piji Antioquia kae.

b: Ia emage ui mito tu jedu iei Agabo cedu, ure turagojedo, icare Aroe Pemegareu koiare readodure ia boe eke boi moduie boei du kuricigomode moto jamedu boe keje. Boekimorema, awu boe eke boi aregodure nowu Cláudio brae eimejera kurireui pudumi du tonaji.
source: Ia emage ui mito tu jedu iei Agabo cedu, ure turagojedo, icare Aroe Pemegareu koiare readodure ia boe eke boi moduie boei du kuricigomode moto jamedu boe keje. Boekimorema, awu boe eke boi aregodure nowu Cláudio brae eimejera kurireui pudumi du tonaji.

b: Du kodi icare Antioquia kejeu meartorureuge etaidure tuwo tugera braredo, tuwo toroe maku Judéia kejewu tumanamage etai, tu tu, turoia reore.
source: Du kodi icare Antioquia kejeu meartorureuge etaidure tuwo tugera braredo, tuwo toroe maku Judéia kejewu tumanamage etai, tu tu, turoia reore.

b:
Icare erore oino rugadu ere maku toro Barnabe, Saulo mage ekera tabo.

l2. Herodes onare Pao uwobei, ure Tiago bito.
source:
Icare erore oino rugadu ere maku toro Barnabe, Saulo mage ekera tabo.

l2. Herodes onare Pao uwobei, ure Tiago bito.

b: Barnabé mare Paulo emeru boetojiwu.
source: Barnabé mare Paulo emeru boetojiwu.

b: Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe etada profetadogere, jorduwareugere jamedu. Ia emage reo: Barnabé Simão iei Coreu cedu, Lúcio Cirene pijiwu, Manam cewu Herodes metuia tugodui puregodajidu kimoboe keje, mare Saulo.
source: Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe etada profetadogere, jorduwareugere jamedu. Ia emage reo: Barnabé Simão iei Coreu cedu, Lúcio Cirene pijiwu, Manam cewu Herodes metuia tugodui puregodajidu kimoboe keje, mare Saulo.

b: Ia meri keje, awuge ere todorogado pudui, du kejere ere Pao jora ko, du tabore icare Aroe Pemegareu makore ei, akore: - Tamode Barnabé mare Saulo etawuje inai emaragoduwo itaidure jiboe keje.
source: Ia meri keje, awuge ere todorogado pudui, du kejere ere Pao jora ko, du tabore icare Aroe Pemegareu makore ei, akore: - Tamode Barnabé mare Saulo etawuje inai emaragoduwo itaidure jiboe keje.

b: Du kejere icare, ei todorogado pudui dukejere, ere togwakurido eparu tabo, icare ere tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere ere etudo.
source: Du kejere icare, ei todorogado pudui dukejere, ere togwakurido eparu tabo, icare ere tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere ere etudo.

b: Du koiare Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure etudo, du tabore eture bakurireu mugui pobo maereu okwai du iere Seléucia cedu kae. Du pijire eture ika kurireu tabo ia pobo aiare moto tabowu iei Chipre cedu kae.
source: Du koiare Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure etudo, du tabore eture bakurireu mugui pobo maereu okwai du iere Seléucia cedu kae. Du pijire eture ika kurireu tabo ia pobo aiare moto tabowu iei Chipre cedu kae.

b: Etaregodure Salamina bakurireuto du kejere ere Pao bataru kogado nono judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataru jiwu baidoge etada. João (Marcos) kodure ebo tuwo tugera braredo ei.
source: Etaregodure Salamina bakurireuto du kejere ere Pao bataru kogado nono judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataru jiwu baidoge etada. João (Marcos) kodure ebo tuwo tugera braredo ei.

b: Du kejere emerure jii je, nowu pobo aiare moto tabowu kajeje jii etaregodure Pafos bakurireuto, du tadare eerdure ia judeu iei Barjesu ceduji, duwure boe eekuri pagado turo tuginoiwu tabo, profeta pagareu nure ema.
source: Du kejere emerure jii je, nowu pobo aiare moto tabowu kajeje jii etaregodure Pafos bakurireuto, du tadare eerdure ia judeu iei Barjesu ceduji, duwure boe eekuri pagado turo tuginoiwu tabo, profeta pagareu nure ema.

b: Mugure brae eimejera pemegareu iei Sérgio Paulo cedu apo. Awu brae eimejera makore Barnabé mare Saulo ewogai, aidure tumearduwo Pao bataruji kodi.
source: Mugure brae eimejera pemegareu iei Sérgio Paulo cedu apo. Awu brae eimejera makore Barnabé mare Saulo ewogai, aidure tumearduwo Pao bataruji kodi.

b: Icare nowu profeta paga pagareu, du iere jamedu Elimas cedu, ure tonado ei, aidure tuwo nowu brae eimejera meartoru kado Paoji.
source: Icare nowu profeta paga pagareu, du iere jamedu Elimas cedu, ure tonado ei, aidure tuwo nowu brae eimejera meartoru kado Paoji.

b: Du kodi icare Saulo, du iere Paulo, Aroe Pemegareu mugui apo du koia, ure tuioku kidudo ji, akore: -
source: Du kodi icare Saulo, du iere Paulo, Aroe Pemegareu mugui apo du koia, ure tuioku kidudo ji, akore: -

b: Aroe pegareu onaregedu, ure boe eekuri pagadowu, batararodureu, onare boe jetororeu jiwu imedu, anure Pao Aroe Eimejera utawara jetororeu meki mekido.
source: Aroe pegareu onaregedu, ure boe eekuri pagadowu, batararodureu, onare boe jetororeu jiwu imedu, anure Pao Aroe Eimejera utawara jetororeu meki mekido.

b: Ica, oinonore icare iera butumode awugeje, du koiare aeku bokwamode. Aerdumodukare meri jokuji jii boe emagomode ai pugeje du kae. Kuri je du kejere icare boeco buture joki, icare merure, ure taiado bai bai bai, jemarure ioguduba umode tugera maku pudai du bogai.
source: Ica, oinonore icare iera butumode awugeje, du koiare aeku bokwamode. Aerdumodukare meri jokuji jii boe emagomode ai pugeje du kae. Kuri je du kejere icare boeco buture joki, icare merure, ure taiado bai bai bai, jemarure ioguduba umode tugera maku pudai du bogai.

b:
Nowu brae eiemejera tuiordui nowu Saulo ro rakareu jitu kejere icare, meartorure Paoji, jeebogodu kuricigore Paulo makore jiboeji.
Paulo uwadodae Antioquia bakurireu mugui Pisídia kejewu keje.
source:
Nowu brae eiemejera tuiordui nowu Saulo ro rakareu jitu kejere icare, meartorure Paoji, jeebogodu kuricigore Paulo makore jiboeji.
Paulo uwadodae Antioquia bakurireu mugui Pisídia kejewu keje.

b: Du kejere icare Paulo uture tumedage ebo ika kurireu tabo nowu Pafos bakurireu piji, etaregodure Perge bakurireu mugui Panfília moto kejewu kae. Nonore icare cewu João Marcos uture epiji, ure tugirimi Jerusalemto pugeje.
source: Du kejere icare Paulo uture tumedage ebo ika kurireu tabo nowu Pafos bakurireu piji, etaregodure Perge bakurireu mugui Panfília moto kejewu kae. Nonore icare cewu João Marcos uture epiji, ure tugirimi Jerusalemto pugeje.

b: Ekodure toro Perge bakurireu kori toro Antioquia bakurireu mugure Pisídia moto kejewu kae. Du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataruji tadawu baito, icare ere tumugudo.
source: Ekodure toro Perge bakurireu kori toro Antioquia bakurireu mugure Pisídia moto kejewu kae. Du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataruji tadawu baito, icare ere tumugudo.

b: Du kejere boe emagore profetadoge eno baperaji, emagore boe eroiagudu padui bapera keje duji; du kejere nowu judeudoge ewai tadawu eimejerage emagore Saulo, Barnabé ewogai, egore: - Cemanamage, tagaidure tamagowo iaboeji boe ewiegai du keje, tamagodo.
source: Du kejere boe emagore profetadoge eno baperaji, emagore boe eroiagudu padui bapera keje duji; du kejere nowu judeudoge ewai tadawu eimejerage emagore Saulo, Barnabé ewogai, egore: - Cemanamage, tagaidure tamagowo iaboeji boe ewiegai du keje, tamagodo.

b: Icare Paulore turagojedo, ure tugana aogado boe etae, akore: -Israeldoge, meartorure Pao jiwuge tagi, tawiapagado.
source: Icare Paulore turagojedo, ure tugana aogado boe etae, akore: -Israeldoge, meartorure Pao jiwuge tagi, tawiapagado.

b: Israel uwobe eno Aroe Eimejera ure tugeragu paomagei pudae, ure eidodudo, emugui Egito keje du tonaji, du pijire ure etawuje tugana rakareu tabo.
source: Israel uwobe eno Aroe Eimejera ure tugeragu paomagei pudae, ure eidodudo, emugui Egito keje du tonaji, du pijire ure etawuje tugana rakareu tabo.

b: Jorui 40 du tonaji, ure enogwagedo ia kugaru awadure jiwu moto keje.
source: Jorui 40 du tonaji, ure enogwagedo ia kugaru awadure jiwu moto keje.

b: Du kejere ure Canaã moto kejewu boe etuwobe makareuge eeda kedodo, icare ure nowu moto pedo etai jorui 45 du tonaji.
source: Du kejere ure Canaã moto kejewu boe etuwobe makareuge eeda kedodo, icare ure nowu moto pedo etai jorui 45 du tonaji.

b: Du kejere ure jeture eiwuge emagu etai jii Samuel aregodure du kae.
source: Du kejere ure jeture eiwuge emagu etai jii Samuel aregodure du kae.

b: Du kejere icare enogwamagudure ia boe eimejera kurireu bogai pudai. Du kejere icare Paore Saul, Cis onaregedu, Benjamim uwobe, maku etai jorui 40 du tonaji.
source: Du kejere icare enogwamagudure ia boe eimejera kurireu bogai pudai. Du kejere icare Paore Saul, Cis onaregedu, Benjamim uwobe, maku etai jorui 40 du tonaji.

b: Du kejere Paore Saul pijido, ure eimejera Davi maku etai, du jire Pao akore: Iordure Jessé onaregedu Daviji, itaidure jiwu imedu duwu romode itaidure jiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Du kejere Paore Saul pijido, ure eimejera Davi maku etai, du jire Pao akore: Iordure Jessé onaregedu Daviji, itaidure jiwu imedu duwu romode itaidure jiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Rekodajiwuge epijire Paore nowu ure boe einorudowu Jesus tawuje epiji uwo nono profetadoge emagore marigudu du reore.
source: Rekodajiwuge epijire Paore nowu ure boe einorudowu Jesus tawuje epiji uwo nono profetadoge emagore marigudu du reore.

b: Nowu Jesus aregodu otodaire, Joãore boe eedorodowu boe etaimodu kogado, nowu Israel uwobe eiamedu boe ewiegai.
source: Nowu Jesus aregodu otodaire, Joãore boe eedorodowu boe etaimodu kogado, nowu Israel uwobe eiamedu boe ewiegai.

b: Emare, tui tumaragodae akedudo du tonajire akore: Cewu tameardaere jiwu imedu, imi karega, mare iregodajire icare ia ikare irugadu iwo bure tadawu iku kiwujewu aregodumode.
source: Emare, tui tumaragodae akedudo du tonajire akore: Cewu tameardaere jiwu imedu, imi karega, mare iregodajire icare ia ikare irugadu iwo bure tadawu iku kiwujewu aregodumode.

b: Iwiemage, Abraão ore tagi, meartorure Pao jiwugere tagi, pagaire awu umode paginorudowu bakaru rojaidodure.
source: Iwiemage, Abraão ore tagi, meartorure Pao jiwugere tagi, pagaire awu umode paginorudowu bakaru rojaidodure.

b: Paga karega, Jerusalém tadawuge mare eimejerage eerduwakare Jesusji, ere tugogado ji, ere bito, du tabore ere tumagore baperaji Sábado meri jiwu profetadoge ewadaru ere towuje.
source: Paga karega, Jerusalém tadawuge mare eimejerage eerduwakare Jesusji, ere tugogado ji, ere bito, du tabore ere tumagore baperaji Sábado meri jiwu profetadoge ewadaru ere towuje.

b: Enogwamagudure Pilatoji uwo bito, eerdukare ro pegareuji kodi karega.
source: Enogwamagudure Pilatoji uwo bito, eerdukare ro pegareuji kodi karega.

b: Icare ere bapera atugododure taboboe jamedu towuje, du kejere ere tawuje i padui pugajejedu piji icare ere tugu aroe eiaoto.
source: Icare ere bapera atugododure taboboe jamedu towuje, du kejere ere tawuje i padui pugajejedu piji icare ere tugu aroe eiaoto.

b: Macare Pao Aroe Eimejera ure jewodudo bireuge epiji.
source: Macare Pao Aroe Eimejera ure jewodudo bireuge epiji.

b: Icare cewu ruture apo Galiléia piji Jerusalém kaewuge eerdure ji meri makaguragare du tonaji, duwugere ereadodure boe ewiegai.
source: Icare cewu ruture apo Galiléia piji Jerusalém kaewuge eerdure ji meri makaguragare du tonaji, duwugere ereadodure boe ewiegai.

b: Cereadodu nure tawiegai Pao makore paedogamege eiboeji.
source: Cereadodu nure tawiegai Pao makore paedogamege eiboeji.

b: Ure tumagore eiboe towuje etore ceegai, ure Jesus rakojedo ure nono bapera atugododure Pao roia tabodu reore: “Itonaregedu nure aki, awuji ire atowuje” (Sl 2,7).
source: Ure tumagore eiboe towuje etore ceegai, ure Jesus rakojedo ure nono bapera atugododure Pao roia tabodu reore: “Itonaregedu nure aki, awuji ire atowuje” (Sl 2,7).

b: Paore tonaregedu jewodudo bireuge epiji ukawo tugirimi tubegagoduwo, ure nono ako reore: “Imode imagore Davi jiwu ino boe pemegareu maku tagai” (Is 55,3).
source: Paore tonaregedu jewodudo bireuge epiji ukawo tugirimi tubegagoduwo, ure nono ako reore: “Imode imagore Davi jiwu ino boe pemegareu maku tagai” (Is 55,3).

b: Davi mitodu ia boe keje akore: “Amodukare atugare pemegareu kodu pegadodudo” (Sl 15,10).
source: Davi mitodu ia boe keje akore: “Amodukare atugare pemegareu kodu pegadodudo” (Sl 15,10).

b: Aró, kode, Davi rore nono Pao ui turoiagudu reore du kejere bire. Tugudure mototo puredu tu taomagei, icare kodu pegagodure.
source: Aró, kode, Davi rore nono Pao ui turoiagudu reore du kejere bire. Tugudure mototo puredu tu taomagei, icare kodu pegagodure.

b: Mare cewu Paore jewodudo biereuge epijiwu kodu pegagodukare.
source: Mare cewu Paore jewodudo biereuge epijiwu kodu pegagodukare.

b: Du kodire, iwiemage, taerduwado koiaie cereadodu nure tawiegai boe ero pegareu akedumode duji.
source: Du kodire, iwiemage, taerduwado koiaie cereadodu nure tawiegai boe ero pegareu akedumode duji.

b: Emare ure meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe epemegago, mare Moisés boe eroiagudodu koia karega.
source: Emare ure meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe epemegago, mare Moisés boe eroiagudodu koia karega.

b: Icare tameardu awadudo tai cewu profetadoge emagore jiboe butukawo tawugeje.
source: Icare tameardu awadudo tai cewu profetadoge emagore jiboe butukawo tawugeje.

b: Nowu profetadoge egore: “Ure boe epijidowuge tagi, tameardu awadudo tai, tadugu tai, tabagudu kuricigodo. Paga karega, imode iro kurireu tuginoiwu towuje taegai, du jire tameartorumodukare ji, iaboe ereadodumode tawiegai du keje” (Hab 1,5).
source: Nowu profetadoge egore: “Ure boe epijidowuge tagi, tameardu awadudo tai, tadugu tai, tabagudu kuricigodo. Paga karega, imode iro kurireu tuginoiwu towuje taegai, du jire tameartorumodukare ji, iaboe ereadodumode tawiegai du keje” (Hab 1,5).

b: Du keje icare, ere tudawuje du tonajire icare enogwamagudure ei emagowo pudai pugeje aregodumode pugejewu Sábado meriji.
source: Du keje icare, ere tudawuje du tonajire icare enogwamagudure ei emagowo pudai pugeje aregodumode pugejewu Sábado meriji.

b: Nowu ere tudo pui du kejere icare, judeudoge makareuge, judeukare emawu meartorureu makareuge eture Paulo, Barnabé mage ebo, duwugere emago emagore ei ekidawo tumugui Pao apo jii je.
source: Nowu ere tudo pui du kejere icare, judeudoge makareuge, judeukare emawu meartorureu makareuge eture Paulo, Barnabé mage ebo, duwugere emago emagore ei ekidawo tumugui Pao apo jii je.

b: Nowu Sábado rekodajiwu meriji icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu etaregodure tumearduwo Pao bataruji.
source: Nowu Sábado rekodajiwu meriji icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu etaregodure tumearduwo Pao bataruji.

b: Icare judeudoge tuiordui nowu boe makareugei du koiare, ekorire ei, emago pegare Paulo makore jiboeji.
source: Icare judeudoge tuiordui nowu boe makareugei du koiare, ekorire ei, emago pegare Paulo makore jiboeji.

b: Du kodi icare Paulo mare Barnabé emagore ei tumago raka tabo, egore: - Tagaire Pao bataru kogadodumode tagai boetoji, macare tanure pijido, du kodi icare cemode cemegido judeukare emawuege etai.
source: Du kodi icare Paulo mare Barnabé emagore ei tumago raka tabo, egore: - Tagaire Pao bataru kogadodumode tagai boetoji, macare tanure pijido, du kodi icare cemode cemegido judeukare emawuege etai.

b: Paga karega, oinore Pao akore: “Ire atawuje awo boe eno moto tuginoiwu kejewuge erugudo, iwo moto kejewuge eiamedu boe einorudo” (Is 49,6).
source: Paga karega, oinore Pao akore: “Ire atawuje awo boe eno moto tuginoiwu kejewuge erugudo, iwo moto kejewuge eiamedu boe einorudo” (Is 49,6).

b: Awu bataru koiare ure jedukare emawuge eegare kuricigodo, duwuge ere Pao bataru kurido. Icare ere turugadu tuwo tumagu Pao ai, duwugere emeartorure ji.
source: Awu bataru koiare ure jedukare emawuge eegare kuricigodo, duwuge ere Pao bataru kurido. Icare ere turugadu tuwo tumagu Pao ai, duwugere emeartorure ji.

b: Du tabore icare Pao bataru ure taodo nowu moto jamedu joki.
source: Du tabore icare Pao bataru ure taodo nowu moto jamedu joki.

b: Macare nowu judeudoge ere nowu bakurireu tadawu ia areme kurireuge edo brae eimejerage erugo Pauloji, Barnabeji, icare ere etudo nowu to moto piji.
source: Macare nowu judeudoge ere nowu bakurireu tadawu ia areme kurireuge edo brae eimejerage erugo Pauloji, Barnabeji, icare ere etudo nowu to moto piji.

b: Icare nowuge ei pobedu ere tuwureko tadawu moto urugudu jukodo ei. Ere tudawuje nowu piji, icare eture Icônio kae.
source: Icare nowuge ei pobedu ere tuwureko tadawu moto urugudu jukodo ei. Ere tudawuje nowu piji, icare eture Icônio kae.

b: Meartorureuge rema eegare kuricigore Aroe Pemegareuji.
source: Meartorureuge rema eegare kuricigore Aroe Pemegareuji.

b: Paulo mare Barnabé emugui Icônio kejedu.
source: Paulo mare Barnabé emugui Icônio kejedu.

b: Paulo mare Barnabé etaregodure Icônio kae, du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tadawu baito, nowu turoino reore, du tadare icare ere Pao bataru kogado. Du kodi icare judeudoge makareuge, gregodoge makareuge emeartorure.
source: Paulo mare Barnabé etaregodure Icônio kae, du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tadawu baito, nowu turoino reore, du tadare icare ere Pao bataru kogado. Du kodi icare judeudoge makareuge, gregodoge makareuge emeartorure.

b: Mare ia meartorukareu judeudoge, ere judeukare emawuge erugo nowu meartorureugei.
source: Mare ia meartorukareu judeudoge, ere judeukare emawuge erugo nowu meartorureugei.

b: Du kodi karega, Paulo mare Barnabé emugu raire nono kimo, epagudu bokware, emeartorure Paoji, Pao ierabrarere ewadaruji kodi, ure turo rakareu to to nowu apostolodoge ekera tabo.
source: Du kodi karega, Paulo mare Barnabé emugu raire nono kimo, epagudu bokware, emeartorure Paoji, Pao ierabrarere ewadaruji kodi, ure turo rakareu to to nowu apostolodoge ekera tabo.

b: Icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge ere tugado puiato: iage ere tumegido judeudoge eiaogwai, iage ere tumegido apostolodoge eiaogwai.
source: Icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge ere tugado puiato: iage ere tumegido judeudoge eiaogwai, iage ere tumegido apostolodoge eiaogwai.

b: Macare ia judeudoge, ia judeukare emawuge ere turagojedo turugoduwo apostolodogei, tuwo tori to ei.
source: Macare ia judeudoge, ia judeukare emawuge ere turagojedo turugoduwo apostolodogei, tuwo tori to ei.

b: Du keje icare Apostolodoge ere boe pa, du kodire eregodure Licaônia, Listre, Derbe bakurireuge ekae, oieiwu moto kae jamedu.
source: Du keje icare Apostolodoge ere boe pa, du kodire eregodure Licaônia, Listre, Derbe bakurireuge ekae, oieiwu moto kae jamedu.

b:
Nonore icare ereadodure Pao o bakaru pemegareuji.
Ure tudowuje Listra, Derbe bakurireuge etadaboe.
source:
Nonore icare ereadodure Pao o bakaru pemegareuji.
Ure tudowuje Listra, Derbe bakurireuge etadaboe.

b: Nowu Listra tadare ia imedu pogora pegareu mugure tada, meru bokware jii boture du piji jii oino du kae.
source: Nowu Listra tadare ia imedu pogora pegareu mugure tada, meru bokware jii boture du piji jii oino du kae.

b: Meardu nure Paulo bataruji tumugui nono du tabo, icare Paulore tuioku kidudo ji, jordure meartoruie tuwo tubemegado.
source: Meardu nure Paulo bataruji tumugui nono du tabo, icare Paulore tuioku kidudo ji, jordure meartoruie tuwo tubemegado.

b: Du koiare ure tumago rakado ji, akore ji: - Aragojedo, aedorodo awure keje. Icare ure taredo taci je, icare merure.
source: Du koiare ure tumago rakado ji, akore ji: - Aragojedo, aedorodo awure keje. Icare ure taredo taci je, icare merure.

b: Icare nowu boe makareuge, tuiordui Paulo roinoduji du keje, ere tumago rakado, enoiogwarire Licaônia kejewuge ewadaru tabo, egore: - Ime ereoreu Aroe Eimejerage ere turawuje pagae!
source: Icare nowu boe makareuge, tuiordui Paulo roinoduji du keje, ere tumago rakado, enoiogwarire Licaônia kejewuge ewadaru tabo, egore: - Ime ereoreu Aroe Eimejerage ere turawuje pagae!

b: Icare ere Barnabé iedo Zeusce, ere Paulo iedo Hermesce, paga karega, awu mako makore du kodi.
source: Icare ere Barnabé iedo Zeusce, ere Paulo iedo Hermesce, paga karega, awu mako makore du kodi.

b: Icare ia Zeus bure joia imedu iei Propeleo cedu ure ia tapiradoge ime eerego mato, nowu bakurireu baiporo kae, ure ekenawudo, ure edugodo tuwo ewido nowu Paulo mare Barnabé etai, tumeardui Aroe Eimejerageie ure emage, nowu boe eiamedu emeardaere oino jamedu.
source: Icare ia Zeus bure joia imedu iei Propeleo cedu ure ia tapiradoge ime eerego mato, nowu bakurireu baiporo kae, ure ekenawudo, ure edugodo tuwo ewido nowu Paulo mare Barnabé etai, tumeardui Aroe Eimejerageie ure emage, nowu boe eiamedu emeardaere oino jamedu.

b: Mare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu, tui boe pa nowu oinodu jitu kejere, ere tugudae bowuje, ere taredo nowu makareuge etoiado.
source: Mare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu, tui boe pa nowu oinodu jitu kejere, ere tugudae bowuje, ere taredo nowu makareuge etoiado.

b: Egore : - Ime, kodiba taroino? Boe bimodeugere cegi jamedu tareore. Ica, cenogituwa nure tai tawo taedorodo, tawo tagirimi boe pegareu piji, Pao jereu kae, koiare ure baru to, ure awu moto to, ure pobo maereu to, ure mugure jekeboe jamedu boe ure towuje jamedu.
source: Egore : - Ime, kodiba taroino? Boe bimodeugere cegi jamedu tareore. Ica, cenogituwa nure tai tawo taedorodo, tawo tagirimi boe pegareu piji, Pao jereu kae, koiare ure baru to, ure awu moto to, ure pobo maereu to, ure mugure jekeboe jamedu boe ure towuje jamedu.

b: Marigudu ure moto kejewu boe etawarado mitotu mitotu tu ereore.
source: Marigudu ure moto kejewu boe etawarado mitotu mitotu tu ereore.

b: Du kodi karega ure towadudo paiamedu jekai jii je, turo pemegareu tabo, ure butaodoge ewududo pagai baru piji, ure boe pemegareudo pagai, ure page kuricigodo boe jameduji, ure pawabo jekare kuricigodo.
source: Du kodi karega ure towadudo paiamedu jekai jii je, turo pemegareu tabo, ure butaodoge ewududo pagai baru piji, ure boe pemegareudo pagai, ure page kuricigodo boe jameduji, ure pawabo jekare kuricigodo.

b: Mare rakare ei tukawo edo tapiradoge ewido, tukawo edo tubujodo tuiegai.
source: Mare rakare ei tukawo edo tapiradoge ewido, tukawo edo tubujodo tuiegai.

b: Macare ia Antioquia pijiwu, ia Icônio pijiwu judeudoge etaregodure, duwugere ere boe makareuge etaora pegado. Du kodi icare ere tori to Pauloji, icare emeardaere tuie bito duji, du kodi icare ere tumugudo keje kororo, toro nowu bakurireu baawadu kae.
source: Macare ia Antioquia pijiwu, ia Icônio pijiwu judeudoge etaregodure, duwugere ere boe makareuge etaora pegado. Du kodi icare ere tori to Pauloji, icare emeardaere tuie bito duji, du kodi icare ere tumugudo keje kororo, toro nowu bakurireu baawadu kae.

b: Du kejere icare ure jorduwadowuge ere taiado apo. Icare ure turagojedo taci, ure turemo bakurireuto pugeje. Nowu rekodajiwu meri jire icare uture Barnabé apo toro Derbe bakurireu kae.
source: Du kejere icare ure jorduwadowuge ere taiado apo. Icare ure turagojedo taci, ure turemo bakurireuto pugeje. Nowu rekodajiwu meri jire icare uture Barnabé apo toro Derbe bakurireu kae.

b: Icare ereadodure Pao bataruji nowu Derbe kejewuge ewiegai, ere ture jorduwadowuge emagado nono. Du kejere icare ere tugirimi nowu piji, toro Listra, Icônio, Antioquia (Pisídia kejewu) bakurireuge etae.
source: Icare ereadodure Pao bataruji nowu Derbe kejewuge ewiegai, ere ture jorduwadowuge emagado nono. Du kejere icare ere tugirimi nowu piji, toro Listra, Icônio, Antioquia (Pisídia kejewu) bakurireuge etae.

b: Ere meartorureuge emeardu awadudo pudui tuwo tudurudo tumeartorui Pao jitu tabo. Egore ei uie turugadu pawo paremo Pao mugurewo kae pabagai boe ecebae makareu kajeje du tabo.
source: Ere meartorureuge emeardu awadudo pudui tuwo tudurudo tumeartorui Pao jitu tabo. Egore ei uie turugadu pawo paremo Pao mugurewo kae pabagai boe ecebae makareu kajeje du tabo.

b: Du kejere ere Pao bure jore kejewuge emugudo Igreja jamedu tada. Enogwamagudure Paoji eparu tabo, tui todorogado pudui du tabo, tui togwa kurido du tabo.
source: Du kejere ere Pao bure jore kejewuge emugudo Igreja jamedu tada. Enogwamagudure Paoji eparu tabo, tui todorogado pudui du tabo, tui togwa kurido du tabo.

b: Icare ere pagado Pisídia moto kajeje, etaregodure Panfília moto kae.
source: Icare ere pagado Pisídia moto kajeje, etaregodure Panfília moto kae.

b: Ereadodure Pao bataruji Perge bakurireu tada, du kejere ere turawuje Atália kae.
source: Ereadodure Pao bataruji Perge bakurireu tada, du kejere ere turawuje Atália kae.

b: Du pijire icare ere taredo ika kurireuto, ekodure Antioquia (Sria kejewu) kae pugeje. Nowu bakurireu pijire ere tudawuje marigudu tui tumagu Pao ai awu tumaragodae akedugoduredu kae.
source: Du pijire icare ere taredo ika kurireuto, ekodure Antioquia (Sria kejewu) kae pugeje. Nowu bakurireu pijire ere tudawuje marigudu tui tumagu Pao ai awu tumaragodae akedugoduredu kae.

b: Etaregodure nono du keje, ere meartorureuge eto pui, icare ereadodure ewiegai Paoi turo kurireu towuje etaiduji, ui judeukare emawuge emeartorudo tuwadaru jituji.
source: Etaregodure nono du keje, ere meartorureuge eto pui, icare ereadodure ewiegai Paoi turo kurireu towuje etaiduji, ui judeukare emawuge emeartorudo tuwadaru jituji.

b: Icare emugu raire nono ebo.
source: Icare emugu raire nono ebo.

b: Judeudoge ei tuwiri kadodu jiboe.
source: Judeudoge ei tuwiri kadodu jiboe.

b: Icarema ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu ia ime emagore Pao uwobei, egore: -Tamodukare tawiri kado, Moisesre boe eroiagudo du reore ma, tamodukare taginorudo. Oinore egore ei.
source: Icarema ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu ia ime emagore Pao uwobei, egore: -Tamodukare tawiri kado, Moisesre boe eroiagudo du reore ma, tamodukare taginorudo. Oinore egore ei.

b: Icare Paulo mare Barnabé enogituwa kuricigore ei, mare ekare tuwudugugo Icare eiamedu etaidure tuwo Paulo mare Barnabé etudo toro Jerusalém kae, ia tuwiemage ebo, tunorawo apostolodogei, inoba umode duji.
source: Icare Paulo mare Barnabé enogituwa kuricigore ei, mare ekare tuwudugugo Icare eiamedu etaidure tuwo Paulo mare Barnabé etudo toro Jerusalém kae, ia tuwiemage ebo, tunorawo apostolodogei, inoba umode duji.

b:
Icare ere tugimadudo nowu Pao uwobe epiji, icare ekodure toro Fenícia, Samaria kajejewu awaraji. Icare ereadodure Pao uwobe eiamedu ewiegai icai judeukare emawuge emeartoruie Pao jituji. Du koiare eiamedu jekare kuricigore.
Apostolodoge eiamedu ere tudo pui Jerusalém tadadu.
source:
Icare ere tugimadudo nowu Pao uwobe epiji, icare ekodure toro Fenícia, Samaria kajejewu awaraji. Icare ereadodure Pao uwobe eiamedu ewiegai icai judeukare emawuge emeartoruie Pao jituji. Du koiare eiamedu jekare kuricigore.
Apostolodoge eiamedu ere tudo pui Jerusalém tadadu.

b: Icare etaregodure Jerusalémto. Nonore Pao uwobe, apostolodoge, Pao uwobe eimejerage ere tugeragu ei tuiegare tabo. Du kejere ereadodure ewiegai Pao rore puduiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Icare etaregodure Jerusalémto. Nonore Pao uwobe, apostolodoge, Pao uwobe eimejerage ere tugeragu ei tuiegare tabo. Du kejere ereadodure ewiegai Pao rore puduiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Macare iage, duwugere fariseudogere emage marigudu tumeartorure Pao jitu otodai, ere turagojedo, egore umoduie turugadu boewo judeukare emawuge ewiri kado jamedu, uwo nono Moisés ure boe eroiagudo du reore.
source: Macare iage, duwugere fariseudogere emage marigudu tumeartorure Pao jitu otodai, ere turagojedo, egore umoduie turugadu boewo judeukare emawuge ewiri kado jamedu, uwo nono Moisés ure boe eroiagudo du reore.

b: Icare apostolodoge, mare nowu Pao uwobe ia eimejerage, ere tudo pui tumagowo nowu inoduji, inoba umode duji.
source: Icare apostolodoge, mare nowu Pao uwobe ia eimejerage, ere tudo pui tumagowo nowu inoduji, inoba umode duji.

b: Emago raire pui, du kejere icare Pedrore turagojedo, akore ei: - Iwiemage, taerduware jii paru pijie Paore tugeragu ii tabiji ireadoduwo tuwadaruji judeukare emawuge ewiegai ma, emeartoruwo ji.
source: Emago raire pui, du kejere icare Pedrore turagojedo, akore ei: - Iwiemage, taerduware jii paru pijie Paore tugeragu ii tabiji ireadoduwo tuwadaruji judeukare emawuge ewiegai ma, emeartoruwo ji.

b: Emare jorduware ime ewaboji, du koiare ure turodo nono tumeardu kurii ei du kodiwore, ure Aroe Pemegareu maku etai, umagai maku pagai du reore.
source: Emare jorduware ime ewaboji, du koiare ure turodo nono tumeardu kurii ei du kodiwore, ure Aroe Pemegareu maku etai, umagai maku pagai du reore.

b: Aiwore ei taiwo magai pai du reore, ure ewabo pemegado emeartorure ji kodi.
source: Aiwore ei taiwo magai pai du reore, ure ewabo pemegado emeartorure ji kodi.

b: Kode, kodiba tagomare Paoji? Tare jorduwadowuge enoredudo paomage eroiwakare jiboe tabo, paroiwakare jiboe tabo, kodiba?
source: Kode, kodiba tagomare Paoji? Tare jorduwadowuge enoredudo paomage eroiwakare jiboe tabo, paroiwakare jiboe tabo, kodiba?

b: Pagire pameartorure paginorudoduie Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o boe pemegareu koia duji. Oinore umode etai jamedu.
source: Pagire pameartorure paginorudoduie Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o boe pemegareu koia duji. Oinore umode etai jamedu.

b: Eiamedu biapagare Pedro bataruji tumago bokwa tabo. Du keje icare ewiapagare Barnabé mare Paulo ereadodui tuwiegai Paoi tudowuje ekera tabo judeukare emawuge etaiwu turo pemegareu kurireu jameduji.
source: Eiamedu biapagare Pedro bataruji tumago bokwa tabo. Du keje icare ewiapagare Barnabé mare Paulo ereadodui tuwiegai Paoi tudowuje ekera tabo judeukare emawuge etaiwu turo pemegareu kurireu jameduji.

b: Emago akedu kejere icare, Tiago akore: - Iwiemage tawiapagado:
source: Emago akedu kejere icare, Tiago akore: - Iwiemage tawiapagado:

b: Oino maigodu Simão Pedro readodure pawiegai Pao aiwoi judeukare emawuge eiduji, tuwo tuwobedo emage.
source: Oino maigodu Simão Pedro readodure pawiegai Pao aiwoi judeukare emawuge eiduji, tuwo tuwobedo emage.

b: Ica, awu inodu ure nono profetadoge ewadaru padui bapera kejedu reore:
source: Ica, awu inodu ure nono profetadoge ewadaru padui bapera kejedu reore:

b: Awu inodu otobiji imode ikirimi, imode Davi uwai butureu rakojedo pugeje, imode uwai kobo rogu boe pemegado, imode rakojedo.
source: Awu inodu otobiji imode ikirimi, imode Davi uwai butureu rakojedo pugeje, imode uwai kobo rogu boe pemegado, imode rakojedo.

b: Ma, rakoje kimomodeu ime ekoduwo Aroe Eimejera bogai, boe emagore ikie bogai bukejewu boe epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe ekoduwo bogai jamedu.
source: Ma, rakoje kimomodeu ime ekoduwo Aroe Eimejera bogai, boe emagore ikie bogai bukejewu boe epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe ekoduwo bogai jamedu.

b: Oinore Pao akore, duwure awu jamedu towuje, jorduware jamedu boeji jii paru piji (Am 9,11s).
source: Oinore Pao akore, duwure awu jamedu towuje, jorduware jamedu boeji jii paru piji (Am 9,11s).

b: Du kodi icare imeardaere uie turugadu pakawo judeukare emawuge ei tugirimi Pao ae tuibagi pugejewu emorora amagadudo.
source: Du kodi icare imeardaere uie turugadu pakawo judeukare emawuge ei tugirimi Pao ae tuibagi pugejewu emorora amagadudo.

b: Imeardaere uie turugadu pawo bapera atugodo etai ekawo makudure aroe eimejerage pagareuge etaiwu barege ekodu kowuje, eerebari kawo, ekawo akere bitowu barege ekodu, eku, kowuje. Oino tu je.
source: Imeardaere uie turugadu pawo bapera atugodo etai ekawo makudure aroe eimejerage pagareuge etaiwu barege ekodu kowuje, eerebari kawo, ekawo akere bitowu barege ekodu, eku, kowuje. Oino tu je.

b: Paga karega, padure bapera kejewu Moisés ure boe eroiagudodu makodu makodure Sábado jameduji bakurireuge eiamedu tada boe eiamedu padui pumekejedu ewiegai jii marigudu jii oino.
source: Paga karega, padure bapera kejewu Moisés ure boe eroiagudodu makodu makodure Sábado jameduji bakurireuge eiamedu tada boe eiamedu padui pumekejedu ewiegai jii marigudu jii oino.

b:
Du kodi icare apostolodoge, Pao uwobe eimejerage, Pao uwobe eiamedu boe eerdu pemegare tuwo ia ime etawuje tubiji, etuwo Paulo apo, Barnabé apo, Antioquia kae. Ere etawujewuge reo: Judas, iei Barsaba cedu, mare Silas, duwuge kurireugere emage tumedage etada.
Jerusalém pijiwu boe eroiagudu.
source:
Du kodi icare apostolodoge, Pao uwobe eimejerage, Pao uwobe eiamedu boe eerdu pemegare tuwo ia ime etawuje tubiji, etuwo Paulo apo, Barnabé apo, Antioquia kae. Ere etawujewuge reo: Judas, iei Barsaba cedu, mare Silas, duwuge kurireugere emage tumedage etada.
Jerusalém pijiwu boe eroiagudu.

b: Ere reko pudabowu bapera atugo reo: - Apostolodoge cegi, Pao uwobe eimejerage cegi, cegimadu nure judeukare emawu Antioquia tadawu, Sria tadawu, Cilícia tadawu cewiemage tagai.
source: Ere reko pudabowu bapera atugo reo: - Apostolodoge cegi, Pao uwobe eimejerage cegi, cegimadu nure judeukare emawu Antioquia tadawu, Sria tadawu, Cilícia tadawu cewiemage tagai.

b: Cemeardure boe egoi ia uture cebijiwuge ei tumago maere tai, tui tamorora amagadudo du tabo. Mare cegire cekare etudo tawogai.
source: Cemeardure boe egoi ia uture cebijiwuge ei tumago maere tai, tui tamorora amagadudo du tabo. Mare cegire cekare etudo tawogai.

b: Du kodi icare cere cedo pui, cere ia ime etawuje cebiji cewo etudo tawogai, cemeardu kurire jiwu Barnabé, Paulo mage ebo.
source: Du kodi icare cere cedo pui, cere ia ime etawuje cebiji cewo etudo tawogai, cemeardu kurire jiwu Barnabé, Paulo mage ebo.

b: Duwuge ere tumagu tuwidoduwo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie koia.
source: Duwuge ere tumagu tuwidoduwo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie koia.

b: Icare cere Judas mare Sila etudo ebo tawogai, duwuge ereadodumode nowu inoduji tawiegai.
source: Icare cere Judas mare Sila etudo ebo tawogai, duwuge ereadodumode nowu inoduji tawiegai.

b: Aroe Pemegareu apore ceerdu pemegare cekawo tagoredudo iaboe iaboe tabo, mare awu inodu tabo tu je:
source: Aroe Pemegareu apore ceerdu pemegare cekawo tagoredudo iaboe iaboe tabo, mare awu inodu tabo tu je:

b: Tagogwagekawo makudure aroe eimejerage pagareuge etaiwu barege ekoduji, takawo akere bitowu barege ekodu, eku kowuje, tagera keadu kawo jamedu. Umode turugadu tawo inoduboe pijido. Cegimadu nure tawogai.
source: Tagogwagekawo makudure aroe eimejerage pagareuge etaiwu barege ekoduji, takawo akere bitowu barege ekodu, eku kowuje, tagera keadu kawo jamedu. Umode turugadu tawo inoduboe pijido. Cegimadu nure tawogai.

b: Du kejere icare nowugere tugimadudo epiji, icare eture toro Antioquia kae, torore icare ere Pao uwobe eto pui, icare ere bapera maku etai.
source: Du kejere icare nowugere tugimadudo epiji, icare eture toro Antioquia kae, torore icare ere Pao uwobe eto pui, icare ere bapera maku etai.

b: Emagore baperaji, du tabore eiamedu jekarere, icare emeardu awadure pudui pugeje.
source: Emagore baperaji, du tabore eiamedu jekarere, icare emeardu awadure pudui pugeje.

b: Icare Judas, Silamage, duwugere profetadogere emage jamedu, emago awadure nowu Pao uwobei, tui eerduwado, tui emeardae awadudo pudui jamedu du tabo.
source: Icare Judas, Silamage, duwugere profetadogere emage jamedu, emago awadure nowu Pao uwobei, tui eerduwado, tui emeardae awadudo pudui jamedu du tabo.

b: Meri makakare ei nono, du kejere Pao uwobe ere tugimadudo ebo pugeje, boe butugu tabo. Icare ere tugirimi tuibagi cewu ure tududo torowuge etae pugeje. 34(Boekarema. Silas jordu pemegare tumuguwo nono, Judas rema ure tugirimi Jerusalém kae tuibagi).
source: Meri makakare ei nono, du kejere Pao uwobe ere tugimadudo ebo pugeje, boe butugu tabo. Icare ere tugirimi tuibagi cewu ure tududo torowuge etae pugeje. 34(Boekarema. Silas jordu pemegare tumuguwo nono, Judas rema ure tugirimi Jerusalém kae tuibagi).

b:
Paulo mare Barnabé emugure Antioquia tada jamedu. Ere boe eerduwado, ere Pao bataru kogado ia tumedage makareuge ebo.
Paulo mare Sila emeru rekodajiwu.
source:
Paulo mare Barnabé emugure Antioquia tada jamedu. Ere boe eerduwado, ere Pao bataru kogado ia tumedage makareuge ebo.
Paulo mare Sila emeru rekodajiwu.

b: Meri makakare pugeje du keje, Paulo makore Barnabeji, akore: - Pawo pagirimi, paerduwo pawiemagei pugeje, nowu pare Pao bataru kogado tadawu bakurireuge eiamedu boe ekao. Paerduwo inoba ere, epemegare, iarema epegare du bogai.
source: Meri makakare pugeje du keje, Paulo makore Barnabeji, akore: - Pawo pagirimi, paerduwo pawiemagei pugeje, nowu pare Pao bataru kogado tadawu bakurireuge eiamedu boe ekao. Paerduwo inoba ere, epemegare, iarema epegare du bogai.

b: Boekimorema, Barnabé aidure tuwo João iei Marcos cedu ko pudabo.
source: Boekimorema, Barnabé aidure tuwo João iei Marcos cedu ko pudabo.

b: Paulorema meardaere boroie, paga karega, marigudu, emugui Panfília keje du keje, João uturadu Paulo mare Barnabé epiji, ukare tugerabraredo ei emaragodae keje.
source: Paulorema meardaere boroie, paga karega, marigudu, emugui Panfília keje du keje, João uturadu Paulo mare Barnabé epiji, ukare tugerabraredo ei emaragodae keje.

b: Du kodi icare Paulo, Barnabé emeardaekare pureore, icare ere tudo tuginoi. Icare Barnabé uture Chipre kae, ika kurireu tabo, ure Marcos reko pudabo.
source: Du kodi icare Paulo, Barnabé emeardaekare pureore, icare ere tudo tuginoi. Icare Barnabé uture Chipre kae, ika kurireu tabo, ure Marcos reko pudabo.

b: Paulorema ure Silas reko pudabo, icare Pao uwobe emagore Paoji eparu tabo, icare uture jamedu. Merure Síria moto kae, Cilícia moto kae, tui Pao uwobe emeardu awadudo pudui du tabo.
source: Paulorema ure Silas reko pudabo, icare Pao uwobe emagore Paoji eparu tabo, icare uture jamedu. Merure Síria moto kae, Cilícia moto kae, tui Pao uwobe emeardu awadudo pudui du tabo.

b: Paulore tumeduiado Timoteoce.
source: Paulore tumeduiado Timoteoce.

b: Aregodure Derbe bakurireu kae du kejere uture Listra bakurireuto. Nonore icare ia ure jorduwadowu iei Timóteo cedu mugure nono. Uce Judéia cristãorodo rema, uo Grécia kejeu rema.
source: Aregodure Derbe bakurireu kae du kejere uture Listra bakurireuto. Nonore icare ia ure jorduwadowu iei Timóteo cedu mugure nono. Uce Judéia cristãorodo rema, uo Grécia kejeu rema.

b: Awu imedu pemega remawu nure Listra, Icõnio kejewu Pao uwobe eegai.
source: Awu imedu pemega remawu nure Listra, Icõnio kejewu Pao uwobe eegai.

b: Du kodi icare Paulo aidure koduwo pudabo, mare ure biri kado jao, judeudoge eigoia, eiamedu jorduware uoie Grêcia kejewuie ure ema kodi.
source: Du kodi icare Paulo aidure koduwo pudabo, mare ure biri kado jao, judeudoge eigoia, eiamedu jorduware uoie Grêcia kejewuie ure ema kodi.

b: Ekodure kaewu bakurireuge etada ere boe eerduwado emeartoruwo apostolodoge mare Pao uwobe eimejerage ere boe eroiagudu Jerusalém tadaduji.
source: Ekodure kaewu bakurireuge etada ere boe eerduwado emeartoruwo apostolodoge mare Pao uwobe eimejerage ere boe eroiagudu Jerusalém tadaduji.

b: Oinodu tabore Pao uwobe ere tubewudo tumeartoru tabo, ere cidodudo gu gu meri jameduji.
source: Oinodu tabore Pao uwobe ere tubewudo tumeartoru tabo, ere cidodudo gu gu meri jameduji.

b: Du kejere ere pagado Frígia moto kajeje, Galácia moto kajeje, mare ekodukare Asia moto kae, Aroe Pemegareu aidukare kodi.
source: Du kejere ere pagado Frígia moto kajeje, Galácia moto kajeje, mare ekodukare Asia moto kae, Aroe Pemegareu aidukare kodi.

b: Etaregodui Mísia moto kae du keje, etaidure tugoduwo Bitínia moto kae, mare Pagimejera Jesus Utaroe Pemegareu aidukare jamedu.
source: Etaregodui Mísia moto kae du keje, etaidure tugoduwo Bitínia moto kae, mare Pagimejera Jesus Utaroe Pemegareu aidukare jamedu.

b:
Du kejere icare ere pagado goro goro tabo Mísia moto kajeje, icare ere turawuje Tróades bakurireu padui pobo maereu okwai du kae.
Ere pagado Macedônia kae.
source:
Du kejere icare ere pagado goro goro tabo Mísia moto kajeje, icare ere turawuje Tróades bakurireu padui pobo maereu okwai du kae.
Ere pagado Macedônia kae.

b: Ia boeco jire Paulo unuiaore: Jordure ia Macedônia pijiwu imedu rakojei tuiegai, okwamagudi pudui duji, akore: -Amode pagado pobo maereu okwa bakowu kae, amode akera braredo cei.
source: Ia boeco jire Paulo unuiaore: Jordure ia Macedônia pijiwu imedu rakojei tuiegai, okwamagudi pudui duji, akore: -Amode pagado pobo maereu okwa bakowu kae, amode akera braredo cei.

b:
Awu unuiao akedu kejere icare akore cei cegoduwo toro Macedônia kae, ceerduware Pao makoi cewogai, cewo tuwadaru kogado nonowuge ewiegai duji kodi.
Emugure Filipo bakurireu tada. Lídia ure tumagu Pao ai.
source:
Awu unuiao akedu kejere icare akore cei cegoduwo toro Macedônia kae, ceerduware Pao makoi cewogai, cewo tuwadaru kogado nonowuge ewiegai duji kodi.
Emugure Filipo bakurireu tada. Lídia ure tumagu Pao ai.

b: Du kodi icare, nowu Tróade bakurireu pijire icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, cegodure kuri toro Samotrácia kae, du pijire cegodure Necápoli kae.
source: Du kodi icare, nowu Tróade bakurireu pijire icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, cegodure kuri toro Samotrácia kae, du pijire cegodure Necápoli kae.

b: Du pijire cegodure pugeje Macedônia kejewu kurire tumedage ekoriwu bakurireu iei Filipo cedu kae. Awu Macedônia moto mugure Roma kejewuge ero kuda. Meri makakare cei nono.
source: Du pijire cegodure pugeje Macedônia kejewu kurire tumedage ekoriwu bakurireu iei Filipo cedu kae. Awu Macedônia moto mugure Roma kejewuge ero kuda. Meri makakare cei nono.

b: Icare, nowu Sábado meriji, cere cedawuje nowu bakurireu o baiporo piji toro pobo okwato, cemeardaere toroie pemegamode cenogwamaguduwo Paoji kodi. Nonore icare cemugure, du tabore cereadodure ia areme etui pui nonodu biegai.
source: Icare, nowu Sábado meriji, cere cedawuje nowu bakurireu o baiporo piji toro pobo okwato, cemeardaere toroie pemegamode cenogwamaguduwo Paoji kodi. Nonore icare cemugure, du tabore cereadodure ia areme etui pui nonodu biegai.

b: Ia emage ui mitodu, iei Lídia cedu, Tiatira bakurireu pijiwudo, duwudore aroia akirodo tabo, pagudure Paoji, biapaga nure cei, Paore uwabo jado biapaga pemegawo Paulo bataruji.
source: Ia emage ui mitodu, iei Lídia cedu, Tiatira bakurireu pijiwudo, duwudore aroia akirodo tabo, pagudure Paoji, biapaga nure cei, Paore uwabo jado biapaga pemegawo Paulo bataruji.

b:
Du kodi icare ao pegododure, uwobe jamedu, du kejere okwamagudure cei, akore: - Tameardaemode imeartoruie Paoji ma, taremo iwaito, tamugudo itabo. Icare ure cerodo ino rugadu.
Braere Paulo mare Sila etugu baicoreuto.
source:
Du kodi icare ao pegododure, uwobe jamedu, du kejere okwamagudure cei, akore: - Tameardaemode imeartoruie Paoji ma, taremo iwaito, tamugudo itabo. Icare ure cerodo ino rugadu.
Braere Paulo mare Sila etugu baicoreuto.

b: Boekimorema, ia meri keje, cedui pagogwamagudure Paoji kejewo kae du keje, ia nogwaredu aregodure cedogi, brae etugareredo nure ema, duwudo, Paokare emawu iei Piton cedu utaroe meture tada, du kodire jorduware boe biareuji, du tabore ure cimejerage eno diiero maka makado.
source: Boekimorema, ia meri keje, cedui pagogwamagudure Paoji kejewo kae du keje, ia nogwaredu aregodure cedogi, brae etugareredo nure ema, duwudo, Paokare emawu iei Piton cedu utaroe meture tada, du kodire jorduware boe biareuji, du tabore ure cimejerage eno diiero maka makado.

b: Icare uture ceregodaji, Paulo rekodaji, tagoi oino du tabo: - Awu imere Aroe Eimejera Kurireu utugaregere emage duwugere taerduwado baru kaewu awaraji.
source: Icare uture ceregodaji, Paulo rekodaji, tagoi oino du tabo: - Awu imere Aroe Eimejera Kurireu utugaregere emage duwugere taerduwado baru kaewu awaraji.

b: Mako makore awu inoduji meri makaguragare tu tu tu je. Du inodu otobiji, Paulo korigodure ji, ure tuie kirimi bogai, icare makore nowu aroeji, akore: - Jesus Cristo ie tabo imago nure ai: atawuje piji. Kuri je du kejere icare ure tudawuje piji.
source: Mako makore awu inoduji meri makaguragare tu tu tu je. Du inodu otobiji, Paulo korigodure ji, ure tuie kirimi bogai, icare makore nowu aroeji, akore: - Jesus Cristo ie tabo imago nure ai: atawuje piji. Kuri je du kejere icare ure tudawuje piji.

b: Boekimorema, nowu imejerage ere boe pa tumodukae tugeragu o diieroji pugeje duji. Du kodi icare ere tugeragu Pauloji, Silaji, ere erego toro brae eimejerage ere tudo pui tuwo tugogado boeiwo kae.
source: Boekimorema, nowu imejerage ere boe pa tumodukae tugeragu o diieroji pugeje duji. Du kodi icare ere tugeragu Pauloji, Silaji, ere erego toro brae eimejerage ere tudo pui tuwo tugogado boeiwo kae.

b: Du kejere ere brae eimejerage eerdudo ei, tagoi oino du tabo: - Awu imere judeudogere emage, enure pago bakurireu tadawuge etago turugoduwo, enure boe eerduwado erowo nono Roma pijiwuge cegi cedaidukare, ceroiwakare jiboe reore.
source: Du kejere ere brae eimejerage eerdudo ei, tagoi oino du tabo: - Awu imere judeudogere emage, enure pago bakurireu tadawuge etago turugoduwo, enure boe eerduwado erowo nono Roma pijiwuge cegi cedaidukare, ceroiwakare jiboe reore.

b: Du kodi icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge ere turagojedu turugoduwo ei. Icare brae eiemejerage ere boedo ekudae tawuje tuwo iwara to ei.
source: Du kodi icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge ere turagojedu turugoduwo ei. Icare brae eiemejerage ere boedo ekudae tawuje tuwo iwara to ei.

b: Ere iwara to ei du tabore ere ecebae kuricigodo, du kejere ere etugu baicoreuto, egore jeture eiwuji jetu pemegawo ei.
source: Ere iwara to ei du tabore ere ecebae kuricigodo, du kejere ere etugu baicoreuto, egore jeture eiwuji jetu pemegawo ei.

b: Nowure icare meartorure tugimejerage ewadaruji du koiare ure etugu baicoreuto toro upo kae, ure ewure gogudo iku meriri tabo, ure nowu meriri iku kogudo ipo kajeje pugeje tuku.
source: Nowure icare meartorure tugimejerage ewadaruji du koiare ure etugu baicoreuto toro upo kae, ure ewure gogudo iku meriri tabo, ure nowu meriri iku kogudo ipo kajeje pugeje tuku.

b: Boekimorema, boeco oia keje, Paulo mare Sila enogwamagudu nure Paoji, era nure Pao o roia pemegareuji; meture baicoreu tadawuge ewiapagare ei.
source: Boekimorema, boeco oia keje, Paulo mare Sila enogwamagudu nure Paoji, era nure Pao o roia pemegareuji; meture baicoreu tadawuge ewiapagare ei.

b: Kuri je du kejere icare, moto amagadu kuricigore, du kodire nowu baicoreu bure amagadure jamedu. Icare baiporodoge ere tuiado, mugure baicoreu tadawuge ewure kajejewu iku meriri ure tugiwuje jamedu.
source: Kuri je du kejere icare, moto amagadu kuricigore, du kodire nowu baicoreu bure amagadure jamedu. Icare baiporodoge ere tuiado, mugure baicoreu tadawuge ewure kajejewu iku meriri ure tugiwuje jamedu.

b: Icare nowu jeture eiwu imedu jetadure, jordure baiporodoge ei tuiado duji, icare meardaere meture baicoreu tadawuge eregoduie marigudu duji. Icare ure toriga raireu tawuje tuwo tuwido.
source: Icare nowu jeture eiwu imedu jetadure, jordure baiporodoge ei tuiado duji, icare meardaere meture baicoreu tadawuge eregoduie marigudu duji. Icare ure toriga raireu tawuje tuwo tuwido.

b: Macare Paulo oiogwarire ji, akore: - Akaba akogorido! Cemugure woe ceiamedu tabo.
source: Macare Paulo oiogwarire ji, akore: - Akaba akogorido! Cemugure woe ceiamedu tabo.

b: Du kejere, nowu jeture eiwu makore jorugu bogai, icare ure turemo nowu baito, ure tuwu tai je Paulo mare Sila ewure paru.
source: Du kejere, nowu jeture eiwu makore jorugu bogai, icare ure turemo nowu baito, ure tuwu tai je Paulo mare Sila ewure paru.

b: Du kejere ure turagojedo, ure erego baawadu kae, unorare ei, akore: - Ikimejerage, inoba iromode iwo ikinorudo?
source: Du kejere ure turagojedo, ure erego baawadu kae, unorare ei, akore: - Ikimejerage, inoba iromode iwo ikinorudo?

b: Icare egore ji: - Ameartorudo Pagimejera Jesus Cristoji, du tabore amode akinorudo, aki awobe eiamedu tabo.
source: Icare egore ji: - Ameartorudo Pagimejera Jesus Cristoji, du tabore amode akinorudo, aki awobe eiamedu tabo.

b: Icare ere Pao bataru kogado ji, uwobei jamedu.
source: Icare ere Pao bataru kogado ji, uwobei jamedu.

b: Icare nowu boeco mitoduji, ure jetu pemegare ei, ure ecebae kabi. Kuri je du kejere icare ere ao pegodo jamedu.
source: Icare nowu boeco mitoduji, ure jetu pemegare ei, ure ecebae kabi. Kuri je du kejere icare ere ao pegodo jamedu.

b: Du kejere ure erego toro tuwai kae coboji, ure eke pemegado, icare jekare kuricigore, tuwobe eiamedu tabo, icai tumeartorui Pao jitu koia.
source: Du kejere ure erego toro tuwai kae coboji, ure eke pemegado, icare jekare kuricigore, tuwobe eiamedu tabo, icai tumeartorui Pao jitu koia.

b: Barogwatore icare brae eimejerage ere ia tugobaigarege emagodo ji. Nowu ime etawuje, etudo.
source: Barogwatore icare brae eimejerage ere ia tugobaigarege emagodo ji. Nowu ime etawuje, etudo.

b: Icare nowu jeture baicoreu jiwu imedu readodure Paulo biegai, akore: - Nowu ikimejerage emagore iwiegai iwo taginorudo, du kodi icare tadawuje, tadudo boe butugureu tabo.
source: Icare nowu jeture baicoreu jiwu imedu readodure Paulo biegai, akore: - Nowu ikimejerage emagore iwiegai iwo taginorudo, du kodi icare tadawuje, tadudo boe butugureu tabo.

b: Macare Paulo akore: - Roma kejewugere cegi, du kodi karega ere iwara to cei boe eegai, icare ere cedugu baicoreuto tukai tugogado cei du tabo. Macare oino ere cedo cedawuje oino podu tabo. Umodukare ino! Etuwo mato cedae, ewo cegiwuje tugera tabo ewo cedawuje awu piji.
source: Macare Paulo akore: - Roma kejewugere cegi, du kodi karega ere iwara to cei boe eegai, icare ere cedugu baicoreuto tukai tugogado cei du tabo. Macare oino ere cedo cedawuje oino podu tabo. Umodukare ino! Etuwo mato cedae, ewo cegiwuje tugera tabo ewo cedawuje awu piji.

b: Icare nowu tugobaigarege ereadodure nowu bataruji nowu brae eimejerage ewiegai, duwugere epagudugodure tumeardui Roma kejewugeie emage.
source: Icare nowu tugobaigarege ereadodure nowu bataruji nowu brae eimejerage ewiegai, duwugere epagudugodure tumeardui Roma kejewugeie emage.

b: Icare eture toro etae, emagore ei butugu tabo, emagore ewo tuwudugugo pudui, enogwamagudure ei etuwo nowu bakurireu piji.
source: Icare eture toro etae, emagore ei butugu tabo, emagore ewo tuwudugugo pudui, enogwamagudure ei etuwo nowu bakurireu piji.
