b: Icare ere tudawuje nowu bakurireu piji, du kejere icare ere turemo Lídia uwaito, du tadare eerdure tuwiemagei, ere emeardu awadudo pudui pugeje, du kejere eture nowu bakurireu piji.
source: Icare ere tudawuje nowu bakurireu piji, du kejere icare ere turemo Lídia uwaito, du tadare eerdure tuwiemagei, ere emeardu awadudo pudui pugeje, du kejere eture nowu bakurireu piji.

b: Paulo mare Sila emugui Tessalônica kejedu.
source: Paulo mare Sila emugui Tessalônica kejedu.

b: Ere pagado Anfípoli bakurireu kajeje, du kejere ere pagado Apolônia bakurireu kajeje, icare etaregodure Tessalônica bakurireuto. Nonore judeudoge ia eno sinagoga mugure.
source: Ere pagado Anfípoli bakurireu kajeje, du kejere ere pagado Apolônia bakurireu kajeje, icare etaregodure Tessalônica bakurireuto. Nonore judeudoge ia eno sinagoga mugure.

b: Icare Paulo uture etae turorewoji, icare makore ei, emagore ji, emagore pui puibagi, sabadore ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Icare Paulo uture etae turorewoji, icare makore ei, emagore ji, emagore pui puibagi, sabadore ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b: Readodure ewiegai, ure eerduwado Pao o bapera tabo uie turugadu Cristowo tuiwodo dukeje tuiewoduwo bireuge epiji duji. - Awu ireadodure tawiegaiwu Jesus, emare Cristo rema. oinore akore ei.
source: Readodure ewiegai, ure eerduwado Pao o bapera tabo uie turugadu Cristowo tuiwodo dukeje tuiewoduwo bireuge epiji duji. - Awu ireadodure tawiegaiwu Jesus, emare Cristo rema. oinore akore ei.

b: Icare ia emage emeartorure Paoji, ere tumedagedo Paulo, Sila magece. Ia judeukare emawu makareuge duwugere emeartorure Paoji marigudu, mare ia areme kurireuge, ere tumedagedo emage jamedu.
source: Icare ia emage emeartorure Paoji, ere tumedagedo Paulo, Sila magece. Ia judeukare emawu makareuge duwugere emeartorure Paoji marigudu, mare ia areme kurireuge, ere tumedagedo emage jamedu.

b: Icare judeudoge ekorire ei, ere ia ime eto pui du tabore icare ere boedo turagojedo turugoduwo ei. Icare eture Jason uwai kae, ere turemo to, tuiemarui ewogai tuwo emagu boe etai ewo ewido.
source: Icare judeudoge ekorire ei, ere ia ime eto pui du tabore icare ere boedo turagojedo turugoduwo ei. Icare eture Jason uwai kae, ere turemo to, tuiemarui ewogai tuwo emagu boe etai ewo ewido.

b: Mare eerdukare ei nono, du kodi icare ere tugeragu Jasonji, ia Pao uwobe ebo, icare ere erego toro brae eiemejerage eegai egore: - Awuge ere boedo turugoduwo pui boe jamedu boe keje. Icare emugure oino woe. Icare Jason ure tugeragu ei tuwai tada.
source: Mare eerdukare ei nono, du kodi icare ere tugeragu Jasonji, ia Pao uwobe ebo, icare ere erego toro brae eiemejerage eegai egore: - Awuge ere boedo turugoduwo pui boe jamedu boe keje. Icare emugure oino woe. Icare Jason ure tugeragu ei tuwai tada.

b: Eiamedu etonare pagimejera kurireu Cesarji, tui ia eimejera kurireu mugudo mugato, dure Jesus reno.
source: Eiamedu etonare pagimejera kurireu Cesarji, tui ia eimejera kurireu mugudo mugato, dure Jesus reno.

b: Awu tuwadaru tabore ere boe ekorigo, ere eiemejerage ekorigo.
source: Awu tuwadaru tabore ere boe ekorigo, ere eiemejerage ekorigo.

b: Macare Jason mare ia uwobe ere diiero maku etai, du kejere ere etudo.
source: Macare Jason mare ia uwobe ere diiero maku etai, du kejere ere etudo.

b: Icare, boeco aregodure du keje, Pao uwobe ere Paulo mare Sila etudo Beréia bakurireu kae. Etaregodure to du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataruji tadawu baito.
source: Icare, boeco aregodure du keje, Pao uwobe ere Paulo mare Sila etudo Beréia bakurireu kae. Etaregodure to du kejere icare ere turemo judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataruji tadawu baito.

b: Awu judeudoge epemega kodure nowu Tessalônica tadawuge epemega kori, du kodi icare ere tugeragu Pao bataruji taidu kuricigo tabo. Eemarure Pao o bapera keje umode ino rugadu du bogai.
source: Awu judeudoge epemega kodure nowu Tessalônica tadawuge epemega kori, du kodi icare ere tugeragu Pao bataruji taidu kuricigo tabo. Eemarure Pao o bapera keje umode ino rugadu du bogai.

b: Makareuge emeartorure Paoji, ia judeukare emawu areme kurireuge emeartorure jamedu, ia ime makareuge emeartorure jamedu.
source: Makareuge emeartorure Paoji, ia judeukare emawu areme kurireuge emeartorure jamedu, ia ime makareuge emeartorure jamedu.

b: Macare nowu Tessalôica kejewu judeudoge ere boe pa Pauloie Pao bataru kogado Beréia keje duji, du koiare icare eture toro tuwo nowu boe erugo ji pugeje.
source: Macare nowu Tessalôica kejewu judeudoge ere boe pa Pauloie Pao bataru kogado Beréia keje duji, du koiare icare eture toro tuwo nowu boe erugo ji pugeje.

b: Du kodi icare Pao uwobe ere Paulo utudo nowu piji toro pobo maereu okwa kae. Sila mare Timóteo emugure nono.
source: Du kodi icare Pao uwobe ere Paulo utudo nowu piji toro pobo maereu okwa kae. Sila mare Timóteo emugure nono.

b:
Uture Paulo apowuge ere reko Atenas bakurireu kae, du pijire ere tugirimi tuibagi, icare emagore Sila mare Timóteo ewiegai Paulo bataruji, etuwo tuwogai kuri je.
Paulo uwadodae Atenas kejedu.
source:
Uture Paulo apowuge ere reko Atenas bakurireu kae, du pijire ere tugirimi tuibagi, icare emagore Sila mare Timóteo ewiegai Paulo bataruji, etuwo tuwogai kuri je.
Paulo uwadodae Atenas kejedu.

b: Paulo paga nure tumedage ewogai Atenas bakurireu keje, du tonajire icare kiarigodu kuricigore tuiordui boe emugui Paokare emawuge ekuda duji kodi.
source: Paulo paga nure tumedage ewogai Atenas bakurireu keje, du tonajire icare kiarigodu kuricigore tuiordui boe emugui Paokare emawuge ekuda duji kodi.

b: Meri jameduji mako makore judeudogei, meartorure Pao jiwu judeukare emawugei, jordure ji bororo jiwugei jamedu.
source: Meri jameduji mako makore judeudogei, meartorure Pao jiwu judeukare emawugei, jordure ji bororo jiwugei jamedu.

b: Ia jorduwareuge, epicureuge, estoicodoge emagore ji. Iage egore: - Kaba jiba awu mako paga pagareu akoino?  Iage egore: - Readodu nure Aroe Eimejerage maiwugei rakudu.
source: Ia jorduwareuge, epicureuge, estoicodoge emagore ji. Iage egore: - Kaba jiba awu mako paga pagareu akoino?  Iage egore: - Readodu nure Aroe Eimejerage maiwugei rakudu.

b: Du kodi icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko toro pudabo, jorduwareuge ewai kae, icare egore ji: amagodo: Kakoduwu bataru maiwu jiba akagoino?
source: Du kodi icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko toro pudabo, jorduwareuge ewai kae, icare egore ji: amagodo: Kakoduwu bataru maiwu jiba akagoino?

b: Cemeardure aiabiji jiboe ure tuginoi ceegai. Cedaidure ceerduwawo kaboba jiba akagoino.
source: Cemeardure aiabiji jiboe ure tuginoi ceegai. Cedaidure ceerduwawo kaboba jiba akagoino.

b: Paga karega, Atenas kejewuge, aregodure Atenas kaewuge, erokare ia turo, mare etaidure tuiorduwawo kakoduwu bataru maiwu jiboe egoino tu je.
source: Paga karega, Atenas kejewuge, aregodure Atenas kaewuge, erokare ia turo, mare etaidure tuiorduwawo kakoduwu bataru maiwu jiboe egoino tu je.

b: Icare Paulore turagojedo nowu jorduwareuge ewai oiabiji, akore: - Atenas kejewu ime, inure boe pa tameartoru kuricigoi Aroe Eimejerage eiduji.
source: Icare Paulore turagojedo nowu jorduwareuge ewai oiabiji, akore: - Atenas kejewu ime, inure boe pa tameartoru kuricigoi Aroe Eimejerage eiduji.

b: Imerure tago bakurireu kao, du tabore iordure tare tabujodo jiwu tagoroei, icare itaregodure ia tago Aroe Eimejera muga kae du kejere atugododure oino: - Boe eerduwakare jiwu Aroe Eimejera ai. Oino. Ica, tare tabujodo ji taerduwakai jitu tabowu Aroe Eimejera jire ireadodu nure tawiegai.
source: Imerure tago bakurireu kao, du tabore iordure tare tabujodo jiwu tagoroei, icare itaregodure ia tago Aroe Eimejera muga kae du kejere atugododure oino: - Boe eerduwakare jiwu Aroe Eimejera ai. Oino. Ica, tare tabujodo ji taerduwakai jitu tabowu Aroe Eimejera jire ireadodu nure tawiegai.

b: Ure awu moto towuje, ure mugure kejewu boe jamedu boe towujewu Pao Kurireu rema. Ore awu moto, awu baru rema. Mugukare ime ere towujewu baidoge etada.
source: Ure awu moto towuje, ure mugure kejewu boe jamedu boe towujewu Pao Kurireu rema. Ore awu moto, awu baru rema. Mugukare ime ere towujewu baidoge etada.

b: Makokare boewo tugerabraredo pudui, okeakare iaboe bogai iaboe bogai. Emare ure boe eiamedu jedo, ure ake arego boe eiamedu ja piji, ure boe jamedu boe maku boe etai.
source: Makokare boewo tugerabraredo pudui, okeakare iaboe bogai iaboe bogai. Emare ure boe eiamedu jedo, ure ake arego boe eiamedu ja piji, ure boe jamedu boe maku boe etai.

b: Ure ime eiamedu botudo ia imedu mito tu je du piji, emuguwo awu moto jamedu boe kao. Ure eno joru, eno moto ure remagu etai.
source: Ure ime eiamedu botudo ia imedu mito tu je du piji, emuguwo awu moto jamedu boe kao. Ure eno joru, eno moto ure remagu etai.

b: Aidure boe eiamedu boe eemaruwo Pao Kurireu bogai, etaregoduwo ae, eerduwo ji. Ica, Pao Aroe Eimejera mugu jaekare pai.
source: Aidure boe eiamedu boe eemaruwo Pao Kurireu bogai, etaregoduwo ae, eerduwo ji. Ica, Pao Aroe Eimejera mugu jaekare pai.

b: Paga karega, tadare pamugure, tadare pamagadure, tadare paragojere. Umagai ia tageroia epa akore: “Pagi jamedu uwobere pagi”.
source: Paga karega, tadare pamugure, tadare pamagadure, tadare paragojere. Umagai ia tageroia epa akore: “Pagi jamedu uwobere pagi”.

b: Kode Pao Kurireu uwobere pagi du keje, pameardaemodukare Pao Kurireuie nono meriri ekureu, iarema meriri kigadureu, iarema imere towuje tuiorduwa tabowu tori mori kurireu reore.
source: Kode Pao Kurireu uwobere pagi du keje, pameardaemodukare Pao Kurireuie nono meriri ekureu, iarema meriri kigadureu, iarema imere towuje tuiorduwa tabowu tori mori kurireu reore.

b: Mare Pao Kurireu aiwokare ime eerduwakai puduidu kodiwoji. Oino mako nure padure boe jamedu boe kejewu ime eiamedu bogai ewo tugirimi pudae tuibagi.
source: Mare Pao Kurireu aiwokare ime eerduwakai puduidu kodiwoji. Oino mako nure padure boe jamedu boe kejewu ime eiamedu bogai ewo tugirimi pudae tuibagi.

b: Jorduware tumode tugogado awu moto kejewu ime eiamedu boei du kejewu meriji. Aidure tuwo tugogado ime eiamedu boei ia imedu mito tu jewu maragodae tabo. Ure awu inodu awadudo boe eegai, tui nowu imedu jewodudo bireuge epiji du tabo.
source: Jorduware tumode tugogado awu moto kejewu ime eiamedu boei du kejewu meriji. Aidure tuwo tugogado ime eiamedu boei ia imedu mito tu jewu maragodae tabo. Ure awu inodu awadudo boe eegai, tui nowu imedu jewodudo bireuge epiji du tabo.

b: Icare emeardure makoi boe ewodumodeduji du keje, ia emage ewadarurerure ji, iage egore: - Piji jao, ia boe keje cemeardumode awu akoinoduji pugeje.
source: Icare emeardure makoi boe ewodumodeduji du keje, ia emage ewadarurerure ji, iage egore: - Piji jao, ia boe keje cemeardumode awu akoinoduji pugeje.

b: Du kodi icare Paulore tudawuje epiji.
source: Du kodi icare Paulore tudawuje epiji.

b: Boekimorema, ia ime enogwaceradu Paulo jaogwai, emeartorure bataruji, duwuge etada Dionísio jorduwa rakareu mugure, mare ia aredu iei Dêmaris mare iage emugure jamedu.
source: Boekimorema, ia ime enogwaceradu Paulo jaogwai, emeartorure bataruji, duwuge etada Dionísio jorduwa rakareu mugure, mare ia aredu iei Dêmaris mare iage emugure jamedu.

b: Paulo mugui Corinto kejedu.
source: Paulo mugui Corinto kejedu.

b: Nowu inodu rekodajire icare Paulore tudawuje Atenas bakurireu piji, icare uture Corinto bakurireu kae.
source: Nowu inodu rekodajire icare Paulore tudawuje Atenas bakurireu piji, icare uture Corinto bakurireu kae.

b: Nonore jordure ia judeu iei Aquila cedu, Ponto pijiwu, oreduje apo duji, Awuge etaregodure maigodu Itália piji. Brae eimejera kurireu iei Cláudio cedu ure judeudoge eiamedu edo tudawuje Roma piji kodi. Icare Paulore tumedagedo emage.
source: Nonore jordure ia judeu iei Aquila cedu, Ponto pijiwu, oreduje apo duji, Awuge etaregodure maigodu Itália piji. Brae eimejera kurireu iei Cláudio cedu ure judeudoge eiamedu edo tudawuje Roma piji kodi. Icare Paulore tumedagedo emage.

b: Emaragodaere pureore, du kodi icare mugure ebo, maragodu nure ebo jamedu (Ere aroia bai towuje brae ewaice).
source: Emaragodaere pureore, du kodi icare mugure ebo, maragodu nure ebo jamedu (Ere aroia bai towuje brae ewaice).

b: Sábado jameduji mako makore sinagoga bai tada, ure tubewudo tuwo judeudoge, gregodoge emeartorudo.
source: Sábado jameduji mako makore sinagoga bai tada, ure tubewudo tuwo judeudoge, gregodoge emeartorudo.

b: Du kejere icare Sila, mare Timóteo etaregodure Macedônia moto piji. Icare Paulore tumagu tuiamedu tabo tuwo Pao bataru kogado, mako makore judeudoge ewiegai Jesusie ure Cristo rema duji.
source: Du kejere icare Sila, mare Timóteo etaregodure Macedônia moto piji. Icare Paulore tumagu tuiamedu tabo tuwo Pao bataru kogado, mako makore judeudoge ewiegai Jesusie ure Cristo rema duji.

b: Nowugerema emeartorukare, emago pegare ji, du kodi icare ure tugudae aroia jukodo ei, akore ei: - Tagu butuwo taiogi. Ikera rorogodukare. Ica, awu otobiji iemarumode judeukare emawuge ewogai.
source: Nowugerema emeartorukare, emago pegare ji, du kodi icare ure tugudae aroia jukodo ei, akore ei: - Tagu butuwo taiogi. Ikera rorogodukare. Ica, awu otobiji iemarumode judeukare emawuge ewogai.

b: Icare ure tudawuje nowu piji, ure turemo ia judeukare emawu meartorure Pao jiwu iei Tito Jetororeu cedu uwaito, uwai mugure nowu sinagoga bai meki.
source: Icare ure tudawuje nowu piji, ure turemo ia judeukare emawu meartorure Pao jiwu iei Tito Jetororeu cedu uwaito, uwai mugure nowu sinagoga bai meki.

b: Du inodu tabo ia imedu iei Crispo cedu, nowu sinagoga bai kejewuge eimejera, meartorure Paoji uwobe apo du kodire, Corinto bakurireu tadawu ia makareuge emeardure Paulo bataruji, emeartorure jamedu, icare etao pegododure.
source: Du inodu tabo ia imedu iei Crispo cedu, nowu sinagoga bai kejewuge eimejera, meartorure Paoji uwobe apo du kodire, Corinto bakurireu tadawu ia makareuge emeardure Paulo bataruji, emeartorure jamedu, icare etao pegododure.

b: Icare ia boecoji Pao makore Pauloji unuiao pemegareu tada, akore: - Apagudu kaba, amagodo boei, amago bokwa kaba. Ica, iragojere akabo.
source: Icare ia boecoji Pao makore Pauloji unuiao pemegareu tada, akore: - Apagudu kaba, amagodo boei, amago bokwa kaba. Ica, iragojere akabo.

b: Iaboe iaboe emodukare tuburedo ai tuwo akogorido, iwobe emagare awu bakurireu tada du kodi.
source: Iaboe iaboe emodukare tuburedo ai tuwo akogorido, iwobe emagare awu bakurireu tada du kodi.

b:
Paulo rakojere nono joru mito, ari ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, unure boe eerduwado Pao bataruji.	
Paulo rakojei brae eimejera jekaidu.
source:
Paulo rakojere nono joru mito, ari ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, unure boe eerduwado Pao bataruji.	
Paulo rakojei brae eimejera jekaidu.

b: Nowu Acaia moto kejewuge eimejera Galião rema, du tabore nowu judeudoge ere turagojedo tuiamedu tabo Paulo togi. Icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko brae eiemejera ae, egore: -
source: Nowu Acaia moto kejewuge eimejera Galião rema, du tabore nowu judeudoge ere turagojedo tuiamedu tabo Paulo togi. Icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko brae eiemejera ae, egore: -

b: Awu imedu ure boedo tubujodo ia Aroe Eimejera ukai nono judeudoge eroiagudu reoreduji.
source: Awu imedu ure boedo tubujodo ia Aroe Eimejera ukai nono judeudoge eroiagudu reoreduji.

b: Icare Paulo aidure tumagowo, macare nowu brae eimejera Galião makore judeudogei, akore: - Awu inodu umode ia boe ero pegareu rugadu du keje, umode turugadu iwiapagawo tai.
source: Icare Paulo aidure tumagowo, macare nowu brae eimejera Galião makore judeudogei, akore: - Awu inodu umode ia boe ero pegareu rugadu du keje, umode turugadu iwiapagawo tai.

b: Mare taerduwa reno, taroiagudu reno, du kodire tagire tamode tagogado ji. Itaidukare iwo ikogado awu inoduji.
source: Mare taerduwa reno, taroiagudu reno, du kodire tagire tamode tagogado ji. Itaidukare iwo ikogado awu inoduji.

b: Icare ure etudo nowu bai piji.
source: Icare ure etudo nowu bai piji.

b:
Du kodi icare eiamedure tugeragu Sostenesji, nowu sinagoga kejewuge eimejera, ere boe to ji nowu brae eiemejera jekai. Du tabore nowu brae eiemejera Galião makokare iaboeji.
Pauloi tugirimi Antioquia kaedu.
source:
Du kodi icare eiamedure tugeragu Sostenesji, nowu sinagoga kejewuge eimejera, ere boe to ji nowu brae eiemejera jekai. Du tabore nowu brae eiemejera Galião makokare iaboeji.
Pauloi tugirimi Antioquia kaedu.

b: Paulo mugure Corinto tada biega tu je kimo, du kejere ure tugimadudo nowu Pao uwobe epiji, icare uture ika kurireu tabo Síria moto kae. Priscila, mare Aquila ekodure apo jamedu. Mare etaregodumode Síria kaedu otodai, Paulo rakojere jao Cencréia ba kurireu tada tuwo tao rawuje, ia boe keje makore Paoji oinoie turomode pudui du kodi.
source: Paulo mugure Corinto tada biega tu je kimo, du kejere ure tugimadudo nowu Pao uwobe epiji, icare uture ika kurireu tabo Síria moto kae. Priscila, mare Aquila ekodure apo jamedu. Mare etaregodumode Síria kaedu otodai, Paulo rakojere jao Cencréia ba kurireu tada tuwo tao rawuje, ia boe keje makore Paoji oinoie turomode pudui du kodi.

b: Du kejere etaregodure Éfeso bakurireu kae du tadare ure nowuge ei pobedu mugudo nono. Emare ure turemo sinagoga baito du tadare makore nowu judeudogei.
source: Du kejere etaregodure Éfeso bakurireu kae du tadare ure nowuge ei pobedu mugudo nono. Emare ure turemo sinagoga baito du tadare makore nowu judeudogei.

b: Awuge enogwamagudure ji muguwo nono ebo kimo, mare aidukare.
source: Awuge enogwamagudure ji muguwo nono ebo kimo, mare aidukare.

b: Imadure ebo tuberabiji, akore: - Imode ikirimi tawogai Pao aidumode du keje. Du kejere icare uture nowu Éfeso piji.
source: Imadure ebo tuberabiji, akore: - Imode ikirimi tawogai Pao aidumode du keje. Du kejere icare uture nowu Éfeso piji.

b: Uture jii Cesaréia moto kae, icare ruture Jerusalém bakurireu kae, cimaduwo nowu Pao uwobe ebo, du pijire kuri je ure turawuje Antioquia kae.
source: Uture jii Cesaréia moto kae, icare ruture Jerusalém bakurireu kae, cimaduwo nowu Pao uwobe ebo, du pijire kuri je ure turawuje Antioquia kae.

b:
Nonore mugure biega tu je, du kejere uture pugeje ure pagado Galácia moto kajeje, icare ure pagado Frígia moto kajeje, tui Pao uwobe emeardu awadudo pudui du tabo.
Apolo maragodae Éfeso kejedu.
source:
Nonore mugure biega tu je, du kejere uture pugeje ure pagado Galácia moto kajeje, icare ure pagado Frígia moto kajeje, tui Pao uwobe emeardu awadudo pudui du tabo.
Apolo maragodae Éfeso kejedu.

b: Du tonajire icare ia judeu iei Apolo cedu, ia Alexandria pijiwu imedu, mako pemegareu, jorduwa kuricigore Pao bataru jiwu imedu, aregodure Éfeso bakurireuto.
source: Du tonajire icare ia judeu iei Apolo cedu, ia Alexandria pijiwu imedu, mako pemegareu, jorduwa kuricigore Pao bataru jiwu imedu, aregodure Éfeso bakurireuto.

b: Emare jorduwa rakare Pao utawaraji, mako kuricigore tumeardae pemegareu tabo Jesus jiboeji, jorduware João o boe etao pegoji tu rugadu kodi karega.
source: Emare jorduwa rakare Pao utawaraji, mako kuricigore tumeardae pemegareu tabo Jesus jiboeji, jorduware João o boe etao pegoji tu rugadu kodi karega.

b: Du kodire makore nowu sinagoga bai tada tubagudu bokwa tabo. Icare Priscila, Aquila emeardure ji, du kodi icare ere ko pudabo ere Pao utawara awadudodu pemegado jekai.
source: Du kodire makore nowu sinagoga bai tada tubagudu bokwa tabo. Icare Priscila, Aquila emeardure ji, du kodi icare ere ko pudabo ere Pao utawara awadudodu pemegado jekai.

b: Icare aidure tuduwo Acáia moto kae, du kodi icare Éfeso tadawu meartorureuge ere meardu awadudo pudui, ere aidudo, ere bapera atugodo nowu Acáia kejewu meartorureuge etai ewo tugeragu ji. Tumugui toro du tabore ure tugera braredodu kuricigodo nowu meartorureugei Pao o boe pemegareu koia.
source: Icare aidure tuduwo Acáia moto kae, du kodi icare Éfeso tadawu meartorureuge ere meardu awadudo pudui, ere aidudo, ere bapera atugodo nowu Acáia kejewu meartorureuge etai ewo tugeragu ji. Tumugui toro du tabore ure tugera braredodu kuricigodo nowu meartorureugei Pao o boe pemegareu koia.

b: Ure tumago rakado judeudoge ewadaru jipagi boe eegai, tui eerduwado, Pao o bapera tabo, Cristoie ure Jesusce duji.
source: Ure tumago rakado judeudoge ewadaru jipagi boe eegai, tui eerduwado, Pao o bapera tabo, Cristoie ure Jesusce duji.

b: Éfeso kejewu Joãore jorduwadowuge.
source: Éfeso kejewu Joãore jorduwadowuge.

b: Apolo mugui Corinto bakurireu tada du tonaji, Paulore pagado mugure cobojiwu moto kajeje, icare aregodure Éfeso bakurireuto. Nonore jordure ia meartorureugei, unorare ei, akore: -
source: Apolo mugui Corinto bakurireu tada du tonaji, Paulore pagado mugure cobojiwu moto kajeje, icare aregodure Éfeso bakurireuto. Nonore jordure ia meartorureugei, unorare ei, akore: -

b: Nowu tameartorure boetoji du kodiboe keje, Aroe Pemegareu makudure tagai?
source: Nowu tameartorure boetoji du kodiboe keje, Aroe Pemegareu makudure tagai?

b: Icare egore ji: - Boro. Mare cemeardukare Aroe Pemegareuie ure duji jamedu. 3. Icare Paulo akore: - Kode, kakoduwu boe etao pegododu taboba tagao pegore?  Egore: - João o boe etao pego tabore cedao pegododure.
source: Icare egore ji: - Boro. Mare cemeardukare Aroe Pemegareuie ure duji jamedu. 3. Icare Paulo akore: - Kode, kakoduwu boe etao pegododu taboba tagao pegore?  Egore: - João o boe etao pego tabore cedao pegododure.

b: Icare Paulo akore: - Joãore boe etao pegodo boe eedorore tabowu boe etao pego tabo, makore boei emeartoruwo aregodumode turegodajiwu imeduji, duwure Jesus rema.
source: Icare Paulo akore: - Joãore boe etao pegodo boe eedorore tabowu boe etao pego tabo, makore boei emeartoruwo aregodumode turegodajiwu imeduji, duwure Jesus rema.

b: Emeardure awu inodu jitu kejere icare etao pegododure Pagimejera Jesus ie tabo.
source: Emeardure awu inodu jitu kejere icare etao pegododure Pagimejera Jesus ie tabo.

b: Icare Paulore tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje. Icare emagore boe ewadaru tuginoiwuji, emagore Pao bataruji jamedu.
source: Icare Paulore tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje. Icare emagore boe ewadaru tuginoiwuji, emagore Pao bataruji jamedu.

b:
Nowu ime ere pagera pudogidure ere pobe pugeje.
Pao uwobe ei tuguo Éfeso bakurireu tadadu.
source:
Nowu ime ere pagera pudogidure ere pobe pugeje.
Pao uwobe ei tuguo Éfeso bakurireu tadadu.

b: Icare Paulore turemo sinagoga baito du tadare readodure Pao bataruji tubagudu bokwa tabo, Arire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ure eerduwado Pao o boe pemegareuji.
source: Icare Paulore turemo sinagoga baito du tadare readodure Pao bataruji tubagudu bokwa tabo, Arire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ure eerduwado Pao o boe pemegareuji.

b: Mare ia emage emeartorukare, ewabo rakare, emago pega kuricigore Pao bataruji boe eegai, du kodi icare Paulore tuiaedo ei. Icare ure meartorureuge eto pui pudabo, ure eerduwado meri jameduji, ia imedu iei Tirano cedu uwai tada.
source: Mare ia emage emeartorukare, ewabo rakare, emago pega kuricigore Pao bataruji boe eegai, du kodi icare Paulore tuiaedo ei. Icare ure meartorureuge eto pui pudabo, ure eerduwado meri jameduji, ia imedu iei Tirano cedu uwai tada.

b: Oinore ure jorui pobedu keje. Du kodire Asia kejewuge eiamedu boe, judeudoge, judeukare emawuge emeardure Pao bataruji.
source: Oinore ure jorui pobedu keje. Du kodire Asia kejewuge eiamedu boe, judeudoge, judeukare emawuge emeardure Pao bataruji.

b: Paore turo kurireu towuje towuje Paulo iera tabo. Du kodire ere jore Paulo jiwu kigadureu aroiarogu, mare ia aroia boe reko kogodureuge etai.
source: Paore turo kurireu towuje towuje Paulo iera tabo. Du kodire ere jore Paulo jiwu kigadureu aroiarogu, mare ia aroia boe reko kogodureuge etai.

b: Du keje epemegagodure, Aroe pegareure tudawuj tumedure tadawuge epiji jamedu.
source: Du keje epemegagodure, Aroe pegareure tudawuj tumedure tadawuge epiji jamedu.

b: Boekarema, ia judeudoge, duwugere Aroe pegareuge ewarigu boe epiji jamedu, emerure nono, icare ere tumeardae tawuje tuwo Aroe pegareuge ewarigu Jesus ie tabo Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji. Icare egore Aroe pegareu dogei: - Cenure tado etadawuje Paulo readodure jiwu Jesus ie tabo.
source: Boekarema, ia judeudoge, duwugere Aroe pegareuge ewarigu boe epiji jamedu, emerure nono, icare ere tumeardae tawuje tuwo Aroe pegareuge ewarigu Jesus ie tabo Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji. Icare egore Aroe pegareu dogei: - Cenure tado etadawuje Paulo readodure jiwu Jesus ie tabo.

b: Rore oinowugere ia sacerdote judeu iei Scevas cedu ore nure emage.
source: Rore oinowugere ia sacerdote judeu iei Scevas cedu ore nure emage.

b: Macare Aroe pegareu akore ewadaru jipagi, akore: - Iorduware Jesusji, iorduware Pauloji, tagirema, kakoduwuge tagiba?
source: Macare Aroe pegareu akore ewadaru jipagi, akore: - Iorduware Jesusji, iorduware Pauloji, tagirema, kakoduwuge tagiba?

b: Du tabore nowu Aroe pegareu meture tadawu imedu ure taredo ewugeje, ure etogorido, du koiare eregodure nowu bai piji, togoridodu tabo, tugudae aroia mega mega rogu tabo.
source: Du tabore nowu Aroe pegareu meture tadawu imedu ure taredo ewugeje, ure etogorido, du koiare eregodure nowu bai piji, togoridodu tabo, tugudae aroia mega mega rogu tabo.

b: Awu bakaru aregodure nowu mugure Éfeso bakurireu tadawu judeudoge eiamedu boe, gregodoge eiamedu boe etae. Icare eiamedu pagudugodu kuricigore. Kodi icare ere Pagimejera Jesus ie kurido.
source: Awu bakaru aregodure nowu mugure Éfeso bakurireu tadawu judeudoge eiamedu boe, gregodoge eiamedu boe etae. Icare eiamedu pagudugodu kuricigore. Kodi icare ere Pagimejera Jesus ie kurido.

b: Icare makareuge etaregodure tumagowo turo pegareuji.
source: Icare makareuge etaregodure tumagowo turo pegareuji.

b: Ia makareuge emaragodure  Aroe pegareuge ebo, duwugere to bapera arego, ere kowu boe eiamedu jekai. Nowu baperadoge emori kuricigore kodi karega.
source: Ia makareuge emaragodure  Aroe pegareuge ebo, duwugere to bapera arego, ere kowu boe eiamedu jekai. Nowu baperadoge emori kuricigore kodi karega.

b:
Oinore Pao bataru ure tugidado, ure taododu kuricigodo.
Paulo mearudae.
source:
Oinore Pao bataru ure tugidado, ure taododu kuricigodo.
Paulo mearudae.

b: Du kejere Paulo aidure tuduwo Jerusalemto, mare umode pagado Macedônia moto kajeje, Acáia moto kajeje jao. Icare akore: - Imugumode toro (Jerusalém keje) du keje umode turugadu ituwo Roma bakurireu kae jorduwo ji.
source: Du kejere Paulo aidure tuduwo Jerusalemto, mare umode pagado Macedônia moto kajeje, Acáia moto kajeje jao. Icare akore: - Imugumode toro (Jerusalém keje) du keje umode turugadu ituwo Roma bakurireu kae jorduwo ji.

b:
Ure tumedage Timóteo mare Erosto ei pobedu etudo Macedônia kae, pudumire mugure eiageje Asia moto keje jao.
Meriri kigadureu epage erugodui Paulo jidu.
source:
Ure tumedage Timóteo mare Erosto ei pobedu etudo Macedônia kae, pudumire mugure eiageje Asia moto keje jao.
Meriri kigadureu epage erugodui Paulo jidu.

b: Nowu du kodi ia boe pegareu ure tuguo Pao bataruji.
source: Nowu du kodi ia boe pegareu ure tuguo Pao bataruji.

b: Ia imedu meriri kigadureu epa iei Demétrio cedu duwure aroe eimejerago pagareudo iei Diana cedu uwai meriri kigadureu rogudoge etowuje, du tabore ure tumedage edo tugeragu mori kuricigoreuji.
source: Ia imedu meriri kigadureu epa iei Demétrio cedu duwure aroe eimejerago pagareudo iei Diana cedu uwai meriri kigadureu rogudoge etowuje, du tabore ure tumedage edo tugeragu mori kuricigoreuji.

b: Icare ure nowu tumedage meriri epage eto pui, akore ei: - Taerduware pai pageragu du kuricigoie diieroji awu pamaragodae morice duji.
source: Icare ure nowu tumedage meriri epage eto pui, akore ei: - Taerduware pai pageragu du kuricigoie diieroji awu pamaragodae morice duji.

b: Macare taerdure, tameardu nure awu Paulo akoi makareuge ewiegai, imere towujewu aroe eimejerageie, aroe eimejerage kaegae. Ure awu Éfeso tadawuge eiamedu boce kodi emeartorudo tagoino duji.
source: Macare taerdure, tameardu nure awu Paulo akoi makareuge ewiegai, imere towujewu aroe eimejerageie, aroe eimejerage kaegae. Ure awu Éfeso tadawuge eiamedu boce kodi emeartorudo tagoino duji.

b: Awu imedu pemegakare pai, pamaragodae umode tubegado. Boe emeartorumodukare pagimejerago Diana Kurireudo uwaiji pugeje. Cewu Asia kejewuge eiamedu, moto kejewuge eiamedu ere tubujodo jekaiwu pagimejerago Diana biegamode pugeje.
source: Awu imedu pemegakare pai, pamaragodae umode tubegado. Boe emeartorumodukare pagimejerago Diana Kurireudo uwaiji pugeje. Cewu Asia kejewuge eiamedu, moto kejewuge eiamedu ere tubujodo jekaiwu pagimejerago Diana biegamode pugeje.

b: Kodi icare, awu bataru koiare ure enogorawu boe kori tabo, du kodire enoiogwarigodure, egore: - Éfeso kejewuge eimejerago Diana kuricigore.
source: Kodi icare, awu bataru koiare ure enogorawu boe kori tabo, du kodire enoiogwarigodure, egore: - Éfeso kejewuge eimejerago Diana kuricigore.

b: Icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere turagojedo eregodure nowu bai kurireu kae, ere tugeragu Caioji, Aristarcoji, duwugere Paulo metagere emage, Macedônia moto pijiwugere emage.
source: Icare nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere turagojedo eregodure nowu bai kurireu kae, ere tugeragu Caioji, Aristarcoji, duwugere Paulo metagere emage, Macedônia moto pijiwugere emage.

b: Paulo aidure tuwo boe eerdudo pudui, mare metage etaidukare rowo ino.
source: Paulo aidure tuwo boe eerdudo pudui, mare metage etaidukare rowo ino.

b: Ia Asia kejewuge eiemejarage duwugere tumeduiado ema marigudu, ere bakaru maku bogai jamedu utukawo nowu bakurireu kae.
source: Ia Asia kejewuge eiemejarage duwugere tumeduiado ema marigudu, ere bakaru maku bogai jamedu utukawo nowu bakurireu kae.

b: Nowu boe etui puidu pega remawu nure: enoiogwarire jice woje, jice woje, mare eiamedu jorduwakare kodiba turagojere nono duji.
source: Nowu boe etui puidu pega remawu nure: enoiogwarire jice woje, jice woje, mare eiamedu jorduwakare kodiba turagojere nono duji.

b: Du kejere ere ia judeu iei Alexandre cedu tawuje tubiji, metage ere tugera jodo keje tuwo rakojedo boe etogea keje makowo boei. Icare Alexandre ure tugera awogado boe eegai tumagowo.
source: Du kejere ere ia judeu iei Alexandre cedu tawuje tubiji, metage ere tugera jodo keje tuwo rakojedo boe etogea keje makowo boei. Icare Alexandre ure tugera awogado boe eegai tumagowo.

b: Mare boe eerdure judeuie ure emaduji, du keje eiamedu oiogwarire jii je horare pobe duji, egore:  “Éfeso kejewuge eimejerago Diana kuricigo remawu nure”. Oinore egore tu tu tu je.
source: Mare boe eerdure judeuie ure emaduji, du keje eiamedu oiogwarire jii je horare pobe duji, egore:  “Éfeso kejewuge eimejerago Diana kuricigo remawu nure”. Oinore egore tu tu tu je.

b: Du keje, nowu bakurireu tadawuge eimejera rekodajiwu aregodure tuwo boe ewudugugo. Akore: - Éfeso tadawuge tagi, ime eiamedure eerduware awu Éfeso bakureuie akarureu Diana kurido, eiamedu boe eerduware Diana ureureu meriri butuie baru piji duji.
source: Du keje, nowu bakurireu tadawuge eimejera rekodajiwu aregodure tuwo boe ewudugugo. Akore: - Éfeso tadawuge tagi, ime eiamedure eerduware awu Éfeso bakureuie akarureu Diana kurido, eiamedu boe eerduware Diana ureureu meriri butuie baru piji duji.

b: Iaboe iaboe emodukare tuiorduwa bokwado awu inoduji, du kodire ure turugadu tawudugugoduwo, tarokawo ia taro tameardae bokwa tabo.
source: Iaboe iaboe emodukare tuiorduwa bokwado awu inoduji, du kodire ure turugadu tawudugugoduwo, tarokawo ia taro tameardae bokwa tabo.

b: Awu tare tageragu jiwu ekare tagimejerago pegado, emago pega karega ure ji.
source: Awu tare tageragu jiwu ekare tagimejerago pegado, emago pega karega ure ji.

b: Kode, Demétrio iarema ia metage etaidure tumagowo iaboe rogu boeji iaboei ma, boe eimejerage ewai mugure nono, jadodure, eimejerage emugure nono jamedu, emode tugogado ei.
source: Kode, Demétrio iarema ia metage etaidure tumagowo iaboe rogu boeji iaboei ma, boe eimejerage ewai mugure nono, jadodure, eimejerage emugure nono jamedu, emode tugogado ei.

b: Tagaidure tamagowo iaboeji ma, boe eimejerage emode tugogado.
source: Tagaidure tamagowo iaboeji ma, boe eimejerage emode tugogado.

b: Boe puredumode pai boewo parego brae eimejerage etae awu ure tudowuje awuji oinono du koia. Paga karega, boe kodiboe bokware awu boe enogo kuricigoi pui turugoduwo pui, tokiwo pui, togoriwo pui du bogai.
source: Boe puredumode pai boewo parego brae eimejerage etae awu ure tudowuje awuji oinono du koia. Paga karega, boe kodiboe bokware awu boe enogo kuricigoi pui turugoduwo pui, tokiwo pui, togoriwo pui du bogai.

b: Nowu bataru koiare icare nowu boe etui puidu ure taodo, akedure.
source: Nowu bataru koiare icare nowu boe etui puidu ure taodo, akedure.

b: Paulo utui Macedônia kaedu, Grécia kaedu.
source: Paulo utui Macedônia kaedu, Grécia kaedu.

b: Nowu boe enogoi puidu akedu keje, Paulore tumedage eto pui pudae, icare makore ei; du keje imadure ebo tudui epiji toro Macednia kae du tabo.
source: Nowu boe enogoi puidu akedu keje, Paulore tumedage eto pui pudae, icare makore ei; du keje imadure ebo tudui epiji toro Macednia kae du tabo.

b: Merure nowu moto kao jii je, ure Pao uwobe eerduwado tumago kuricigo tabo, du kejere aregodure Grécia moto kae.
source: Merure nowu moto kao jii je, ure Pao uwobe eerduwado tumago kuricigo tabo, du kejere aregodure Grécia moto kae.

b: Nonore rakojere arire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware. Uiagu taredo ika kurireuto tuduwo Sria moto kae, du tonajire judeudogere jorubo reko utawaraji. Du kodi icare ure tugirimi tuibagi Macedônia moto kae.
source: Nonore rakojere arire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware. Uiagu taredo ika kurireuto tuduwo Sria moto kae, du tonajire judeudogere jorubo reko utawaraji. Du kodi icare ure tugirimi tuibagi Macedônia moto kae.

b: Ia metage ekodure apo, duwugere Sápatro, Beréia moto pijiwu, Pitro onaregedu, mare Aristarco, mare Segundo, Tessalônica pijiwuge, mare Gaio, Derbe pijiwu, mare Timóteo, mare Títico, mare Trófico, Asia pijiwuge.
source: Ia metage ekodure apo, duwugere Sápatro, Beréia moto pijiwu, Pitro onaregedu, mare Aristarco, mare Segundo, Tessalônica pijiwuge, mare Gaio, Derbe pijiwu, mare Timóteo, mare Títico, mare Trófico, Asia pijiwuge.

b: Awugere eture cedododai, icare epagare cewogai Tróade bakurireu keje.
source: Awugere eture cedododai, icare epagare cewogai Tróade bakurireu keje.

b: Cegirema cemugure nono jao. Icare, Páscoa akedu keje, cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, nowu Filipo bakurireu piji toro Tróade kae etae. Nonore ceragojere semanare mito.
source: Cegirema cemugure nono jao. Icare, Páscoa akedu keje, cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, nowu Filipo bakurireu piji toro Tróade kae etae. Nonore ceragojere semanare mito.

b: Nowu semana boetojiwu meriji cere cedo pui cewo Pao o amireu kowuje. Icare Paulore tuduiagu nowu piji nowu meri rekodajiwuji, du kodire mako makore nowu Pao uwobei, makore ei jii boeco oia kae tu...
source: Nowu semana boetojiwu meriji cere cedo pui cewo Pao o amireu kowuje. Icare Paulore tuduiagu nowu piji nowu meri rekodajiwuji, du kodire mako makore nowu Pao uwobei, makore ei jii boeco oia kae tu...

b: Jorugu makare nono cemugure tadawu bai tada.
source: Jorugu makare nono cemugure tadawu bai tada.

b: Boekimorema, ia iparedu iei Eutico cedu, muguradu ia baiporo koborigodu keje, icare unudure, Paulo mako tonaji. Nori kori remawu nure jokuji du kodire buture baire pobe ma awu metuia bokware du piji moto kae, nori kori koia. Icare bire. Ere tugeragu ji bi inoduji.
source: Boekimorema, ia iparedu iei Eutico cedu, muguradu ia baiporo koborigodu keje, icare unudure, Paulo mako tonaji. Nori kori remawu nure jokuji du kodire buture baire pobe ma awu metuia bokware du piji moto kae, nori kori koia. Icare bire. Ere tugeragu ji bi inoduji.

b: Icare Paulore turawuje ae, ure tumegido bukeje, ure tugeragu ji tugana pobe du tabo, ure bu todogajeje, akore: - Tamorora amagadu kaba, jeere pugeje.
source: Icare Paulore turawuje ae, ure tumegido bukeje, ure tugeragu ji tugana pobe du tabo, ure bu todogajeje, akore: - Tamorora amagadu kaba, jeere pugeje.

b: Icare ruture pugeje, du kejere mako raire ei pugeje jii barogwa kododu kae.
source: Icare ruture pugeje, du kejere mako raire ei pugeje jii barogwa kododu kae.

b: Nowu iparedu rema, ere reko, je inodu tabo, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.
source: Nowu iparedu rema, ere reko, je inodu tabo, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.

b: Icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, icare cegodure Assos bakurireu kae; Paulorema uture moto kajeje. Assos keje cebagare bogai, taidu rekodaji.
source: Icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, icare cegodure Assos bakurireu kae; Paulorema uture moto kajeje. Assos keje cebagare bogai, taidu rekodaji.

b: Nowu Assos bakurireu kaere icare aregodure cedae, cere cegeragu ji ika kurireu tada du tabore cegodure Mitilene bakurireu kae.
source: Nowu Assos bakurireu kaere icare aregodure cedae, cere cegeragu ji ika kurireu tada du tabore cegodure Mitilene bakurireu kae.

b: Du pijire cegodure pugeje nowu pobo maereu kajeje pugeje. Barogwatore icare cedaregodure Quios bakurireu kae. Nowu meri rekodajiwuji pugeje cedaregodure Samos bakurireu kae. Barogwato pugeje icare cedaregodure Mileto bakurireuto.
source: Du pijire cegodure pugeje nowu pobo maereu kajeje pugeje. Barogwatore icare cedaregodure Quios bakurireu kae. Nowu meri rekodajiwuji pugeje cedaregodure Samos bakurireu kae. Barogwato pugeje icare cedaregodure Mileto bakurireuto.

b:
Paulo kiarire tuduwo Éfeso bakurireuto, tumugu raikawo Asia moto keje, akere ji taregoduwo Jerusalém kae tuwo Pentecostes o peta ko.
Paulo uwadodae Éfeso kejewu codudoge ewiegaiwu.
source:
Paulo kiarire tuduwo Éfeso bakurireuto, tumugu raikawo Asia moto keje, akere ji taregoduwo Jerusalém kae tuwo Pentecostes o peta ko.
Paulo uwadodae Éfeso kejewu codudoge ewiegaiwu.

b: Mare nowu Mileto mito du pijire makore Éfeso tadawu Pao uwobe eimejerage ewogai.
source: Mare nowu Mileto mito du pijire makore Éfeso tadawu Pao uwobe eimejerage ewogai.

b: Icare etaregodure ae, ere tuiamedu to pui, du kejere icare akore ei: - Taerduware inoba iro irore tai boe jaeduji jii ire iremo awu Asia moto kaewu boetojiwu meri otobiji.
source: Icare etaregodure ae, ere tuiamedu to pui, du kejere icare akore ei: - Taerduware inoba iro irore tai boe jaeduji jii ire iremo awu Asia moto kaewu boetojiwu meri otobiji.

b: Imaragodure Pao ai, ire iwiegado tu je du tabo, itoragudu tabo, judeudoge ere mugudo inaiwu jorubo oiagi.
source: Imaragodure Pao ai, ire iwiegado tu je du tabo, itoragudu tabo, judeudoge ere mugudo inaiwu jorubo oiagi.

b: Taerduware ikae umode turugadu tagaiboe iaboe iaboe pijido, ikare biado, mare ire awadudo tawiegai boe eegai tawai otoji duji.
source: Taerduware ikae umode turugadu tagaiboe iaboe iaboe pijido, ikare biado, mare ire awadudo tawiegai boe eegai tawai otoji duji.

b: Inogituware judeudogei, inogituware judeukare emawugei, ewo tugirimi tuibagi Pao ae, emeartoruwo pagimejera Jesus Cristoji.
source: Inogituware judeudogei, inogituware judeukare emawugei, ewo tugirimi tuibagi Pao ae, emeartoruwo pagimejera Jesus Cristoji.

b: Oinore icare Aroe Pemegareure tumugudo ikeje ikoduwo Jerusalemto, mare iorduwakare iwo aidugirimode toroduji.
source: Oinore icare Aroe Pemegareure tumugudo ikeje ikoduwo Jerusalemto, mare iorduwakare iwo aidugirimode toroduji.

b: Iorduware tu jiboe reo: Aroe Pemegareu ure ido boe pa itu iture kaewu bakurireu jamedu kejeie, baicoreu, boe ecebae epagare iwogaiduji.
source: Iorduware tu jiboe reo: Aroe Pemegareu ure ido boe pa itu iture kaewu bakurireu jamedu kejeie, baicoreu, boe ecebae epagare iwogaiduji.

b: Mare ipagudukare iaboeji iaboeji, ipagudukare iwiwo. Umode turugadu iwo Pagimejera Jesusre maku inaiwu imaragodae akedudo, umode turugadu ireadoduwo o boe pemegareu akaruji.
source: Mare ipagudukare iaboeji iaboeji, ipagudukare iwiwo. Umode turugadu iwo Pagimejera Jesusre maku inaiwu imaragodae akedudo, umode turugadu ireadoduwo o boe pemegareu akaruji.

b: Oino iorduware taiamedu taboie, duwuge etoiagire imeru imerure ireadodui Pao o boe pemegareuji, taerdumodukare ii pugeje duji.
source: Oino iorduware taiamedu taboie, duwuge etoiagire imeru imerure ireadodui Pao o boe pemegareuji, taerdumodukare ii pugeje duji.

b: Du kodire inagoino tawiegai: Ia tagi tawogwamode ma, boe jomodukere iwugeje.
source: Du kodire inagoino tawiegai: Ia tagi tawogwamode ma, boe jomodukere iwugeje.

b: Paga karega, ikiarikare imagowo tawiegai Pao aidure jiboeji.
source: Paga karega, ikiarikare imagowo tawiegai Pao aidure jiboeji.

b: Taeto tai, taeto Aroe Pemegareure maku tagaiboeji. Aroe Pemegareu ure boe eimejeragedo tagi taetuwo Pao uwobei, duwuge ure etaru Tonaregedu ku tabo.
source: Taeto tai, taeto Aroe Pemegareure maku tagaiboeji. Aroe Pemegareu ure boe eimejeragedo tagi taetuwo Pao uwobei, duwuge ure etaru Tonaregedu ku tabo.

b: Iorduware iiagejeie icare riedoge emode turemo tado, tuwo barege pemegareuge ewido.
source: Iorduware iiagejeie icare riedoge emode turemo tado, tuwo barege pemegareuge ewido.

b: Jamedu ime pegareuge emode turemo tadoda jamedu duwugere emode bakaru pegareu kogado, tuwo Pao uwobe erego pudabo.
source: Jamedu ime pegareuge emode turemo tadoda jamedu duwugere emode bakaru pegareu kogado, tuwo Pao uwobe erego pudabo.

b: Tameardu awadudo tai, tawiagodu kaba jorure pobe ma awu metuia bokwaredu meriji boecoji inogituware tai tu tu tu je, itoragudu tabo, ikiarigodu tabo.
source: Tameardu awadudo tai, tawiagodu kaba jorure pobe ma awu metuia bokwaredu meriji boecoji inogituware tai tu tu tu je, itoragudu tabo, ikiarigodu tabo.

b: Oinore icare inure tamagu Pao ai, inure tamagu Pao o bataru pemegare ai, emare jorduware tuwo tarijodudo, roiware tuwo tamugudo pemegareuge etada.
source: Oinore icare inure tamagu Pao ai, inure tamagu Pao o bataru pemegare ai, emare jorduware tuwo tarijodudo, roiware tuwo tamugudo pemegareuge etada.

b: Imagokare iaboeji meriri ekureu bogai, meriri kigadureu bogai du kare.
source: Imagokare iaboeji meriri ekureu bogai, meriri kigadureu bogai du kare.

b: Taerduware awu ikera tabore imaragodure iwo ikerogudo, iwo ikudae rogudo, iwo imedage ekerogudo jamedu.
source: Taerduware awu ikera tabore imaragodure iwo ikerogudo, iwo ikudae rogudo, iwo imedage ekerogudo jamedu.

b: Jii je ire taerduwado uie turugadu pamaragoduwo, pawo pagerabraredo roiwakareugei du bogai, uwo nono Pagimejera bataru reore: Nowu ure boe makuwu jekare kodure nowu boe makudure aiwu jekare kori.
source: Jii je ire taerduwado uie turugadu pamaragoduwo, pawo pagerabraredo roiwakareugei du bogai, uwo nono Pagimejera bataru reore: Nowu ure boe makuwu jekare kodure nowu boe makudure aiwu jekare kori.

b: Awu tuwadaru rekodajire icare Paulore tubujodo mototo, okwamagudure Paoji ebo.
source: Awu tuwadaru rekodajire icare Paulore tubujodo mototo, okwamagudure Paoji ebo.

b: Rakojere nonowuge eiamedu etoragudugodure, icare ere todomo Paulo kajeje, imadui puabo du tonaji.
source: Rakojere nonowuge eiamedu etoragudugodure, icare ere todomo Paulo kajeje, imadui puabo du tonaji.

b: Ekiarigodu kuricigore Paulo akore ei eerdumodukae pudui pugeje du kodi. Icare eture apo toro ika kurireu kae.
source: Ekiarigodu kuricigore Paulo akore ei eerdumodukae pudui pugeje du kodi. Icare eture apo toro ika kurireu kae.

b: Paulo aregodui Tiro bakurireu kaedu.
source: Paulo aregodui Tiro bakurireu kaedu.

b: Cedure epiji du keje cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, du tabore cegodure Cós bakurireu kae. Barogwatore icare cegodure pugeje Rodes bakurireu kae, du pijire cegodure pugeje Pátara bakurireu kae.
source: Cedure epiji du keje cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, du tabore cegodure Cós bakurireu kae. Barogwatore icare cegodure pugeje Rodes bakurireu kae, du pijire cegodure pugeje Pátara bakurireu kae.

b: Nonore ceerdure kodumode Fenícia kaewu ia ika kurireuji. I,care cere cedaredo to, du tabore cegodure cenodobiji.
source: Nonore ceerdure kodumode Fenícia kaewu ia ika kurireuji. I,care cere cedaredo to, du tabore cegodure cenodobiji.

b: Icare ceerdure ia pobo aiare tabowu moto iei Chipre ceduji, okwacere woje cegana koboreu jaogwai; cegodure kori toro Síria moto kae. Icare cedaregodure ia bakurireu mugui pobo okwai iei Tiro cedu kae. Nonore boe emode nowu ika kurireu biorodo, du kodire cerudure moto kae nono.
source: Icare ceerdure ia pobo aiare tabowu moto iei Chipre ceduji, okwacere woje cegana koboreu jaogwai; cegodure kori toro Síria moto kae. Icare cedaregodure ia bakurireu mugui pobo okwai iei Tiro cedu kae. Nonore boe emode nowu ika kurireu biorodo, du kodire cerudure moto kae nono.

b: Nonore ceerdure ia Pao uwobei, du kodi icare cere cemugudo ebo merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto; Aroe Pemegareu jore ewugeje, du koiare enogituware Pauloji rutu kawo Jerusalemto.
source: Nonore ceerdure ia Pao uwobei, du kodi icare cere cemugudo ebo merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto; Aroe Pemegareu jore ewugeje, du koiare enogituware Pauloji rutu kawo Jerusalemto.

b: Nowu merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu akedure du kejere icare cegodure cedawaraji pugeje. Eiamedu rore taci cedabo tuwiremage ebo, tore ebo jii bakurireu kujeto. Du kejere cere cebujodo nowu kugaru keje icare cenogwamagudure Paoji.
source: Nowu merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu akedure du kejere icare cegodure cedawaraji pugeje. Eiamedu rore taci cedabo tuwiremage ebo, tore ebo jii bakurireu kujeto. Du kejere cere cebujodo nowu kugaru keje icare cenogwamagudure Paoji.

b: Du keje icare cegimadure ebo, icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, emage ere tugirimi tuwai kae.
source: Du keje icare cegimadure ebo, icare cere cedaredo ika kurireuto, emage ere tugirimi tuwai kae.

b:
Cegodure ika kurireu tabo nowu Tiro bakurireu piji jii ia bakurireu iei Ptolomaida cedu kae. Nonore cegimadure cewiemage ebo, icare cemugure ebo nowu meriji.
Profeta Agabo akore Paulo jiboe Cesareia kejedu.
source:
Cegodure ika kurireu tabo nowu Tiro bakurireu piji jii ia bakurireu iei Ptolomaida cedu kae. Nonore cegimadure cewiemage ebo, icare cemugure ebo nowu meriji.
Profeta Agabo akore Paulo jiboe Cesareia kejedu.

b: Barogwatore icare cegodure pugeje, icare cedaregodure Cesareia bakurireuto pugeje. Du kejere cere ceremo Filipe uwaito. Emare Pao bataru epa rema, nowu diaconodoge ei sete ia emage nure ema. Icare cemugure uwai tada.
source: Barogwatore icare cegodure pugeje, icare cedaregodure Cesareia bakurireuto pugeje. Du kejere cere ceremo Filipe uwaito. Emare Pao bataru epa rema, nowu diaconodoge ei sete ia emage nure ema. Icare cemugure uwai tada.

b: Ore areme ere pobe puibiji duwuge emugukare imedu apo roga; emagere emago emagore Pao bataruji.
source: Ore areme ere pobe puibiji duwuge emugukare imedu apo roga; emagere emago emagore Pao bataruji.

b: Cemugure nono meri makakare, du keje ia profeta aregodure Judéia piji, iere Agabo.
source: Cemugure nono meri makakare, du keje ia profeta aregodure Judéia piji, iere Agabo.

b: Aregodure mato cewogai, du kejere icare ure tugeragu Paulo peagajejewu, du tabore ure tugeragogudo tabo, ure tuwure gogudo tabo, icare akore: - Oinore Aroe Pemegareu akore: - Oinore judeudoge emode ore awu boe epeagajejewu iera gogudo, buregogudo, emode maku judeukare emawuge ekera kai toro Jerusalém tada.
source: Aregodure mato cewogai, du kejere icare ure tugeragu Paulo peagajejewu, du tabore ure tugeragogudo tabo, ure tuwure gogudo tabo, icare akore: - Oinore Aroe Pemegareu akore: - Oinore judeudoge emode ore awu boe epeagajejewu iera gogudo, buregogudo, emode maku judeukare emawuge ekera kai toro Jerusalém tada.

b: Awu bataru koiare icare cegi mare mugure nonowu Pao uwobe cenogwamagudure ji rutu kawo Jerusalemto.
source: Awu bataru koiare icare cegi mare mugure nonowu Pao uwobe cenogwamagudure ji rutu kawo Jerusalemto.

b: Mare Paulo akore: - Kodiba tagoragudure? Icare tare ikiarigodu kuricigodo! Ica, inure irugadu boewo ikeragogudo, boewo iwido jamedu Pagimejera Jesus ie koia.
source: Mare Paulo akore: - Kodiba tagoragudure? Icare tare ikiarigodu kuricigodo! Ica, inure irugadu boewo ikeragogudo, boewo iwido jamedu Pagimejera Jesus ie koia.

b: Icare cewadaru iwakare rutu kawo toro. Du kodire cemagokare ji pugeje, icare cemagore: - Boewo nono Pao aidu reore.
source: Icare cewadaru iwakare rutu kawo toro. Du kodire cemagokare ji pugeje, icare cemagore: - Boewo nono Pao aidu reore.

b: Meri makakare du kejere icare cere cerugadu cemeruwo, icare cerudure Jerusalém kae.
source: Meri makakare du kejere icare cere cerugadu cemeruwo, icare cerudure Jerusalém kae.

b:
Cesaréia tadawu ia pawobe ekodure cedabo, duwuge ere cerego ia Chipre pijiwu imedu iei Menason cedu uwai kae, nonore cenudumode.
Paulo rakojei Jerusalém tadadu.
source:
Cesaréia tadawu ia pawobe ekodure cedabo, duwuge ere cerego ia Chipre pijiwu imedu iei Menason cedu uwai kae, nonore cenudumode.
Paulo rakojei Jerusalém tadadu.

b: Icare cedaregodure Jerusalemto, du kejere pawiemage ere tugeragu cei tuiegare tabo taidu tabo.
source: Icare cedaregodure Jerusalemto, du kejere pawiemage ere tugeragu cei tuiegare tabo taidu tabo.

b: Barogwatore icare Paulo uture cedabo Tiago uwai kae, nonore icare nowu Pao uwobe eimejerage eiamedure tudo pui nono cedaregodu kae.
source: Barogwatore icare Paulo uture cedabo Tiago uwai kae, nonore icare nowu Pao uwobe eimejerage eiamedure tudo pui nono cedaregodu kae.

b: Icare Paulo imadure ebo, icare readodure ewiegai Pao rore judeukare emawuge etai tugera tabowu jamedu jiboeji.
source: Icare Paulo imadure ebo, icare readodure ewiegai Pao rore judeukare emawuge etai tugera tabowu jamedu jiboeji.

b: Emeardui awu inodu jamedu jitu koiare ere Pao kurido, icare emagore Pauloji, egore: - Cemana, aerdu pemega nure, awu judeudoge makareuge duwugere emeartorure Pao bataruji tukai judeudoge eroiagudu pijido du tabo duji.
source: Emeardui awu inodu jamedu jitu koiare ere Pao kurido, icare emagore Pauloji, egore: - Cemana, aerdu pemega nure, awu judeudoge makareuge duwugere emeartorure Pao bataruji tukai judeudoge eroiagudu pijido du tabo duji.

b: Emagere emeardure boe egoi akie are nowu mugure judeukare emawuge etadawu judeudoge eerduwado ewo tugera ra Moisés piji, akagoi ei: ekawo tore ewiri kado, erokawo nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.
source: Emagere emeardure boe egoi akie are nowu mugure judeukare emawuge etadawu judeudoge eerduwado ewo tugera ra Moisés piji, akagoi ei: ekawo tore ewiri kado, erokawo nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.

b: Inoba paromode? Eerduwamode akaregoduie rugadu.
source: Inoba paromode? Eerduwamode akaregoduie rugadu.

b: Kode, arodo nono cemagomode ai du reore. Imere pobe puibiji woe, tuwo tumorido Pao ai.
source: Kode, arodo nono cemagomode ai du reore. Imere pobe puibiji woe, tuwo tumorido Pao ai.

b: Eko akabo, aedorodo ebo, mori maku eparu tabo tuwo etao rawuje. Du tabore eiamedu boe eerduwamode tumeardure jiwu aiboe boe kaegae, aki jamedu aroie nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.
source: Eko akabo, aedorodo ebo, mori maku eparu tabo tuwo etao rawuje. Du tabore eiamedu boe eerduwamode tumeardure jiwu aiboe boe kaegae, aki jamedu aroie nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.

b: Judeukare emawu meartorureuge eiboe rema, cere bapera atugodo etai, ewo tugera ra tui mori maku aroe eimejerage pagareuge etai du piji, ekawo ake todure towu barege eku ekodu kowuje, ekera keadu kawo jamedu.
source: Judeukare emawu meartorureuge eiboe rema, cere bapera atugodo etai, ewo tugera ra tui mori maku aroe eimejerage pagareuge etai du piji, ekawo ake todure towu barege eku ekodu kowuje, ekera keadu kawo jamedu.

b: Barogwatore icare Paulo kodure nowu ime ebo, icare ure tuiedorodo ebo, ure turemo Pao uwaito, nonore icare ure remagu umode mori maku tubaru tabowu eparu tabowu moriji.
source: Barogwatore icare Paulo kodure nowu ime ebo, icare ure tuiedorodo ebo, ure turemo Pao uwaito, nonore icare ure remagu umode mori maku tubaru tabowu eparu tabowu moriji.

b: Merire pagera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du keje, ia judeudoge etaregodui Asia moto piji, eerdure Pauloji nowu Pao uwai tada, du kodire ere boe erugo ji. Ere tugeragu ji, icare enoiogwarire.
source: Merire pagera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du keje, ia judeudoge etaregodui Asia moto piji, eerdure Pauloji nowu Pao uwai tada, du kodire ere boe erugo ji. Ere tugeragu ji, icare enoiogwarire.

b: Egore: - Judeudoge, tagerabraredo cei! Mako pagare cewobei, Pao uwaiji, ceroiagudu boe jiwu imedu reo! Emareo! Unure Grécia pijiwu ime edo turemo Pao uwaito jamedu, tui pegado du tabo.
source: Egore: - Judeudoge, tagerabraredo cei! Mako pagare cewobei, Pao uwaiji, ceroiagudu boe jiwu imedu reo! Emareo! Unure Grécia pijiwu ime edo turemo Pao uwaito jamedu, tui pegado du tabo.

b: Egore oino, eerdure Trofimo, Éfeso pijiwu, kodui apo bakurireu tada duji, du koiare emeardaere uie turemo Pao uwaito, kodire egoino.
source: Egore oino, eerdure Trofimo, Éfeso pijiwu, kodui apo bakurireu tada duji, du koiare emeardaere uie turemo Pao uwaito, kodire egoino.

b: Mugure nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe emorora amagadure, icare ere tudo puidu emagaguragare. Ere tugeragu Pauloji, ere reko oino motoji Pao uwai piji toro baawadu kae, icare Pao uwai porodoge ere tumi pi tuku peragajeje.
source: Mugure nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe emorora amagadure, icare ere tudo puidu emagaguragare. Ere tugeragu Pauloji, ere reko oino motoji Pao uwai piji toro baawadu kae, icare Pao uwai porodoge ere tumi pi tuku peragajeje.

b: Etaidure tuwo bito, mare iage ere tugobaigarege eimejera bie Jerusalém tadawuge eiameduie turagojedo turugoduwo.
source: Etaidure tuwo bito, mare iage ere tugobaigarege eimejera bie Jerusalém tadawuge eiameduie turagojedo turugoduwo.

b: Du kodire icare kuri je ure tugobaigarege mare ia tugobaigarege eimejerage eko pudabo toro rugodureuge etae. Awugerema, eerdui nowu tugobaigarege eimejera aregodui tudugarege eboduji du keje kuri je, ere tugera ra tui boe to Paulo jitu piji.
source: Du kodire icare kuri je ure tugobaigarege mare ia tugobaigarege eimejerage eko pudabo toro rugodureuge etae. Awugerema, eerdui nowu tugobaigarege eimejera aregodui tudugarege eboduji du keje kuri je, ere tugera ra tui boe to Paulo jitu piji.

b: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure tuburedo Pauloji, ure tugeragu ji, ure tudugarege edo ieragogudo meriri iku pobe du tabo. Icare unorare boei iogudubabao, kaboba jiba roino.
source: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure tuburedo Pauloji, ure tugeragu ji, ure tudugarege edo ieragogudo meriri iku pobe du tabo. Icare unorare boei iogudubabao, kaboba jiba roino.

b: Eiamedu boe enoiogwarire jice woje, jice woje, du kodire roiwakare tuiorduwawo nowu boe enogoi pui du koia. Du kodi icare ure tudugarege edo reko baicoreu rakareuto.
source: Eiamedu boe enoiogwarire jice woje, jice woje, du kodire roiwakare tuiorduwawo nowu boe enogoi pui du koia. Du kodi icare ure tudugarege edo reko baicoreu rakareuto.

b: Icare Paulo aregodui bai kurireu o escala kae du keje, tugobaigarege ere tudugu ji tuietuwo ji boe ekorii ji tu piji.
source: Icare Paulo aregodui bai kurireu o escala kae du keje, tugobaigarege ere tudugu ji tuietuwo ji boe ekorii ji tu piji.

b: Nowu boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji toiogwari tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Bito rugau.
source: Nowu boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji toiogwari tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Bito rugau.

b: Umode turemo nowu baicoreu rakareu to du keje, Paulo unoragodure nowu tugobaigarege eimejeraji, akore ji: - Awudugugo ii biegatu je, imagowo boei jao. Nowu tugobaigarege eimejera akore: - Aerduware gregodoge ewadaruji?
source: Umode turemo nowu baicoreu rakareu to du keje, Paulo unoragodure nowu tugobaigarege eimejeraji, akore ji: - Awudugugo ii biegatu je, imagowo boei jao. Nowu tugobaigarege eimejera akore: - Aerduware gregodoge ewadaruji?

b: Nowu Egito pijiwu imedu, duwure boe erugo pui marigudu, icare ure rugodureu ime ei quatro mil reko pudabo boe matadu kaewu aki kanao?
source: Nowu Egito pijiwu imedu, duwure boe erugo pui marigudu, icare ure rugodureu ime ei quatro mil reko pudabo boe matadu kaewu aki kanao?

b: Icare Paulo akore: Judeu nure imi, Cilécia moto kejewu bakurireu iei Tarso cedu pijiwu nure imi, inogwamagudu nure ai awo imagodo boei.
source: Icare Paulo akore: Judeu nure imi, Cilécia moto kejewu bakurireu iei Tarso cedu pijiwu nure imi, inogwamagudu nure ai awo imagodo boei.

b: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure makodo. Icare Paulo, turagojei nowu escala keje du piji, ure tugera aogado boei, icare boe makodure pi tuku. Icare makore ei hebreudoge ewadaru tabo, akore:
source: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure makodo. Icare Paulo, turagojei nowu escala keje du piji, ure tugera aogado boei, icare boe makodure pi tuku. Icare makore ei hebreudoge ewadaru tabo, akore:

b: Paulo uwadodae judeudoge ewiegaidu. -
source: Paulo uwadodae judeudoge ewiegaidu. -

b: Imanamage, iwiemage, iogamage, tawiapagado iwadaruji: ireadodumode tawiegai kodiba iroino.
source: Imanamage, iwiemage, iogamage, tawiapagado iwadaruji: ireadodumode tawiegai kodiba iroino.

b: Emeardure makoi hebreudoge ewadaruji du kejere ewiapaga awadure ji.
source: Emeardure makoi hebreudoge ewadaruji du kejere ewiapaga awadure ji.

b: Icare akore pugeje: - Judeu nure imi. Cilécia moto kejewu bakurireu iei Tarso cedu kejere iwodure, mare irijodure awu bakurireu tada, nowu jorduwa rakareu iei Gamaliel cedu bure paru iorduwadodure paomage eroji. Pao Kurireu jaogwaire inogwacere tareore, tare tagogwacere Pao jaogwai jii oino jamedu, du reorere ire ino jamedu marigudu.
source: Icare akore pugeje: - Judeu nure imi. Cilécia moto kejewu bakurireu iei Tarso cedu kejere iwodure, mare irijodure awu bakurireu tada, nowu jorduwa rakareu iei Gamaliel cedu bure paru iorduwadodure paomage eroji. Pao Kurireu jaogwaire inogwacere tareore, tare tagogwacere Pao jaogwai jii oino jamedu, du reorere ire ino jamedu marigudu.

b: Marigudu itonare Cristo metagei iwo ewido. Ire ikeragu meartorure Cristo jiwu imei, aremei, ire erego baicoreuto.
source: Marigudu itonare Cristo metagei iwo ewido. Ire ikeragu meartorure Cristo jiwu imei, aremei, ire erego baicoreuto.

b: Sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare boe eimejerage eerduware iroinoduji. Ere bapera maku inai iwo reko Damasco kejewu judeudoge etae, icare iture nowu bakurireu kae iwo ikeragu meartorureuge emugui toro duji, iwo erego Jerusalém kae boewo eedorodo.
source: Sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare boe eimejerage eerduware iroinoduji. Ere bapera maku inai iwo reko Damasco kejewu judeudoge etae, icare iture nowu bakurireu kae iwo ikeragu meartorureuge emugui toro duji, iwo erego Jerusalém kae boewo eedorodo.

b: Boekimorema, ikodui awaraji, puredu tu Damasco bakurireuji, meri jetui pagaia keje du tabo, icare baru pijiwu ia urugureboe kuricigoreu ure itaiado pi tuku je.
source: Boekimorema, ikodui awaraji, puredu tu Damasco bakurireuji, meri jetui pagaia keje du tabo, icare baru pijiwu ia urugureboe kuricigoreu ure itaiado pi tuku je.

b: Icare iwudure moto kae, icare imeardure ia boe emagoi ii duji, akore: - Saulo, Saulo, kodiba akonare ii? Kodiba?
source: Icare iwudure moto kae, icare imeardure ia boe emagoi ii duji, akore: - Saulo, Saulo, kodiba akonare ii? Kodiba?

b: Icare imagore ji: - Ioguduba akagoino, ikimejera?  Icare nowu akoinoboe makore ii pugeje, akore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu imireo, cewu akonare jiwu imireo.
source: Icare imagore ji: - Ioguduba akagoino, ikimejera?  Icare nowu akoinoboe makore ii pugeje, akore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu imireo, cewu akonare jiwu imireo.

b: Boekimorema, imedage eerdure urugureboeji, mare emeardukare nowu akoino iiboe makoji.
source: Boekimorema, imedage eerdure urugureboeji, mare emeardukare nowu akoino iiboe makoji.

b: Icare imagore ji: - Ikimejera, inoba iromode?  Icare akore ii: - Aragojedo, atudo Damasco bakurireuto, torore boe emode awiie inoba aromode duji.
source: Icare imagore ji: - Ikimejera, inoba iromode?  Icare akore ii: - Aragojedo, atudo Damasco bakurireuto, torore boe emode awiie inoba aromode duji.

b: Iordukare iaboeji nowu urugureboe kuricigoreu koia, du kodire imedage ere tugera kogudo ikera kajeje du tabore itaregodure Damascoto.
source: Iordukare iaboeji nowu urugureboe kuricigoreu koia, du kodire imedage ere tugera kogudo ikera kajeje du tabore itaregodure Damascoto.

b: Ia imedu iei Ananias cedu, mako makore Pao jiwu imedu, duwu rore nono judeudoge eroiagudo du reore, nowu bakurireu tadawu judeudoge eerdu pemegare jiwu imedu,
source: Ia imedu iei Ananias cedu, mako makore Pao jiwu imedu, duwu rore nono judeudoge eroiagudo du reore, nowu bakurireu tadawu judeudoge eerdu pemegare jiwu imedu,

b: Aregodure itae, akore ii: Iwie Saulo, aeku pemegare pugeje. Du keje kuri je itaiwore.
source: Aregodure itae, akore ii: Iwie Saulo, aeku pemegare pugeje. Du keje kuri je itaiwore.

b: Icare akore pugeje: Paomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure atawuje aerduwawo taidure jiboeji, aerduwawo Imedu Pemegareuji, amearduwo jabijiwu bataruji.
source: Icare akore pugeje: Paomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure atawuje aerduwawo taidure jiboeji, aerduwawo Imedu Pemegareuji, amearduwo jabijiwu bataruji.

b: Ica, areadodumode ime eiamedu boe ewiegai aerdure jiboeji, ameardure jiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Ica, areadodumode ime eiamedu boe ewiegai aerdure jiboeji, ameardure jiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Kodi icare, amara tabo! Aragojedo, akao pegodo, awabo kigadudo aro pegareu piji nowu Pemegareu Imedu ie tabo.
source: Kodi icare, amara tabo! Aragojedo, akao pegodo, awabo kigadudo aro pegareu piji nowu Pemegareu Imedu ie tabo.

b: Du kejere icare ire ikirimi Jerusalemto, icare inogwamagudure Paoji uwai tada, du tonajire Paore ido ikinoi, ure iordudo boe pemegareuji.
source: Du kejere icare ire ikirimi Jerusalemto, icare inogwamagudure Paoji uwai tada, du tonajire Paore ido ikinoi, ure iordudo boe pemegareuji.

b: Icare iordure Jesus makoi ii duji, akore: Amara tabo! Atudo Jerusalém piji, paga karega, awuge emeardumodukare areadodui iiboe jituji
source: Icare iordure Jesus makoi ii duji, akore: Amara tabo! Atudo Jerusalém piji, paga karega, awuge emeardumodukare areadodui iiboe jituji

b: Icare imagore: Ikimejera, emage eerduware iie meartorure aiwuge etugu etugu baicoreuto, eerduware iie iwara to to ei duji.
source: Icare imagore: Ikimejera, emage eerduware iie meartorure aiwuge etugu etugu baicoreuto, eerduware iie iwara to to ei duji.

b: Icare Estêvão ure tuiwodo akie koia du keje, iragojere nono jamedu, ieture ure bitowuge ekudawu aroiaji.
source: Icare Estêvão ure tuiwodo akie koia du keje, iragojere nono jamedu, ieture ure bitowuge ekudawu aroiaji.

b:
Macare Jesus akore: Toro, imode atudo toro ia boe etae jaegiri.
Paulo mugui baicoreu rakareu tadadu.
source:
Macare Jesus akore: Toro, imode atudo toro ia boe etae jaegiri.
Paulo mugui baicoreu rakareu tadadu.

b: Judeudoge emeardure jii je nowu bataru kae, du keje icare enoiogwarire, egore: - Nowu imedu tawuje nowu piji, umodukare turugadu tuiewo.
source: Judeudoge emeardure jii je nowu bataru kae, du keje icare enoiogwarire, egore: - Nowu imedu tawuje nowu piji, umodukare turugadu tuiewo.

b: Du keje icare enoiogwari kuricigore, ere tugudae aroia tawuje, ere moto urugudu barigu baruto boekori koia ji.
source: Du keje icare enoiogwari kuricigore, ere tugudae aroia tawuje, ere moto urugudu barigu baruto boekori koia ji.

b: Du kodi icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure tudugarege edo tugeragu ji ewo reko baicoreu rakareuto, ewo iwara to ji, ewo okoridodu kuricigodo, tuiorduwawo kodiba boe enoiogwarire boe kori koia ji du bogai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ure tudugarege edo tugeragu ji ewo reko baicoreu rakareuto, ewo iwara to ji, ewo okoridodu kuricigodo, tuiorduwawo kodiba boe enoiogwarire boe kori koia ji du bogai.

b: Icare enure kogudo barogo biri bukigu tabo du kejere Paulo unorare ia tugobaigarege eimejera mugui nonoduji, akore: - Umodukana turugadu boewo boe to ia Roma kejewu imeduji, brae eiemejerage ekai tugogado jitu otodai?
source: Icare enure kogudo barogo biri bukigu tabo du kejere Paulo unorare ia tugobaigarege eimejera mugui nonoduji, akore: - Umodukana turugadu boewo boe to ia Roma kejewu imeduji, brae eiemejerage ekai tugogado jitu otodai?

b: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera meardure awu bataru jitu keje kuri je, uture tugimejera ae, ure bie, akore: - Inoba aromode? Awu imedu Roma kejewu nure ema.
source: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera meardure awu bataru jitu keje kuri je, uture tugimejera ae, ure bie, akore: - Inoba aromode? Awu imedu Roma kejewu nure ema.

b: Icare nowu brae eimejera uture mato Paulo ae, akore ji: - Roma kejewu akinao? Amagodo. Paulo akore: - U!
source: Icare nowu brae eimejera uture mato Paulo ae, akore ji: - Roma kejewu akinao? Amagodo. Paulo akore: - U!

b: Icare nowu brae eiemejera akore: - Ire Roma kejewudo imi mori kuricigo tabo. Icare Paulo akore: - Ica, Roma kejewu nure imi iwodure du piji.
source: Icare nowu brae eiemejera akore: - Ire Roma kejewudo imi mori kuricigo tabo. Icare Paulo akore: - Ica, Roma kejewu nure imi iwodure du piji.

b: Du keje kuri je, nowu umode okoridowuge ere tuiaedo ji pi tuku. Nowu brae eiemejera morora amagadure, paga karega, ure tudugarege eedo kogudo Roma kejewui ema du tabo.
source: Du keje kuri je, nowu umode okoridowuge ere tuiaedo ji pi tuku. Nowu brae eiemejera morora amagadure, paga karega, ure tudugarege eedo kogudo Roma kejewui ema du tabo.

b: Barogwatore icare, nowu brae eiemejera aidure tuiorduwa birigoduwo kodiba rakuduie judeudoge emago pegare ji. Ure iera kiwuje, icare ure sacerdotedoge eiemejerage eto pui. Icare ure Paulo arego etae.
source: Barogwatore icare, nowu brae eiemejera aidure tuiorduwa birigoduwo kodiba rakuduie judeudoge emago pegare ji. Ure iera kiwuje, icare ure sacerdotedoge eiemejerage eto pui. Icare ure Paulo arego etae.

b: Paulo rakojei boe eimejerage eegaidu.
source: Paulo rakojei boe eimejerage eegaidu.

b: Icare Paulore tuioku kidudo nowu judeudoge eimejerage ei tu... Icare akore: - Imanamage, imire imerure Pao jekai iwabo pemegareu tabo, imeardae pemegareu tabo jii awu meri kae.
source: Icare Paulore tuioku kidudo nowu judeudoge eimejerage ei tu... Icare akore: - Imanamage, imire imerure Pao jekai iwabo pemegareu tabo, imeardae pemegareu tabo jii awu meri kae.

b: Macare nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera iei Ananias cedu, ure mugure mekiwuge edo tugera to okwaji.
source: Macare nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera iei Ananias cedu, ure mugure mekiwuge edo tugera to okwaji.

b: Icare Paulo akore ji: Imedu roarodureu, Pao umode akogorido jamedu. Amugure awo akogado ii paroiagudu rekodaji, macare akonai paroiagudu jitu tabore are boedo itogorido. Kodiba?
source: Icare Paulo akore ji: Imedu roarodureu, Pao umode akogorido jamedu. Amugure awo akogado ii paroiagudu rekodaji, macare akonai paroiagudu jitu tabore are boedo itogorido. Kodiba?

b: Icare mugure nonowuge egore: - Awadaru pegare Pao bure joia kurireuji.
source: Icare mugure nonowuge egore: - Awadaru pegare Pao bure joia kurireuji.

b: Icare Paulo akore: - Iwiemage iorduwakare Pao burejoiaie ure emaduji. Paga karega, Pao o bapera keje atugododure oino: “Amago pega kaba awobe eimejerajii” (Ex 22,28).
source: Icare Paulo akore: - Iwiemage iorduwakare Pao burejoiaie ure emaduji. Paga karega, Pao o bapera keje atugododure oino: “Amago pega kaba awobe eimejerajii” (Ex 22,28).

b: Paulo jorduware nowu judeudoge eiemejerageie tuginoi duji. Iage fariseudogere emage, iage saduceudogere emage. Du kodi lcare akore tumago raka tabo: - Imanamage, fariseu nure imi, fariseudoge etonaregedu nure imi. Ica, imeartorure bireuge eewodumode tuwi piji pugeje duji, du koiare boere tugogado ii
source: Paulo jorduware nowu judeudoge eiemejerageie tuginoi duji. Iage fariseudogere emage, iage saduceudogere emage. Du kodi lcare akore tumago raka tabo: - Imanamage, fariseu nure imi, fariseudoge etonaregedu nure imi. Ica, imeartorure bireuge eewodumode tuwi piji pugeje duji, du koiare boere tugogado ii

b: Awu bataru keje, nowu fariseudoge mare nowu saduceudoge etokire pui, emagore pui puibagi, icare nowu boe eimejerage etonare pui. 8(Paga karega, saduceudoge egore bireuge ewodumodukae, tupadoge bokwae, aroedoge bokwae; fariseudogerema emeartorure nowu boe jameduji).
source: Awu bataru keje, nowu fariseudoge mare nowu saduceudoge etokire pui, emagore pui puibagi, icare nowu boe eimejerage etonare pui. 8(Paga karega, saduceudoge egore bireuge ewodumodukae, tupadoge bokwae, aroedoge bokwae; fariseudogerema emeartorure nowu boe jameduji).

b: Du kodi icare ia boe enoiogwari kuricigoreu ure tuguo. Icare ia fariseudoge, ere turagojedo, emago rakare, egore: - Ceerduwakare awu imedu ia ro pegareuji. Ia Pao o tupa, iarema ia Aroe emago kana ji?
source: Du kodi icare ia boe enoiogwari kuricigoreu ure tuguo. Icare ia fariseudoge, ere turagojedo, emago rakare, egore: - Ceerduwakare awu imedu ia ro pegareuji. Ia Pao o tupa, iarema ia Aroe emago kana ji?

b: Icare nowu emagoi puidu nowu etokii puidu icare rakagodure. Du kodi icare nowu brae eimejera pagudugodure emode Paulo roto oino pa je duji, du kodi icare ure tugobaigarege edo turawuje, ewo Paulo aru epiji, ewo reko baicoreu rakareu kae.
source: Icare nowu emagoi puidu nowu etokii puidu icare rakagodure. Du kodi icare nowu brae eimejera pagudugodure emode Paulo roto oino pa je duji, du kodi icare ure tugobaigarege edo turawuje, ewo Paulo aru epiji, ewo reko baicoreu rakareu kae.

b: Nowu boecoji icare Paore towadudo Paulo jekai, akore ji: - Ameardu awadudo ai, areadodure ii Jerusalém tadadu reorere umode turugadu areadoduwo ii pugeje Roma bakurireu tada jamedu.
source: Nowu boecoji icare Paore towadudo Paulo jekai, akore ji: - Ameardu awadudo ai, areadodure ii Jerusalém tadadu reorere umode turugadu areadoduwo ii pugeje Roma bakurireu tada jamedu.

b: Barogwa kododu tabore icare ia judeudoge ere tudo pui, emagore pui togwagemodukae iaboe boeji, tugudumodukae iaboe boece, tumode Paulo bito du otodai.
source: Barogwa kododu tabore icare ia judeudoge ere tudo pui, emagore pui togwagemodukae iaboe boeji, tugudumodukae iaboe boece, tumode Paulo bito du otodai.

b: Nowu makore oinowuge ere nono ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du reore.
source: Nowu makore oinowuge ere nono ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du reore.

b: Icare eture nowu sacerdotedoge eiemejerage etae, egore ei: - Cemagore Pao jekai, cenogwagemodukae iaboe boeji jii cemode Paulo bito du kae.
source: Icare eture nowu sacerdotedoge eiemejerage etae, egore ei: - Cemagore Pao jekai, cenogwagemodukae iaboe boeji jii cemode Paulo bito du kae.

b: Kode, tagi mare pagimejerage tamagodo brae eiemejeraji uwo Paulo reko mato tawogai. Tamagodo ji tamode tagoga pemagado ji pugeje. Cegirema, umode tuburedo mato du keje, cemode cedo cerugadu cewo bito.
source: Kode, tagi mare pagimejerage tamagodo brae eiemejeraji uwo Paulo reko mato tawogai. Tamagodo ji tamode tagoga pemagado ji pugeje. Cegirema, umode tuburedo mato du keje, cemode cedo cerugadu cewo bito.

b: Boekimorema, Paulo utuie ia onaregedu, urade nowu emeardae pegareu pawuje, du kodi icare kodure toro baicoreu rakareu kae, ure Paulo bie.
source: Boekimorema, Paulo utuie ia onaregedu, urade nowu emeardae pegareu pawuje, du kodi icare kodure toro baicoreu rakareu kae, ure Paulo bie.

b: Awure icare makore tugobaigarege eimejera bogai, akore ji: - Awu iparedu reko toro akimejera ae, aidure tumagowo ji iaboeji.
source: Awure icare makore tugobaigarege eimejera bogai, akore ji: - Awu iparedu reko toro akimejera ae, aidure tumagowo ji iaboeji.

b: Icare ure reko nowu brae eimejera jekae, akore ji: - Nowu meture baicoreu tadawu iei Paulo cedu okwamagudure ii iwo awu iparedu reko mato aegai, aidure tumagowo ai iaboeji du kodi.
source: Icare ure reko nowu brae eimejera jekae, akore ji: - Nowu meture baicoreu tadawu iei Paulo cedu okwamagudure ii iwo awu iparedu reko mato aegai, aidure tumagowo ai iaboeji du kodi.

b: Icare nowu brae eimejera ure tugera kogudo nowu iparedu iera kajeje, ure reko jice baiporo kae, akore ji: - Kaboba jiba akaidure amagowo ii?
source: Icare nowu brae eimejera ure tugera kogudo nowu iparedu iera kajeje, ure reko jice baiporo kae, akore ji: - Kaboba jiba akaidure amagowo ii?

b: Akore: - Judeudoge emagore pui barogwatoie togwamagudumode ai awo Paulo reko judeudoge eimejerage eegai pugeje, ewo tugogadodu pemegado ji.
source: Akore: - Judeudoge emagore pui barogwatoie togwamagudumode ai awo Paulo reko judeudoge eimejerage eegai pugeje, ewo tugogadodu pemegado ji.

b: Akirema, awiapaga kaba ewadaruji. Paga karega, ia ime ere ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu, duwuge emode tuwiado awara okwai tuwo bito. Ere togwatugu Pao jekai togwagemodukae iaboe oeji, tugudumodukae iaboe boece jii tumode bito du otodai. Enure turugadu, epagamode awadaru bogai tu je.
source: Akirema, awiapaga kaba ewadaruji. Paga karega, ia ime ere ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu, duwuge emode tuwiado awara okwai tuwo bito. Ere togwatugu Pao jekai togwagemodukae iaboe oeji, tugudumodukae iaboe boece jii tumode bito du otodai. Enure turugadu, epagamode awadaru bogai tu je.

b:
Icare nowu brae eimejera ure nowu iparedu utudo, akore ji mako kaiagu iaboe boei tuie bie pudui duji.
Paulo rekodudodui Cesaria kaedu.
source:
Icare nowu brae eimejera ure nowu iparedu utudo, akore ji mako kaiagu iaboe boei tuie bie pudui duji.
Paulo rekodudodui Cesaria kaedu.

b:
Du keje icare makore tugobaigarege eimejerage ei pobedu bogai, akore ei: - 
Tamode tugobaigarege ei 200 cedu edo turugadu etuwo Cesaréia kae, awu boeco kajeje.
source:
Du keje icare makore tugobaigarege eimejerage ei pobedu bogai, akore ei: - 
Tamode tugobaigarege ei 200 cedu edo turugadu etuwo Cesaréia kae, awu boeco kajeje.

b: Tamode kawarudoge edo turugadu Paulo bogai jamedu, dure tamode reko pagimejera Félix ae. Taetu pemegado ji.
source: Tamode kawarudoge edo turugadu Paulo bogai jamedu, dure tamode reko pagimejera Félix ae. Taetu pemegado ji.

b: Ure ia bapera atugodo tagoi oino du tabo:
source: Ure ia bapera atugodo tagoi oino du tabo:

b: "Cludio Lísia ikimadu nure pagimejera kurireu Félix awogai.
source: "Cludio Lísia ikimadu nure pagimejera kurireu Félix awogai.

b: Judeudoge ere awu imedu ieragogudo, eiagu bito, du kejere icare itaregodure ae ino tugobaigarege ebo, icare iordure Roma kejewuie ure ema duji, du kodire ire inorudo ekera piji.
source: Judeudoge ere awu imedu ieragogudo, eiagu bito, du kejere icare itaregodure ae ino tugobaigarege ebo, icare iordure Roma kejewuie ure ema duji, du kodire ire inorudo ekera piji.

b: Du keje icare itaidure iorduwawo kaba kodiba ere tuiagu bito, du kodire ire reko judeudoge eimejerage eegai, ewo tugogado ji,
source: Du keje icare itaidure iorduwawo kaba kodiba ere tuiagu bito, du kodire ire reko judeudoge eimejerage eegai, ewo tugogado ji,

b: Icare imeardure eie tuiagu bito turoiagudu koia, mare ia ro pegareu bokware ewo bito, iarema ewo tugu baicoreuto.
source: Icare imeardure eie tuiagu bito turoiagudu koia, mare ia ro pegareu bokware ewo bito, iarema ewo tugu baicoreuto.

b: Mare du kejere icare ia boere iwie ia judeudogeie tudo turugadu tuwo bito rugadu, du kodire icare ire boedo reko toro akae, imagore onare jiwugei etuwo akae jamedu. Urugadu. Amugu pemegado.
source: Mare du kejere icare ia boere iwie ia judeudogeie tudo turugadu tuwo bito rugadu, du kodire icare ire boedo reko toro akae, imagore onare jiwugei etuwo akae jamedu. Urugadu. Amugu pemegado.

b: Icare, nowu boecoji nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Pauloji, nowu tugimejera mako rekodaji, icare ere reko toro Antipátride kae.
source: Icare, nowu boecoji nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Pauloji, nowu tugimejera mako rekodaji, icare ere reko toro Antipátride kae.

b: Barogwatore icare ere maku kawaru epage etae, ewo reko tododai, pudumire icare ere tugirimi tuibagi tumuga kae pugeje.
source: Barogwatore icare ere maku kawaru epage etae, ewo reko tododai, pudumire icare ere tugirimi tuibagi tumuga kae pugeje.

b: Etaregodure Cesaréia bakurireuto du keje, ere bapera maku nowu brae eimejera ai, ere jordudo Pauloji jamedu.
source: Etaregodure Cesaréia bakurireuto du keje, ere bapera maku nowu brae eimejera ai, ere jordudo Pauloji jamedu.

b: Icare makore nowu bapera atugoji, du kejere icare unoragodure ei kakoduwu moto kajeba. Egore: Cilécia moto kejewu reno. Icare akore: - 35 Iwiapagamode ai, onare aiwuge etaregodumode du keje. Icare ure edo Paulo jetu otorogado judeudoge eimejera Herodes uwai kurireu tada.
source: Icare makore nowu bapera atugoji, du kejere icare unoragodure ei kakoduwu moto kajeba. Egore: Cilécia moto kejewu reno. Icare akore: - 35 Iwiapagamode ai, onare aiwuge etaregodumode du keje. Icare ure edo Paulo jetu otorogado judeudoge eimejera Herodes uwai kurireu tada.

b: Brae eimejerage ere tugogado Pauloji.
source: Brae eimejerage ere tugogado Pauloji.

b: Merire pagera awubodure du rekodajire icare nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera kurireu ure turawuje nowu kae, ia codureuge ebo, ia boe eroiagudu epa iei Tertulo cedu kodure ebo. Etaregodure du kejere, eture nowu brae eimejera kurireu ae, tumago pegawo Pauloji biegai.
source: Merire pagera awubodure du rekodajire icare nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera kurireu ure turawuje nowu kae, ia codureuge ebo, ia boe eroiagudu epa iei Tertulo cedu kodure ebo. Etaregodure du kejere, eture nowu brae eimejera kurireu ae, tumago pegawo Pauloji biegai.

b: Emagore Paulo bogai tuwo tugogado ji. Icare nowu Tertulo mako pegare ji nowu brae eimejera jekai, akore: - Akire are boe pemegado cei, are boe butugudo cei. Aro koiare boe ero pegareu makareu kadodure ceno moto keje.
source: Emagore Paulo bogai tuwo tugogado ji. Icare nowu Tertulo mako pegare ji nowu brae eimejera jekai, akore: - Akire are boe pemegado cei, are boe butugudo cei. Aro koiare boe ero pegareu makareu kadodure ceno moto keje.

b: Ceerduware aroinoduji, boe jamedu boeji jii je, boe jamedu boe keje, akarureu Félix, du kodire cenure tukutaido ai.
source: Ceerduware aroinoduji, boe jamedu boeji jii je, boe jamedu boe keje, akarureu Félix, du kodire cenure tukutaido ai.

b: Macare itaidukare boe koriwo ai jii je du kodire inogwamagudu nure ai awiapagawo iwadaruji jao.
source: Macare itaidukare boe koriwo ai jii je du kodire inogwamagudu nure ai awiapagawo iwadaruji jao.

b: Ceerdure awu imeduji, pega remawure, ure boe erugo pui boe jamedu boe keje, judeudoge etada. Nazareudoge ia eimejera nure ema.
source: Ceerdure awu imeduji, pega remawure, ure boe erugo pui boe jamedu boe keje, judeudoge etada. Nazareudoge ia eimejera nure ema.

b: Uiagu Pao uwai pegado jamedu, macare cere cegeragu ji. 7(Cedaidure cewo cegogado ji, ceroiagudu rekodaji, mare nowu brae eimejera iei Lísias cedu aregodure, icare ure tugeragu cegera piji turaga tabo taci je, icare ure onare jiwuge cedudo mato aegai).
source: Uiagu Pao uwai pegado jamedu, macare cere cegeragu ji. 7(Cedaidure cewo cegogado ji, ceroiagudu rekodaji, mare nowu brae eimejera iei Lísias cedu aregodure, icare ure tugeragu cegera piji turaga tabo taci je, icare ure onare jiwuge cedudo mato aegai).

b: Ica, aki mitodu anoramode ji, du tabore aerduwamode cemagore ai jiboeji jamedu boe ema remawuie.
source: Ica, aki mitodu anoramode ji, du tabore aerduwamode cemagore ai jiboeji jamedu boe ema remawuie.

b: Icare nowu judeudoge ere tuiodo nowu turoiagudu epa bataru keje, egore oinoie ure rugadu.
source: Icare nowu judeudoge ere tuiodo nowu turoiagudu epa bataru keje, egore oinoie ure rugadu.

b:
Du keje icare nowu brae eimejera ure tugera amagadudo Paulo bogai, icare Paulo akore: 
Iorduware joru makaguragare aetui awu moto jitu duji, du kodire imagomode iparu tabo aegai ipagudu bokwa tabo, imeartorui ai du tabo.
source:
Du keje icare nowu brae eimejera ure tugera amagadudo Paulo bogai, icare Paulo akore: 
Iorduware joru makaguragare aetui awu moto jitu duji, du kodire imagomode iparu tabo aegai ipagudu bokwa tabo, imeartorui ai du tabo.

b: Boe rakamodukare ai aerduwawo meri kodukae ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu kori irudui Jerusalém bakurireuto du piji. Irudure toro, inogwamaguduwo Paoji.
