b: Tumeartoru koiare Sara jamedu roiware tuguiaruwo, codure kodi karega, meartorure makore pudaiwu Pao bataruji kodi.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Sara jamedu roiware tuguiaruwo, codure kodi karega, meartorure makore pudaiwu Pao bataruji kodi.

b: Du kodire puredugodure puduiwu imedu mito tu jedu pijire, uwobe etaregodure, duwuge emagaguragare nono baru tadawu kuiejedoge ereore, eremagududodukare nono pobo maereu okwaiwu kugaru remagududodumodukare du reore.
source: Du kodire puredugodure puduiwu imedu mito tu jedu pijire, uwobe etaregodure, duwuge emagaguragare nono baru tadawu kuiejedoge ereore, eremagududodukare nono pobo maereu okwaiwu kugaru remagududodumodukare du reore.

b: Tumeartoru kejere pagododaiwuge ewire taregodukai makudumode pudaiwu moto kae, egore ia moto tuginoiwu kejewugeie ure pudumi, emeruie ure tu je awu moto keje.
source: Tumeartoru kejere pagododaiwuge ewire taregodukai makudumode pudaiwu moto kae, egore ia moto tuginoiwu kejewugeie ure pudumi, emeruie ure tu je awu moto keje.

b: Tagoi oino du tabo ere boe edo boe pa tugodui ia tumugumode kejewu moto kae duji.
source: Tagoi oino du tabo ere boe edo boe pa tugodui ia tumugumode kejewu moto kae duji.

b: Emagomode cewu taregodure pijiwu motoji ma, eroiwamode tuwo tugirimi kae pugeje.
source: Emagomode cewu taregodure pijiwu motoji ma, eroiwamode tuwo tugirimi kae pugeje.

b: Paci oino, etu nure moto pemega kodui nowu moto pemega koriwu bogai, baru tadaboe bogaire eroino. Du kodire Pao Aroe Eimejera ukare inodu perodudo boe egoi to Aroe Eimejeraie ure pudumi duji. Paga karega, ure ia bakurireudo turugadu etai.
source: Paci oino, etu nure moto pemega kodui nowu moto pemega koriwu bogai, baru tadaboe bogaire eroino. Du kodire Pao Aroe Eimejera ukare inodu perodudo boe egoi to Aroe Eimejeraie ure pudumi duji. Paga karega, ure ia bakurireudo turugadu etai.

b: Tumeartoru koiare Abraão, Paoi turokogado ji du keje, ure tonaregedu mito tu jedu maku, Pao o boe pemegareu makudumode ai kodi karega.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Abraão, Paoi turokogado ji du keje, ure tonaregedu mito tu jedu maku, Pao o boe pemegareu makudumode ai kodi karega.

b: Pao akore ji marigudu: “Isaac kejere botumode aiwuge eiedodumode” (Gn 21,12).
source: Pao akore ji marigudu: “Isaac kejere botumode aiwuge eiedodumode” (Gn 21,12).

b: Meardae nure Pao ro rakaie tuwo bireuge ewodudo. Du inodu koiare jiwo aidugirire tonaregedu makuduwo pudai pugeje. Du inodu ure nono ia kodiboe pemegareu pagai.
source: Meardae nure Pao ro rakaie tuwo bireuge ewodudo. Du inodu koiare jiwo aidugirire tonaregedu makuduwo pudai pugeje. Du inodu ure nono ia kodiboe pemegareu pagai.

b: Tumeartoru koiare Isaac ure tugera bu Jacó aora keje, Esaú aora keje, umode tudowuje eiboe koia.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Isaac ure tugera bu Jacó aora keje, Esaú aora keje, umode tudowuje eiboe koia.

b: Tumeartoru koiare Jacó, tuwogwamode du otodai, ure tugera bu José ore etao keje tu tu je, du kejere ure tubujodo tuioi tuiodo keje du tabo.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Jacó, tuwogwamode du otodai, ure tugera bu José ore etao keje tu tu je, du kejere ure tubujodo tuioi tuiodo keje du tabo.

b: Tumeartoru koiare José, tuwogwamodedu otodai, akore Israeldoge emode tudawuje nowu moto piji duji, makore inoba eromode tura tabo duji.
source: Tumeartoru koiare José, tuwogwamodedu otodai, akore Israeldoge emode tudawuje nowu moto piji duji, makore inoba eromode tura tabo duji.

b: Tumeartoru koiare Moisés uomagere biado arii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du tabo, tuiordu motui tonaregedu jitu koia. Epagudukare brae eimejera kurireu bataru keje.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Moisés uomagere biado arii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du tabo, tuiordu motui tonaregedu jitu koia. Epagudukare brae eimejera kurireu bataru keje.

b: Tumeartoru koiare Moisés, aregodui imedu pudae du keje, ure tugera ra Faraó onaregedu aredu onaregedui pudumi du piji.
source: Tumeartoru koiare Moisés, aregodui imedu pudae du keje, ure tugera ra Faraó onaregedu aredu onaregedui pudumi du piji.

b: Aidure tujebaewo Pao uwobe ecebaece, mare tuwo togwa pagado boe etaidae pegareu akedumode kurijewuji karega.
source: Aidure tujebaewo Pao uwobe ecebaece, mare tuwo togwa pagado boe etaidae pegareu akedumode kurijewuji karega.

b: Tuioku kidui makudumode pudaiboe keje, jordure Cristo aiwu tujebae pemega kodui nowu Egito kejewuge eiamedu boe enoroe pemega kori.
source: Tuioku kidui makudumode pudaiboe keje, jordure Cristo aiwu tujebae pemega kodui nowu Egito kejewuge eiamedu boe enoroe pemega kori.

b: Tumeartoru koiare uture Egito piji, tubagudukai brae eimejera kurireu korigoduji. Meartorure nono tuiordui boe eerdukare jiboe reore.
source: Tumeartoru koiare uture Egito piji, tubagudukai brae eimejera kurireu korigoduji. Meartorure nono tuiordui boe eerdukare jiboe reore.

b: Tumeartoru koiare ure boe edo Páscoa parudo, ure boe edo tuwai poro krucado barogo ku tabo, du ma, umode brae etore boetojiwuge ewidowu Pao o tupa ukawo Israeldoge etore boetojiwuge ewido.
source: Tumeartoru koiare ure boe edo Páscoa parudo, ure boe edo tuwai poro krucado barogo ku tabo, du ma, umode brae etore boetojiwuge ewidowu Pao o tupa ukawo Israeldoge etore boetojiwuge ewido.

b: Tumeartoru koiare ure Israeldoge edo Pobo Maereu Kujagureu pagado bakowuto, ekodui moto kidureu jitu reore, du tonajire, Egito kejewuge eregodui eregodajidu ewogware poboto.
source: Tumeartoru koiare ure Israeldoge edo Pobo Maereu Kujagureu pagado bakowuto, ekodui moto kidureu jitu reore, du tonajire, Egito kejewuge eregodui eregodajidu ewogware poboto.

b: Tumeartoru koiare ure Jericó bakurireu oieiwu motori kurireu butudo, tui bakuredo ji meri ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du rekodaji.
source: Tumeartoru koiare ure Jericó bakurireu oieiwu motori kurireu butudo, tui bakuredo ji meri ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du rekodaji.

b: Tumeartoru koiare nowu ro pegareu aredu iei Raab cedu, ure cinorudo, du kodire bikare nowu onare Pao jiwuge ebo, ure tugeragu tuwaito butugu tabo oe aiworeuge ei kodi.
source: Tumeartoru koiare nowu ro pegareu aredu iei Raab cedu, ure cinorudo, du kodire bikare nowu onare Pao jiwuge ebo, ure tugeragu tuwaito butugu tabo oe aiworeuge ei kodi.

b: Inoba inagomode pugeje? Boe umodukare turugadu inai imagowo Gedeao, Barac, Sansão. Jefté, Davi, Samuel, profetadoge ero jiboeji.
source: Inoba inagomode pugeje? Boe umodukare turugadu inai imagowo Gedeao, Barac, Sansão. Jefté, Davi, Samuel, profetadoge ero jiboeji.

b: Tumeartoru koiare ere tugeragu brae eno moto boeji, ere boe ero jetorogodudo, ere barege pegareuge eia mi, makudumode pudaiboe makudure etai.
source: Tumeartoru koiare ere tugeragu brae eno moto boeji, ere boe ero jetorogodudo, ere barege pegareuge eia mi, makudumode pudaiboe makudure etai.

b: Ere joru kurireu bitudo, ere cinorudo toriga raireu o piji, ere turagojedo tugogodae piji, erokare doi doi je boe etonai pudui du keje, ere tumorido moto tuginoiwu kejewu tugobaigaregei.
source: Ere joru kurireu bitudo, ere cinorudo toriga raireu o piji, ere turagojedo tugogodae piji, erokare doi doi je boe etonai pudui du keje, ere tumorido moto tuginoiwu kejewu tugobaigaregei.

b: Ere ia bireu boe etore eewodudo pugeje, ere maku etujemage ekera kai pugeje. Iage boe erorerure ei, etaidukare boewo meriri iku kiwuje tugera piji, epagare ia mori kuri remawureboe bogai du kodi.
source: Ere ia bireu boe etore eewodudo pugeje, ere maku etujemage ekera kai pugeje. Iage boe erorerure ei, etaidukare boewo meriri iku kiwuje tugera piji, epagare ia mori kuri remawureboe bogai du kodi.

b: Iage boe emago pegare ei, boere boe to ei, boere ekera kogudo meriri iku tabo, ere tugu baicoreuto.
source: Iage boe emago pegare ei, boere boe to ei, boere ekera kogudo meriri iku tabo, ere tugu baicoreuto.

b: Tori todure ei, boere ewido, boere ewowuje etoiado, boere ewido toriga raireu tabo. Iage emeru paga pagare jice woje, ovelhadoge, cabradoge ewiri metui pudui du tabo. Boe jamedu boe bokware etai, boe etonare ei, boe ekera kiogokare ei.
source: Tori todure ei, boere ewido, boere ewowuje etoiado, boere ewido toriga raireu tabo. Iage emeru paga pagare jice woje, ovelhadoge, cabradoge ewiri metui pudui du tabo. Boe jamedu boe bokware etai, boe etonare ei, boe ekera kiogokare ei.

b: Emeru pagare tori raireu boe kao, ere tuwiado tori poro tada, motoia boe tada. Awu moto ukare turugadu nowu imei.
source: Emeru pagare tori raireu boe kao, ere tuwiado tori poro tada, motoia boe tada. Awu moto ukare turugadu nowu imei.

b: Awuge eiamedu ewire tumeartoru koia, mare eerdukare tubagare bogaiboe ui tudowuje duji.
source: Awuge eiamedu ewire tumeartoru koia, mare eerdukare tubagare bogaiboe ui tudowuje duji.

b: Mare paga karega, Pao ure paiwo aidugirireu pemega remawureu jetu otorogado pagaidu, aidukare etaregoduwo pagododai boe pemegareu remawu kae.
source: Mare paga karega, Pao ure paiwo aidugirireu pemega remawureu jetu otorogado pagaidu, aidukare etaregoduwo pagododai boe pemegareu remawu kae.

b: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro.
source: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro.

b: Du kodi icare, pagi jamedu, awu pagododaiwuge makareuge ero rekodaji, pawo paro pegareu iku kiwuje pabiji, paregodu pemegawo awaraji, paeku kidui ure pameartoru maku pagaiwu, ure pabemegadowu Jesus keje.
source: Du kodi icare, pagi jamedu, awu pagododaiwuge makareuge ero rekodaji, pawo paro pegareu iku kiwuje pabiji, paregodu pemegawo awaraji, paeku kidui ure pameartoru maku pagaiwu, ure pabemegadowu Jesus keje.

b: Emare, tui boe etaidae pijido tubiji, pogurukare tuwo tudugu i padui pugajejedu kuda, tuwiwo keje. Du kodire icare ure tumugudo Pao kana pemegareu jaogwai.
source: Emare, tui boe etaidae pijido tubiji, pogurukare tuwo tudugu i padui pugajejedu kuda, tuwiwo keje. Du kodire icare ure tumugudo Pao kana pemegareu jaogwai.

b:
Tameardae tugudu pemegado cewu okoridodure oinowu pegareuge ekera tabowuto, du tabore taromodukare doi doi je.
Boe puredugodui boeidu.
source:
Tameardae tugudu pemegado cewu okoridodure oinowu pegareuge ekera tabowuto, du tabore taromodukare doi doi je.
Boe puredugodui boeidu.

b: Takare tadurudo roga jii tagu redo du kae tagonai taro pegareuji.
source: Takare tadurudo roga jii tagu redo du kae tagonai taro pegareuji.

b: Tawiagodure nowu Pao okituwai tai du piji: “Itonaregedu, akaba Pagimejera okituware aidu pijido, arokaba doi doi je, okituwai ai du keje.
source: Tawiagodure nowu Pao okituwai tai du piji: “Itonaregedu, akaba Pagimejera okituware aidu pijido, arokaba doi doi je, okituwai ai du keje.

b: Paga karega, Pagimejera okituware tumeardu kurire jiwugei, ure tore eiamedu boe eedorodo” (Prov 3,1112).
source: Paga karega, Pagimejera okituware tumeardu kurire jiwugei, ure tore eiamedu boe eedorodo” (Prov 3,1112).

b: Pao oebatodure tai tuwo taedorodo, du kodire Pao jeture tai, boe eetu magai torei du reore. Aro! Kakoduwu boe etonaregeduba uo okituwakare ji?
source: Pao oebatodure tai tuwo taedorodo, du kodire Pao jeture tai, boe eetu magai torei du reore. Aro! Kakoduwu boe etonaregeduba uo okituwakare ji?

b: Mare Pao okituwamodukare tai ma, ore remawuge karega umode tagi, ia boe etore pagawuge rumode tagi.
source: Mare Pao okituwamodukare tai ma, ore remawuge karega umode tagi, ia boe etore pagawuge rumode tagi.

b: Ia pugeje, awu moto kejewu paomagere duwugere enogituware pai, pameartorure ewadaruji. Kode, pameartorumodukare pagaroe etuo bataruji uwo jereboe maku pagai?
source: Ia pugeje, awu moto kejewu paomagere duwugere enogituware pai, pameartorure ewadaruji. Kode, pameartorumodukare pagaroe etuo bataruji uwo jereboe maku pagai?

b: Jewuge enogituware pai taidu reore, awurema okituware pai tuwo pabemegado du bogai, tuwo to boe pemegareboe maku pagai.
source: Jewuge enogituware pai taidu reore, awurema okituware pai tuwo pabemegado du bogai, tuwo to boe pemegareboe maku pagai.

b: Boe jokodu, boe enogituwadodu ure nono korireboere, boe eegareae karega, mare jetorododure oinowuge eonagodure boe jetororeuji, boe butugureuji.
source: Boe jokodu, boe enogituwadodu ure nono korireboere, boe eegareae karega, mare jetorododure oinowuge eonagodure boe jetororeuji, boe butugureuji.

b: Du kodire tagera metugodureu awogado, tabogodawu rore du du du jewu rakojedo (Is 35,3).
source: Du kodire tagera metugodureu awogado, tabogodawu rore du du du jewu rakojedo (Is 35,3).

b:
Awara mekireu jetorodo tameruwo ji, du tabowo pogora pegareuge ekawo tubogora pega jokodudo, mare epemegagoduwo.
 	Boe eroiaguduwu boe ero pemegareu.
source:
Awara mekireu jetorodo tameruwo ji, du tabowo pogora pegareuge ekawo tubogora pega jokodudo, mare epemegagoduwo.
 	Boe eroiaguduwu boe ero pemegareu.

b: Taemarudo tawo tawudugugo boe eiamedu boei, tawo tabemegado. Awu inodu pijimode ma, iaboe iaboe eerdumodukare Paoji.
source: Taemarudo tawo tawudugugo boe eiamedu boei, tawo tabemegado. Awu inodu pijimode ma, iaboe iaboe eerdumodukare Paoji.

b: Tameardu awadudo tai, takawo Pao o boe pemegareu ko tagori. Ia ukwa korireu jirireu botu kawo tadoda, ukawo makareuge emorora amagadudo, ukawo makareuge epegado tadoda.
source: Tameardu awadudo tai, takawo Pao o boe pemegareu ko tagori. Ia ukwa korireu jirireu botu kawo tadoda, ukawo makareuge emorora amagadudo, ukawo makareuge epegado tadoda.

b: Iaboe iaboe emedukawo tadoda Esaú ro magai tuge boi koia du reore: ure tuionare jiboe maku togwagemode jiboe jipagi.
source: Iaboe iaboe emedukawo tadoda Esaú ro magai tuge boi koia du reore: ure tuionare jiboe maku togwagemode jiboe jipagi.

b: Taerduware taidui tuowo tugera bu tao keje duji, onaregedu boetojiwu nure ema kodi, mare pijidodure, roiwakare tuwo tuodo tuwadaru kirimi, okwamagudure ji toragudu tabo kodi karega.
source: Taerduware taidui tuowo tugera bu tao keje duji, onaregedu boetojiwu nure ema kodi, mare pijidodure, roiwakare tuwo tuodo tuwadaru kirimi, okwamagudure ji toragudu tabo kodi karega.

b: Boe jokodu takare taburedo ia torekariji, joru uru rakareuji, boetuguji, boecoji, bakuru pegareu bubutu taboduji.
source: Boe jokodu takare taburedo ia torekariji, joru uru rakareuji, boetuguji, boecoji, bakuru pegareu bubutu taboduji.

b: Ika akoji, cewu ure boe epagududowu boe emago rakareuji, du boe emeardui jitu kejere enogwamagudure ji mako kawo pudui pugeje du bogai.
source: Ika akoji, cewu ure boe epagududowu boe emago rakareuji, du boe emeardui jitu kejere enogwamagudure ji mako kawo pudui pugeje du bogai.

b: Awu makoreboe ui epagududodu kuricigododu emareo: “Umode tugera bu awu torikari kejeboe eiamedu boe, barogomode ema jamedu ma, bitodumode tori tabo”  (Ex 19,2).
source: Awu makoreboe ui epagududodu kuricigododu emareo: “Umode tugera bu awu torikari kejeboe eiamedu boe, barogomode ema jamedu ma, bitodumode tori tabo”  (Ex 19,2).

b: Awu inodu boe epagudae pegareu nure ema, du kodire Moisés akore: “Irore du du du je ipagudu koia“  (Deut 9,19).
source: Awu inodu boe epagudae pegareu nure ema, du kodire Moisés akore: “Irore du du du je ipagudu koia“  (Deut 9,19).

b: Du karega. Tare taburedo Sião toriji, Pao jereu o bakurireuji, baru tadawu Jerusalemji, makaguragareu tupadogei.
source: Du karega. Tare taburedo Sião toriji, Pao jereu o bakurireuji, baru tadawu Jerusalemji, makaguragareu tupadogei.

b: Ia padure baru tadawu bapera keje boetojiwu boei tudo pui tuiegare tabowuji, ure tugogado boe eimadu boeiwu Paoji, ure tubemegadowu ro pemegareuge aroedogei.
source: Ia padure baru tadawu bapera keje boetojiwu boei tudo pui tuiegare tabowuji, ure tugogado boe eimadu boeiwu Paoji, ure tubemegadowu ro pemegareuge aroedogei.

b: Tare taburedo Jesusji, ure aliança maiwu towuje, ure tugu reko paiogi, du pemega kodure Abel ku pemega kori.
source: Tare taburedo Jesusji, ure aliança maiwu towuje, ure tugu reko paiogi, du pemega kodure Abel ku pemega kori.

b: Du kodi icare, tameardu awadudo tai, takawo nowu makoreboe akaru perodudo, paga karega, cewu ure tuiaedo bataru piji makoi ei awu moto keje du tabowuge, ekare cinorudo mori pegareu piji ma, kode pagi, pamode pijido akoi pai baru piji du keje, pamodukare paginorudo rugadu jamedu.
source: Du kodi icare, tameardu awadudo tai, takawo nowu makoreboe akaru perodudo, paga karega, cewu ure tuiaedo bataru piji makoi ei awu moto keje du tabowuge, ekare cinorudo mori pegareu piji ma, kode pagi, pamode pijido akoi pai baru piji du keje, pamodukare paginorudo rugadu jamedu.

b: Marigudu ure moto amagadudo tuwadaru tabo. Awuji pugeje makore pai awu tuwadaru remawu tabo: “Ia pugeje, imode moto amagadudo, imode baru amagadudo jamedu”.
source: Marigudu ure moto amagadudo tuwadaru tabo. Awuji pugeje makore pai awu tuwadaru remawu tabo: “Ia pugeje, imode moto amagadudo, imode baru amagadudo jamedu”.

b: Tagoi oino: “Ia pugeje” du tabore, unure boedo boe pa awu todureboe jamedu boe akedumoduie duji, ukare tudududoboe rakojemode tu rugadu.
source: Tagoi oino: “Ia pugeje” du tabore, unure boedo boe pa awu todureboe jamedu boe akedumoduie duji, ukare tudududoboe rakojemode tu rugadu.

b: Du kodi icare pamugure ia boe eeda akedumodukareu keje du koiare, pagedu rakawo awu boe pemegareuji, pamaragoduwo tabo Pao ai, pai aidudo du tabo, pabagudu tabo, pabemega tabo.
source: Du kodi icare pamugure ia boe eeda akedumodukareu keje du koiare, pagedu rakawo awu boe pemegareuji, pamaragoduwo tabo Pao ai, pai aidudo du tabo, pabagudu tabo, pabemega tabo.

b: Paga karega, Pao baru tadawu ure nono joru joi boe todu rema. (Deut 4, 24).
source: Paga karega, Pao baru tadawu ure nono joru joi boe todu rema. (Deut 4, 24).

b: Boe enogituwae.
source: Boe enogituwae.

b: Tameardu kurido pui jii je.
source: Tameardu kurido pui jii je.

b: Tawiagodu kaba tawo tageragu tawai keje aregodure tagaiwugei du piji, paga karega, iage ere tugeragu tupadogei, tuiorduwakai tupadogeie ure emage duji.
source: Tawiagodu kaba tawo tageragu tawai keje aregodure tagaiwugei du piji, paga karega, iage ere tugeragu tupadogei, tuiorduwakai tupadogeie ure emage duji.

b: Tawiabutudo mugure baicoreu tadawuge ewugeje, tado nono tamugui baicoreu tada ebo du reore. Tawiabutudo mugure tujebae tadawuge ewugeje, tado nono tameduie ure ekodu ewiri tadadu reore.
source: Tawiabutudo mugure baicoreu tadawuge ewugeje, tado nono tamugui baicoreu tada ebo du reore. Tawiabutudo mugure tujebae tadawuge ewugeje, tado nono tameduie ure ekodu ewiri tadadu reore.

b: Taiamedu tabo, taerdu pemegado tagera makudui puai duji, takawo inodu pegado, paga karega, Pao umode tugogado ro pegareugei, kodure tugogekare emawu, tuwirekare emawudo apuwugei.
source: Taiamedu tabo, taerdu pemegado tagera makudui puai duji, takawo inodu pegado, paga karega, Pao umode tugogado ro pegareugei, kodure tugogekare emawu, tuwirekare emawudo apuwugei.

b: Taedorikaba pui, taegaredo jeture tagabo boeji, mare paga karega, Pao akore: “Imodukare ikera ra apiji, iwiapaga bokwamodukare ai” (Deut 31,6).
source: Taedorikaba pui, taegaredo jeture tagabo boeji, mare paga karega, Pao akore: “Imodukare ikera ra apiji, iwiapaga bokwamodukare ai” (Deut 31,6).

b: Du kodire paroiware pamagowo pameartoru tabo: “Pagimejera unure tugera braredo ii, ipagudure ceboe bokwa, inoba imedu romode ii?” (Sl 117,5).
source: Du kodire paroiware pamagowo pameartoru tabo: “Pagimejera unure tugera braredo ii, ipagudure ceboe bokwa, inoba imedu romode ii?” (Sl 117,5).

b: Tawiabutudo makore Pao bataruji taiwuge ewugeje. Tameardae tugu inoba ewire, tameartorudo emeartoru reore.
source: Tawiabutudo makore Pao bataruji taiwuge ewugeje. Tameardae tugu inoba ewire, tameartorudo emeartoru reore.

b: Jesus Cristo unure pudumi jii je, jawuji, awuji, boe jameduji jii je.
source: Jesus Cristo unure pudumi jii je, jawuji, awuji, boe jameduji jii je.

b: Tagaba boedo taeku to pui ia tuwadaru tuginoiwu keje. Ure turugadu tawo tagaroe ro rakado Pao o boe pemegareu tabo, mare tamagoi boe emode ko boejitu pemegamodukare iaboeji iaboeji.
source: Tagaba boedo taeku to pui ia tuwadaru tuginoiwu keje. Ure turugadu tawo tagaroe ro rakado Pao o boe pemegareu tabo, mare tamagoi boe emode ko boejitu pemegamodukare iaboeji iaboeji.

b: Ceno altar re (Ceno boere mori maku Pao ai kejewu irare). Maragodure Pao o aroia bai tadawuge enogwagemodukare nowu ira kejeboeji.
source: Ceno altar re (Ceno boere mori maku Pao ai kejewu irare). Maragodure Pao o aroia bai tadawuge enogwagemodukare nowu ira kejeboeji.

b: Paga karega, judeudoge eno baire eimejera kurireu ure bitodureboe barege eku reko tuwo maku Pao uwaito boe ero pegareu morice du keje, awu barege ekodu kowudure bakujei.
source: Paga karega, judeudoge eno baire eimejera kurireu ure bitodureboe barege eku reko tuwo maku Pao uwaito boe ero pegareu morice du keje, awu barege ekodu kowudure bakujei.

b: Du kodire Jesus jamedu, taidui tuwo tuwobe epemegado tugu remawu tabo du keje, jiwore bakujei.
source: Du kodire Jesus jamedu, taidui tuwo tuwobe epemegado tugu remawu tabo du keje, jiwore bakujei.

b: Kode, paduwo togi bakujebiji, pai ucebae reko pagabo du tabo.
source: Kode, paduwo togi bakujebiji, pai ucebae reko pagabo du tabo.

b: Paga karega, pago bakurireu rakojei jii je bokware woe, mare pameru nure paemaru tabo ia aregodumodewu bakurireu bogai.
source: Paga karega, pago bakurireu rakojei jii je bokware woe, mare pameru nure paemaru tabo ia aregodumodewu bakurireu bogai.

b: Du kodi icare, pawo pagomea pemegareu maku Pao ai Jesus koia, awu inodure boe eiabijiwu boe emago pemagai ie jitu rema.
source: Du kodi icare, pawo pagomea pemegareu maku Pao ai Jesus koia, awu inodure boe eiabijiwu boe emago pemagai ie jitu rema.

b: Tagaba taro pemegai puidu pijido, tagaba tameardu kurii puidu pijido. Awu tagomea oinodu ure Pao aidudo.
source: Tagaba taro pemegai puidu pijido, tagaba tameardu kurii puidu pijido. Awu tagomea oinodu ure Pao aidudo.

b:
Tameartorudo jeture taiwuge ewadaruji: eetu nure tagaroeji, Pao umode tugogado ei, du kode eromode oino tuiegare tabo, mare toragudu tabo karega, du umodukare turugadu tai.
Bapera ao.
source:
Tameartorudo jeture taiwuge ewadaruji: eetu nure tagaroeji, Pao umode tugogado ei, du kode eromode oino tuiegare tabo, mare toragudu tabo karega, du umodukare turugadu tai.
Bapera ao.

b: Tamagodo Paoji cenai, ceerduware cemeardae jetoroie duji, cenure cedurudo cero pemegawo cero jamedu boeji tu je.
source: Tamagodo Paoji cenai, ceerduware cemeardae jetoroie duji, cenure cedurudo cero pemegawo cero jamedu boeji tu je.

b: Tamagodo Paoji jii je inai, iwo ikirimi tawogai kuri je.
source: Tamagodo Paoji jii je inai, iwo ikirimi tawogai kuri je.

b: Pao butugureu, koiare ure jeture paiwu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo biereuge epiji aliança maiwu jiwu ku koia.
source: Pao butugureu, koiare ure jeture paiwu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo biereuge epiji aliança maiwu jiwu ku koia.

b: Uwo tagiari kado taro pemegareuji, tarowo nono taidu reore, turoi tadoda taidure jiboeji, Jesus Cristo koia. Boewo akaru kurido jii je. Oino godu.
source: Uwo tagiari kado taro pemegareuji, tarowo nono taidu reore, turoi tadoda taidure jiboeji, Jesus Cristo koia. Boewo akaru kurido jii je. Oino godu.

b: Inogwamagudu nure tai, iwiemage, tawo tageragu awu imagore taiboe inogituwa tabo duji, paga karega, ire bapera atugododu biegado tagai kodi.
source: Inogwamagudu nure tai, iwiemage, tawo tageragu awu imagore taiboe inogituwa tabo duji, paga karega, ire bapera atugododu biegado tagai kodi.

b: Taerduware pawie Timóteo ui tudawuje baicoreu piji duji. Umode tugirimi marigudu ma, ikodumode apo iorduwo tai.
source: Taerduware pawie Timóteo ui tudawuje baicoreu piji duji. Umode tugirimi marigudu ma, ikodumode apo iorduwo tai.

b: Tagimadudo jeture taiwuge eiamedu apo, pemegareuge eiamedu boe ebo. Awu Itália kejewu pawiemage eimadu nure tawogai.
source: Tagimadudo jeture taiwuge eiamedu apo, pemegareuge eiamedu boe ebo. Awu Itália kejewu pawiemage eimadu nure tawogai.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu muguwo taiamedu apo. Oino godu.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu muguwo taiamedu apo. Oino godu.

b: Ure boe eedowu Bataru.
source: Ure boe eedowu Bataru.

b: Boe paru ui tudowuje du otodai, Bataru ure marigudu. Bataru mugure Aroe Eimejera apo. Bataru Aroe Eimejera nure ema rugadu.
source: Boe paru ui tudowuje du otodai, Bataru ure marigudu. Bataru mugure Aroe Eimejera apo. Bataru Aroe Eimejera nure ema rugadu.

b: Boe paru ui tudowuje du otodai, Bataru mugure Pao apo rugadu.
source: Boe paru ui tudowuje du otodai, Bataru mugure Pao apo rugadu.

b: Koiare ure boe jamedu boe towuje; taobiji karega boe jamedu boere tudowuje: Koiare ure towuje.
source: Koiare ure boe jamedu boe towuje; taobiji karega boe jamedu boere tudowuje: Koiare ure towuje.

b: Tadare jereboe mugure; nowu jereboe, ime eerugu nure ema.
source: Tadare jereboe mugure; nowu jereboe, ime eerugu nure ema.

b: Nowu urugureboe jore boecoto, mare boeco ukare tugeragu ji.
source: Nowu urugureboe jore boecoto, mare boeco ukare tugeragu ji.

b: Paore ia imedu iere João cedu rojai,
source: Paore ia imedu iere João cedu rojai,

b: Makowo urugureboe jiboeji, du koiawo boe eiamedu boe emeartorure.
source: Makowo urugureboe jiboeji, du koiawo boe eiamedu boe emeartorure.

b: Urugureboe karega ure awu imeduce, mare aregodure tumagowo boe jokoduie nowu urugureboe rema.
source: Urugureboe karega ure awu imeduce, mare aregodure tumagowo boe jokoduie nowu urugureboe rema.

b: Nowu urugureboe, boe riki remawu urugureboe, du aregodui awu mato kae du keje, urugu jore ime eiameduto.
source: Nowu urugureboe, boe riki remawu urugureboe, du aregodui awu mato kae du keje, urugu jore ime eiameduto.

b: Rakojere moto keje, koiare ure awu moto towuje, mare awu moto jorduwakare ji.
source: Rakojere moto keje, koiare ure awu moto towuje, mare awu moto jorduwakare ji.

b: Aregodure woe toe remaboe kae mare nowu oere emawuge ekare tugeragu ji.
source: Aregodure woe toe remaboe kae mare nowu oere emawuge ekare tugeragu ji.

b: Mare cewu ure tugeragu jiwuge eiamedu boe, duwugere emeartorure ieji, ure turo rakareu maku etai, ewo Pao Aroe Eimejare oredo pudumi.
source: Mare cewu ure tugeragu jiwuge eiamedu boe, duwugere emeartorure ieji, ure turo rakareu maku etai, ewo Pao Aroe Eimejare oredo pudumi.

b: Awuge ewodukare ime eku koia, boe ekodu koia, boe etaidu koia, mare tu Pao Aroe Eimejera koiare ure ewodudo.
source: Awuge ewodukare ime eku koia, boe ekodu koia, boe etaidu koia, mare tu Pao Aroe Eimejera koiare ure ewodudo.

b: Ica, Batarure imedudo pudumi, mugure padoda, paerdure o boe pemegareu kurireuji, cewu Paore maku tonaregedu ui mitotu jewu aiwu, okorobadui boe pemegareu boe rikireu tabo duji.
source: Ica, Batarure imedudo pudumi, mugure padoda, paerdure o boe pemegareu kurireuji, cewu Paore maku tonaregedu ui mitotu jewu aiwu, okorobadui boe pemegareu boe rikireu tabo duji.

b: João makore ji awu tagoino du tabo: - Awu jire inagore oino: cewu aregodumode iregodajiwu, emare kuri remawu nure ikori, ema ure marigudu ikoda piji kodi.
source: João makore ji awu tagoino du tabo: - Awu jire inagore oino: cewu aregodumode iregodajiwu, emare kuri remawu nure ikori, ema ure marigudu ikoda piji kodi.

b: O boe pemegareu makudure paiamedu ai, o boe pemegareu joi puregodajitu.
source: O boe pemegareu makudure paiamedu ai, o boe pemegareu joi puregodajitu.

b: Paga karega, Moisesre boe eroiagudu maku boe etai, mare boe pemegareu, boe rikireu aregodure mato Jesus Cristo koia.
source: Paga karega, Moisesre boe eroiagudu maku boe etai, mare boe pemegareu, boe rikireu aregodure mato Jesus Cristo koia.

b:
Iaboe iaboe eerdukare Aroe Eimejeraji. Onaregedu mitotu metui Pao tadadu koiare ure paerdudo ji.
João Batista.
source:
Iaboe iaboe eerdukare Aroe Eimejeraji. Onaregedu mitotu metui Pao tadadu koiare ure paerdudo ji.
João Batista.

b: Awu inodu jire João akore, cewu judeudoge ei sacerdotedoge, levitadoge erojai Jerusalém piji enorawo ji: - Ioguduba akibao?
source: Awu inodu jire João akore, cewu judeudoge ei sacerdotedoge, levitadoge erojai Jerusalém piji enorawo ji: - Ioguduba akibao?

b: Icare ure boe jokodu rugadudo, ure inodu awadudo tubagudu bokwa tabo, akore: - Imi karega Cristore imi.
source: Icare ure boe jokodu rugadudo, ure inodu awadudo tubagudu bokwa tabo, akore: - Imi karega Cristore imi.

b: Enoragodure ji: - Kode, ioguduba akibao? Elias akinao?  Akore: - Ema, imi karega. Egore: - Akina profetare aki?  Akore: - Boro.
source: Enoragodure ji: - Kode, ioguduba akibao? Elias akinao?  Akore: - Ema, imi karega. Egore: - Akina profetare aki?  Akore: - Boro.

b: Enoragodure ji pugeje, egore: - Kode, amagodo cewiegai ioguduba ure aki, cemagowo ure cerojaiwuge ewiegai. Kode, inoba akagomode ai?
source: Enoragodure ji pugeje, egore: - Kode, amagodo cewiegai ioguduba ure aki, cemagowo ure cerojaiwuge ewiegai. Kode, inoba akagomode ai?

b: Akore ei: - Imire cewu mako padure boe makodu kajejeure imi: “Pagimejera utawara jetorodo” profeta Isaias ako magadu reore. (Is 40,3).
source: Akore ei: - Imire cewu mako padure boe makodu kajejeure imi: “Pagimejera utawara jetorodo” profeta Isaias ako magadu reore. (Is 40,3).

b: Fariseudoge eigoiare erojaidodure.
source: Fariseudoge eigoiare erojaidodure.

b: Enora kimore ji, egore: - Kode, kodiba are boe etao pegodo? Cristo karega ure aki, Elias karega ure aki, profeta karega ure aki, kode, kodiba aro aroino?
source: Enora kimore ji, egore: - Kode, kodiba are boe etao pegodo? Cristo karega ure aki, Elias karega ure aki, profeta karega ure aki, kode, kodiba aro aroino?

b: João akore: - Ire boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, mare tadoda, taerduwakare jiwu rakojere tadoda.
source: João akore: - Ire boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, mare tadoda, taerduwakare jiwu rakojere tadoda.

b: Dure cewu aregodumode iregodajiwu rema, duwure icekare iwo bure tadawu okwa iku kiwuje.
source: Dure cewu aregodumode iregodajiwu rema, duwure icekare iwo bure tadawu okwa iku kiwuje.

b:
Awu inodure ure tudowuje Betânia keje, Jordao okwa bakowu keje, cewu Joãore boe etao pegodowo keje.
Pao Aroe Eimejera o Cordeiro.
source:
Awu inodure ure tudowuje Betânia keje, Jordao okwa bakowu keje, cewu Joãore boe etao pegodowo keje.
Pao Aroe Eimejera o Cordeiro.

b: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, João jordure Jesus kodui pudae duji, akore: - Cewu Pao o Cordeiro reo, duwu koiare ure awu moto kejewu boe ero pegareu okwado.
source: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, João jordure Jesus kodui pudae duji, akore: - Cewu Pao o Cordeiro reo, duwu koiare ure awu moto kejewu boe ero pegareu okwado.

b: Duwu jire inago inagoino: -Iregodajire ia kurire ikoriwu aregodumode, ure marigudu ikoda piji kodi.
source: Duwu jire inago inagoino: -Iregodajire ia kurire ikoriwu aregodumode, ure marigudu ikoda piji kodi.

b: Iorduwakare ji mare itaregodure woe iwo boe etao pegodo, duma awu Israeldoge eerduwawo ji.
source: Iorduwakare ji mare itaregodure woe iwo boe etao pegodo, duma awu Israeldoge eerduwawo ji.

b: Joãore awu inodu awadudo: - Iordure Aroe Pemegareuji, ure nono metugu reoredure, ui turawuje baru piji bukeje duji.
source: Joãore awu inodu awadudo: - Iordure Aroe Pemegareuji, ure nono metugu reoredure, ui turawuje baru piji bukeje duji.

b: Iorduwakare ioguduba ure ema duji, mare cewu ure ido boe etao pegodo pobo tabowu akore ii: Cewu aerdumode Aroei tagurudo bukejewu, emare umode boe etao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
source: Iorduwakare ioguduba ure ema duji, mare cewu ure ido boe etao pegodo pobo tabowu akore ii: Cewu aerdumode Aroei tagurudo bukejewu, emare umode boe etao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo.

b:
Iordure ji, kodire inogwa kidare boe jokoduie Pao Onaregedure ema duji.
Jesus ure jorduwadowu boetojiwuge.
source:
Iordure ji, kodire inogwa kidare boe jokoduie Pao Onaregedure ema duji.
Jesus ure jorduwadowu boetojiwuge.

b: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, João rakojere nono pugeje ia ture jorduwadowuge ei pobedu apo.
source: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, João rakojere nono pugeje ia ture jorduwadowuge ei pobedu apo.

b: Tuiordui Jesus kodui nono du keje, akore: - Cewu Pao Aroe Eimejera o Cordeiro reo.
source: Tuiordui Jesus kodui nono du keje, akore: - Cewu Pao Aroe Eimejera o Cordeiro reo.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ei pobedu, emeardure akoino duji, kodi icare ekodure kuri Jesus rekodaji.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ei pobedu, emeardure akoino duji, kodi icare ekodure kuri Jesus rekodaji.

b: Icare Jesus ure tuiekirimi pai ei, unoragodure ei: - Kaboba bogaiba taemarure?  Egore ji: - Rabi (Cegimejera, oinodu jire egoino), kaiba amugure?
source: Icare Jesus ure tuiekirimi pai ei, unoragodure ei: - Kaboba bogaiba taemarure?  Egore ji: - Rabi (Cegimejera, oinodu jire egoino), kaiba amugure?

b: Akore ei: - Mato taerdudo. Ekodure apo eerdure kaiba mugure, eedure apo nowu meriji. Meri rekodugodu tabo rabodu.
source: Akore ei: - Mato taerdudo. Ekodure apo eerdure kaiba mugure, eedure apo nowu meriji. Meri rekodugodu tabo rabodu.

b: Nowuge ei pobedu, emeardure João bataru jidu, ekodure Jesus apodu, ia André rema, cewu Simão Pedro uwie.
source: Nowuge ei pobedu, emeardure João bataru jidu, ekodure Jesus apodu, ia André rema, cewu Simão Pedro uwie.

b: Duwure icare jeemarure kuri tumana bogai, akore ji: - Ceerdure Messiasji (Cristo, oinodu jire boe egoino).
source: Duwure icare jeemarure kuri tumana bogai, akore ji: - Ceerdure Messiasji (Cristo, oinodu jire boe egoino).

b: Icare uture apo Jesus ae. Jesus aiwore tu ji du tabore akore ji: - Jonas onaregedu Simão aki reo. Akiemode Cefas (Tori, oinodu jire boe egoino).
source: Icare uture apo Jesus ae. Jesus aiwore tu ji du tabore akore ji: - Jonas onaregedu Simão aki reo. Akiemode Cefas (Tori, oinodu jire boe egoino).

b: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, Jesus uture Galiléia kae. Du kejere jordure Filipeji, akore ji: - Ako itabo.
source: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, Jesus uture Galiléia kae. Du kejere jordure Filipeji, akore ji: - Ako itabo.

b: Filipe buture Betsaida keje, cewu André, Pedro eno bakurireu keje.
source: Filipe buture Betsaida keje, cewu André, Pedro eno bakurireu keje.

b: Icare Filipe jordure Natanaelji, akore ji: - Ceerdure cewu Moisere bapera atugodo jiwuji, profetadoge emagore akaru jiwuji: cewu Nazaré pijiwu Jesus, cewu José onaregedure emawu.
source: Icare Filipe jordure Natanaelji, akore ji: - Ceerdure cewu Moisere bapera atugodo jiwuji, profetadoge emagore akaru jiwuji: cewu Nazaré pijiwu Jesus, cewu José onaregedure emawu.

b: Icare Natanael akore ji: Kode, ia boe pemegareu aregodumodukana Nazaré piji?  Icare Filipe akore ji: - Mato, aerduwo.
source: Icare Natanael akore ji: Kode, ia boe pemegareu aregodumodukana Nazaré piji?  Icare Filipe akore ji: - Mato, aerduwo.

b: Jesus jordure Natanael kodui pudae duji, akore: - Ica, boe jokoduwu israelita reo, ia boe ero pegadodureu ukare apo.
source: Jesus jordure Natanael kodui pudae duji, akore: - Ica, boe jokoduwu israelita reo, ia boe ero pegadodureu ukare apo.

b: Icare Natanael akore: - Kaiba are ipawuje?  Jesus akore ji: - Filipe makomode ai du koda piji iordure ai marigudu, cewu amugui figuiera i kuda du kodiwu kodi.
source: Icare Natanael akore: - Kaiba are ipawuje?  Jesus akore ji: - Filipe makomode ai du koda piji iordure ai marigudu, cewu amugui figuiera i kuda du kodiwu kodi.

b: Icare Natanael akore: - Cegimejera, Pao Onaregedu akireo, Israeldoge eimejera akireo.
source: Icare Natanael akore: - Cegimejera, Pao Onaregedu akireo, Israeldoge eimejera akireo.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: -Inagore iorduie ai figueira i kuda du koia ameartorure ii. Mare aerdumode kurire nowu kori pugejeboeji.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: -Inagore iorduie ai figueira i kuda du koia ameartorure ii. Mare aerdumode kurire nowu kori pugejeboeji.

b: Icare akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Taerdumode barui tuiado, Pao o tupadoge erudui, ei turawuje Imedu Onaregedu bukeje duji.
source: Icare akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Taerdumode barui tuiado, Pao o tupadoge erudui, ei turawuje Imedu Onaregedu bukeje duji.

b: Caná kejewu boei tugera maku puaidu.
source: Caná kejewu boei tugera maku puaidu.

b: Meri pobe ma jewu metia bokware du keje, ia braere tugera maku puai, Galiléia kejewu Caná keje. Boekarema, Jesus uce rakoje radu nono.
source: Meri pobe ma jewu metia bokware du keje, ia braere tugera maku puai, Galiléia kejewu Caná keje. Boekarema, Jesus uce rakoje radu nono.

b: Emagore Jesus bogai, ure jorduwadowuge ewogai jamedu.
source: Emagore Jesus bogai, ure jorduwadowuge ewogai jamedu.

b: Parera kuru ma akedu rabodu. Du kodire Jesus uce makore ji, akore: - Awuge eke parera kuru akedure.
source: Parera kuru ma akedu rabodu. Du kodire Jesus uce makore ji, akore: - Awuge eke parera kuru akedure.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imuga, inoba akaidure irowo? Boekare turugadu ii roga.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imuga, inoba akaidure irowo? Boekare turugadu ii roga.

b: Du kejere icare uce makore nowu ure boe pedowugei, akore: - Tarodo nono ui taroiagudu reore.
source: Du kejere icare uce makore nowu ure boe pedowugei, akore: - Tarodo nono ui taroiagudu reore.

b: Aró, kode, pori toricedu mugure nono, ere ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, judeudoge ekera kabidaece, ee kabidaece, boe remagudui tadawu pobo makare.
source: Aró, kode, pori toricedu mugure nono, ere ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, judeudoge ekera kabidaece, ee kabidaece, boe remagudui tadawu pobo makare.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Awu poridoge enogorobadudo pobo tabo. Ere eiamedu boe enogorobadudo jii okwa kae.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Awu poridoge enogorobadudo pobo tabo. Ere eiamedu boe enogorobadudo jii okwa kae.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tawuje pugeje, reko jice ure boe pedowuge eimejera ae. Ere reko rugadu.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tawuje pugeje, reko jice ure boe pedowuge eimejera ae. Ere reko rugadu.

b: Nowu ure boe pedowuge eimejera, tui togwapagado nowu poboi parera kurudo pudumidu jitu keje, tuiorduwakai kaibawu parera kuruba (mare nowu ure boe pedowuge eerduware, pobore ere tawuje kodi), du keje, makore cewu uwiredodureu ae, akore ji: -
source: Nowu ure boe pedowuge eimejera, tui togwapagado nowu poboi parera kurudo pudumidu jitu keje, tuiorduwakai kaibawu parera kuruba (mare nowu ure boe pedowuge eerduware, pobore ere tawuje kodi), du keje, makore cewu uwiredodureu ae, akore ji: -

b: Boe eroiare boei parera kuru pemegareu maku boetoji du rema; icai jetugodui boei du keje, boere beregadureu maku tu pugeje. Macare are parera kuru pemegareu jetu otorogado jii oino.
source: Boe eroiare boei parera kuru pemegareu maku boetoji du rema; icai jetugodui boei du keje, boere beregadureu maku tu pugeje. Macare are parera kuru pemegareu jetu otorogado jii oino.

b: Awure Jesus ro kurireu boetojiwu rema. Ure towuje Galiléia tadawu bakurireu iei Caná cedu keje. Ure turo raka awadudo, du kodi icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge emeartorure ji.
source: Awure Jesus ro kurireu boetojiwu rema. Ure towuje Galiléia tadawu bakurireu iei Caná cedu keje. Ure turo raka awadudo, du kodi icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge emeartorure ji.

b:
Inodu rekodajire icare ure turawuje Cafarnaum bakurireu kae, tuje apo, tuwiemage ebo, ture jorduwadowuge ebo. Nonore meri awarore tu ei.
Jesus ui ure akirodo Pao uwai tadawuge ewarigu pijidu.
source:
Inodu rekodajire icare ure turawuje Cafarnaum bakurireu kae, tuje apo, tuwiemage ebo, ture jorduwadowuge ebo. Nonore meri awarore tu ei.
Jesus ui ure akirodo Pao uwai tadawuge ewarigu pijidu.

b: Judeudoge eno Páscoa puredugodure, du icare Jeus ruture Jerusalém kae.
source: Judeudoge eno Páscoa puredugodure, du icare Jeus ruture Jerusalém kae.

b: Jordure Pao uwai tada boei akirodo tapiradoge, ovelhadoge, metugoe ebo duji, jordure ure akiró maku puibagiwuge eno iradogei jamedu.
source: Jordure Pao uwai tada boei akirodo tapiradoge, ovelhadoge, metugoe ebo duji, jordure ure akiró maku puibagiwuge eno iradogei jamedu.

b: Icare ure bukigu iku opodo puapo, ure nowu barege ewarigu Pao uwai piji, ure cewu ure akirodowuge eno akiró roto ja toro moto joki, ure iradoge ewududo.
source: Icare ure bukigu iku opodo puapo, ure nowu barege ewarigu Pao uwai piji, ure cewu ure akirodowuge eno akiró roto ja toro moto joki, ure iradoge ewududo.

b: Akore nowu ure akirodo metugue ebowugei: - Awu inoboe tawuje awu piji, tagaba akiró epage ewaido Ioga uwaice.
source: Akore nowu ure akirodo metugue ebowugei: - Awu inoboe tawuje awu piji, tagaba akiró epage ewaido Ioga uwaice.

b: Du kodire icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiabuture cewu bapera atugore du keje: - “Imeardu kurii awai jitu ure ikowu” (Sl 68,10).
source: Du kodire icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiabuture cewu bapera atugore du keje: - “Imeardu kurii awai jitu ure ikowu” (Sl 68,10).

b: Icare judeudoge enoragodure ji :- Kaboba jiba amode ceerdudo awu aroinodu koia?
source: Icare judeudoge enoragodure ji :- Kaboba jiba amode ceerdudo awu aroinodu koia?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Awu Pao uwai butudo. Imode rakojedo pugeje meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Awu Pao uwai butudo. Imode rakojedo pugeje meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.

b: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Jorure 46 boewo awu Pao uwai towuje; akirema amode rakojedo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje?
source: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Jorure 46 boewo awu Pao uwai towuje; akirema amode rakojedo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje?

b: Makore Pao uwaiji, mare puduire akoino.
source: Makore Pao uwaiji, mare puduire akoino.

b:
Cewu jewodui bireuge epijidu rekodaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiabuture nowu bataru keje, icare emeartorure bapera atugore jiboeji, Jesus bataruji jamedu.
Jesus jorduware boe eiamedu boei.
source:
Cewu jewodui bireuge epijidu rekodaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiabuture nowu bataru keje, icare emeartorure bapera atugore jiboeji, Jesus bataruji jamedu.
Jesus jorduware boe eiamedu boei.

b: Jesus rakojei Jerusalém tada du keje, Páscoa kodiwu keje, makareuge emeartorure ji, tuiordui ro kurireu makareu jitu du koia.
source: Jesus rakojei Jerusalém tada du keje, Páscoa kodiwu keje, makareuge emeartorure ji, tuiordui ro kurireu makareu jitu du koia.

b: Mare Jesus meartorukare ei, jorduware eiamedu jitu koia.
source: Mare Jesus meartorukare ei, jorduware eiamedu jitu koia.

b: Okeakare iaboe iaboe ewo tuwie ime eiboeji, paga karega, jorduware meture ime etadaboeji.
source: Okeakare iaboe iaboe ewo tuwie ime eiboeji, paga karega, jorduware meture ime etadaboeji.

b: Jesus mare Nicodemo.
source: Jesus mare Nicodemo.

b: Ia imedu iei Nicodemo cedu, fariseudoge etadadu, judeudoge eimejera nure emadu, 2uture Jesus bogai boecoji, akore ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduware akaregodui Pao Aroe Eimejera piji, awo ceerduwado du bogai duji. Iaboe iaboe eroiwamodukare turowo nono aro reore, Pao rakoje kai ebo du keje.
source: Ia imedu iei Nicodemo cedu, fariseudoge etadadu, judeudoge eimejera nure emadu, 2uture Jesus bogai boecoji, akore ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduware akaregodui Pao Aroe Eimejera piji, awo ceerduwado du bogai duji. Iaboe iaboe eroiwamodukare turowo nono aro reore, Pao rakoje kai ebo du keje.

b: Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cewu butukare pugejewu, jordumodukare Pao o boe pemegareuji.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cewu butukare pugejewu, jordumodukare Pao o boe pemegareuji.

b: Icare Nicodemo unoragodure ji: -Kode, inoba imedu kuridogeduredu butumode pugeje? Umodukana turemo tujeto tuwoduwo pugeje?
source: Icare Nicodemo unoragodure ji: -Kode, inoba imedu kuridogeduredu butumode pugeje? Umodukana turemo tujeto tuwoduwo pugeje?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cewu butukare pobo pijiwu, cewu butukare Aroe Pemegareu pijiwu, roiwamodukare tuwo turemo Pao o boe pemegareuto.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cewu butukare pobo pijiwu, cewu butukare Aroe Pemegareu pijiwu, roiwamodukare tuwo turemo Pao o boe pemegareuto.

b: Cewu buture imedu pijiwu, imedu nure ema, mare boture Aroe pijiwu, aroe nure ema jamedu.
source: Cewu buture imedu pijiwu, imedu nure ema, mare boture Aroe pijiwu, aroe nure ema jamedu.

b: Ae ro kaba ta... je, awu inagore oino ai jiboeji: Ema remawu tawidumode pugejedu rema.
source: Ae ro kaba ta... je, awu inagore oino ai jiboeji: Ema remawu tawidumode pugejedu rema.

b: Bakuru okwamudumode taidure jaogwai. Ameardure jaruruji, mare aerduwakare kaiba aregodure, kaiba kodure jamedu. Nowu inodu reorere cewu buture Aroe Pemegareu pijiwure.
source: Bakuru okwamudumode taidure jaogwai. Ameardure jaruruji, mare aerduwakare kaiba aregodure, kaiba kodure jamedu. Nowu inodu reorere cewu buture Aroe Pemegareu pijiwure.

b: Icare Nicodemo akore ji pugeje: - Inoba boe eromode turowo oinono?
source: Icare Nicodemo akore ji pugeje: - Inoba boe eromode turowo oinono?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Akire jorduwa rakareure aki Israeldoge etada, icare aerduwa bokware awu inoduji?
source: Jesus akore ji: - Akire jorduwa rakareure aki Israeldoge etada, icare aerduwa bokware awu inoduji?

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cemagore ceerduware jiboeji, cere ceerdure jiboe kodiboe maku tagai, mare takare tageragu ji.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: cemagore ceerduware jiboeji, cere ceerdure jiboe kodiboe maku tagai, mare takare tageragu ji.

b: Imagoi awu moto kejeboe jitu keje, tameartorukare. Kode, kodiba tameartorumode imagoi tai baru tadaboe jituji?
source: Imagoi awu moto kejeboe jitu keje, tameartorukare. Kode, kodiba tameartorumode imagoi tai baru tadaboe jituji?

b: Iaboe iaboe erudukare baruto, tu nowu ure turawuje baru pijiwu Imedu Onaregedu, du rakojere baru tada.
source: Iaboe iaboe erudukare baruto, tu nowu ure turawuje baru pijiwu Imedu Onaregedu, du rakojere baru tada.

b: Moisés magai awagu aogado boe makodu tada du reorere, Imedu Onaregedu aogadodumode jamedu.
source: Moisés magai awagu aogado boe makodu tada du reorere, Imedu Onaregedu aogadodumode jamedu.

b: Du koiawo meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ewi kawo.
source: Du koiawo meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ewi kawo.

b: Paga karega, Pao Aroe Eimejera tumeardu kurii awu moto jitu koia, ure tonaregedu ui mito tu jedu maku, du koiawo cewu meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ewikare, mare ure boe eedo jii jeboe makuduwo etai.
source: Paga karega, Pao Aroe Eimejera tumeardu kurii awu moto jitu koia, ure tonaregedu ui mito tu jedu maku, du koiawo cewu meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ewikare, mare ure boe eedo jii jeboe makuduwo etai.

b: Awurema karega, Pao ure tonaregedu utudo moto kae, mare uwo moto akedudo du bogai karega, mare koiawo ure motodo cinorudo.
source: Awurema karega, Pao ure tonaregedu utudo moto kae, mare uwo moto akedudo du bogai karega, mare koiawo ure motodo cinorudo.

b: Meartorumode jiwuge ewudumodukare boe pegareuto, mare meartorukare jiwuge, ewudure boe pegareuto marigudu, paga karega, emeartorukare Pao Onaregedu ui mitotu jedu jitu koia.
source: Meartorumode jiwuge ewudumodukare boe pegareuto, mare meartorukare jiwuge, ewudure boe pegareuto marigudu, paga karega, emeartorukare Pao Onaregedu ui mitotu jedu jitu koia.

b: Aro kode, boe pegareu reo: urugureboe aregodure moto kae, mare ime emeardu kurire boeco tadaboeji urugureboe kori, ero pegare du koia.
source: Aro kode, boe pegareu reo: urugureboe aregodure moto kae, mare ime emeardu kurire boeco tadaboeji urugureboe kori, ero pegare du koia.

b: Paga karega, ro pegareuge eiamedu boe ekodu kagirire joruguji, etukare urugu kae, boe eerdukawo ero pegareuji.
source: Paga karega, ro pegareuge eiamedu boe ekodu kagirire joruguji, etukare urugu kae, boe eerdukawo ero pegareuji.

b:
Mare ro pemegareuge ere tugirimi urugureboe kae, nowu inodu tabo boe emode boe pawuje erore jiboe uie nono Pao aidu reore duji.
Jesus mare João Batista.
source:
Mare ro pemegareuge ere tugirimi urugureboe kae, nowu inodu tabo boe emode boe pawuje erore jiboe uie nono Pao aidu reore duji.
Jesus mare João Batista.

b: Nowu inodu otobiji, Jesus uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo Judéia moto kae, nonore rakojere ebo, tui boe etao pegodo du tabo.
source: Nowu inodu otobiji, Jesus uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo Judéia moto kae, nonore rakojere ebo, tui boe etao pegodo du tabo.

b: Joãore boe etao pegodo jamedu Enon keje, puredu tu Salimji, paga karega, nono pobo kuricigore kodi. Makareu boe etaregodure, etao pegododure jmedu.
source: Joãore boe etao pegodo jamedu Enon keje, puredu tu Salimji, paga karega, nono pobo kuricigore kodi. Makareu boe etaregodure, etao pegododure jmedu.

b: Nowu du kodi João barigudukare roga baicoreuto kodi.
source: Nowu du kodi João barigudukare roga baicoreuto kodi.

b: Boekarema, nowu Joãore jorduwadowuge mare ia judeudoge ewadaru pega pegare pui, nowu boe etao pegododu kodiboe koia.
source: Boekarema, nowu Joãore jorduwadowuge mare ia judeudoge ewadaru pega pegare pui, nowu boe etao pegododu kodiboe koia.

b: Icare eture João ae, emagore ji: -Cegimejera, cewu rakojere akabo Jordão okwa bakowu kejewu, cewu akagore boe jokoduie emawu, ica, unure boe etao pegodo, boe eiamedu boe etu nure ae.
source: Icare eture João ae, emagore ji: -Cegimejera, cewu rakojere akabo Jordão okwa bakowu kejewu, cewu akagore boe jokoduie emawu, ica, unure boe etao pegodo, boe eiamedu boe etu nure ae.

b: Icare João akore ei: - Iaboe iaboe emodukare tugeragu ia turomode jiboeji pudae, makudukai baru piji du keje.
source: Icare João akore ei: - Iaboe iaboe emodukare tugeragu ia turomode jiboeji pudae, makudukai baru piji du keje.

b: Tagi rugadure tameardure inagoinoduji. Inagore: Cristo karega ure imi, mare imire irojaidodure otodai.
source: Tagi rugadure tameardure inagoinoduji. Inagore: Cristo karega ure imi, mare imire irojaidodure otodai.

b: Cewu oredu jereu, oredu nure ema, mare metuia imedu, rakojere nonodu, meardure jidu, jekare kuricigore tumeardui oredu mako jitu keje. Imi jamedu iegare kuricigore awu inodu ui tudowuje du keje.
source: Cewu oredu jereu, oredu nure ema, mare metuia imedu, rakojere nonodu, meardure jidu, jekare kuricigore tumeardui oredu mako jitu keje. Imi jamedu iegare kuricigore awu inodu ui tudowuje du keje.

b: Ure turugadu imi iwiegawo, ema rema kuriwo.
source: Ure turugadu imi iwiegawo, ema rema kuriwo.

b: Aregodure cebojeboe pijiwu, emare kodure boe eiamedu boe ekori. Aregodure moto pijiwu, moto nure ema, makore moto kejeboeji.
source: Aregodure cebojeboe pijiwu, emare kodure boe eiamedu boe ekori. Aregodure moto pijiwu, moto nure ema, makore moto kejeboeji.

b: Aregodure baru pijiwu, makore tuiordure jiboeji, tumeardure jiboeji, mare iaboe iaboe emeartorukare ji.
source: Aregodure baru pijiwu, makore tuiordure jiboeji, tumeardure jiboeji, mare iaboe iaboe emeartorukare ji.

b: Meartorure jiwu ure boe jokodudo Paoie boe rikireure ema duji.
source: Meartorure jiwu ure boe jokodudo Paoie boe rikireure ema duji.

b: Paga karega, Cewu Paore rojaiwu mako nure Pao bataru remawuji. Paga karega, Paore Aroe Pemegareu maku boe etai remagudu kadu tabo kodi.
source: Paga karega, Cewu Paore rojaiwu mako nure Pao bataru remawuji. Paga karega, Paore Aroe Pemegareu maku boe etai remagudu kadu tabo kodi.

b: Pao meardu kurire tonaregeduji, ure boe jamedu bu iera keje.
source: Pao meardu kurire tonaregeduji, ure boe jamedu bu iera keje.

b: Meartorure Onaregedu jiwu, jere jii jeboe umode apo. Mare meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, jere jii jeboe umodukare apo, mare Pao okorigodae mugumode keje.
source: Meartorure Onaregedu jiwu, jere jii jeboe umode apo. Mare meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, jere jii jeboe umodukare apo, mare Pao okorigodae mugumode keje.

b: Jesus makoi Samaria moto kejewu aredu jidu.
source: Jesus makoi Samaria moto kejewu aredu jidu.

b: Jesus jorduware fariseudoge emeardui boe egoe emaie ure boedo tudo pui, emaie ure boe etao pegododu maka remawudo João kori. 2(Mare ema karega ure boe etao pegodo, mare nowu ure jorduwadowuge emagere boe etao pegodo, kodi karega).
source: Jesus jorduware fariseudoge emeardui boe egoe emaie ure boedo tudo pui, emaie ure boe etao pegododu maka remawudo João kori. 2(Mare ema karega ure boe etao pegodo, mare nowu ure jorduwadowuge emagere boe etao pegodo, kodi karega).

b: Du kodi icare uture Judéia piji tuibagi Galiléia kae.
source: Du kodi icare uture Judéia piji tuibagi Galiléia kae.

b: Mare kodu rumode Samaria moto kajeje toro Galiléia kae.
source: Mare kodu rumode Samaria moto kajeje toro Galiléia kae.

b: Du kodi icare aregodure ia Samaria moto kejewu bakurireu kae iei Sicar cedu kae, nowu Jacó ure maku tonaregedu José aiwu moto puredu tu je du kae.
source: Du kodi icare aregodure ia Samaria moto kejewu bakurireu kae iei Sicar cedu kae, nowu Jacó ure maku tonaregedu José aiwu moto puredu tu je du kae.

b: Nonore Jacó o motoia pobo kaiwu mugure. Icare Jesus tumedugodui tumeru raicigore du koia, ure tumugudo tu, nowu motoia okwa keje, meri jetui baru oiadoda du tabo.
source: Nonore Jacó o motoia pobo kaiwu mugure. Icare Jesus tumedugodui tumeru raicigore du koia, ure tumugudo tu, nowu motoia okwa keje, meri jetui baru oiadoda du tabo.

b: Du kaere Samaria kejewu ia aredu aregodure tuwo tugeragu poboji. Icare Jesus okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikududo ia poboce.
source: Du kaere Samaria kejewu ia aredu aregodure tuwo tugeragu poboji. Icare Jesus okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikududo ia poboce.

b: Nowu ture jorduwadowuge eture marigudu toro bakurireuto tuwo akirodo iaboe boeji tugeje.
source: Nowu ture jorduwadowuge eture marigudu toro bakurireuto tuwo akirodo iaboe boeji tugeje.

b: Icare nowu Samaria kejewudo akore ji: - Judeu nure aki, macare akogwamagudu nure Samaria kejewudo ii, iwo akududo. Kodiba umode ino?  (Paga karega, Judeudoge mare Samaria kejewuge epemegakare pui).
source: Icare nowu Samaria kejewudo akore ji: - Judeu nure aki, macare akogwamagudu nure Samaria kejewudo ii, iwo akududo. Kodiba umode ino?  (Paga karega, Judeudoge mare Samaria kejewuge epemegakare pui).

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aerduwamode Pao o boe pemegareuji, aerduwamode ioguduba okwamagudure ai pobo bogai duji ma, aki akaobiji akogwamagudumode ji, umode pobo jereu maku akai.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aerduwamode Pao o boe pemegareuji, aerduwamode ioguduba okwamagudure ai pobo bogai duji ma, aki akaobiji akogwamagudumode ji, umode pobo jereu maku akai.

b: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Cegimejera, are pobo tawuje taboboe bokwa, awu motoia raicigo jamedu, kode, kaiba amode akeragu nowu pobo jereuji?
source: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Cegimejera, are pobo tawuje taboboe bokwa, awu motoia raicigo jamedu, kode, kaiba amode akeragu nowu pobo jereuji?

b: Kode, aki kana akodure pao Jacó kori, 0dure awu motoia po maku cenai, du kudure awu poce, ore ekudure ce, akuiee ekudure ce jamedu?
source: Kode, aki kana akodure pao Jacó kori, 0dure awu motoia po maku cenai, du kudure awu poce, ore ekudure ce, akuiee ekudure ce jamedu?

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Kudure awu pobo cewuge eiamedu boe, pobo boimode ei pugeje.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Kudure awu pobo cewuge eiamedu boe, pobo boimode ei pugeje.

b: Mare kudumode ire maku pudaiwu pobo cewuge, pobo boimodukare ei pugeje. Paga karega, imode maku boe etaiwu pobo, pododa parumode ema etai boe ewi bokwareu kae.
source: Mare kudumode ire maku pudaiwu pobo cewuge, pobo boimodukare ei pugeje. Paga karega, imode maku boe etaiwu pobo, pododa parumode ema etai boe ewi bokwareu kae.

b: Icare nowu aredu okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, nowu akagoino jiwu ia pobo makinai, pobo boi kawo ii pugeje, itukawo mato iwo ikeragu awu poji pugeje.
source: Icare nowu aredu okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, nowu akagoino jiwu ia pobo makinai, pobo boi kawo ii pugeje, itukawo mato iwo ikeragu awu poji pugeje.

b: Jesus akore ji: - Toro, amagodo akoredu bogai, akirimi mato.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Toro, amagodo akoredu bogai, akirimi mato.

b: Icare aredu akore ji: - Ikoge bokwa. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe rugadu jire akagoino akoge bokwaie duji.
source: Icare aredu akore ji: - Ikoge bokwa. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe rugadu jire akagoino akoge bokwaie duji.

b: Akogere ikera awubodure, awu mugure oino akabowu, akoredu karega, kodire amagore boe rikireuji. +Icare nowu aredu akore: - Cegimejera, icare iordure profetaie ure aki duji.
source: Akogere ikera awubodure, awu mugure oino akabowu, akoredu karega, kodire amagore boe rikireuji. +Icare nowu aredu akore: - Cegimejera, icare iordure profetaie ure aki duji.

b: Ceomage emagore Paoji awu torekodu aogeje, mare tagagore Jerusalém kejeie boe emagomode Paoji.
source: Ceomage emagore Paoji awu torekodu aogeje, mare tagagore Jerusalém kejeie boe emagomode Paoji.

b: Jesus akore: - Aredu, amearutorudo ii, boe puredugodu nure boe emago kawo Paoji ceboje, boe emago kawo ji awu torekodu aogeje, iarema Jerusalém keje du kae.
source: Jesus akore: - Aredu, amearutorudo ii, boe puredugodu nure boe emago kawo Paoji ceboje, boe emago kawo ji awu torekodu aogeje, iarema Jerusalém keje du kae.

b: Tare tabujodo cewu taerduwakare jiwuji, cere cebujodo ceerduware jiwuji; paga karega, Judéia kejewuge epijire umode boe einorudoboe aregodumode du kodi..
source: Tare tabujodo cewu taerduwakare jiwuji, cere cebujodo ceerduware jiwuji; paga karega, Judéia kejewuge epijire umode boe einorudoboe aregodumode du kodi..

b: Mare nowu kodiboe aregodumode, du aregodure, du kejewo upojó kigodureu ema remawuge emode tubujodo Paoji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada. Paga karega, Pao aidure nowu upujó kigodureuge ei.
source: Mare nowu kodiboe aregodumode, du aregodure, du kejewo upojó kigodureu ema remawuge emode tubujodo Paoji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada. Paga karega, Pao aidure nowu upujó kigodureuge ei.

b: Aroe nure Paoce, du kodi icare upujó kigodure jiwuge emode tubujodo ji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada.
source: Aroe nure Paoce, du kodi icare upujó kigodure jiwuge emode tubujodo ji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada.

b: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Iordiware Messias aregodumode duji (cewu iere Cristo cedu). Kode, aregodumode du keje, umode ceerduwado boe jamedu boeji.
source: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Iordiware Messias aregodumode duji (cewu iere Cristo cedu). Kode, aregodumode du keje, umode ceerduwado boe jamedu boeji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Cewu akagoino jiwu imi reo, du imire inagore oino imago tabo ai.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Cewu akagoino jiwu imi reo, du imire inagore oino imago tabo ai.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure, erore ta... tuiordui akoi tumago tabo ia aredu ji tuji. Mare ia emage egokare ji: - Kaba jiba anorare ji? Iarema: - Kaba jiba amagore ji? Inodukare. 28. Cewu aredu uture tubori piji nono, uture bakurireuto, makore nowu tadawu imei.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure, erore ta... tuiordui akoi tumago tabo ia aredu ji tuji. Mare ia emage egokare ji: - Kaba jiba anorare ji? Iarema: - Kaba jiba amagore ji? Inodukare. 28. Cewu aredu uture tubori piji nono, uture bakurireuto, makore nowu tadawu imei.

b: Akore: - Mato taerduwo ia imeduji, du readodure iwiagai iro jamedu boeji. Cewu Cristo, ino jiwu, umodukana?
source: Akore: - Mato taerduwo ia imeduji, du readodure iwiagai iro jamedu boeji. Cewu Cristo, ino jiwu, umodukana?

b: Eture bakurireu piji Jesus ae.
source: Eture bakurireu piji Jesus ae.

b: Du inodu tada nowu ure jorduwadowuge enogwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, akogwagedo!
source: Du inodu tada nowu ure jorduwadowuge enogwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, akogwagedo!

b: Mare akore ei: - Ia ikere, mare taerduwakare ji.
source: Mare akore ei: - Ia ikere, mare taerduwakare ji.

b: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enorare jice woje pui, egore: - Ia boe kana ukerogu arego mato bogai?
source: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enorare jice woje pui, egore: - Ia boe kana ukerogu arego mato bogai?

b: Icare Jesus Akore ei: - Ikere iromode nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore du rema, iwo maragodae poru kororogo tu je du rema.
source: Icare Jesus Akore ei: - Ikere iromode nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore du rema, iwo maragodae poru kororogo tu je du rema.

b: Tagagokare arimoduie pobe puibiji du kejeie boe emode tugeragu boepa tadaboeji? Icá, kode inagomode oino tai: Tae aogado, tagaiwodo boepadogei: tadaboe kidu nure, ure turugadu kadoduwo.
source: Tagagokare arimoduie pobe puibiji du kejeie boe emode tugeragu boepa tadaboeji? Icá, kode inagomode oino tai: Tae aogado, tagaiwodo boepadogei: tadaboe kidu nure, ure turugadu kadoduwo.

b: Cewu ure boepa tadaboe kadowu mori makudumode ai, du umode boepa tadaboe to pui jere jii je boe kae.  Du tabore ure boe a tuguwu, ure kadowu, eegaremode puapo.
source: Cewu ure boepa tadaboe kadowu mori makudumode ai, du umode boepa tadaboe to pui jere jii je boe kae.  Du tabore ure boe a tuguwu, ure kadowu, eegaremode puapo.

b: Du ure nono boe egore: ure boe tuguwu ure tuginoi, ure kadowu ure tuginoi.
source: Du ure nono boe egore: ure boe tuguwu ure tuginoi, ure kadowu ure tuginoi.

b: Ire tarojai tawo boe kado iage emaragodure mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto.
source: Ire tarojai tawo boe kado iage emaragodure mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto.

b: Nowu aredu bataru koiare makareu Samaria kejewuge emeartorure, cewu makoi ei du kodi: Makore ii iro jamedu boeji.
source: Nowu aredu bataru koiare makareu Samaria kejewuge emeartorure, cewu makoi ei du kodi: Makore ii iro jamedu boeji.

b: Du kodi icare Samaria kejewuge eture ae, enogwamagudure ji rakojewo pudabo. Kodi icare rakojere ebo meri pobe.
source: Du kodi icare Samaria kejewuge eture ae, enogwamagudure ji rakojewo pudabo. Kodi icare rakojere ebo meri pobe.

b: Kodi icare iage pugeje makareuge emeartorure ji makore ewiegai boe koia.
source: Kodi icare iage pugeje makareuge emeartorure ji makore ewiegai boe koia.

b:
Icare emago emagore nowu areduji: - Ica, mare awadaru koia karega cemeartorure, cegi rugadure cemeardure ji ceerduware moto inorudodu epaie ure ema duji.
Jesus ure ia brae eimejera kurireu utugare onaregedu pemegago.
source:
Icare emago emagore nowu areduji: - Ica, mare awadaru koia karega cemeartorure, cegi rugadure cemeardure ji ceerduware moto inorudodu epaie ure ema duji.
Jesus ure ia brae eimejera kurireu utugare onaregedu pemegago.

b: Meri pobe du keje, Jesus uture nowu piji Galiléia kae.
source: Meri pobe du keje, Jesus uture nowu piji Galiléia kae.

b: Ema mitodu akore marigudu, boe emeartorukae profetadogei eno moto keje.
source: Ema mitodu akore marigudu, boe emeartorukae profetadogei eno moto keje.

b: Du kodi icare, aregodui Galiléia kae du keje, nowu Galiléia kejewuge ere tugeragu ji tudada, mare paga karega, eerdure ro jamedu boeji toro Jerusalém tada, peta keje. Eturadu nowu peta kae jamedu du kodi.
source: Du kodi icare, aregodui Galiléia kae du keje, nowu Galiléia kejewuge ere tugeragu ji tudada, mare paga karega, eerdure ro jamedu boeji toro Jerusalém tada, peta keje. Eturadu nowu peta kae jamedu du kodi.

b: Ure tugirimi Galiléia tadawu Caná baboturogu kae, cewu ture parera kurudo pobo cewo kae. Nowu du kodi, brae eimejera kurireu ia utugare onaregedu kogodure, du rakojere Cafarnaum keje.
source: Ure tugirimi Galiléia tadawu Caná baboturogu kae, cewu ture parera kurudo pobo cewo kae. Nowu du kodi, brae eimejera kurireu ia utugare onaregedu kogodure, du rakojere Cafarnaum keje.

b: Nowu brae eimejera utugare tumeardui Jesus utui Jerusalém piji Galiléia kaedu jitu keje, uture ae, okwamagudure ji uwo tonaregedu pemegago puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.
source: Nowu brae eimejera utugare tumeardui Jesus utui Jerusalém piji Galiléia kaedu jitu keje, uture ae, okwamagudure ji uwo tonaregedu pemegago puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Taerdumodukare boe kodiboeji, boe ero kurireuji du keje, tameartorumodukare.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Taerdumodukare boe kodiboeji, boe ero kurireuji du keje, tameartorumodukare.

b: Mare nowu brae eimejera utugare okwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, arawuje toro, itonaegedu rogu bimodedu otodai.
source: Mare nowu brae eimejera utugare okwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, arawuje toro, itonaegedu rogu bimodedu otodai.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Toro, akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu. Nowu imedu meartorure Jesus bataruji, uture taci je.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Toro, akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu. Nowu imedu meartorure Jesus bataruji, uture taci je.

b: Utugarege eridure togi awaraji, egore ji: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure.
source: Utugarege eridure togi awaraji, egore ji: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure.

b: Kodi icare unoragodure ei inobadu kejeba pemegagodure. Egore ji: - Jawuji, meri roi goroci je du keje biri uru ure tugera ra piji.
source: Kodi icare unoragodure ei inobadu kejeba pemegagodure. Egore ji: - Jawuji, meri roi goroci je du keje biri uru ure tugera ra piji.

b: Icare nowu uo ure boe pa Jesus akore: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu oino pudui du kejeie tonaregedu pemegagodure kuri je duji. Du kodi icare meartorure Paoji, nowu uwobe eiamedu boe emeartorure jamedu.
source: Icare nowu uo ure boe pa Jesus akore: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu oino pudui du kejeie tonaregedu pemegagodure kuri je duji. Du kodi icare meartorure Paoji, nowu uwobe eiamedu boe emeartorure jamedu.

b: Jesus ure awu turo kurireu towuje dure pobedu rema, tui tugirimi Judéia piji Galiléia kaedu rekodaji.
source: Jesus ure awu turo kurireu towuje dure pobedu rema, tui tugirimi Judéia piji Galiléia kaedu rekodaji.

b: Jesus ure ia pogora bireu imedu pemegago.
source: Jesus ure ia pogora bireu imedu pemegago.

b: Du keje icare judeudogere tuiagu ia peta towuje, du kodi icare Jesus ruture Jerusalém kae.
source: Du keje icare judeudogere tuiagu ia peta towuje, du kodi icare Jesus ruture Jerusalém kae.

b: Nono Jerusalém keje, ia pobo aia mugu puredure tu Ovelhadoge ewaiporoji, hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Betesda cedu, uwaiporodogere ikera awubodure.
source: Nono Jerusalém keje, ia pobo aia mugu puredure tu Ovelhadoge ewaiporoji, hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Betesda cedu, uwaiporodogere ikera awubodure.

b: Nowu baiporodoge ekuda, makareu kogodureuge emugure: joku bokwareuge, pogora pegareuge, pogora bireuge, tubaga tabo pobo amagadodumode du bogai.
source: Nowu baiporodoge ekuda, makareu kogodureuge emugure: joku bokwareuge, pogora pegareuge, pogora bireuge, tubaga tabo pobo amagadodumode du bogai.

b: Paga karega, ia kodiboe keje tu tu je Pao o tupa ure turawuje nowu pobo aia kae du kejere pobore tamagadudo. Cewu ure tuiodo ca boetoji nowu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu rekodajiwu, pemegagodure kuri, ia tugogodae boe piji.
source: Paga karega, ia kodiboe keje tu tu je Pao o tupa ure turawuje nowu pobo aia kae du kejere pobore tamagadudo. Cewu ure tuiodo ca boetoji nowu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu rekodajiwu, pemegagodure kuri, ia tugogodae boe piji.

b: Ia kogodureu imedu mugure nono, jorure ji nono ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci je du mugure nono. (38 anos).
source: Ia kogodureu imedu mugure nono, jorure ji nono ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci je du mugure nono. (38 anos).

b: Icare Jesus tuiordui padui nono, tuiorduwai mariguduie padure nonodu jitu keje, unorare ji: - Akaidure apemegagoduwo kuri je?
source: Icare Jesus tuiordui padui nono, tuiorduwai mariguduie padure nonodu jitu keje, unorare ji: - Akaidure apemegagoduwo kuri je?

b: Nowu kogodureu akore ji: -Ikimejera, ia ure iwu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu keje, boe bokwa, du kodire ikodu kimoi mai to du keje, iare marigudu ikoda piji.
source: Nowu kogodureu akore ji: -Ikimejera, ia ure iwu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu keje, boe bokwa, du kodire ikodu kimoi mai to du keje, iare marigudu ikoda piji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu apaji, toro tabo.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu apaji, toro tabo.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu imedu pemegagodure, ure tugeragu tubaji, uture tabo. Aro kode, nowu meri sabadore jiwu meri.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu imedu pemegagodure, ure tugeragu tubaji, uture tabo. Aro kode, nowu meri sabadore jiwu meri.

b: Judeudoge rema emagore nowu imedu pemegagodureuji, egore: - Amodukare nowu apa rekodudo awu meriji.
source: Judeudoge rema emagore nowu imedu pemegagodureuji, egore: - Amodukare nowu apa rekodudo awu meriji.

b: Akore ei: - Cewu ure ipemegagowu akore ii: Akeragu apaji, amerudo.
source: Akore ei: - Cewu ure ipemegagowu akore ii: Akeragu apaji, amerudo.

b: Egore ji: - Kakoduwu ia imeduba akoino ai: Akeragu apaji, amerudo ino?
source: Egore ji: - Kakoduwu ia imeduba akoino ai: Akeragu apaji, amerudo ino?

b: Mare cewu pemegagodureu imedu jorduwakare iogudubaba, mare paga karega, Jesus ure tadawuje nowu boe makareuge eedui nonodu piji kodi.
source: Mare cewu pemegagodureu imedu jorduwakare iogudubaba, mare paga karega, Jesus ure tadawuje nowu boe makareuge eedui nonodu piji kodi.

b: Inodu rekodaji raka dugu je, Jesus jordure ji Pao uwai tada, akore ji: - Icare apemegagodure. Aro pega kaba pugeje, ia boe pegareu remawu ukawo ai pugeje du bogai.
source: Inodu rekodaji raka dugu je, Jesus jordure ji Pao uwai tada, akore ji: - Icare apemegagodure. Aro pega kaba pugeje, ia boe pegareu remawu ukawo ai pugeje du bogai.

b: Du keje icare nowu imedu readodure Jesus koiaie ure tubemegago duji.
source: Du keje icare nowu imedu readodure Jesus koiaie ure tubemegago duji.

b: Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etonare Jesusji, paga karega, ure awu turo kurireu towuje sabadore jiwu meri jitu koia.
source: Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etonare Jesusji, paga karega, ure awu turo kurireu towuje sabadore jiwu meri jitu koia.

b: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ioga maragodure jii oino rugadu; imi jamedu, imaragodu nure jamedu.
source: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ioga maragodure jii oino rugadu; imi jamedu, imaragodu nure jamedu.

b:
Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etagemo raka remawure tuwo bito, paga karega, ukare Sábado pegado tu rugadu, mare akore tuoie Pao rema; ica, nowu inodu tabo unure tudo nono Pao reore du koia.
Pao Onaregedu ro raka.
source:
Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etagemo raka remawure tuwo bito, paga karega, ukare Sábado pegado tu rugadu, mare akore tuoie Pao rema; ica, nowu inodu tabo unure tudo nono Pao reore du koia.
Pao Onaregedu ro raka.

b: Jesus akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Onaregedureboe tui mito tu jedu roiwakare iaboeji iaboeji. Romode tuiordure tuo rore jiboeji tu je. Tuo rore jiboe jamedu boeji, onaregedu romode ino jamedu.
source: Jesus akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Onaregedureboe tui mito tu jedu roiwakare iaboeji iaboeji. Romode tuiordure tuo rore jiboeji tu je. Tuo rore jiboe jamedu boeji, onaregedu romode ino jamedu.

b: Mare paga karega, Uo meardu kurire Tonaregeduji, ure jordudo turore jiboe jamedu boeji; umode jordudo ia turo kurireu remawuji kimo, duma taebogodu kuriwo.
source: Mare paga karega, Uo meardu kurire Tonaregeduji, ure jordudo turore jiboe jamedu boeji; umode jordudo ia turo kurireu remawuji kimo, duma taebogodu kuriwo.

b: Mare paga karega, Uo magai bireuge ewodudo, ure jereboe maku etai, du reorere Onaregedu umode jereboe maku taidure jiwuge etai jamedu.
source: Mare paga karega, Uo magai bireuge ewodudo, ure jereboe maku etai, du reorere Onaregedu umode jereboe maku taidure jiwuge etai jamedu.

b: Nowu inodu reorere, Uo umodukare tugogado iaboei iaboei, mare ure boei tugogadodu jamedu boe mugudo Tonaregedu apo.
source: Nowu inodu reorere, Uo umodukare tugogado iaboei iaboei, mare ure boei tugogadodu jamedu boe mugudo Tonaregedu apo.

b: Du tabowo boe emeartorumode Onaregeduji tumeartoru magai Uo jitu reore. cewu meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, Uo koiare ure rojaidu, kode meartorukare Uoji jamedu.
source: Du tabowo boe emeartorumode Onaregeduji tumeartoru magai Uo jitu reore. cewu meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, Uo koiare ure rojaidu, kode meartorukare Uoji jamedu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Meardure iwadaru jiwu, meartorure ure irojaiwu jiwu, boe ewi bokwareu ure apo, utumodukare boe pegareuto, mare jepadure tuwi piji tuierewo kae.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Meardure iwadaru jiwu, meartorure ure irojaiwu jiwu, boe ewi bokwareu ure apo, utumodukare boe pegareuto, mare jepadure tuwi piji tuierewo kae.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Icare boe aregodumode pudae, puredugodu nure, icai bireuge emeardumode Pao mako jitu kae. Meardureuge eemode.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Icare boe aregodumode pudae, puredugodu nure, icai bireuge emeardumode Pao mako jitu kae. Meardureuge eemode.

b: Mare paga karega, nono Uo o magai jereboece tu taobiji, ure maku tonaregedu ai owo jereboece taobiji jamedu.
source: Mare paga karega, nono Uo o magai jereboece tu taobiji, ure maku tonaregedu ai owo jereboece taobiji jamedu.

b: Ure ro raka maku tonaregedu ai uwo tugogado boei, mare paga karega, Imedu Onareedu rema kodi.
source: Ure ro raka maku tonaregedu ai uwo tugogado boei, mare paga karega, Imedu Onareedu rema kodi.

b: Taro kaba ta... je awu inagoino jiboeji. Boe aregodumode du keje meture tuiao tadawuge eiamedu boe emeardumode Imedu Onaregedu makoji, emode tuiebu mako padui boe kajeje du kae.
source: Taro kaba ta... je awu inagoino jiboeji. Boe aregodumode du keje meture tuiao tadawuge eiamedu boe emeardumode Imedu Onaregedu makoji, emode tuiebu mako padui boe kajeje du kae.

b: Ro pemegareuge eewodumode tuiwo pemegareu kae. Ro pegareuge eewodumode mare tuiwo pega remawureu kae.
source: Ro pemegareuge eewodumode tuiwo pemegareu kae. Ro pegareuge eewodumode mare tuiwo pega remawureu kae.

b: Imi itaobiji ikare iaboe iaboe to. Imeardae tugudure imeardure jiboe reore. Itugure jiboe boe jokodu nure ema. Mare paga karega, iemarukare irowo nono itaidu reore, mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidu reore.
source: Imi itaobiji ikare iaboe iaboe to. Imeardae tugudure imeardure jiboe reore. Itugure jiboe boe jokodu nure ema. Mare paga karega, iemarukare irowo nono itaidu reore, mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidu reore.

b: Imagomode imi rugaduie iroino ma, imagoi oinodu umodukare turugadu.
source: Imagomode imi rugaduie iroino ma, imagoi oinodu umodukare turugadu.

b: Iare tagoi imi rugaduie iroino, iorduware cewu akoino boe jokodu rugaduie duji.
source: Iare tagoi imi rugaduie iroino, iorduware cewu akoino boe jokodu rugaduie duji.

b: Tare iaboe erojai João ae, makore boe jokoduji boe ewiegai.
source: Tare iaboe erojai João ae, makore boe jokoduji boe ewiegai.

b: Iomodukare iaboe iaboe ewugeje. Imagore oino, mare taginorudoduwo du bogaire inagoino.
source: Iomodukare iaboe iaboe ewugeje. Imagore oino, mare taginorudoduwo du bogaire inagoino.

b: Jorugu ja ururireu urugureu nure Joãoce. Tagire tagaidure taegarewo biegatu je nowu urugu tabo.
source: Jorugu ja ururireu urugureu nure Joãoce. Tagire tagaidure taegarewo biegatu je nowu urugu tabo.

b: Mare imirema ia iore kejewure du kodure João kori. Paga karega, Iogare iroiagudu jire iroino, du tabore boere boe pa Iogai irojai duji.
source: Mare imirema ia iore kejewure du kodure João kori. Paga karega, Iogare iroiagudu jire iroino, du tabore boere boe pa Iogai irojai duji.

b: Ioga, koiare ure irojaiwu, bataru jore iwugeje jamedu. Tagire tameardu kigodukare makoji, taerdu kigodukare jeji.
source: Ioga, koiare ure irojaiwu, bataru jore iwugeje jamedu. Tagire tameardu kigodukare makoji, taerdu kigodukare jeji.

b: Bataru metukare tawabo tada, tameartorukare cewu ure rojaiwu jitu kodi.
source: Bataru metukare tawabo tada, tameartorukare cewu ure rojaiwu jitu kodi.

b: Tare taeku tugu bapera atugoto, tadugu tado taerdumode boe ewi boekwareu jitu bogai. Kode ica, nowu bapera mitodure makore ii.
source: Tare taeku tugu bapera atugoto, tadugu tado taerdumode boe ewi boekwareu jitu bogai. Kode ica, nowu bapera mitodure makore ii.

b: Mare tagi tagaidukare taduwo itae, taewo du bogai.
source: Mare tagi tagaidukare taduwo itae, taewo du bogai.

b: Ipaga kare imewo inojorodo du bogai.
source: Ipaga kare imewo inojorodo du bogai.

b: Imire iorduware tai. Pao meardu kuriae metukare tadoda.
source: Imire iorduware tai. Pao meardu kuriae metukare tadoda.

b: Itaregodure Ioga ie tabo, mare tagare tageragu ii. Mare ia aregodumode cie tabo ma, tamode tageragu ji.
source: Itaregodure Ioga ie tabo, mare tagare tageragu ii. Mare ia aregodumode cie tabo ma, tamode tageragu ji.

b: Inobadu taboba tameartorumode? Tagi taemarure pui puwo tugurido du bogai, mare taemarukare tawo Pao Aroe Eimejera mitotu jewu akaru kurido du bogai.
source: Inobadu taboba tameartorumode? Tagi taemarure pui puwo tugurido du bogai, mare taemarukare tawo Pao Aroe Eimejera mitotu jewu akaru kurido du bogai.

b: Tadugu kaba imago pegamode tai Ioga biegai duji. Okirure taiboere Moisés rema, duwu kejere tare tabagaredu bu.
source: Tadugu kaba imago pegamode tai Ioga biegai duji. Okirure taiboere Moisés rema, duwu kejere tare tabagaredu bu.

b: Mare tameartorumode Moisesji ma, boe jokodu jire tameartorumode ii jamedu, ure bapera atugodo iiboe jitu kodi.
source: Mare tameartorumode Moisesji ma, boe jokodu jire tameartorumode ii jamedu, ure bapera atugodo iiboe jitu kodi.

b: Mare tameartorukare o bapera atugoji ma, kode, inoba taboba tameartorumode iwadaruji?
source: Mare tameartorukare o bapera atugoji ma, kode, inoba taboba tameartorumode iwadaruji?

b: Jesus ure boe makareuge enogwagedo.
source: Jesus ure boe makareuge enogwagedo.

b: Du keje icare Jesus ure pagado Galiléia kejewu kuruga bakowu kae (Tiberades kejewu kuruga).
source: Du keje icare Jesus ure pagado Galiléia kejewu kuruga bakowu kae (Tiberades kejewu kuruga).

b: Boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji, eerdure ro kurireui kogodureuge eidu jitu koia.
source: Boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji, eerdure ro kurireui kogodureuge eidu jitu koia.

b: Icare Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae; nono ure tumugudo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.
source: Icare Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae; nono ure tumugudo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.

b: Boe puredugodure judeudoge eno peta iei Páscoa cedu kae.
source: Boe puredugodure judeudoge eno peta iei Páscoa cedu kae.

b: Jesus ure tuie aogado nowu kodure pudaewu boe makareuge ei, akore Filipeji: - Kaiba pamode akirodo amireuji awuge eiamedu boe ewo kowuje?
source: Jesus ure tuie aogado nowu kodure pudaewu boe makareuge ei, akore Filipeji: - Kaiba pamode akirodo amireuji awuge eiamedu boe ewo kowuje?

b: Akore oinono tui turokagado ji du tabo, mare jorduware inoba turomode duji.
source: Akore oinono tui turokagado ji du tabo, mare jorduware inoba turomode duji.

b: Icare Filipe akore ji: - Diiero umode 200 ma, umodukare turugadu eiamedu boe ekewo ia koboroguce.
source: Icare Filipe akore ji: - Diiero umode 200 ma, umodukare turugadu eiamedu boe ekewo ia koboroguce.

b: Icare ia nowu ure jorduwadowuge, iere André cedu, Simão Pedro uwie, akore ji: -
source: Icare ia nowu ure jorduwadowuge, iere André cedu, Simão Pedro uwie, akore ji: -

b: Ia negedurogu rakojere woe, du o amireure ikera awubodure tu je, kare kugurere pobe tu je, mare inoba nowu inodu rogu umode awu boe emaga inodu ai?
source: Ia negedurogu rakojere woe, du o amireure ikera awubodure tu je, kare kugurere pobe tu je, mare inoba nowu inodu rogu umode awu boe emaga inodu ai?

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Edo tumugudo. Boekarema, boebutu kuricigore nono du imere cinco mil cedu ere tumugudo nono.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Edo tumugudo. Boekarema, boebutu kuricigore nono du imere cinco mil cedu ere tumugudo nono.

b: Icare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amireu roguji, makore baruto keje, du kejere ure pedo nowu mugure nonowu boe etai. Du reorere rore cewu kare kugurei pobe tu jeduji, ure maku nowu boe etai etaidu reore.
source: Icare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amireu roguji, makore baruto keje, du kejere ure pedo nowu mugure nonowu boe etai. Du reorere rore cewu kare kugurei pobe tu jeduji, ure maku nowu boe etai etaidu reore.

b: Icare ekuredure. Du kejere icare akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Nowu kobo jetu onareu to pui, tawo jetu otorogado ma, ia okwa kawo.
source: Icare ekuredure. Du kejere icare akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Nowu kobo jetu onareu to pui, tawo jetu otorogado ma, ia okwa kawo.

b: Ere to pui. Ica, cewu iro amireu rogui ikera awubodure tu jedu kobo jetu kimoi tuiagejedu, eiamedu boe enogwage akedu rekodaji, ere kododoge ikera awubodure pobe taci ikare awubowutodu enogorobadudo tabo.
