b: Mare fariseudoge egore oino pui: -Tagaiwodo, paroiwa bokwa radure. Boe eiamedu boe eregodu nure rekodaji.
source: Mare fariseudoge egore oino pui: -Tagaiwodo, paroiwa bokwa radure. Boe eiamedu boe eregodu nure rekodaji.

b: Ia gregodoge emugure nowu ruture tumagowo baruto peta kejewuge etada.
source: Ia gregodoge emugure nowu ruture tumagowo baruto peta kejewuge etada.

b: Duwuge ere tuburedo Filipeji (cewu Galiléia tadawu Betsaida kejewu), enogwamagudure ji, egore: - Cegimejera, cedagemo nure ceerduwo Jesusji.
source: Duwuge ere tuburedo Filipeji (cewu Galiléia tadawu Betsaida kejewu), enogwamagudure ji, egore: - Cegimejera, cedagemo nure ceerduwo Jesusji.

b: Icare Filipe kodure André ae, ure bie. Icare Filipe mare André, ere Pagimejera bie.
source: Icare Filipe kodure André ae, ure bie. Icare Filipe mare André, ere Pagimejera bie.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Icare boe aregodure pudae Imedu Onaregedu kuridodumodedu kae.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Icare boe aregodure pudae Imedu Onaregedu kuridodumodedu kae.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: ia trigo a butui moto todu, mare bimodukare du keje, umode mitotu nono rugadu, mare bimode du keje, a makaguragamode.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: ia trigo a butui moto todu, mare bimodukare du keje, umode mitotu nono rugadu, mare bimode du keje, a makaguragamode.

b: Cewu meardu kurire puduiwu, umode tuwarigu boeto, mare cewu kodu kagirire puduiwu, ikaruru nure pudui jere jii jeboe kae.
source: Cewu meardu kurire puduiwu, umode tuwarigu boeto, mare cewu kodu kagirire puduiwu, ikaruru nure pudui jere jii jeboe kae.

b: Iaboe eromode nono itaidu reore du keje, ekodumode iregodaji. Cewu iragojemodewo keje, itugare rakojemode nono jamedu. Iaboe itugaremode ma, Ioga umode kuridodudo.
source: Iaboe eromode nono itaidu reore du keje, ekodumode iregodaji. Cewu iragojemodewo keje, itugare rakojemode nono jamedu. Iaboe itugaremode ma, Ioga umode kuridodudo.

b: Oino, itaroe kiarigodu nure. Inoba inagomode? Ioga, ikinorudo awu du kodiboe piji. Mare awu inodu koia rugadure itaregodure tu oino.
source: Oino, itaroe kiarigodu nure. Inoba inagomode? Ioga, ikinorudo awu du kodiboe piji. Mare awu inodu koia rugadure itaregodure tu oino.

b: Ioga, akie kurido. Nowu inodu keje kuri je, ia boe emago aregodure baru piji, akore: - Ire kurido marigudu, imode kurido pugeje.
source: Ioga, akie kurido. Nowu inodu keje kuri je, ia boe emago aregodure baru piji, akore: - Ire kurido marigudu, imode kurido pugeje.

b: Aró, kode, nowu boe makareuge eedure nonodu, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, egore boiarurugoduie. Iage egore: - Ia tupare akoino ji.
source: Aró, kode, nowu boe makareuge eedure nonodu, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, egore boiarurugoduie. Iage egore: - Ia tupare akoino ji.

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Awu makore oinoboe igoia karega akoino, mare taigoia.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Awu makore oinoboe igoia karega akoino, mare taigoia.

b: Ure tugogado awu moto jiboe aregodure; icare awu moto ukimejera barigudumode.
source: Ure tugogado awu moto jiboe aregodure; icare awu moto ukimejera barigudumode.

b: Mare icai itaogado moto piji du keje, imode imugudo ime eiamedu boe keje itae.
source: Mare icai itaogado moto piji du keje, imode imugudo ime eiamedu boe keje itae.

b: Akore oino, mare tuwo boe eerduwado inoba tuwimode du jire akoino.
source: Akore oino, mare tuwo boe eerduwado inoba tuwimode du jire akoino.

b: Icare egore: - Cemeardure Pao o bakaru akoi Cristo jemode jii je duji. Kodiba icare akore: Ure turugadu Imedu Onaregeduwo taogado? Kakoduwuba nowu Imedu Onaregedu rema?
source: Icare egore: - Cemeardure Pao o bakaru akoi Cristo jemode jii je duji. Kodiba icare akore: Ure turugadu Imedu Onaregeduwo taogado? Kakoduwuba nowu Imedu Onaregedu rema?

b: Jesus akore: - Urugureboe mugumode tagabo kimo biega tu je. Tamerudo urugu kimodu otoi, boeco ukawo taroiwa bokwado. Cewu merure boeco kaowu jordukare kaiba tugodumode.
source: Jesus akore: - Urugureboe mugumode tagabo kimo biega tu je. Tamerudo urugu kimodu otoi, boeco ukawo taroiwa bokwado. Cewu merure boeco kaowu jordukare kaiba tugodumode.

b:
Urugureboei tagabo kimodu otoi, tameartorudo ji, duma urugureboe orewo tagi. Awu tuwadaru rekodaji, Jesus ure tudawuje nowu piji, ure tuwiado epiji.
Judeudoge emeartorukare.
source:
Urugureboei tagabo kimodu otoi, tameartorudo ji, duma urugureboe orewo tagi. Awu tuwadaru rekodaji, Jesus ure tudawuje nowu piji, ure tuwiado epiji.
Judeudoge emeartorukare.

b: Ure turo kurireu kuo du makado, mare du inodu tabo emeartorukare ji.
source: Ure turo kurireu kuo du makado, mare du inodu tabo emeartorukare ji.

b: Oinore nowu inodu jia profeta Isaias akore: - Cegimejera, ioguduba meartorure cereadodure jiboeji? Ioguduba biegaiba Pagimejera ro rakareu kogadodure?
source: Oinore nowu inodu jia profeta Isaias akore: - Cegimejera, ioguduba meartorure cereadodure jiboeji? Ioguduba biegaiba Pagimejera ro rakareu kogadodure?

b: Mare eroiwakare tumeartoruwo, paga karega, ia du kodi, profeta Isaias akore pugeje:
source: Mare eroiwakare tumeartoruwo, paga karega, ia du kodi, profeta Isaias akore pugeje:

b: "Ure eeku mi, ure ewabo rakado, duma eerdukawo tuioku tabo, eerduwa kawo tuwabo tada, ekawo tubemegado, ikawo epemegado” (Is 6,9s).
source: "Ure eeku mi, ure ewabo rakado, duma eerdukawo tuioku tabo, eerduwa kawo tuwabo tada, ekawo tubemegado, ikawo epemegado” (Is 6,9s).

b: Oinore Isaias akore tuiordui o boe pemegareu kurireu jitu keje.
source: Oinore Isaias akore tuiordui o boe pemegareu kurireu jitu keje.

b: Mare ia judeudoge eiemejerage makareuge emeartorure ji, mare fariseudoge eigoia ekare towadudo, duma tuwarigudu kawo sinagoga piji.
source: Mare ia judeudoge eiemejerage makareuge emeartorure ji, mare fariseudoge eigoia ekare towadudo, duma tuwarigudu kawo sinagoga piji.

b: Paga karega, etaidure boewo tugurido duji, mare tuguridodu aregodui baru piji duji karega.
source: Paga karega, etaidure boewo tugurido duji, mare tuguridodu aregodui baru piji duji karega.

b: Du kodi icare Jesus ure tumago rakado, akore: - Cewu meartorure iiwu, ii karega meartorure, mare ure irojaiwu jire meartorure.
source: Du kodi icare Jesus ure tumago rakado, akore: - Cewu meartorure iiwu, ii karega meartorure, mare ure irojaiwu jire meartorure.

b: Jordure iiwu, ure irojaiwu jire jordure.
source: Jordure iiwu, ure irojaiwu jire jordure.

b: Itaregodure nono urugureboe aregodui moto kaedu reore, nowu inodu tabo, cewu meartorure iiwu rakojemodukare boecoreu tada.
source: Itaregodure nono urugureboe aregodui moto kaedu reore, nowu inodu tabo, cewu meartorure iiwu rakojemodukare boecoreu tada.

b: Iaboe emeardumode iwadaruji, mare eromodukare nono iwadaru reore ma, imodukare ikogado ji, paga karega, itaregodure moto kae, mare iwo ikogado boei du bogai karega, mare iwo boe einorudodu bogaire itaregodure.
source: Iaboe emeardumode iwadaruji, mare eromodukare nono iwadaru reore ma, imodukare ikogado ji, paga karega, itaregodure moto kae, mare iwo ikogado boei du bogai karega, mare iwo boe einorudodu bogaire itaregodure.

b: Cewu ure iwarigududowu, ukare tugeragu iwadaru jiwu, iaboe emode tugogado ji: Ire awadudowu iwadaru umode tugogado ji boigoduwu meriji.
source: Cewu ure iwarigududowu, ukare tugeragu iwadaru jiwu, iaboe emode tugogado ji: Ire awadudowu iwadaru umode tugogado ji boigoduwu meriji.

b: Paga karega, itaobiji karega inagoino, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga, ure inagomodedudo, ure imode boe eerduwadodudo jamedu.
source: Paga karega, itaobiji karega inagoino, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga, ure inagomodedudo, ure imode boe eerduwadodudo jamedu.

b: Iorduware: ure boe eroiagudu boe ewi bokwareu rema. Kode, Iogare inagoiagu jiboe, jire inagoino.
source: Iorduware: ure boe eroiagudu boe ewi bokwareu rema. Kode, Iogare inagoiagu jiboe, jire inagoino.

b: Jesus ure ture jorduwadowuge ewure kabi.
source: Jesus ure ture jorduwadowuge ewure kabi.

b: Páscoa jiwu petamodedu otodai, Jesus tuiorduai icai boe aregodui pudae, icai tudumode Tuo ae awu moto piji duji, meardu kurire awu moto kejewu tuwobei, meardu kurire jii ei rugadu.
source: Páscoa jiwu petamodedu otodai, Jesus tuiorduai icai boe aregodui pudae, icai tudumode Tuo ae awu moto piji duji, meardu kurire awu moto kejewu tuwobei, meardu kurire jii ei rugadu.

b: Enogwagei ira keje du tonaji, Aroe pegareuma urade Judas, cewu Simão Iscariote onaregedu, meardae pegareu barigu uwaboto, uwo Jesus maku onare jiwuge etai.
source: Enogwagei ira keje du tonaji, Aroe pegareuma urade Judas, cewu Simão Iscariote onaregedu, meardae pegareu barigu uwaboto, uwo Jesus maku onare jiwuge etai.

b: Icare Jesus, tuiorduwai Tuoie boe jamedu boe bu tugera keje, Pao pijie taregodure, du tumoduie tugirimi Pao ae pugeje,
source: Icare Jesus, tuiorduwai Tuoie boe jamedu boe bu tugera keje, Pao pijie taregodure, du tumoduie tugirimi Pao ae pugeje,

b: Ure turagojedo taci ira piji, ure tugudae aroia boareu tawuje, icare tui tugeragu ia aroia koboji, ure kogudo tu tubeagajeje.
source: Ure turagojedo taci ira piji, ure tugudae aroia boareu tawuje, icare tui tugeragu ia aroia koboji, ure kogudo tu tubeagajeje.

b: Icare ure pobo tugu ia ruwoboto, icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge ewure kabi, ure ewure kidudo nowu ture kogudo tubeagajejewu aroia tabo.
source: Icare ure pobo tugu ia ruwoboto, icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge ewure kabi, ure ewure kidudo nowu ture kogudo tubeagajejewu aroia tabo.

b: Aregodure tu Simão Pedro ae, mare Pedro akore ji: - Ikimejera, arumode iwure kabi?
source: Aregodure tu Simão Pedro ae, mare Pedro akore ji: - Ikimejera, arumode iwure kabi?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Awu irore oino jiboe amodukare pawuje roga, mare dukeje kuri je, amode pawuje.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Awu irore oino jiboe amodukare pawuje roga, mare dukeje kuri je, amode pawuje.

b: Pedro akore ji: Amodukare iwure kabi rugadu. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imodukare akabi ma, aragojemodukare itabo
source: Pedro akore ji: Amodukare iwure kabi rugadu. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imodukare akabi ma, aragojemodukare itabo

b: Kodi icare Simão Pedro akore: - Ikimejera, kode, iwure tu rugadu karega, ikera jamedu, itaora jamedu, amode kabi.
source: Kodi icare Simão Pedro akore: - Ikimejera, kode, iwure tu rugadu karega, ikera jamedu, itaora jamedu, amode kabi.

b: Jesus akore ji: -Cewu ure taimo mariguduu biapagamodukare tuwo tugabi du bogai pugeje; ema jamedu boe kabidure kodi. Aró, kode, tagi tagabidure, mare taiamedu karega.
source: Jesus akore ji: -Cewu ure taimo mariguduu biapagamodukare tuwo tugabi du bogai pugeje; ema jamedu boe kabidure kodi. Aró, kode, tagi tagabidure, mare taiamedu karega.

b: Jorduware ioguduba umode tumagu tujebage etai duji, du kodire akoino: - Taiamedu karega kabidure.
source: Jorduware ioguduba umode tumagu tujebage etai duji, du kodire akoino: - Taiamedu karega kabidure.

b: Tui ewure kabidu akedu keje, ure tugeragu tugudaeji, ure tugu tu pudui pugeje, icare ure tumugudo tu ira keje. Du kejere icare makore ture jorduwadowugei, akore: -Taerdure iroino jiboeji?
source: Tui ewure kabidu akedu keje, ure tugeragu tugudaeji, ure tugu tu pudui pugeje, icare ure tumugudo tu ira keje. Du kejere icare makore ture jorduwadowugei, akore: -Taerdure iroino jiboeji?

b: Tagagore ure taerduwadowuie ure imi, tagagore tagimejeraie ure imi. Tagagoi oinodu pemegare, cewu imi rugadu kodi.
source: Tagagore ure taerduwadowuie ure imi, tagagore tagimejeraie ure imi. Tagagoi oinodu pemegare, cewu imi rugadu kodi.

b: Kodi icare imire tagimejerare imi, ure taerduwadowure imi, mare du inodu tabo ire tawure kabi. Kode ica, tamode pu bure kabi jamedu.
source: Kodi icare imire tagimejerare imi, ure taerduwadowure imi, mare du inodu tabo ire tawure kabi. Kode ica, tamode pu bure kabi jamedu.

b: Taerdu nure iroi oinoduji, du reorere taromode pui jamedu.
source: Taerdu nure iroi oinoduji, du reorere taromode pui jamedu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Boe etugare emawu kurikare tugimejera kori;  jamedu cewu rojaidodureu kodukare cewu ure rojaiwu kori.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Boe etugare emawu kurikare tugimejera kori;  jamedu cewu rojaidodureu kodukare cewu ure rojaiwu kori.

b: Tamode awu inodu boe pawuje ma, boe pemegareu jetumode tagabo, mare tamode inodu towuje du keje.
source: Tamode awu inodu boe pawuje ma, boe pemegareu jetumode tagabo, mare tamode inodu towuje du keje.

b: Taiamedu boeji karega inagoino. Iorduware cewu ire tawuje tumedage epijigugei. Mare umode turugadu boewo nono bapera atugo reore: -“Cewu ure amireu kowuje itabowu unure tuwureadu awagado ii” (Sl 40,10).
source: Taiamedu boeji karega inagoino. Iorduware cewu ire tawuje tumedage epijigugei. Mare umode turugadu boewo nono bapera atugo reore: -“Cewu ure amireu kowuje itabowu unure tuwureadu awagado ii” (Sl 40,10).

b: Imago nure awu inoduji oino, nowu inodu umode tudo du otodai, duma umode tudowuje ma tameartoruwo, taerduwawo ioguduba ure imi duji.
source: Imago nure awu inoduji oino, nowu inodu umode tudo du otodai, duma umode tudowuje ma tameartoruwo, taerduwawo ioguduba ure imi duji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: - Ure tugeragu cewu ure irojaiwu jiwu, ii rugadure ure tugeragu, cewu ure tugeragu iiwu, ure irojaiwu jiwu jire ure tugeragu jamedu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: - Ure tugeragu cewu ure irojaiwu jiwu, ii rugadure ure tugeragu, cewu ure tugeragu iiwu, ure irojaiwu jiwu jire ure tugeragu jamedu.

b: Tagoi oinodu rekodaji, Jesus utaroe kiarigodu kuricigore, du tabore akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ia tagi tamode imagu icebage etai.
source: Tagoi oinodu rekodaji, Jesus utaroe kiarigodu kuricigore, du tabore akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ia tagi tamode imagu icebage etai.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaiwore jice woje pui, eerduwakare kakoduwu ia puduiba akomode inoduji.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaiwore jice woje pui, eerduwakare kakoduwu ia puduiba akomode inoduji.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia mito tu jedu, Jesus meardu kuricigore jiwu, mugure ira keje mekiwu, ure taora bu Jesus mo keje.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia mito tu jedu, Jesus meardu kuricigore jiwu, mugure ira keje mekiwu, ure taora bu Jesus mo keje.

b: Simão Pedro ure tuiebirigido ji tunora tabo ji: - Ioguduba jiba akoino?
source: Simão Pedro ure tuiebirigido ji tunora tabo ji: - Ioguduba jiba akoino?

b: Nowu mitodu, taora padui Jesus mo keje du tabore, unoragodure ji: - Cegimejera, ioguduba?
source: Nowu mitodu, taora padui Jesus mo keje du tabore, unoragodure ji: - Cegimejera, ioguduba?

b: Jesus akore: - Cewu imode amireu pegodu du imode maku aiwu. Du keje icare ure amireu pegodo, ure maku Simão Iscariote onaregedu Judas ai.
source: Jesus akore: - Cewu imode amireu pegodu du imode maku aiwu. Du keje icare ure amireu pegodo, ure maku Simão Iscariote onaregedu Judas ai.

b: Ui nowu amireu remo du keje kuri je, Aroe pegareure taredo to. Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - Amode towujeboe todu marigudo ii.
source: Ui nowu amireu remo du keje kuri je, Aroe pegareure taredo to. Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - Amode towujeboe todu marigudo ii.

b: Mare nowu jeture ira kejewuge, ia emage ia emage eerduwakare kodiba akoino ji.
source: Mare nowu jeture ira kejewuge, ia emage ia emage eerduwakare kodiba akoino ji.

b: Paga karega, Judas apore akirododu epa ja mugure, du koiare ia emage emeardaere akoe oino ji: - Akirodo ia okwamode pagai peta epa boeji. Iarema, ia maku marenarue etai.
source: Paga karega, Judas apore akirododu epa ja mugure, du koiare ia emage emeardaere akoe oino ji: - Akirodo ia okwamode pagai peta epa boeji. Iarema, ia maku marenarue etai.

b: Tui cewu amireu kobo ko du rekodaji, ure akedo pudui tuwo tuiebu. Boekarema, boecoradure marigudu.
source: Tui cewu amireu kobo ko du rekodaji, ure akedo pudui tuwo tuiebu. Boekarema, boecoradure marigudu.

b: Judas ui tuiebu du keje, Jesus akore: - Oinore icare Imedu Onaregedu kuridodure, Paore tugurireu towuje tada.
source: Judas ui tuiebu du keje, Jesus akore: - Oinore icare Imedu Onaregedu kuridodure, Paore tugurireu towuje tada.

b: Kode Paore tugurireu towuje tada du keje, Pao umode kurireudo ema tudada, umode kurireudo ema kuri je.
source: Kode Paore tugurireu towuje tada du keje, Pao umode kurireudo ema tudada, umode kurireudo ema kuri je.

b: Itore kugure, biegatu kimo iragojei oino tagabo. Taemarumode iwogai, mare imago magai judeudoge eidu reorere, inagomode oino tai jamedu: Taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae.
source: Itore kugure, biegatu kimo iragojei oino tagabo. Taemarumode iwogai, mare imago magai judeudoge eidu reorere, inagomode oino tai jamedu: Taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae.

b: Boe etawara Pao ai dure Jesus rema. -
source: Boe etawara Pao ai dure Jesus rema. -

b: Tawabo pagudugodu kaba. Tameartorure Paoji, kode tameartorudo ii jamedu.
source: Tawabo pagudugodu kaba. Tameartorure Paoji, kode tameartorudo ii jamedu.

b: Boe eeda makaguragare Ioga uwai tada; umodukare ino ma, imagomode tai marigudu. Ica, itumode toro iwo taeda pemegado.
source: Boe eeda makaguragare Ioga uwai tada; umodukare ino ma, imagomode tai marigudu. Ica, itumode toro iwo taeda pemegado.

b: Itumode toro, imode taeda pemegado du keje, imode ikirimi, imode ikeragu tai itabo, duma, taeduwo iragojemodewo keje.
source: Itumode toro, imode taeda pemegado du keje, imode ikirimi, imode ikeragu tai itabo, duma, taeduwo iragojemodewo keje.

b: Taerduware kakoduwu awaraba umode boe arego ikodumodewo kaeduji.
source: Taerduware kakoduwu awaraba umode boe arego ikodumodewo kaeduji.

b: Icare Tomé akore ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduwakare kaiba akodumode duji. Kode, inobadu taboba ceerduwamode nowu awaraji?
source: Icare Tomé akore ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduwakare kaiba akodumode duji. Kode, inobadu taboba ceerduwamode nowu awaraji?

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imire Awarare imi, Boe Rikireu nure mi, ure boe eedowu nure imi, iaboe iaboe etaregodumodukare Ioga ae ipiji du keje.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imire Awarare imi, Boe Rikireu nure mi, ure boe eedowu nure imi, iaboe iaboe etaregodumodukare Ioga ae ipiji du keje.

b: Taerduwamode ii ma, taerduwamode Iogaji jamedu. Oino taerduware ji, paga karega, taerdure ji marigudu kodi.
source: Taerduwamode ii ma, taerduwamode Iogaji jamedu. Oino taerduware ji, paga karega, taerdure ji marigudu kodi.

b: Filipe akore: - Cegimejera, ceerduwado Paoji. Nowu inodu umode turugadu cei.
source: Filipe akore: - Cegimejera, ceerduwado Paoji. Nowu inodu umode turugadu cei.

b: Jesus akore: - Mariigudu iragojere tagabo, macare aerduwakare ii, Felipe? Cewu jordure iiwu, jordure Iogaji jamedu. Kodiba icare akagore oinono: Ceerduwado Paoji, oino?
source: Jesus akore: - Mariigudu iragojere tagabo, macare aerduwakare ii, Felipe? Cewu jordure iiwu, jordure Iogaji jamedu. Kodiba icare akagore oinono: Ceerduwado Paoji, oino?

b: Ameartorukare imedui Ioga tada duji, Ioga metui itoda duji? Imagore ji taiboe, itaobiji karega inagoino, mare Iogare, meture itadadu, ure turore jiboe boe towuje.
source: Ameartorukare imedui Ioga tada duji, Ioga metui itoda duji? Imagore ji taiboe, itaobiji karega inagoino, mare Iogare, meture itadadu, ure turore jiboe boe towuje.

b: Tameartorudo ii. Imedure Ioga tada, Ioga meture itada. Tameartorudo awu inodu boeji, awu roboe koia.
source: Tameartorudo ii. Imedure Ioga tada, Ioga meture itada. Tameartorudo awu inodu boeji, awu roboe koia.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: cewu meartorure iiwu, romode nono irore jiboeji, mare ro kodumode awu iroino jiboe kori. Mare paga karega, itumode Ioga ae kodi.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: cewu meartorure iiwu, romode nono irore jiboeji, mare ro kodumode awu iroino jiboe kori. Mare paga karega, itumode Ioga ae kodi.

b: Ica, tagogwamagudumode Paoji ikie tabo bogaiboe jamedu boe, iromode ino tagai, duma Uo kuridoduwo tonaregedu tada.
source: Ica, tagogwamagudumode Paoji ikie tabo bogaiboe jamedu boe, iromode ino tagai, duma Uo kuridoduwo tonaregedu tada.

b:
Tagogwamagudumode ii, ikie taboboe jamedu boe, iromode ino tagai.
Jesus akore tumoduie Aroe Pemegareu arego.
source:
Tagogwamagudumode ii, ikie taboboe jamedu boe, iromode ino tagai.
Jesus akore tumoduie Aroe Pemegareu arego.

b: Tameardu kurimode ii ma, taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore.
source: Tameardu kurimode ii ma, taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore.

b: Icare inogwamagudumode Paoji, du umode ia Tagimejera Pemegareu maku tagai muguwo tagabo boe jameduji jii je.
source: Icare inogwamagudumode Paoji, du umode ia Tagimejera Pemegareu maku tagai muguwo tagabo boe jameduji jii je.

b: Duwure boe jokoduwu remawu Aroe rema, duwure awu moto umodukare tugeragu ji, paga karega, roiwakare tuiorduwo ji kodi. Tagirema, taerduware ji, paga karega, rakojemode tagabo, metumode tadoda du kodi.
source: Duwure boe jokoduwu remawu Aroe rema, duwure awu moto umodukare tugeragu ji, paga karega, roiwakare tuiorduwo ji kodi. Tagirema, taerduware ji, paga karega, rakojemode tagabo, metumode tadoda du kodi.

b: Imodukare marenarudo tagi ii ikera ra tabiji du tabo. Imode ikirimi tawogai pugeje.
source: Imodukare marenarudo tagi ii ikera ra tabiji du tabo. Imode ikirimi tawogai pugeje.

b: Biegatu kimo, awu moto jordumodukare ii. Mare tagirema, taerdumode ii pugeje, iere kodi, tagi jamedu taemode jamedu kodi.
source: Biegatu kimo, awu moto jordumodukare ii. Mare tagirema, taerdumode ii pugeje, iere kodi, tagi jamedu taemode jamedu kodi.

b: Nowu meriji taerduwamode iragojei Ioga tada duji, taedui itada duji, imedui tadoda duji jamedu.
source: Nowu meriji taerduwamode iragojei Ioga tada duji, taedui itada duji, imedui tadoda duji jamedu.

b: Cewu jedure ino boe eroiagudu jiwu, romode ino ma, nowure meardu kurire ii. Cewu meardu kurire iiwu, Ioga meardu kurimode ji jamedu, imeardu kurimode ji, imode itowadudo jekai.
source: Cewu jedure ino boe eroiagudu jiwu, romode ino ma, nowure meardu kurire ii. Cewu meardu kurire iiwu, Ioga meardu kurimode ji jamedu, imeardu kurimode ji, imode itowadudo jekai.

b: Icare Judas unoragodure ji, mare cewu Iscariote karega, akore: - Cegimejera, kodiba amode akowadudo ceegai, mare amodukare akowadudo awu moto jekai?
source: Icare Judas unoragodure ji, mare cewu Iscariote karega, akore: - Cegimejera, kodiba amode akowadudo ceegai, mare amodukare akowadudo awu moto jekai?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Cewu meardu kurire iiwu, remode nono ii boe eroiagudu reore, du kejere icare Ioga meardu kurimode ji jamedu, du kejere cedumode mato ae, icare cemode ceeda bu tada.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Cewu meardu kurire iiwu, remode nono ii boe eroiagudu reore, du kejere icare Ioga meardu kurimode ji jamedu, du kejere cedumode mato ae, icare cemode ceeda bu tada.

b: Cewu meardu kurikare iiwu, romodukare nono ii boe eroiagudu reore. Tameardure jiwu iwadaruji, mare iwadaru karega, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga bataru.
source: Cewu meardu kurikare iiwu, romodukare nono ii boe eroiagudu reore. Tameardure jiwu iwadaruji, mare iwadaru karega, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga bataru.

b: Inagore awu inodu boeji iragojei kimo tagabodu otoi.
source: Inagore awu inodu boeji iragojei kimo tagabodu otoi.

b: Mare ure boe ewudugugowu Aroe Pemegareu, dure Ioga umode rojai ikie tabodu, umode taerduwado boe jamedu boeji, umode tawia jetu imagore jiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Mare ure boe ewudugugowu Aroe Pemegareu, dure Ioga umode rojai ikie tabodu, umode taerduwado boe jamedu boeji, umode tawia jetu imagore jiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Inure boe butugureu mugudo tagabo, inure ino boe butugureu maku tagai. Mare imodukare maku tagai nono awu moto kejewuge magai maku du reore. Tawabo kiarigodu kaba, tawabo pagudu kaba jamedu.
source: Inure boe butugureu mugudo tagabo, inure ino boe butugureu maku tagai. Mare imodukare maku tagai nono awu moto kejewuge magai maku du reore. Tawabo kiarigodu kaba, tawabo pagudu kaba jamedu.

b: Tameardure imagoi awu inodu jituji: Itumode, mare imode ikirimi tagae pugeje. Tameardu kurimode ii ma, boe jokodure taegare kuricigomode itui Ioga ae duji, mare paga karega, Iogare kuri remawure ikori.
source: Tameardure imagoi awu inodu jituji: Itumode, mare imode ikirimi tagae pugeje. Tameardu kurimode ii ma, boe jokodure taegare kuricigomode itui Ioga ae duji, mare paga karega, Iogare kuri remawure ikori.

b: Inagore awu inoduji oino tai, nowu inodu umode tudowujedu koda piji, duma inodu ui tudowuje du keje, tameartoruwo.
source: Inagore awu inoduji oino tai, nowu inodu umode tudowujedu koda piji, duma inodu ui tudowuje du keje, tameartoruwo.

b: Imago kuri jokodumodukare tai pugeje, mare paga karega, awu moto ukimejera aregodu nure kodi, mare ro rakamodukare iaboeji iaboeji ii.
source: Imago kuri jokodumodukare tai pugeje, mare paga karega, awu moto ukimejera aregodu nure kodi, mare ro rakamodukare iaboeji iaboeji ii.

b: Mare awu moto jorduwamode imeardu kurii Ioga jituji, iroi nono Ioga iroiagudu reore duji. Taragojedo, paduwo awu piji.
source: Mare awu moto jorduwamode imeardu kurii Ioga jituji, iroi nono Ioga iroiagudu reore duji. Taragojedo, paduwo awu piji.

b: Parera ikure Jesus rema. -
source: Parera ikure Jesus rema. -

b: Imire boe jokoduwu parera ikure imi; Iogare parera iguru epa rema.
source: Imire boe jokoduwu parera ikure imi; Iogare parera iguru epa rema.

b: Enari botukareu jetara kuguri jamedu boe umode kado; enari botureu jamedu boe umode jetara kuguri rogu kado piji, duma enari makawo.
source: Enari botukareu jetara kuguri jamedu boe umode kado; enari botureu jamedu boe umode jetara kuguri rogu kado piji, duma enari makawo.

b: Tagire tagabidure (jetara boe kabidure tabiji) imagore jiwu iwadaru koia.
source: Tagire tagabidure (jetara boe kabidure tabiji) imagore jiwu iwadaru koia.

b: Tamugudo itabo, imi jamedu imugumode tagabo. Enari boe botumodukare taobiji jetukai cito du tabo. Oinore tare jamedu: taro pemegareu umodukare tamugukai itabo du keje.
source: Tamugudo itabo, imi jamedu imugumode tagabo. Enari boe botumodukare taobiji jetukai cito du tabo. Oinore tare jamedu: taro pemegareu umodukare tamugukai itabo du keje.

b: Imire parera ikure imi, tagire jetaragurure tagi. Mugure itabowu, imugure apowu, ro pemegareu kuricigomode, paga karega, itabo karega du keje, taroiwamodukare iaboeji iaboeji.
source: Imire parera ikure imi, tagire jetaragurure tagi. Mugure itabowu, imugure apowu, ro pemegareu kuricigomode, paga karega, itabo karega du keje, taroiwamodukare iaboeji iaboeji.

b: Cewu mugukare itadawuge eiamedu boe, barigudumode toro baawadu kae, cewu enari botukare jetara boe reore. Du kidumode, boe emode ako, bariguduwo joruto, kowuduwo.
source: Cewu mugukare itadawuge eiamedu boe, barigudumode toro baawadu kae, cewu enari botukare jetara boe reore. Du kidumode, boe emode ako, bariguduwo joruto, kowuduwo.

b: Tamugumode itabo ma, iwadaru metumode tagabo ma, tagogwamagudumode tagaidure jiboe jamedu boe bogai, du umode ino rugadu.
source: Tamugumode itabo ma, iwadaru metumode tagabo ma, tagogwamagudumode tagaidure jiboe jamedu boe bogai, du umode ino rugadu.

b: Ioga akaru kuridodu nure, tai taro pemegareu makado du tabo, tai ire jorduwadowugedo tagi du tabo.
source: Ioga akaru kuridodu nure, tai taro pemegareu makado du tabo, tai ire jorduwadowugedo tagi du tabo.

b: Nono Ioga meardu kuri magai ii du reorere, imeardu kurire tai jamedu. Tamugudo imeardu kuriae tada.
source: Nono Ioga meardu kuri magai ii du reorere, imeardu kurire tai jamedu. Tamugudo imeardu kuriae tada.

b: Taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore ma, tamugumode imeardu kuriae tada. Nono iro magai Iogai iroiagudu reore du koiare imugure meardu kuriae tada du reore.
source: Taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore ma, tamugumode imeardu kuriae tada. Nono iro magai Iogai iroiagudu reore du koiare imugure meardu kuriae tada du reore.

b:
Inagore tai awu inodu boeji du ma iegareae metuwo tadoda, taegareae kororogoduwo.
Boe emeardu kurii puidu. -
source:
Inagore tai awu inodu boeji du ma iegareae metuwo tadoda, taegareae kororogoduwo.
Boe emeardu kurii puidu. -

b: Awu ino boe eroiagudu reo: Tameardu kurido pui, imeardu kuri magai tai du reore.
source: Awu ino boe eroiagudu reo: Tameardu kurido pui, imeardu kuri magai tai du reore.

b: Iaboe iaboe emeardu kuriae kodukare cewu ure tumagu tuwidoduwo tumeardu kurire jiwuge etai du kori.
source: Iaboe iaboe emeardu kuriae kodukare cewu ure tumagu tuwidoduwo tumeardu kurire jiwuge etai du kori.

b: Imedage nure tagi taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore du keje.
source: Imedage nure tagi taromode nono ii taroiagudu reore du keje.

b: Imagomodukare itugaregeie ure tagi pugeje, mare paga karega, ire taerduwado imeardure ji Ioga pijiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Imagomodukare itugaregeie ure tagi pugeje, mare paga karega, ire taerduwado imeardure ji Ioga pijiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Tagire tamagokare iwogai, mare imire imagore tawogai. Ire tarojai toro taro pemegareuwo tudowuje, nowu taro pemereuwo jii je, du ma, tagogwamagudumode Iogaji ikie taboboe jamedu boe makuduwo tagai.
source: Tagire tamagokare iwogai, mare imire imagore tawogai. Ire tarojai toro taro pemegareuwo tudowuje, nowu taro pemereuwo jii je, du ma, tagogwamagudumode Iogaji ikie taboboe jamedu boe makuduwo tagai.

b:
Ire taroiagu jiboe reo: Tameardu kuriwo pui jice woje.
Awu moto kejewu boe etonamode Jesus apawugei. -
source:
Ire taroiagu jiboe reo: Tameardu kuriwo pui jice woje.
Awu moto kejewu boe etonamode Jesus apawugei. -

b: Awu moto kodu kagirimode tai ma, taerduwado iie kodu kagirire tagodobiji.
source: Awu moto kodu kagirimode tai ma, taerduwado iie kodu kagirire tagodobiji.

b: Moto omode tagi ma, moto meardu kurimode tai, toi tagi du koia. Mare moto o karega ure tagi du keje, ire ikeragu tai piji du kodi, du kodire moto kodu kagirire tai.
source: Moto omode tagi ma, moto meardu kurimode tai, toi tagi du koia. Mare moto o karega ure tagi du keje, ire ikeragu tai piji du kodi, du kodire moto kodu kagirire tai.

b: Tawia jetu imagore tai jiwu iwadaruji: Boe etugare kodukare tugimejera kori. Erorerure ii, kode, erorerumode tai jamedu. Eromode nono iwadaru reore ma, kode eromode nono tawadaru reore jamedu.
source: Tawia jetu imagore tai jiwu iwadaruji: Boe etugare kodukare tugimejera kori. Erorerure ii, kode, erorerumode tai jamedu. Eromode nono iwadaru reore ma, kode eromode nono tawadaru reore jamedu.

b: Mare eromode nowu inodu jamedu boeji ikie koia tai, mare paga karega, eerduwakare cewu ure irojaiwu jitu koia.
source: Mare eromode nowu inodu jamedu boeji ikie koia tai, mare paga karega, eerduwakare cewu ure irojaiwu jitu koia.

b: Mare itaregodumodukare, imagomodukare ma, ero pegamodukare rabodu. Mare oino ego okwacereu bokwa turo pegareuji.
source: Mare itaregodumodukare, imagomodukare ma, ero pegamodukare rabodu. Mare oino ego okwacereu bokwa turo pegareuji.

b: Cewu kodu kagirire iiwu, kodu kagirimode Iogaji jamedu.
source: Cewu kodu kagirire iiwu, kodu kagirimode Iogaji jamedu.

b: Iro kurireu umodukare etada, nono ia rokare nono iro reore, ma, ero pegamodukaradu. Macare eerdure iroji, mare ekodu kagirire ii, ekodu kagirire Iogaji.
source: Iro kurireu umodukare etada, nono ia rokare nono iro reore, ma, ero pegamodukaradu. Macare eerdure iroji, mare ekodu kagirire ii, ekodu kagirire Iogaji.

b:
Mare uwo nono bataru padui eno bapera kejedu reore: 
“Ekodu kagirire ii paga tu je”  (Sl 34,19; 68,5).
source:
Mare uwo nono bataru padui eno bapera kejedu reore: 
“Ekodu kagirire ii paga tu je”  (Sl 34,19; 68,5).

b: Cewu mako kigodure boe eparu kejewu, imode rojai Ioga ie tabowu, cewu ore boe rikireu Aroe Pemegareu, ure tudawuje Ioga pijidu, aregodumode du keje, jomode iwugeje.
source: Cewu mako kigodure boe eparu kejewu, imode rojai Ioga ie tabowu, cewu ore boe rikireu Aroe Pemegareu, ure tudawuje Ioga pijidu, aregodumode du keje, jomode iwugeje.

b: Tagi jamedu, taiomode iwugeje, mare paga karega, tagi taedure itabo jii boe paruto du koia.
source: Tagi jamedu, taiomode iwugeje, mare paga karega, tagi taedure itabo jii boe paruto du koia.

b: Boe etonai meartorure Jesus jiwugeidu. -
source: Boe etonai meartorure Jesus jiwugeidu. -

b: Inagore oino tai, tawo tabewudo tai, tawudu kawo boe pegareuto.
source: Inagore oino tai, tawo tabewudo tai, tawudu kawo boe pegareuto.

b: Tawarigudumode sinagogadoge epiji. Boe aregodumode pudae du keje cewu ure tawidowuge eiamedu boe emeardaemode tuie ure Pao kurido duji.
source: Tawarigudumode sinagogadoge epiji. Boe aregodumode pudae du keje cewu ure tawidowuge eiamedu boe emeardaemode tuie ure Pao kurido duji.

b: Eromode oino, mare paga karega, eerdukare Iogaji, eerdukare ii jamedu kodi.
source: Eromode oino, mare paga karega, eerdukare Iogaji, eerdukare ii jamedu kodi.

b:
Mare inagore oino tai awu iwadaruji, duma, boe aregodumode pudae du keje, tawia jetuwo inagoi tai marigudu duji. Mare ikare tawie nowu inoduji boe paruto, iragoje kimore tagabo kodi. 
Aroe Pemegareu maragodae.
source:
Mare inagore oino tai awu iwadaruji, duma, boe aregodumode pudae du keje, tawia jetuwo inagoi tai marigudu duji. Mare ikare tawie nowu inoduji boe paruto, iragoje kimore tagabo kodi. 
Aroe Pemegareu maragodae.

b: Icare itumode cewu ure irojaiwu ae, macare ia tagi ia tagi tanorakare ii: - Kaiba akodumode?
source: Icare itumode cewu ure irojaiwu ae, macare ia tagi ia tagi tanorakare ii: - Kaiba akodumode?

b: Mare awu inagoinodu ure tagiarigodaedo tumaedo tawabo tada.
source: Mare awu inagoinodu ure tagiarigodaedo tumaedo tawabo tada.

b: Mare du inodu tabo imagomode tai boe jokoduji: Pemegare tai ituwo tabiji, paga karega, itumodukare ma, cewu makomode tawugejewu aregodumodukare tagae. Mare itumode du keje, imode rojai tawogai.
source: Mare du inodu tabo imagomode tai boe jokoduji: Pemegare tai ituwo tabiji, paga karega, itumodukare ma, cewu makomode tawugejewu aregodumodukare tagae. Mare itumode du keje, imode rojai tawogai.

b: Aregodumode du kodiboe keje, awu moto umode boe pa boe ero pegareuji, boe jetororeuji, boei tugogado boeiboeji.
source: Aregodumode du kodiboe keje, awu moto umode boe pa boe ero pegareuji, boe jetororeuji, boei tugogado boeiboeji.

b: Umode awu motodo boe pa boe ero pegareuji, emeartorukare ii kodi.
source: Umode awu motodo boe pa boe ero pegareuji, emeartorukare ii kodi.

b: Umode udo boe pa boe jetotoreuji, mare paga karega, itumode Pao ae, du rekodajire icare taerdumode ii pugeje.
source: Umode udo boe pa boe jetotoreuji, mare paga karega, itumode Pao ae, du rekodajire icare taerdumode ii pugeje.

b: Umode udo boe pa boei tugogado boeiboeji, mare paga karega, boere tugogado awu moto kejeboe eimejeraji marigudu.
source: Umode udo boe pa boei tugogado boeiboeji, mare paga karega, boere tugogado awu moto kejeboe eimejeraji marigudu.

b: Imagomode ji taiboe makaguragare kimo, mare tugiwa rakamodukare ji oino.
source: Imagomode ji taiboe makaguragare kimo, mare tugiwa rakamodukare ji oino.

b: Mare makomode tawugejewu, cewu boe rikireu Aroe Pemegareu aregodumode du keje, umode taerduwado boe rikireu jamedu boeji, mare paga karega, taobiji karega makomode, mare makomode tumeardure jiboeji; umode tawie aregodumodeboeji jamedu.
source: Mare makomode tawugejewu, cewu boe rikireu Aroe Pemegareu aregodumode du keje, umode taerduwado boe rikireu jamedu boeji, mare paga karega, taobiji karega makomode, mare makomode tumeardure jiboeji; umode tawie aregodumodeboeji jamedu.

b: Ema umode ikurido, mare paga karega, inoe makudumode ai du kodi, umode tawie ji jamedu.
source: Ema umode ikurido, mare paga karega, inoe makudumode ai du kodi, umode tawie ji jamedu.

b:
Ure Ioga apoboe jamedu boe ino nure ema jamedu. Du kodire inagore tai: Inoe makudumode ai, umode kogado tawiegai jamedu.
Boe ekiarimode, mare boe eegaremode pugeje, Cristo koia.
source:
Ure Ioga apoboe jamedu boe ino nure ema jamedu. Du kodire inagore tai: Inoe makudumode ai, umode kogado tawiegai jamedu.
Boe ekiarimode, mare boe eegaremode pugeje, Cristo koia.

b: Biegatu kimo, teardumodukare ii, mare biegatu pugeje, taerdumode ii pugeje, mare paga karega, itumode Pao ae imuguwo apo kodi.
source: Biegatu kimo, teardumodukare ii, mare biegatu pugeje, taerdumode ii pugeje, mare paga karega, itumode Pao ae imuguwo apo kodi.

b: Nowu inodu koia, nowu ia ure jorduwadowuge enorare pui jice woje, jice woje, egore: - Kaboba jiba akore oino pai. Biegatu kimo taerdumodukare ii, biegatu kimo pugeje, du keje taerdumode ii pugeje? Inobadu jiba akomode oino: Itumode Pao ae?
source: Nowu inodu koia, nowu ia ure jorduwadowuge enorare pui jice woje, jice woje, egore: - Kaboba jiba akore oino pai. Biegatu kimo taerdumodukare ii, biegatu kimo pugeje, du keje taerdumode ii pugeje? Inobadu jiba akomode oino: Itumode Pao ae?

b: Du keje egore: - Inobadu jiba akore: Biegatu kimo? Paerduwakare kaboba jiba aidure tagoi oinono.
source: Du keje egore: - Inobadu jiba akore: Biegatu kimo? Paerduwakare kaboba jiba aidure tagoi oinono.

b: Jesus ure boe pa ei tunoragoduiagu iaboe bogai duji, du kodi icare akore: - Tanorare pui jice woje, jice woje, cewu imagore jiboeji, inagoi biegatu kimo, du keje teardumodukare ii pugeje, du ia biegatu pugeje du keje taerdumode ii pugeje duji.
source: Jesus ure boe pa ei tunoragoduiagu iaboe bogai duji, du kodi icare akore: - Tanorare pui jice woje, jice woje, cewu imagore jiboeji, inagoi biegatu kimo, du keje teardumodukare ii pugeje, du ia biegatu pugeje du keje taerdumode ii pugeje duji.

b: Boe jokodu jire imagomode oino tai: Tagi tagoragudumode, tamode maido, mare awu moto kejewu boe eegaremode. Tagiarigodumode, mare tagiarigodae umode taegareaedo pudumi.
source: Boe jokodu jire imagomode oino tai: Tagi tagoragudumode, tamode maido, mare awu moto kejewu boe eegaremode. Tagiarigodumode, mare tagiarigodae umode taegareaedo pudumi.

b: Aredu tui tuguri butuiagu du keje, kiarigodure, boe aregodure pudae ji du koia, mare tuguri butu rekodaji, bia puredukare cewu tugiarigodaeji pugeje, tuiegare koia, ia imedurogu buture kodi.
source: Aredu tui tuguri butuiagu du keje, kiarigodure, boe aregodure pudae ji du koia, mare tuguri butu rekodaji, bia puredukare cewu tugiarigodaeji pugeje, tuiegare koia, ia imedurogu buture kodi.

b: Du reorere tagi tagiarigodure oino jamedu, mare iordumode tai pugeje, nono tawabo jekaremode pugeje, iaboe iaboe emodukare taegareae barigu tabiji.
source: Du reorere tagi tagiarigodure oino jamedu, mare iordumode tai pugeje, nono tawabo jekaremode pugeje, iaboe iaboe emodukare taegareae barigu tabiji.

b:
Nowu meriji tanoramodukare ii iaboe iaboe bogai pugeje.
Boe enogwamaguduwo Jesus ie tabo. - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Tagogwamagudumode Paoji ikie tabo bogaiboe jamedu boe, umode maku tagai.
source:
Nowu meriji tanoramodukare ii iaboe iaboe bogai pugeje.
Boe enogwamaguduwo Jesus ie tabo. - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Tagogwamagudumode Paoji ikie tabo bogaiboe jamedu boe, umode maku tagai.

b: Jii oino tagogwamagudukare iaboe iaboe bogai ikie tabo roga. Tagogwamagududo du makudumode tagai, duma taegareae kororogoduwo.
source: Jii oino tagogwamagudukare iaboe iaboe bogai ikie tabo roga. Tagogwamagududo du makudumode tagai, duma taegareae kororogoduwo.

b: Ire iwadaru jeonado ia bakaruji du tabore inagore tai, mare boe aregodumode pudae ikai iwadaru jeonado jice woje, jice woje ia bakaru boeji tai, du umodukare pugeje, mare imago awadumode tai Pao jiboeji.
source: Ire iwadaru jeonado ia bakaruji du tabore inagore tai, mare boe aregodumode pudae ikai iwadaru jeonado jice woje, jice woje ia bakaru boeji tai, du umodukare pugeje, mare imago awadumode tai Pao jiboeji.

b: Nowu du kodiwu keje tagogwamagudumode ikie tabo du keje, inogwamagudukare Paoji tagai pugeje.
source: Nowu du kodiwu keje tagogwamagudumode ikie tabo du keje, inogwamagudukare Paoji tagai pugeje.

b: Mare paga karega, Pao meardu kuricigore tai, tameardu kuricigore ii, tameartorure itaregodui Pao piji kodi.
source: Mare paga karega, Pao meardu kuricigore tai, tameardu kuricigore ii, tameartorure itaregodui Pao piji kodi.

b:
Ire itawuje Pao piji ituwo mato moto kae. Ica, oinore icare imode moto pijido, ituwo Pao ae pugeje.
Jesus ure jorduwadowuge emeartorae.
source:
Ire itawuje Pao piji ituwo mato moto kae. Ica, oinore icare imode moto pijido, ituwo Pao ae pugeje.
Jesus ure jorduwadowuge emeartorae.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge emagore ji: Ica, oinore icare are awadaru awadudo rugadu, akarega ure awadaru jeonado iaboeji pugeje.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge emagore ji: Ica, oinore icare are awadaru awadudo rugadu, akarega ure awadaru jeonado iaboeji pugeje.

b: Ica, oinore icare cere boe pa aerduwai boe jamedu boe jituji, akogeamodukai iaboe iaboe enorawo ai pugeje duji. Nowu inodu koiare cemeartorure akaregodui Pao piji duji rugadu.
source: Ica, oinore icare cere boe pa aerduwai boe jamedu boe jituji, akogeamodukai iaboe iaboe enorawo ai pugeje duji. Nowu inodu koiare cemeartorure akaregodui Pao piji duji rugadu.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Oinore icare tameartorure?
source: Jesus akore ei: - Oinore icare tameartorure?

b: Ica, boe aregodumode, boe aregodure marigudu, du kejere tamode tagaodo tagogwacemodewo jaogwai, tamode ipijido, tamode ido mito tu je. Mare ikare mito tu je. Ioga mugure itabo.
source: Ica, boe aregodumode, boe aregodure marigudu, du kejere tamode tagaodo tagogwacemodewo jaogwai, tamode ipijido, tamode ido mito tu je. Mare ikare mito tu je. Ioga mugure itabo.

b: Inagore awu inoduji tai, duma boe pemegareuwo, boe butugureuwo tai igoia. Awu moto keje taiwomode. Mare tabewudo tai. Imire ire imorido awu motoji.
source: Inagore awu inoduji tai, duma boe pemegareuwo, boe butugureuwo tai igoia. Awu moto keje taiwomode. Mare tabewudo tai. Imire ire imorido awu motoji.

b: Jesus makoi tubaru tabodu.
source: Jesus makoi tubaru tabodu.

b: Jesus ure tuioku awogado baruto, du tabore akore: - Ioga, icare boe aregodure pudae; akonaregedu kurido, duma, akonaregedu uwo akurido jamedu.
source: Jesus ure tuioku awogado baruto, du tabore akore: - Ioga, icare boe aregodure pudae; akonaregedu kurido, duma, akonaregedu uwo akurido jamedu.

b: Are ro rakareu makai, are boe jamedu maku iera kai, uwo jere jii jeboe maku cewu are maku aiwuge eiamedu boe etai.
source: Are ro rakareu makai, are boe jamedu maku iera kai, uwo jere jii jeboe maku cewu are maku aiwuge eiamedu boe etai.

b: Mare jere jii jeboe reo: Boe eerduwawo ai ure mitotu jewu boe jokoduwu Aroe Eimejeraji, mare boe eerduwawo are rojaiwu Jesus Cristoji jamedu.
source: Mare jere jii jeboe reo: Boe eerduwawo ai ure mitotu jewu boe jokoduwu Aroe Eimejeraji, mare boe eerduwawo are rojaiwu Jesus Cristoji jamedu.

b: Ire akurido awu moto keje. Ire are iroiagudu jiwu imaragodae iado.
source: Ire akurido awu moto keje. Ire are iroiagudu jiwu imaragodae iado.

b: Kodi icare, oino, Ioga, ikurido akabo, amagai ikurido akabo moto todudumodedu otodai.
source: Kodi icare, oino, Ioga, ikurido akabo, amagai ikurido akabo moto todudumodedu otodai.

b: Imagore akieji are maku inaiwu moto kejewu ime ewiegai, akogere emage du are emagu inai, duwuge erore nono awadaru rekodaji.
source: Imagore akieji are maku inaiwu moto kejewu ime ewiegai, akogere emage du are emagu inai, duwuge erore nono awadaru rekodaji.

b: Icare oino ere boe pa are maku inaiboe jamedu boe apijie aregodure duji.
source: Icare oino ere boe pa are maku inaiboe jamedu boe apijie aregodure duji.

b: Mare paga karega, ara maku inaiwu awadaru ire maku etai, ere tugeragu ji, ere boe pa boe jokoduie ure apijie itawujedure, emeartorure ai irojai duji.
source: Mare paga karega, ara maku inaiwu awadaru ire maku etai, ere tugeragu ji, ere boe pa boe jokoduie ure apijie itawujedure, emeartorure ai irojai duji.

b: Nowuge etaire inogwamagudure ai. Inogwamagudukare moto paru tabo, mare cewu are maku inaiwuge eparu tabo inogwamagudure ai, akogere emage kodi.
source: Nowuge etaire inogwamagudure ai. Inogwamagudukare moto paru tabo, mare cewu are maku inaiwuge eparu tabo inogwamagudure ai, akogere emage kodi.

b: Inore emaboe jamedu boe akore ema jamedu, akore emaboe jamedu boe inore ema. Eigoiare itagaru kuridodure.
source: Inore emaboe jamedu boe akore ema jamedu, akore emaboe jamedu boe inore ema. Eigoiare itagaru kuridodure.

b: Iragojemodukare moto keje pugeje, emagerema eragojemode moto keje. Imire itumode akae. Ioga pemegareu, eedu otorogado akie tabo, cewu are maku inaiwu akie tabo, ewo mitogodu tu pureore.
source: Iragojemodukare moto keje pugeje, emagerema eragojemode moto keje. Imire itumode akae. Ioga pemegareu, eedu otorogado akie tabo, cewu are maku inaiwu akie tabo, ewo mitogodu tu pureore.

b: Iragoje kimoi ebo du tabo, ieture ei cewu are maku inaiwu akie tabo. Ieture cewu are maku inaiwugei ia emage ewogwakare, mare tu cewu ure tuwarigu pegareboeto tu rugadu, uwo nono bapera atugo reore.
source: Iragoje kimoi ebo du tabo, ieture ei cewu are maku inaiwu akie tabo. Ieture cewu are maku inaiwugei ia emage ewogwakare, mare tu cewu ure tuwarigu pegareboeto tu rugadu, uwo nono bapera atugo reore.

b: Mare oino itumode akae. Ire awu inogwamagudae towuje iragojei moto keje du tonaji, duma iegareae jamedu boe metuwo ebo.
source: Mare oino itumode akae. Ire awu inogwamagudae towuje iragojei moto keje du tonaji, duma iegareae jamedu boe metuwo ebo.

b: Ire awadaru maku etai, mare moto kodu kagirire ei, mare paga karega, moto kejewugekare emage kodi, imagai moto kejewukare imidu reore.
source: Ire awadaru maku etai, mare moto kodu kagirire ei, mare paga karega, moto kejewugekare emage kodi, imagai moto kejewukare imidu reore.

b: Inogwamagudukare ai awo etawuje moto piji, mare awo einorudo boe pegareu piji.
source: Inogwamagudukare ai awo etawuje moto piji, mare awo einorudo boe pegareu piji.

b: Moto kejewugekare emaga imagai moto kejewukare imi jamedu.
source: Moto kejewugekare emaga imagai moto kejewukare imi jamedu.

b: Boe pemegareugedo emage boe rikireu tabo; awadarure boe rikireu rema.
source: Boe pemegareugedo emage boe rikireu tabo; awadarure boe rikireu rema.

b: Amagai irojai moto kae du reorere imode erojai moto kae jamedu.
source: Amagai irojai moto kae du reorere imode erojai moto kae jamedu.

b: Imire ipemegado etai, duma ewo tubemegado boe rikireu tabo jamedu.
source: Imire ipemegado etai, duma ewo tubemegado boe rikireu tabo jamedu.

b: Inogwamagudukare tu etai rugadu, mare inogwamagudure cewu meartorumode ii ewadaru koiawuge etai jamedu.
source: Inogwamagudukare tu etai rugadu, mare inogwamagudure cewu meartorumode ii ewadaru koiawuge etai jamedu.

b: Duma eiamedu boewo mito tu je. Ioga, amedu magai itada, imedu magai atada du reorere emeduwo padoda jamedu, du tabowo moto meartorure aigoiaie are irojai duji.
source: Duma eiamedu boewo mito tu je. Ioga, amedu magai itada, imedu magai atada du reorere emeduwo padoda jamedu, du tabowo moto meartorure aigoiaie are irojai duji.

b: Are irugu kurireu maku inaidu, ire maku etai jamedu, duma ewo mitotu, pamagai mito tu je du reore.
source: Are irugu kurireu maku inaidu, ire maku etai jamedu, duma ewo mitotu, pamagai mito tu je du reore.

b: Imi etada, aki itada, duma ewo turugadu tui mito tu je du tabo, duma moto meartoruwo akie are irojai duji, ameardu kurie ei ameardu kuri magai ii du reore duji.
source: Imi etada, aki itada, duma ewo turugadu tui mito tu je du tabo, duma moto meartoruwo akie are irojai duji, ameardu kurie ei ameardu kuri magai ii du reore duji.

b: Ioga, itaidure cewu are maku inaiwuge eeduwo itabo iragojerewo keje, duma eerduwo are maku inaiwu irugu kurireuji, mare paga karega, ameardu kurire ii moto towujedumodedu otodai.
source: Ioga, itaidure cewu are maku inaiwuge eeduwo itabo iragojerewo keje, duma eerduwo are maku inaiwu irugu kurireuji, mare paga karega, ameardu kurire ii moto towujedumodedu otodai.

b: Ioga pemegareu, awu moto kejeboe eerduwakare ai, mare imi iorduware ai, awuge jamedu eerduware akie are irojai duji.
source: Ioga pemegareu, awu moto kejeboe eerduwakare ai, mare imi iorduware ai, awuge jamedu eerduware akie are irojai duji.

b: Ire eerduwado akieji, imode eerduwado kimo pugeje, duma ameardu kurii iidu metuwo ebo, imuguwo etada jamedu.
source: Ire eerduwado akieji, imode eerduwado kimo pugeje, duma ameardu kurii iidu metuwo ebo, imuguwo etada jamedu.

b: Boei tugeragu Jesus jitu.
source: Boei tugeragu Jesus jitu.

b: Nowu tuwadaru rekodaji, Jesus uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo ia paga kurireu iere Cedron cedu okwa bakowu kae, ia okureboe pa jeturewo kae, du tore ure turemo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.
source: Nowu tuwadaru rekodaji, Jesus uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo ia paga kurireu iere Cedron cedu okwa bakowu kae, ia okureboe pa jeturewo kae, du tore ure turemo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.

b: Judas, cewu umode makuwu, jorduware nowu boe eedaji, Jesus utu kigodure toro nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo kodi,
source: Judas, cewu umode makuwu, jorduware nowu boe eedaji, Jesus utu kigodure toro nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo kodi,

b: Icare Judas ure tugeragu sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare fariseudoge eno tarigaraidogei, ure eko pudabo, etaregodure nono joru tabo, baigadoge ebo.
source: Icare Judas ure tugeragu sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare fariseudoge eno tarigaraidogei, ure eko pudabo, etaregodure nono joru tabo, baigadoge ebo.

b: Icare Jesus tuiorduwai inoba boemode puduidu jamedu boe jitu du kodi ure tuwure taru etogi, icare unorare ei, akore: Ioguduba bogaiba taroino?
source: Icare Jesus tuiorduwai inoba boemode puduidu jamedu boe jitu du kodi ure tuwure taru etogi, icare unorare ei, akore: Ioguduba bogaiba taroino?

b: Egore: - Jesus Nazaré kejewu bogaire ceroino. Akore ei: -Imireo  (Judas, ure makuwu, rakojere ebo jamedu).
source: Egore: - Jesus Nazaré kejewu bogaire ceroino. Akore ei: -Imireo  (Judas, ure makuwu, rakojere ebo jamedu).

b: Akore: -Imireo, ino du keje kuri je, ere tuwure taru tugujebiji, tuwudui moto keje du tabo.
source: Akore: -Imireo, ino du keje kuri je, ere tuwure taru tugujebiji, tuwudui moto keje du tabo.

b: Icare unoragodure ei pugeje: - Ioguduba bogaiba taroino?  Egore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu bogaire ceroino
source: Icare unoragodure ei pugeje: - Ioguduba bogaiba taroino?  Egore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu bogaire ceroino

b: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Inagore: imireo, oinore inagore tai. Kode iwogaire taroino du keje, awuge etudo.
source: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Inagore: imireo, oinore inagore tai. Kode iwogaire taroino du keje, awuge etudo.

b: Nowu inodu tabo ure nono bataru reore: “Cewu are maku inaiwuge ia ewogwakare ipiji” (Is 17,12).
source: Nowu inodu tabo ure nono bataru reore: “Cewu are maku inaiwuge ia ewogwakare ipiji” (Is 17,12).

b: Simão Pedro ia toriga raireu mugure apo, du ure tawuje tuia piji, ure sacerdotedoge eimejera ia utugare okorido, tui okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwaiwu bia kado du tabo (Nowu utugare iere Malco).
source: Simão Pedro ia toriga raireu mugure apo, du ure tawuje tuia piji, ure sacerdotedoge eimejera ia utugare okorido, tui okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwaiwu bia kado du tabo (Nowu utugare iere Malco).

b:
Mare Jesus akore Pedroji: - Atoriga tugu tuiato! Ikudumodukare Iogare maku inaiwu jirireboece? 
Jesus rakojei baire eimejerage eegoraidu.
source:
Mare Jesus akore Pedroji: - Atoriga tugu tuiato! Ikudumodukare Iogare maku inaiwu jirireboece? 
Jesus rakojei baire eimejerage eegoraidu.

b: Kodi icare utorigaraidoge ere tugeragu Jesusji, ere kogudo.
source: Kodi icare utorigaraidoge ere tugeragu Jesusji, ere kogudo.

b: Ere reko boetoji Anás ae, cewu Caifás uiedoga, duwure baire eimejera rema nowu joruji.
source: Ere reko boetoji Anás ae, cewu Caifás uiedoga, duwure baire eimejera rema nowu joruji.

b: Cewu okituware judeudogei tagoi oino du tabo: - “Ema remawure mitotu jewu biwo boe etai du rema” (Io 11,50).
source: Cewu okituware judeudogei tagoi oino du tabo: - “Ema remawure mitotu jewu biwo boe etai du rema” (Io 11,50).

b: Simão Pedro kodure Jesus apo ia ure jorduwadowu mitotu jedu apo. Nowu ure jorduwadowu ui mito tu jedu sacerdotedoge eimejera jorduware ji, dure ure turemo Jesus apo nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera uwai tadawu uwororo kae.
source: Simão Pedro kodure Jesus apo ia ure jorduwadowu mitotu jedu apo. Nowu ure jorduwadowu ui mito tu jedu sacerdotedoge eimejera jorduware ji, dure ure turemo Jesus apo nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera uwai tadawu uwororo kae.

b: Pedro rema mugure baiporo keje baawadu jaogwai, mare cewu sacerdotedoge eimejera jorduware jiwu makore jeture baiporo jiwudoji, duwudo ure udo turemo.
source: Pedro rema mugure baiporo keje baawadu jaogwai, mare cewu sacerdotedoge eimejera jorduware jiwu makore jeture baiporo jiwudoji, duwudo ure udo turemo.

b: Nowu jeture baiporo jiwudo unoragodure Pedroji, akore: - Awu imedu ure jorduwadowuge ia karega ure aki?  Akore: -Boro! Imi karega.
source: Nowu jeture baiporo jiwudo unoragodure Pedroji, akore: - Awu imedu ure jorduwadowuge ia karega ure aki?  Akore: -Boro! Imi karega.

b: Nowu maragodure nonowuge, nowu jeture boeji nonowuge ere jorugo tuwo towarudo, biaku barikare kodi. Pedro rakojere ebo tui towarudo du tabo.
source: Nowu maragodure nonowuge, nowu jeture boeji nonowuge ere jorugo tuwo towarudo, biaku barikare kodi. Pedro rakojere ebo tui towarudo du tabo.

b: Nowu baire eimejera unoragodure Jesusji nowu ure jorduwadowuge eiboeji, ure boe eerduwado jiboeji jamedu.
source: Nowu baire eimejera unoragodure Jesusji nowu ure jorduwadowuge eiboeji, ure boe eerduwado jiboeji jamedu.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imagore imago awadu tabo motoji, ire boe eerduwadodu maedo sinagoga tada, Pao uwai tada, cewu judeudoge ere tudo puiwo keje; podu karega imago imagore ei.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Imagore imago awadu tabo motoji, ire boe eerduwadodu maedo sinagoga tada, Pao uwai tada, cewu judeudoge ere tudo puiwo keje; podu karega imago imagore ei.

b: Kodiba anorare ii? Anorado cewu meardure imagoi puduiwugei. Nowuge eerduware kaboba jiba ire tuiorduwado.
source: Kodiba anorare ii? Anorado cewu meardure imagoi puduiwugei. Nowuge eerduware kaboba jiba ire tuiorduwado.

b: Awu bataru keje, ia jeture boeji nonowu, ure tugera to Jesus jeji, akore: - Kodiba akagoino awu baire eimejeraji?
source: Awu bataru keje, ia jeture boeji nonowu, ure tugera to Jesus jeji, akore: - Kodiba akagoino awu baire eimejeraji?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Iwadaru pegare du keje, iwadaru pegare jiboe kuo, mare imago pemega nure du keje, kodiba are akera to ii?
source: Jesus akore ji: - Iwadaru pegare du keje, iwadaru pegare jiboe kuo, mare imago pemega nure du keje, kodiba are akera to ii?

b: Icare Anás ure edo reko toro baire eimejera Caifás ae, iera kogu tabo.
source: Icare Anás ure edo reko toro baire eimejera Caifás ae, iera kogu tabo.

b: Simão Pedro mugure nono tui towarudo du tabo. Icare enoragodure ji: - Iarema aki cewu ure jorduwadowuge ia kana ure aki?  Icare ure tuiorduwa bokwado ji, akore: - Boro! Imi karega!
source: Simão Pedro mugure nono tui towarudo du tabo. Icare enoragodure ji: - Iarema aki cewu ure jorduwadowuge ia kana ure aki?  Icare ure tuiorduwa bokwado ji, akore: - Boro! Imi karega!

b: Icare baire eimejera ia utugare, cewu Pedrore bia kadowu ia uwobe, akore ji: - Iordukare ai apo cewu okureboe pa tada?
source: Icare baire eimejera ia utugare, cewu Pedrore bia kadowu ia uwobe, akore ji: - Iordukare ai apo cewu okureboe pa tada?

b:
Mare Pedrore tuiorduwa bokwado ji pugeje. Ca, kuri je kogoriga akogodure.
Jesus rakojei Pilato jokoraidu.
source:
Mare Pedrore tuiorduwa bokwado ji pugeje. Ca, kuri je kogoriga akogodure.
Jesus rakojei Pilato jokoraidu.

b: Ere Jesus reko nowu Caifás uwai piji brae eimejera uwai kae, meri rutu tabo. Mare judeudoge ekare turemo nowu brae eimejera uwaito, turorogodu kawo, duma tuwo Páscoa kowuje.
source: Ere Jesus reko nowu Caifás uwai piji brae eimejera uwai kae, meri rutu tabo. Mare judeudoge ekare turemo nowu brae eimejera uwaito, turorogodu kawo, duma tuwo Páscoa kowuje.

b: Kodi icare Pilatos ure tuiebu etae, unoragodure ei: - Kakoduwu ia ro pegareu koiaba tare awu imedu arego woe?
source: Kodi icare Pilatos ure tuiebu etae, unoragodure ei: - Kakoduwu ia ro pegareu koiaba tare awu imedu arego woe?

b: Egore ji: - Awu ro pegareu umodukare ma, cemodukare maku akai.
source: Egore ji: - Awu ro pegareu umodukare ma, cemodukare maku akai.

b: Du koiare icare Pilato akore: - Emareo, tagire tare tagogado ji nono taroia reore. Icare judeudoge egore: - Cegi, ukare turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewido.
source: Du koiare icare Pilato akore: - Emareo, tagire tare tagogado ji nono taroia reore. Icare judeudoge egore: - Cegi, ukare turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewido.

b: Awu inodu tabore ure nono Jesus bataru reore tagoi inobadu taboba tuwimode duji (Mt 20,19).
source: Awu inodu tabore ure nono Jesus bataru reore tagoi inobadu taboba tuwimode duji (Mt 20,19).

b: Pilatore turemo tuwaito, makore Jesus bogai, unoragodure ji: - Akina judeudoge eimejerare aki?
source: Pilatore turemo tuwaito, makore Jesus bogai, unoragodure ji: - Akina judeudoge eimejerare aki?

b: Jesus akore: - Akaobijina akagoino, iarema iage kana egoino awiegai?  Pilato akore: -
source: Jesus akore: - Akaobijina akagoino, iarema iage kana egoino awiegai?  Pilato akore: -

b: Kode, judeu nure imi? Ako moto kejewu baire eimejerage ere amagu inai. Inoba arore?
source: Kode, judeu nure imi? Ako moto kejewu baire eimejerage ere amagu inai. Inoba arore?

b: Jesus akore: - Boe eimejerai imidu, awu moto kejeboe karega. Boe eimejerai imidu umode awu moto keje ma, boe jokodure itugarege emode tubewudo iwugeje imagudu kawo judeudoge etai. Mare boe eiemejerai imidu woeboe karega.
source: Jesus akore: - Boe eimejerai imidu, awu moto kejeboe karega. Boe eimejerai imidu umode awu moto keje ma, boe jokodure itugarege emode tubewudo iwugeje imagudu kawo judeudoge etai. Mare boe eiemejerai imidu woeboe karega.

b: Kodi icare Pilato unoragodure ji: - Kode, akina boe eimejare aki?  Jesus akore: - U! Imire boe eimejerare imi. Imagowo boe rikireuji du bogaire iwudure, itaregodure awu moto kae. Boe rikireu mugure apowuge eiamedu boe emeardumode imagore jiboeji.
source: Kodi icare Pilato unoragodure ji: - Kode, akina boe eimejare aki?  Jesus akore: - U! Imire boe eimejerare imi. Imagowo boe rikireuji du bogaire iwudure, itaregodure awu moto kae. Boe rikireu mugure apowuge eiamedu boe emeardumode imagore jiboeji.

b: Icare Pilato akore ji: - Kaboba boe rikireu rema? Tagoi oino du tabo, ure tuiebu pugeje, uture judeudoge etae, akore ei: - Iordukare ia ro pegareu boeji.
source: Icare Pilato akore ji: - Kaboba boe rikireu rema? Tagoi oino du tabo, ure tuiebu pugeje, uture judeudoge etae, akore ei: - Iordukare ia ro pegareu boeji.

b: Mare taroiare Páscoa keje tare ido ia meture baicoreu tadawu ro pegareu tawuje du rema. Kode tagaidure iwo judeudoge eimejera inorudo?
source: Mare taroiare Páscoa keje tare ido ia meture baicoreu tadawu ro pegareu tawuje du rema. Kode tagaidure iwo judeudoge eimejera inorudo?

b: Du keje icare eiamedu boe enoiogwarire pugeje, tagoi: - Boro! Awu karega, Mare Barrabás!  (Barrabasre ia iwogu kigodureu, boe ewidowu epa rema).
source: Du keje icare eiamedu boe enoiogwarire pugeje, tagoi: - Boro! Awu karega, Mare Barrabás!  (Barrabasre ia iwogu kigodureu, boe ewidowu epa rema).

b: Jesus bitodu rumode.
source: Jesus bitodu rumode.

b: Kodi icare Pilatore boe edo boe to Jesus biri kajeje.
source: Kodi icare Pilatore boe edo boe to Jesus biri kajeje.

b: Utorigaraidogere ia boto jerigigareu udo nono boe etaogajejewu reoredu ere tugu aoto, ere aroia kujagureu tugu ji.
source: Utorigaraidogere ia boto jerigigareu udo nono boe etaogajejewu reoredu ere tugu aoto, ere aroia kujagureu tugu ji.

b: Ere tuburedo ji, egore ji: - Akireo! Judeudoge eimejera!  Oino tui tugera to to jeji du tabo.
source: Ere tuburedo ji, egore ji: - Akireo! Judeudoge eimejera!  Oino tui tugera to to jeji du tabo.

b: Icare Pilatore tuiebu pugeje, akore judeudogei: - Ica, imode arego woe baawadu kae tagai, duma taerduwo iordukai ia ro pegareu boe jituji.
source: Icare Pilatore tuiebu pugeje, akore judeudogei: - Ica, imode arego woe baawadu kae tagai, duma taerduwo iordukai ia ro pegareu boe jituji.

b: Du keje icare Jesus ure tuiebu boto jerigigareu kogui taogajeje du tabo. Icare Pilato akore: - Cewu imedu reo.
source: Du keje icare Jesus ure tuiebu boto jerigigareu kogui taogajeje du tabo. Icare Pilato akore: - Cewu imedu reo.

b: Icare baire eimejerage mare utorigaraidoge, tuiordui jitu keje, enoiogwarigodure, egore: - Nowu bu i padui pugajejedu keje, nowu bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Icare Pilato akore ei: - Tagi tageragu ji, bu i padui pugajejedu keje, iordukare ia ro pegareu jitu kodi.
source: Icare baire eimejerage mare utorigaraidoge, tuiordui jitu keje, enoiogwarigodure, egore: - Nowu bu i padui pugajejedu keje, nowu bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Icare Pilato akore ei: - Tagi tageragu ji, bu i padui pugajejedu keje, iordukare ia ro pegareu jitu kodi.

b: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Ia ceroiare du koiare awu bitodu rumode, mare paga karega akore Aroe Eimejera Onaregeduie ure pudumi du kodi.
source: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Ia ceroiare du koiare awu bitodu rumode, mare paga karega akore Aroe Eimejera Onaregeduie ure pudumi du kodi.

b: Kodi icare nowu egoinodu ure Pilato pagudugo.
source: Kodi icare nowu egoinodu ure Pilato pagudugo.

b: Ure turemo pugeje nowu brae eimejera tumuga kae, unoragodure Jesusji, akore ji: - Kaibawuba ure aki?  Mare Jesus makokare ji.
source: Ure turemo pugeje nowu brae eimejera tumuga kae, unoragodure Jesusji, akore ji: - Kaibawuba ure aki?  Mare Jesus makokare ji.

b: Kodi icare Pilato akore ji: - Amagomodukare ii? Aerduwakare ie irugadu iwo akinorudo iarema iwo aporu bu i padui pugajejedu keje?
source: Kodi icare Pilato akore ji: - Amagomodukare ii? Aerduwakare ie irugadu iwo akinorudo iarema iwo aporu bu i padui pugajejedu keje?

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Aro rakareu umodukare ii, makudukai akai baru piji du keje. Kodire ure imagu akaiwu ro pega kodure aro pega kori.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Aro rakareu umodukare ii, makudukai akai baru piji du keje. Kodire ure imagu akaiwu ro pega kodure aro pega kori.

b: Nowu otobijire icare Pilato jemarure tuwo inorudo. Mare judeudoge enoiogwarire tagoi oino du tabo: - Amode inorudo ma, kode brae eimejera kurireu César metuia karega ure aki, mare paga karega, cewu ure boe eimejerado pudumiwu ona nure Cesarji.
source: Nowu otobijire icare Pilato jemarure tuwo inorudo. Mare judeudoge enoiogwarire tagoi oino du tabo: - Amode inorudo ma, kode brae eimejera kurireu César metuia karega ure aki, mare paga karega, cewu ure boe eimejerado pudumiwu ona nure Cesarji.

b: Tumeardui nowu egoinodu jitu keje, Pilatore tuiebu Jesus apo, ure tumugudo brae eiemejera muga keje; nowu muga iere Pariri (hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Gabata).
source: Tumeardui nowu egoinodu jitu keje, Pilatore tuiebu Jesus apo, ure tumugudo brae eiemejera muga keje; nowu muga iere Pariri (hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Gabata).

b: Nowu meriji ere tugera pemegado boeji Páscoa kae. Meri jeture baru oiadoda. Icare Pilato akore judeudogei: - Ca, tagimejera reo!
source: Nowu meriji ere tugera pemegado boeji Páscoa kae. Meri jeture baru oiadoda. Icare Pilato akore judeudogei: - Ca, tagimejera reo!

b: Mare ere iogwarido, egore: - Toro apo! Toro apo! Bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Icare Pilato unorare ei: - Imode tagimejera bu i padui pugajejedu keje?  Icare baire eiemejerage egore: - Ia cegimejerakare ia toro pugeje, mare César tu rugadu.
source: Mare ere iogwarido, egore: - Toro apo! Toro apo! Bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Icare Pilato unorare ei: - Imode tagimejera bu i padui pugajejedu keje?  Icare baire eiemejerage egore: - Ia cegimejerakare ia toro pugeje, mare César tu rugadu.

b:
Du keje icare Pilato ure maku etai, ewo bu i padui pugajedu keje rugadu.
Ere Jesus bu i padui pugajejedu keje.
source:
Du keje icare Pilato ure maku etai, ewo bu i padui pugajedu keje rugadu.
Ere Jesus bu i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Du keje icare ere Jesus reko pudabo. Ema taobijire ure i padui pugajejedu reko bakurireu piji jice ia iere Calvário ceboe kae (Hebreudoge ewadaru iere Gólgota, boe ewadaru tabo ure oino: Boe era jeta).
source: Du keje icare ere Jesus reko pudabo. Ema taobijire ure i padui pugajejedu reko bakurireu piji jice ia iere Calvário ceboe kae (Hebreudoge ewadaru iere Gólgota, boe ewadaru tabo ure oino: Boe era jeta).

b: Nonore ere bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Iagere pobe apo: Ia okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwai, ia okwacere kana koboreu jaogwai, Jesusre rakojere boiadoda.
source: Nonore ere bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Iagere pobe apo: Ia okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwai, ia okwacere kana koboreu jaogwai, Jesusre rakojere boiadoda.

b: Pilatore ia bapera atugo pemegado du ure bu aora bukajeje, nowu i padui pugajejedu keje, du akore oino: - Jesus Nazaré kejewu, Judeudoge Eimejera.
source: Pilatore ia bapera atugo pemegado du ure bu aora bukajeje, nowu i padui pugajejedu keje, du akore oino: - Jesus Nazaré kejewu, Judeudoge Eimejera.

b: Makareu judeudoge emagore nowu atugoji, paga karega, Jesus padure i padui pugajejedu keje puredu tu bakurireuji.
source: Makareu judeudoge emagore nowu atugoji, paga karega, Jesus padure i padui pugajejedu keje puredu tu bakurireuji.

b: Icare judeudoge eno baire eimejerage egore Pilatoji: - Akaba atugodo Judeudoge Eimejera oino, mare Awu imedu akore judeudoge eimejeraie ure pudumi oino.
source: Icare judeudoge eno baire eimejerage egore Pilatoji: - Akaba atugodo Judeudoge Eimejera oino, mare Awu imedu akore judeudoge eimejeraie ure pudumi oino.

b: Mare Pilato akore ei: - Ire atugodoboe, atugododure.
source: Mare Pilato akore ei: - Ire atugodoboe, atugododure.

b: Utorigaraidoge ere Jesus bu i padui pugajejedu keje, icare ere tugeragu ukudaeji ere kado pobe puibiji, megawo mito tu tu pudai. Mare nowu ukudae kujiagiwu maegodu nure, kamidukare.
source: Utorigaraidoge ere Jesus bu i padui pugajejedu keje, icare ere tugeragu ukudaeji ere kado pobe puibiji, megawo mito tu tu pudai. Mare nowu ukudae kujiagiwu maegodu nure, kamidukare.

b:
Du kodi icare egore pui: - Pamodukare bowuje, mare pamode pageragudu caido tabo, paerduwo ioguduba onagodumode jiwu bogai. Awu inodu tabore ure nono bapera atugo reore: “Ere ikudae pedo pui, ikudae kujiagiwure ere tugeragu caireboedo tabo.“  (Sl 21,19). Oinore utorigaraidoge erore.























Jesus uce.
source:
Du kodi icare egore pui: - Pamodukare bowuje, mare pamode pageragudu caido tabo, paerduwo ioguduba onagodumode jiwu bogai. Awu inodu tabore ure nono bapera atugo reore: “Ere ikudae pedo pui, ikudae kujiagiwure ere tugeragu caireboedo tabo.“  (Sl 21,19). Oinore utorigaraidoge erore.























Jesus uce.

b: Puredu tu Jesus o i padui pugajeje duji, uce rakojere, uce uwie iei Maria cedu, cewu Cleofas oreduje, rakojere nono jamedu, Maria Madalena apo.
source: Puredu tu Jesus o i padui pugajeje duji, uce rakojere, uce uwie iei Maria cedu, cewu Cleofas oreduje, rakojere nono jamedu, Maria Madalena apo.

b: Icare Jesus, tuiordui tuje jitu keje, cewu meardu kurire jiwu ture jorduwadowu rakojei nono duji jamedu du keje, akore tujeji: - Aredu, akonaregedu reo.
source: Icare Jesus, tuiordui tuje jitu keje, cewu meardu kurire jiwu ture jorduwadowu rakojei nono duji jamedu du keje, akore tujeji: - Aredu, akonaregedu reo.

b:
Du kejere akore nowu ture jorduwadowuji: - Ica, Ace reo. Nowu inodu otobiji nowu ure jorduwadowu ure uce reko pudabo tuwai kae.

Jesus biredu.
source:
Du kejere akore nowu ture jorduwadowuji: - Ica, Ace reo. Nowu inodu otobiji nowu ure jorduwadowu ure uce reko pudabo tuwai kae.

Jesus biredu.

b: Icare Jesus, tuiorduwai boe jamedu boe ui turugadu du keje, uwo nono bapera atugo jamedu reore, akore: - Pobo boire ii.
source: Icare Jesus, tuiorduwai boe jamedu boe ui turugadu du keje, uwo nono bapera atugo jamedu reore, akore: - Pobo boire ii.

b: Ia ruwobo mugure nono, pobo pagodureu tabo, icare utorigaraidogere boe otogugudu tugu nowu pobo pagodureuto, ere boe otogugudu bu ia ipo oto keje, ere raido okwa kae.
source: Ia ruwobo mugure nono, pobo pagodureu tabo, icare utorigaraidogere boe otogugudu tugu nowu pobo pagodureuto, ere boe otogugudu bu ia ipo oto keje, ere raido okwa kae.

b:
Jesus tugudui nowu pobo pagodureuce du keje akore: - Icare boe jamedu boere turugadu. Icare ure tuie jodo, icare akurure.
Ia utorigaraireu ure Jesus mo porodo meriri otoboareu tabo.
source:
Jesus tugudui nowu pobo pagodureuce du keje akore: - Icare boe jamedu boere turugadu. Icare ure tuie jodo, icare akurure.
Ia utorigaraireu ure Jesus mo porodo meriri otoboareu tabo.

b: Judeudoge epagudure, eedumode nowu i padui pugajejedu keje Sábado meri jituji, paga karega, enure tugera pamegado petaji, du kodire cewu sabadore jiwu meri motu rakaguragamode. Kodi icare enogwamagudure Pilatoji, uwo edo epogora ra kado, ewo erodo oino nowu piji.
source: Judeudoge epagudure, eedumode nowu i padui pugajejedu keje Sábado meri jituji, paga karega, enure tugera pamegado petaji, du kodire cewu sabadore jiwu meri motu rakaguragamode. Kodi icare enogwamagudure Pilatoji, uwo edo epogora ra kado, ewo erodo oino nowu piji.

b: Utorigaraidoge etaregodure, ere cewuge ei pobedu epadure i keje apodu, ere epogora kado.
source: Utorigaraidoge etaregodure, ere cewuge ei pobedu epadure i keje apodu, ere epogora kado.

b: Mare etaregodui Jesus ae du keje, eerdure bie marigudu duji, du kodire ekare pogora ra kado.
source: Mare etaregodui Jesus ae du keje, eerdure bie marigudu duji, du kodire ekare pogora ra kado.

b: Mare ia utorigaraireu ure ia meriri otoboareu bu jura otogajeje uwabo kae. Kuri je kure ceredo pobo tabo.
source: Mare ia utorigaraireu ure ia meriri otoboareu bu jura otogajeje uwabo kae. Kuri je kure ceredo pobo tabo.

b: Jordure awu inodu jiwu ureadodure awu inoduji tameartoruwo. Ceerduware makoi boe riki jituji.
source: Jordure awu inodu jiwu ureadodure awu inoduji tameartoruwo. Ceerduware makoi boe riki jituji.

b: Awu inodu ure nono bapera atugo reore: “Ia ra boe kadodumodukare”.
source: Awu inodu ure nono bapera atugo reore: “Ia ra boe kadodumodukare”.

b: Nowu bapera atugo akore ia toro jamedu: “Boe etaiwomode cewu meriri otoboareu padure kajejewuji”. (Zac 12,10).
source: Nowu bapera atugo akore ia toro jamedu: “Boe etaiwomode cewu meriri otoboareu padure kajejewuji”. (Zac 12,10).

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji, José Arimatéia kejewu, ia Jesusre jorduwadowu, mare podu tabo tubagudu koia judeudogece, okwamagudure Pilatoji uwo boedo Jesus rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji. Icare Pilatore udo ino rugadu. Icare uture, ure Jesus rawuje i piji.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji, José Arimatéia kejewu, ia Jesusre jorduwadowu, mare podu tabo tubagudu koia judeudogece, okwamagudure Pilatoji uwo boedo Jesus rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji. Icare Pilatore udo ino rugadu. Icare uture, ure Jesus rawuje i piji.

b: Nicodemo kodure apo (cewu makore Jesusji boecoji ia boe kejedu kodiwu). Ere ia roreboe jirireu reko pudabo.
source: Nicodemo kodure apo (cewu makore Jesusji boecoji ia boe kejedu kodiwu). Ere ia roreboe jirireu reko pudabo.

b: Ere tugeragu Jesusji, ere nowu roreboe jirireu tugu nowu aroiato dure ere upodo apo, nono judeudoge ero magai tui pu tugu mototo du reore.
source: Ere tugeragu Jesusji, ere nowu roreboe jirireu tugu nowu aroiato dure ere upodo apo, nono judeudoge ero magai tui pu tugu mototo du reore.

b: Cewu Jesus birewo kejere ia okureboe pa mugure, nowu okureboe pa tada ia boe emedumodewo maiwu mugure, mare iaboe iaboe emedukare tada roga.
source: Cewu Jesus birewo kejere ia okureboe pa mugure, nowu okureboe pa tada ia boe emedumodewo maiwu mugure, mare iaboe iaboe emedukare tada roga.

b: Du kodi icare ere Jesus tugu nono, paga karega, judeudoge enure tugera pemegado Páscoa jitu kodi, nowu meta mugu puredure nono jamedu kodi.
source: Du kodi icare ere Jesus tugu nono, paga karega, judeudoge enure tugera pemegado Páscoa jitu kodi, nowu meta mugu puredure nono jamedu kodi.

b: Jesus meturewo biororedu.
source: Jesus meturewo biororedu.

b: Kodure Sábado rekodaji boetojiwu meriji, Maria Madalena uture meturewo kae, kuri barogwa kododu tabo, boe guguco kimo tabo. Boekarema, jordure tori kurireu padukai meturewo je keje duji.
source: Kodure Sábado rekodaji boetojiwu meriji, Maria Madalena uture meturewo kae, kuri barogwa kododu tabo, boe guguco kimo tabo. Boekarema, jordure tori kurireu padukai meturewo je keje duji.

b: Rekodure tuibagi, uture Simão Pedro ae, mare cewu Jesus meardu kurire jiwu ure jorduwadowu ae, akore ei: - Ere Pagimejera tawuje tumedurewo piji, ceerduwakare kaiba ere bu.
source: Rekodure tuibagi, uture Simão Pedro ae, mare cewu Jesus meardu kurire jiwu ure jorduwadowu ae, akore ei: - Ere Pagimejera tawuje tumedurewo piji, ceerduwakare kaiba ere bu.

b: Kodi icare Pedro mare cewu ure jorduwadowu ere tudawuje, eture meturewo kae.
source: Kodi icare Pedro mare cewu ure jorduwadowu ere tudawuje, eture meturewo kae.

b: Eregodure puapo, mare nowu ia ure jorduwadowu rekodure Pedro kori, aregodure boetoji meturewo kae.
source: Eregodure puapo, mare nowu ia ure jorduwadowu rekodure Pedro kori, aregodure boetoji meturewo kae.

b: Ure tuie jodo jice, jordure aroiadogei moto keje, mare ukare turemo.
source: Ure tuie jodo jice, jordure aroiadogei moto keje, mare ukare turemo.

b: Simão Pedro, kodure rekodajidu, aregodure, ure turemo nowu meturewoto, jordure aroiadogei moto keje.
source: Simão Pedro, kodure rekodajidu, aregodure, ure turemo nowu meturewoto, jordure aroiadogei moto keje.

b: Jordure padure aora kejewu aroia kigadureuji, mare awu padukare nowu ia aroiadoge ebo: boere opodo tuginoi tu je.
source: Jordure padure aora kejewu aroia kigadureuji, mare awu padukare nowu ia aroiadoge ebo: boere opodo tuginoi tu je.

b: Du kodi icare cewu aregodure boetojiwu ia ure jorduwadowu ure turemo jamedu nowu metato. Jordure, icare meartorure.
source: Du kodi icare cewu aregodure boetojiwu ia ure jorduwadowu ure turemo jamedu nowu metato. Jordure, icare meartorure.

b: Boe jokodure ekare bapera atugo akoi oinoie Jesus jewodumoduie bireuge epijidu pawuje roga.
source: Boe jokodure ekare bapera atugo akoi oinoie Jesus jewodumoduie bireuge epijidu pawuje roga.

b:
Kodi icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere tugirimi tuwai kae.
Jesus ui towadudo Maria Madalena jekaidu.
source:
Kodi icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere tugirimi tuwai kae.
Jesus ui towadudo Maria Madalena jekaidu.

b: Nowu inodu boe tada, Maria rakojere baawadu keje, puredu tu nowu meturewoji toragudu tabo. Du tabore icare ure tuie jodo taiwowo meturewoto.
source: Nowu inodu boe tada, Maria rakojere baawadu keje, puredu tu nowu meturewoji toragudu tabo. Du tabore icare ure tuie jodo taiwowo meturewoto.

b: Du tabore icare jordure tupadogei pobe duji: ekudae kigadure, emugure padurewo okwa keje, ia mugure ao keje, ia mugure bure keje.
source: Du tabore icare jordure tupadogei pobe duji: ekudae kigadure, emugure padurewo okwa keje, ia mugure ao keje, ia mugure bure keje.

b: Duwugere enoragodure ji: - Aredu, kodiba akoragudure?  Akore ei: - Paga karega, boere ikimejera reko mare iorduwakare kaiba ere bu.
source: Duwugere enoragodure ji: - Aredu, kodiba akoragudure?  Akore ei: - Paga karega, boere ikimejera reko mare iorduwakare kaiba ere bu.

b: Nowu tagoino du tabo ure tugirimi tuibagi, jordure Jesus rakojei nono duji, mare jorduwakare ji.
source: Nowu tagoino du tabo ure tugirimi tuibagi, jordure Jesus rakojei nono duji, mare jorduwakare ji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aredu, kodiba akoragudure?  Meardaere nowu jeture okureboe jiwu rakuduie akoino, kodi dukeje akore ji: - Ikimejera, akimode are akeragu ji du keje, iwie kaiba are bu, icare itumode bogai.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aredu, kodiba akoragudure?  Meardaere nowu jeture okureboe jiwu rakuduie akoino, kodi dukeje akore ji: - Ikimejera, akimode are akeragu ji du keje, iwie kaiba are bu, icare itumode bogai.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Maria!  Tui tugirimi bai jaogwai du tabo, ure tumago rakado, akore hebreudoge ewadaru tabo, akore: - Rabboni!  (Boe ewadaru tabo ure oino: Ikimejera! Oino).
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Maria!  Tui tugirimi bai jaogwai du tabo, ure tumago rakado, akore hebreudoge ewadaru tabo, akore: - Rabboni!  (Boe ewadaru tabo ure oino: Ikimejera! Oino).

b: Jesus akore ji: - Akera jetu kaba ii, mare paga karega, irudukare Ioga ae roga, mare toro iwiemage etae, amagodo ei irudumode Ioga ae, Tao ae, ino Aroe Eimejera ae, tago Aroe Eimejera ae.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Akera jetu kaba ii, mare paga karega, irudukare Ioga ae roga, mare toro iwiemage etae, amagodo ei irudumode Ioga ae, Tao ae, ino Aroe Eimejera ae, tago Aroe Eimejera ae.

b:
Icare Maria Madalena rekodure nowu ure jorduwadowuge etae tuwo ewie tuiorduie Pagimejera jituji.
 	


Jesus ui towadudo ture jorduwadowuge eegaidu.
source:
Icare Maria Madalena rekodure nowu ure jorduwadowuge etae tuwo ewie tuiorduie Pagimejera jituji.
 	


Jesus ui towadudo ture jorduwadowuge eegaidu.

b: Nowu meri rekodu tabo, duwure semana o meri boetojiwu rema, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere baiporo mi pudui tuieduwo nowu bai tada, tubagudu koia judeudogece. Du kaere icare Jesus aregodure, ure turagojedo tu etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.
source: Nowu meri rekodu tabo, duwure semana o meri boetojiwu rema, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere baiporo mi pudui tuieduwo nowu bai tada, tubagudu koia judeudogece. Du kaere icare Jesus aregodure, ure turagojedo tu etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.

b: Tagoi oino du keje, ure eerdudo tugeraji, ure eerdudo tawubowuji. Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge eegare kuricigore tuiordui tugimejera jitu keje.
source: Tagoi oino du keje, ure eerdudo tugeraji, ure eerdudo tawubowuji. Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge eegare kuricigore tuiordui tugimejera jitu keje.

b: Icare akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo. Ioga magai irojai du reorere, inure tarojai jamedu.
source: Icare akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo. Ioga magai irojai du reorere, inure tarojai jamedu.

b: Icare ure togwamu ei, akore ei: - Aroe Pemegareu makudure tagai.
source: Icare ure togwamu ei, akore ei: - Aroe Pemegareu makudure tagai.

b: Tamode ro pegareuge ero pegareu butugugo du keje, butugugodaereboe umode ei. Tamodukare ero pegareu butugugo ma, butugugodaereboe umodukare ei jamedu.
source: Tamode ro pegareuge ero pegareu butugugo du keje, butugugodaereboe umode ei. Tamodukare ero pegareu butugugo ma, butugugodaereboe umodukare ei jamedu.

b: Ia ure jorduwadowu iere Tomé cedu, metukare etada nowu Jesus aregodu keje.
source: Ia ure jorduwadowu iere Tomé cedu, metukare etada nowu Jesus aregodu keje.

b: Icare nowu metage egore ji: - Ceerdure Pagimejeraji. Ure kirimi pai ei, akore: - Iordumodukare meriri oiaji ierato ma, imodukare ikerako tugu meriri oioato ma, imodukare ikera tugu mo awubouto ma, imeartorumodukare.
source: Icare nowu metage egore ji: - Ceerdure Pagimejeraji. Ure kirimi pai ei, akore: - Iordumodukare meriri oiaji ierato ma, imodukare ikerako tugu meriri oioato ma, imodukare ikera tugu mo awubouto ma, imeartorumodukare.

b: Meri ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci ikera awubowuto du rekodaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge eedure nowu tuieda mitodu keje pugeje, du tabore icare Tomé rakojere etada. Baiporo miture ei du tabore Jesus aregodure, ure turagojedo etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.
source: Meri ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci ikera awubowuto du rekodaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge eedure nowu tuieda mitodu keje pugeje, du tabore icare Tomé rakojere etada. Baiporo miture ei du tabore Jesus aregodure, ure turagojedo etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.

b: Du kejere icare makore Toméji, akore ji: - Mato, akerako bu woe, akaiwodo ikeraji, akera raido awo tugu imo awubowuto. Ameartoru bokwa kaba, ameartorudo.
source: Du kejere icare makore Toméji, akore ji: - Mato, akerako bu woe, akaiwodo ikeraji, akera raido awo tugu imo awubowuto. Ameartoru bokwa kaba, ameartorudo.

b: Icare Tomé akore ji: - Ikimejera, ino Aroe Eimejera.
source: Icare Tomé akore ji: - Ikimejera, ino Aroe Eimejera.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Ameartorure aerdure ii du koia. Pemega remawugere emeartorumode tuiordukai ii du tabo.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Ameartorure aerdure ii du koia. Pemega remawugere emeartorumode tuiordukai ii du tabo.
