b: Pagai, awu inodu ure turugadu, paro pegareu mori makudu nure pagai; mare awu rema, ia ro pegareu bokwa.
source: Pagai, awu inodu ure turugadu, paro pegareu mori makudu nure pagai; mare awu rema, ia ro pegareu bokwa.

b: Ure oto tawuje pugeje, akore: - Jesus, awia jeto ii, akaregodui aetumode jiboe kae du keje.
source: Ure oto tawuje pugeje, akore: - Jesus, awia jeto ii, akaregodui aetumode jiboe kae du keje.

b:
Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode ai: Awuji rugadure aragojemode itabo baru tada.
Jesus bi.
source:
Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode ai: Awuji rugadure aragojemode itabo baru tada.
Jesus bi.

b: Meri aregodu puregodure baru oia kae du keje, boeco rorire moto jamedu boe joki jii meri jogodu kae.
source: Meri aregodu puregodure baru oia kae du keje, boeco rorire moto jamedu boe joki jii meri jogodu kae.

b: Meri joku core. Pao uwai tada aroia boa kurireu ure tuwowuje oiagi.
source: Meri joku core. Pao uwai tada aroia boa kurireu ure tuwowuje oiagi.

b: Kodi icare Jesus mako rakareu padure kajeje, akore: - Ioga, akera kejere ire itaroe bu. Tagoi oino du tabo, akurure.
source: Kodi icare Jesus mako rakareu padure kajeje, akore: - Ioga, akera kejere ire itaroe bu. Tagoi oino du tabo, akurure.

b: Tugobaigarege eimejera, tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ure Pao ie kurido tumago pemegai jitu tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Boe jokodu rugadu radu, awu imedu pemegare rugadu rabodu.
source: Tugobaigarege eimejera, tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ure Pao ie kurido tumago pemegai jitu tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Boe jokodu rugadu radu, awu imedu pemegare rugadu rabodu.

b: Nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe eedure nono taiwo tabodu, eerdure nowu inodu jamedu boeji, du kejere eture tui tugera to tumo jitu tabo.
source: Nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe eedure nono taiwo tabodu, eerdure nowu inodu jamedu boeji, du kejere eture tui tugera to tumo jitu tabo.

b:
Jesus metage mare ia areme ekodure apo Galiléia pijiwuge, eedu jaere taiwo tabo, toebatodu tabo nowu inodu jamedu boei tudowuje du kae.
Jesus tugudui moto todu.
source:
Jesus metage mare ia areme ekodure apo Galiléia pijiwuge, eedu jaere taiwo tabo, toebatodu tabo nowu inodu jamedu boei tudowuje du kae.
Jesus tugudui moto todu.

b: Ia imedu jetororeu, pemegareu, iei José cedu, judeudoge eimejerage ia mitodu.
source: Ia imedu jetororeu, pemegareu, iei José cedu, judeudoge eimejerage ia mitodu.

b: Jokare tumedage emeardae keje, jokare erore jiboe keje, Arimatia kejewu, Judéia kejewu nure ema, du upagare Pao o boe pemegareu bogai.
source: Jokare tumedage emeardae keje, jokare erore jiboe keje, Arimatia kejewu, Judéia kejewu nure ema, du upagare Pao o boe pemegareu bogai.

b: Awu imedu pemegareu, uture Pilato ae, okwamagudure ji tuwo Jesus rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji.
source: Awu imedu pemegareu, uture Pilato ae, okwamagudure ji tuwo Jesus rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji.

b: Ure rawuje piji, ure ia aroia kigadureu upodo apo ure tugu ia ture porodowu torito, du boe emedukare tada kimo roga.
source: Ure rawuje piji, ure ia aroia kigadureu upodo apo ure tugu ia ture porodowu torito, du boe emedukare tada kimo roga.

b: Sexta feira meri rekodu tabo, sabadore tuiagu turemo du tabo, awu inodu ure tudowuje.
source: Sexta feira meri rekodu tabo, sabadore tuiagu turemo du tabo, awu inodu ure tudowuje.

b: Kodure Galiléia piji Jesus apowuge areme, ekodure José apo, eerdure Jesus meture tadawu toriji.
source: Kodure Galiléia piji Jesus apowuge areme, ekodure José apo, eerdure Jesus meture tadawu toriji.

b: Du kejere icare ere tugirimi tuwai kae, ere tugera pemegado ia roreboeji, ia boekaguru roreuji. Mare sabadore jiwu meriji ere tamudo, judeudoge eroiagudu reore.
source: Du kejere icare ere tugirimi tuwai kae, ere tugera pemegado ia roreboeji, ia boekaguru roreuji. Mare sabadore jiwu meriji ere tamudo, judeudoge eroiagudu reore.

b: Jesus jewoduidu.
source: Jesus jewoduidu.

b: Semana jiwu boetojiwu meriji, kuri boeco kimoto, Maria Madalena mare metage eture Jesus meturewo kae, cewu ture pemegadowu to roreboe tabo.
source: Semana jiwu boetojiwu meriji, kuri boeco kimoto, Maria Madalena mare metage eture Jesus meturewo kae, cewu ture pemegadowu to roreboe tabo.

b: Eerdure cewu tori padure je kejewu padukai je keje duji.
source: Eerdure cewu tori padure je kejewu padukai je keje duji.

b: Ere turemo to, mare eerdukare Pagimejera Jesus bi padui tada duji.
source: Ere turemo to, mare eerdukare Pagimejera Jesus bi padui tada duji.

b: Eerduwakare inoba tumeardaewo. Du tonajire ia boe ei pobedu ere towadudo eegai tugudae kigadu kurukurureu tabo.
source: Eerduwakare inoba tumeardaewo. Du tonajire ia boe ei pobedu ere towadudo eegai tugudae kigadu kurukurureu tabo.

b: Du kejere areme epagudugodure, ere tuie jodo mototo. Du kodi icare cewu boe ei pobedu eegore ei: - Kodiba taemarure bireuge ekao cewu jereu bogai?
source: Du kejere areme epagudugodure, ere tuie jodo mototo. Du kodi icare cewu boe ei pobedu eegore ei: - Kodiba taemarure bireuge ekao cewu jereu bogai?

b: Padukare woe; jewodure. Tawia jetudo cewu akore tai, taragojei Galiléia tadadu kodiwoji.
source: Padukare woe; jewodure. Tawia jetudo cewu akore tai, taragojei Galiléia tadadu kodiwoji.

b: Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode pegareuge ekera kae, padumode i keje, mare jewodumode meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.
source: Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode pegareuge ekera kae, padumode i keje, mare jewodumode meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.

b: Du kodire ewia jeture nowu Jesus bataruji.
source: Du kodire ewia jeture nowu Jesus bataruji.

b: Ere tugirimi nowu meturewo piji, ereadodure Apostolodoge ewiegai, ia boe eiamedu ewiegai, inodu jamedu boeji.
source: Ere tugirimi nowu meturewo piji, ereadodure Apostolodoge ewiegai, ia boe eiamedu ewiegai, inodu jamedu boeji.

b: Cewu ereadodure inoduji Apostolodoge ewiegaiwu areme reo: Maria Madalena, Joana, Tiago uce Maria, ia metage jamedu.
source: Cewu ereadodure inoduji Apostolodoge ewiegaiwu areme reo: Maria Madalena, Joana, Tiago uce Maria, ia metage jamedu.

b: Mare nowu ereadodaere ure nono ia aora bai baireuge ereadodaere eegai. Kodire emeartorukare.
source: Mare nowu ereadodaere ure nono ia aora bai baireuge ereadodaere eegai. Kodire emeartorukare.

b:
Mare Pedro rekodure toro meturewo kae, icare tui tuie jodo taiwo tabo, jordure tu aroia kigadureuji moto keje. Du rekodajire ure turodo oino, uture tuwai kae tuieroi ta... nowu inodu jamedu boe ui tudo oinono duji.
Emaús kaewu awara.
source:
Mare Pedro rekodure toro meturewo kae, icare tui tuie jodo taiwo tabo, jordure tu aroia kigadureuji moto keje. Du rekodajire ure turodo oino, uture tuwai kae tuieroi ta... nowu inodu jamedu boe ui tudo oinono duji.
Emaús kaewu awara.

b: Nowu meri mitoduji, ia ure jorduwadowuge ei pobe tu je du, eture ia bakurireu rogu iei Emas cedu padu puredure Jerusalém bakurireu jitu du kae.
source: Nowu meri mitoduji, ia ure jorduwadowuge ei pobe tu je du, eture ia bakurireu rogu iei Emas cedu padu puredure Jerusalém bakurireu jitu du kae.

b: Emagore pui nowu ure tudoboe jamedu boe.
source: Emagore pui nowu ure tudoboe jamedu boe.

b: Emagoi pui nowu inodu jitu tonaji, Jesus mitodu ure tuburedo jice ei, kodure ebo.
source: Emagoi pui nowu inodu jitu tonaji, Jesus mitodu ure tuburedo jice ei, kodure ebo.

b: Eerdure ji, mare ukare edo boe pa pudui.
source: Eerdure ji, mare ukare edo boe pa pudui.

b: Kodi icare unoragodure ei: - Kaba jiba tagagoino tagodui? Kodiba tagiarigodure?
source: Kodi icare unoragodure ei: - Kaba jiba tagagoino tagodui? Kodiba tagiarigodure?

b: Ia emage iei Cleofas cedu, akore ji: - Ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu mitodu aki kanao? Du kodi kana aerduwakare boei maigodu Jerusalém tada duji?
source: Ia emage iei Cleofas cedu, akore ji: - Ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu mitodu aki kanao? Du kodi kana aerduwakare boei maigodu Jerusalém tada duji?

b: Unoragodure ei: - Inoba?  Egore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu jiboe. Cewu profeta ro rakareu turo tuwadaru tabowu Pao jore keje, boe eiore keje jamedu du.
source: Unoragodure ei: - Inoba?  Egore: - Jesus Nazaré pijiwu jiboe. Cewu profeta ro rakareu turo tuwadaru tabowu Pao jore keje, boe eiore keje jamedu du.

b: Ceno sacerdotedoge eiemejerage, boe eimejerage ere maku bitoduwo, du ere bu i keje.
source: Ceno sacerdotedoge eiemejerage, boe eimejerage ere maku bitoduwo, du ere bu i keje.

b: Cegi cebagare emamode umode Israeldoge einorudo du bogai. Macare merire pobe ma awu metuia bokware nowu inodu jamedu boe rekodaji.
source: Cegi cebagare emamode umode Israeldoge einorudo du bogai. Macare merire pobe ma awu metuia bokware nowu inodu jamedu boe rekodaji.

b: Mare inodu tabo, ia pamedage areme ere cebagududo, mare paga karega, eture toro meturewo kae, meri rutumodedu otodai, 23tuiordukai bi metui nonodu jitu koia, ere tugirimi tagoi boe jokodu jitu tabo, tuiorduie tupadogei, duwuge egoe jeie.
source: Mare inodu tabo, ia pamedage areme ere cebagududo, mare paga karega, eture toro meturewo kae, meri rutumodedu otodai, 23tuiordukai bi metui nonodu jitu koia, ere tugirimi tagoi boe jokodu jitu tabo, tuiorduie tupadogei, duwuge egoe jeie.

b: Ia cemedage eture toro meturewo kae, eerdure nono areme egore uie du reore, mare remawuji eerdukare ji.
source: Ia cemedage eture toro meturewo kae, eerdure nono areme egore uie du reore, mare remawuji eerdukare ji.

b: Kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Tawabo raka remawu nure tameartoruwo profetadoge emagore jiboe jamedu beoji.
source: Kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Tawabo raka remawu nure tameartoruwo profetadoge emagore jiboe jamedu beoji.

b: Ica, Cristo epaemode nowu tujebaere emaboe jamedu boece rugadu ma Aroe Eimejare uwo kurido.
source: Ica, Cristo epaemode nowu tujebaere emaboe jamedu boece rugadu ma Aroe Eimejare uwo kurido.

b: Du kodi icare ure Moisés makore jiboe, profetadoge eiamedu emagore jiboe jamedu boe padui bapera kejedu kogado ewiegai.
source: Du kodi icare ure Moisés makore jiboe, profetadoge eiamedu emagore jiboe jamedu boe padui bapera kejedu kogado ewiegai.

b: Ei tuburedo nowu baboturogu ekodumode kaewu jitu keje, ure turodo nono taidui tugoduwo gu pugeje.
source: Ei tuburedo nowu baboturogu ekodumode kaewu jitu keje, ure turodo nono taidui tugoduwo gu pugeje.

b: Mare ere tubewudo ji, ere buredo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Aragoje rugadu cedabo. Meri rekodu nure, boecodu nure. Du kodi icare ure turemo ebo.
source: Mare ere tubewudo ji, ere buredo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Aragoje rugadu cedabo. Meri rekodu nure, boecodu nure. Du kodi icare ure turemo ebo.

b: Boekarema, tumugui ira keje ebo du tabo, ure tugeragu amireuji, imadure Paoji, ure nowu amireu kado, ure pedo toro ei.
source: Boekarema, tumugui ira keje ebo du tabo, ure tugeragu amireuji, imadure Paoji, ure nowu amireu kado, ure pedo toro ei.

b: Inodu kejere eekure tuiado, ere pawuje emaraboduie. Mare ema okware pi tuku je.
source: Inodu kejere eekure tuiado, ere pawuje emaraboduie. Mare ema okware pi tuku je.

b: Kodi icare emagore pui: - Du kodia nowu akoino awara jiboere pawabo jekaredo, tagoi pawiegai bapera atugo pemegareu jituji.
source: Kodi icare emagore pui: - Du kodia nowu akoino awara jiboere pawabo jekaredo, tagoi pawiegai bapera atugo pemegareu jituji.

b: Du keje kuri je, ere turagojedo, ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Nono eerdure Apostolodoge enogwa padui nono duji, cewu jeture ebowuge eedui nono jamedu duji.
source: Du keje kuri je, ere turagojedo, ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Nono eerdure Apostolodoge enogwa padui nono duji, cewu jeture ebowuge eedui nono jamedu duji.

b: Eiamedu boe egore oino: Boe jokoduji rugadure Pagimejera jewodure, ure towadudo Simão jekai.
source: Eiamedu boe egore oino: Boe jokoduji rugadure Pagimejera jewodure, ure towadudo Simão jekai.

b:
Kodi icare emage ereadodure boere tuiegai awara jiwoji, jamedu tuie boe pa ji ui amireu pedo du keje duji.
Jesus ui towadudo ture jordwuadowuge eegaidu.
source:
Kodi icare emage ereadodure boere tuiegai awara jiwoji, jamedu tuie boe pa ji ui amireu pedo du keje duji.
Jesus ui towadudo ture jordwuadowuge eegaidu.

b: Emago kimoi nowu jitu tonaji, Jesus ure towadudo etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu jetuwo tagabo.
source: Emago kimoi nowu jitu tonaji, Jesus ure towadudo etoiadoda, akore ei: - Boe butugureu jetuwo tagabo.

b: Erore poku, epagudugodure emeardaere tuiorduie ure ia aroe jitu du koia.
source: Erore poku, epagudugodure emeardaere tuiorduie ure ia aroe jitu du koia.

b: Mare akore ei: - Kodiba tarore poku je? Kodiba tagidakare tawabo tada?
source: Mare akore ei: - Kodiba tarore poku je? Kodiba tagidakare tawabo tada?

b: Tagaiwodo ikeraji, tagaiwodo iwureji. Cewu imireo. Tagera pagado ii, tagaiwodo ii: Aroe kodu bokwa, ra bokwa. Imirema, teardu nure ii oinoduji.
source: Tagaiwodo ikeraji, tagaiwodo iwureji. Cewu imireo. Tagera pagado ii, tagaiwodo ii: Aroe kodu bokwa, ra bokwa. Imirema, teardu nure ii oinoduji.

b: Tagoi oino du tabo, ure eerdudo tugeraji, tuwureji.
source: Tagoi oino du tabo, ure eerdudo tugeraji, tuwureji.

b: Mare emeartorukare roga, egurure tuiegare kurireu jaogwai. Du kodi icare Jesus unoragodure: - Ia tagerogure nono tagabo iwo kowuje?
source: Mare emeartorukare roga, egurure tuiegare kurireu jaogwai. Du kodi icare Jesus unoragodure: - Ia tagerogure nono tagabo iwo kowuje?

b: Du keje icare ere ia karo kobo barigudui joradu ao kejedu makai, ia moiawe ewori kobo tabo.
source: Du keje icare ere ia karo kobo barigudui joradu ao kejedu makai, ia moiawe ewori kobo tabo.

b: Kodi icare ure tugeragu ji, ure kowuje eegai.
source: Kodi icare ure tugeragu ji, ure kowuje eegai.

b: Du kejere akore ei: - Marigudu iragojei kimo tagabo du tabo, imagore tai: cewu padure Moisés o bapera kejedu, cewu padure profetadoge eno bapea kejedu, cewu padure salmodoge etadadu ii boe jamedu boe umoduie ino rugadu.
source: Du kejere akore ei: - Marigudu iragojei kimo tagabo du tabo, imagore tai: cewu padure Moisés o bapera kejedu, cewu padure profetadoge eno bapea kejedu, cewu padure salmodoge etadadu ii boe jamedu boe umoduie ino rugadu.

b: Du kejere ure edo pawuje bapera atugo pemegareuji.
source: Du kejere ure edo pawuje bapera atugo pemegareuji.

b: Akore ei: - Cewu padure bapera kejedu reo: Cristo jiwomoduie, mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje jewodumoduie bireuge epiji.
source: Akore ei: - Cewu padure bapera kejedu reo: Cristo jiwomoduie, mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje jewodumoduie bireuge epiji.

b: Ie taboie boe enogituwamode boei tuwo tumeradae kirimi Pao ai, Pao butugugoduwo ei tui boe ero pegareu okwado duji, Jerusalém keje boetoji, du rekodaji moto padui pumekejedu jamedu boe keje.
source: Ie taboie boe enogituwamode boei tuwo tumeradae kirimi Pao ai, Pao butugugoduwo ei tui boe ero pegareu okwado duji, Jerusalém keje boetoji, du rekodaji moto padui pumekejedu jamedu boe keje.

b: Tagire tamode awu inodu jamedu kogado boe ewiegai.
source: Tagire tamode awu inodu jamedu kogado boe ewiegai.

b:
Imode cewu ioga akore tuiagu maku tawogaiwu rojai tawogai. Nowu inodu tonaji, tawudugudo jao bakurireu tada, jii baru tadawu ro rakareboe umode turawuje tawugeje du kae.
Jesus rutui baru todu.
source:
Imode cewu ioga akore tuiagu maku tawogaiwu rojai tawogai. Nowu inodu tonaji, tawudugudo jao bakurireu tada, jii baru tadawu ro rakareboe umode turawuje tawugeje du kae.
Jesus rutui baru todu.

b: Du kejere Jesus ure erego bakurireu piji, ia bakurireurogu iei Betânia cedu kae, ure tugera aogado ewugeje, ure tuwadaru pemegareu bu ewugeje.
source: Du kejere Jesus ure erego bakurireu piji, ia bakurireurogu iei Betânia cedu kae, ure tugera aogado ewugeje, ure tuwadaru pemegareu bu ewugeje.

b: Tui tuwadaru pemegareu bu ewugeje du keje, ure turodo oino taci epiji, ruture gu gu gu baruto.
source: Tui tuwadaru pemegareu bu ewugeje du keje, ure turodo oino taci epiji, ruture gu gu gu baruto.

b: Ere tubujodo ji, du kejere ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae, tuiegare kuricigoreu tabo.
source: Ere tubujodo ji, du kejere ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae, tuiegare kuricigoreu tabo.

b: Eedure jii nono Pao uwai tada, tumago pemegai Pao jitu tabo.
source: Eedure jii nono Pao uwai tada, tumago pemegai Pao jitu tabo.

b: João Batista uwadodae.
source: João Batista uwadodae.

b: Pao baru tadawu Onaregedu Jesus Cristo o bakaru maiwu pemegareu paru. Profeta Isaias o bapera keje atugododure oino:
source: Pao baru tadawu Onaregedu Jesus Cristo o bakaru maiwu pemegareu paru. Profeta Isaias o bapera keje atugododure oino:

b: "Ica, inure ino tupa utudo akododai, emare umode akawara pemegado.
source: "Ica, inure ino tupa utudo akododai, emare umode akawara pemegado.

b: Iaboe mako padure boe matadu kajeje, akore: Pagimejera utawara jetorodo, moto aoporu boe kororogodudo” (Mal 3,1; Is 40,3).
source: Iaboe mako padure boe matadu kajeje, akore: Pagimejera utawara jetorodo, moto aoporu boe kororogodudo” (Mal 3,1; Is 40,3).

b: Kodi icare João Batista je padure boe matadu kajeje tokituwai boei ewo tao pegodo ma, epemegawo, ero pegareu pijidoduwo.
source: Kodi icare João Batista je padure boe matadu kajeje tokituwai boei ewo tao pegodo ma, epemegawo, ero pegareu pijidoduwo.

b: Du kodi icare, Judéia kejewuge eiamedu boe, Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe etu eture ae tumagowo ji; emagore turo pegareuji, du kejere ure etao pegodo Jordão po tada.
source: Du kodi icare, Judéia kejewuge eiamedu boe, Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe etu eture ae tumagowo ji; emagore turo pegareuji, du kejere ure etao pegodo Jordão po tada.

b: João merure camelo biri metui pudui du tabo, ia kogure kajeje, okwagere bokokuadogei, moiawoei jamedu.
source: João merure camelo biri metui pudui du tabo, ia kogure kajeje, okwagere bokokuadogei, moiawoei jamedu.

b: Icare uwadodure, akore: - Ia kodu remawure ikoriwu imedu aregodumode iregodaji, duwu otoji icekare iwo bure tadawu iku kiwuje.
source: Icare uwadodure, akore: - Ia kodu remawure ikoriwu imedu aregodumode iregodaji, duwu otoji icekare iwo bure tadawu iku kiwuje.

b:
Ire tagao pegodo pobo tabo, emarema, umode tagao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
João Batistare Jesus ao pegodo.
source:
Ire tagao pegodo pobo tabo, emarema, umode tagao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
João Batistare Jesus ao pegodo.

b: Boekimorema, nowu ia meri keje Jesus aregodure padure Galiléia kejewu bakurireu iei Nazaré cedu piji. Icare ao pegododure João koia, Jordão po tada.
source: Boekimorema, nowu ia meri keje Jesus aregodure padure Galiléia kejewu bakurireu iei Nazaré cedu piji. Icare ao pegododure João koia, Jordão po tada.

b: Icare ui tudawuje pobo piji du tonajire icare jordure barui tuiado, Aroe Pemegareu ui turawuje tui nono metugu reore du tabo bukeje duji.
source: Icare ui tudawuje pobo piji du tonajire icare jordure barui tuiado, Aroe Pemegareu ui turawuje tui nono metugu reore du tabo bukeje duji.

b: Boe emeardure ia boe mako aregodui baru piji duji, akore:  - Akire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedure aki: Awugejere ire imeardu kuriae jamedu boe bu.
source: Boe emeardure ia boe mako aregodui baru piji duji, akore:  - Akire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedure aki: Awugejere ire imeardu kuriae jamedu boe bu.

b: Awu inodu otobiji, Aroere utudo toro boe mataduto.
source: Awu inodu otobiji, Aroere utudo toro boe mataduto.

b:
Merire ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure, ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ji nono, Aroe pegareu  podure ji nono, barege eedure apo, tupadoge eedure ji.
Jesus uwadodae.
source:
Merire ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure, ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ji nono, Aroe pegareu  podure ji nono, barege eedure apo, tupadoge eedure ji.
Jesus uwadodae.

b: Icare braere João tugu baicoreuto, du rekodajire icare Jesus uture Galiléia kae. Ure Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareu kuo, tagoi: -
source: Icare braere João tugu baicoreuto, du rekodajire icare Jesus uture Galiléia kae. Ure Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareu kuo, tagoi: -

b:
Icare boe aregodure pudae, Pao o boe pemegareu aregodu nure, icare tagodorogado tai, tameartorudo Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareuji.
Jesus ure jorduwadowu boetojiwuge ei pobe puibijidu.
source:
Icare boe aregodure pudae, Pao o boe pemegareu aregodu nure, icare tagodorogado tai, tameartorudo Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareuji.
Jesus ure jorduwadowu boetojiwuge ei pobe puibijidu.

b: Tumerui Galiléia kejewu kuruga kurireu okwai du tabore icare, jordure Simãoji, uwie Andréji, ei buke barigu poboto duji, boekarema, kare ecebage rabodure emage.
source: Tumerui Galiléia kejewu kuruga kurireu okwai du tabore icare, jordure Simãoji, uwie Andréji, ei buke barigu poboto duji, boekarema, kare ecebage rabodure emage.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tago itabo! Iwo tuwugerurudo imeiwugedo tagi.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tago itabo! Iwo tuwugerurudo imeiwugedo tagi.

b: Kuri je ere tugera ra tuwuge piji, ekodure apo.
source: Kuri je ere tugera ra tuwuge piji, ekodure apo.

b: Ekodure gu... je du keje, jordure Tiago, Zebedeu onaregeduji, uwie Joãoji, eedui ia ika tada duji, enure tugare pemegado tuwugeji.
source: Ekodure gu... je du keje, jordure Tiago, Zebedeu onaregeduji, uwie Joãoji, eedui ia ika tada duji, enure tugare pemegado tuwugeji.

b:
Makore kuri etai. Eture tuo Zebedeu mugui tudugarege ebodu piji, ekodure apo.
Jesus ui  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu ia imedu pijidu.
source:
Makore kuri etai. Eture tuo Zebedeu mugui tudugarege ebodu piji, ekodure apo.
Jesus ui  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu ia imedu pijidu.

b: Ere turemo Cafarnaum bakurireuto, icare, Sábado okwabiji, Jesus ure turemo sinagogato. Kejere ure boe eerduwado.
source: Ere turemo Cafarnaum bakurireuto, icare, Sábado okwabiji, Jesus ure turemo sinagogato. Kejere ure boe eerduwado.

b: Eerdu moture nowu uwadodaeji, paga karega, ure eerduwado nono ia boe eimejerare boe eerduwadodu reore, mare escribadoge ereore karega.
source: Eerdu moture nowu uwadodaeji, paga karega, ure eerduwado nono ia boe eimejerare boe eerduwadodu reore, mare escribadoge ereore karega.

b: Ica, nowu sinagoga tada ia Aroe pegareu  pegareu metui tadawu imedu rakojere nono, du oiogwarire, 24akore: - Inoba aromode cei, Jesus Nazaré kejewu? Akaregodure awo cewarigu boeto? Iorduware ai: Aroe Eimejera o imedu pemegareu nure aki.
source: Ica, nowu sinagoga tada ia Aroe pegareu  pegareu metui tadawu imedu rakojere nono, du oiogwarire, 24akore: - Inoba aromode cei, Jesus Nazaré kejewu? Akaregodure awo cewarigu boeto? Iorduware ai: Aroe Eimejera o imedu pemegareu nure aki.

b: Mare Jesus akore ji: - Amago urugadu, atawuje nowu imedu piji!
source: Mare Jesus akore ji: - Amago urugadu, atawuje nowu imedu piji!

b: Aror pegareure nowu imedu amagadudodu kuricigodo, tui toiogwari rakaguragado, tui tudawuje piji du tabo.
source: Aror pegareure nowu imedu amagadudodu kuricigodo, tui toiogwari rakaguragado, tui tudawuje piji du tabo.

b: Boe eiamedu boe erore ta... je, enorare jice woje, jice woje pui, egore: - Kabobao? Uwadodure boe maiwuji tui nono boe eimejerai pudumidu reore! Roiware tuwo  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu jamedu, duwugere emeartorure bataruji!
source: Boe eiamedu boe erore ta... je, enorare jice woje, jice woje pui, egore: - Kabobao? Uwadodure boe maiwuji tui nono boe eimejerai pudumidu reore! Roiware tuwo  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu jamedu, duwugere emeartorure bataruji!

b:
Kuri je, akarure taodo moto jamedu boe kao, Galiléia oiei.
Jesus ui Pedro ucarugo pemegagodu.
source:
Kuri je, akarure taodo moto jamedu boe kao, Galiléia oiei.
Jesus ui Pedro ucarugo pemegagodu.

b: Ure tudawuje nowu sinagoga piji du keje, uture Tiago apo, João apo, nowu Simão, André mage ewai kae.
source: Ure tudawuje nowu sinagoga piji du keje, uture Tiago apo, João apo, nowu Simão, André mage ewai kae.

b: Nowu Simão ucarugo padure tuba kamoreu keje tuwiri uru tabo. Icare emagore kuri ji inoba ure duji.
source: Nowu Simão ucarugo padure tuba kamoreu keje tuwiri uru tabo. Icare emagore kuri ji inoba ure duji.

b:
Ure tuburedo gu jice ji, ure tugeragu ieraji, ure tuera awogado iera tabo. Nowu inodu tonaji, biri uru akedure pi tuku je, du kejere ure enogwagedo.
Jesus ui ia kogodureuge epemegagodu.
source:
Ure tuburedo gu jice ji, ure tugeragu ieraji, ure tuera awogado iera tabo. Nowu inodu tonaji, biri uru akedure pi tuku je, du kejere ure enogwagedo.
Jesus ui ia kogodureuge epemegagodu.

b: Meri rekodu tabo, meri butu rekodaji, ere kogodureuge eiamedu boe,  Aroe pegareuge emedure tadawuge eiamedu boe, eto pui ae.
source: Meri rekodu tabo, meri butu rekodaji, ere kogodureuge eiamedu boe,  Aroe pegareuge emedure tadawuge eiamedu boe, eto pui ae.

b: Nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui nowu baiporo kae.
source: Nowu bakurireu tadawuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui nowu baiporo kae.

b: Ure makareuge epemegago tugogodae jamedu boe piji, ure  Aroe pegareuge ewarigudu makaguragado: ukare egodo ia tago, eerduware ji kodi. Barogwatore icare jetadure barogwa kododumodedu otodai, icare ure tuiebu, uture boe makodureuto, nonore icare ure togwa kurido.
source: Ure makareuge epemegago tugogodae jamedu boe piji, ure  Aroe pegareuge ewarigudu makaguragado: ukare egodo ia tago, eerduware ji kodi. Barogwatore icare jetadure barogwa kododumodedu otodai, icare ure tuiebu, uture boe makodureuto, nonore icare ure togwa kurido.

b: Du tonajire icare Simão jemarure bogai tumedage ebo.
source: Du tonajire icare Simão jemarure bogai tumedage ebo.

b: Eerdure ji du kejere icare, egore ji: - Boe eiamedu boe eemarure awogai.
source: Eerdure ji du kejere icare, egore ji: - Boe eiamedu boe eemarure awogai.

b: Icare akore ei: - Paduwo bakurireu rogudoge etae, bakurireu padu puredureuge etae, iwadoduwo toro jamedu; paga karega, nowu inodu bogaire itaregodure.
source: Icare akore ei: - Paduwo bakurireu rogudoge etae, bakurireu padu puredureuge etae, iwadoduwo toro jamedu; paga karega, nowu inodu bogaire itaregodure.

b:
Kodure toro rugadu, uwadodure eno sinagogadoge etada, nowu Galiléia jamedu boe kao, tui  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu du tabo.
Jesus ure ia moci bare jiwu imedu pemegago.
source:
Kodure toro rugadu, uwadodure eno sinagogadoge etada, nowu Galiléia jamedu boe kao, tui  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu du tabo.
Jesus ure ia moci bare jiwu imedu pemegago.

b: Ia moci bare jiwu imedu uture ae, ure tubujodo ji, togwamagudui jitu du tabo, akore: - Akaidu keje, amode ikabi.
source: Ia moci bare jiwu imedu uture ae, ure tubujodo ji, togwamagudui jitu du tabo, akore: - Akaidu keje, amode ikabi.

b: Jesus okudure apo, ure tugera raido jice ae, ure tugera bu keje, akore ji: - Itaidure. Kode, apemegago.
source: Jesus okudure apo, ure tugera raido jice ae, ure tugera bu keje, akore ji: - Itaidure. Kode, apemegago.

b: Nowu akoinodu tonaji kuri je, moci okware pi tuku je. Akurugudure taci je.
source: Nowu akoinodu tonaji kuri je, moci okware pi tuku je. Akurugudure taci je.

b: Jesus imadure kuri apo, akore ji tumago okori tabo: -
source: Jesus imadure kuri apo, akore ji tumago okori tabo: -

b: Amago kaba boe ewiegai, mare, toro! Sacerdote jordudo ai, ia akomearogu maku apemegagodu morice, Moisés bataru reore, apemegagodu koiaboe reore.
source: Amago kaba boe ewiegai, mare, toro! Sacerdote jordudo ai, ia akomearogu maku apemegagodu morice, Moisés bataru reore, apemegagodu koiaboe reore.

b: Mare nowu imedu uture kuri je, ure nowu inodu boedo taodo, du kodi icare Jesus roiwakare tuwo turemo tui towadudo du tabo bakurireuto. Rakojere bakujei, boe eragojekarewo keje. Boe eiamedu etu eture ae tu tu tubiji.
source: Mare nowu imedu uture kuri je, ure nowu inodu boedo taodo, du kodi icare Jesus roiwakare tuwo turemo tui towadudo du tabo bakurireuto. Rakojere bakujei, boe eragojekarewo keje. Boe eiamedu etu eture ae tu tu tubiji.

b: Jesus ure ia meru bokwareu imedu pemegago.
source: Jesus ure ia meru bokwareu imedu pemegago.

b: Du kejere icare, Jesus ure turemo Cafarnaum bakurireuto pugeje, icare boe eerduware mugui tuwai kejeduji.
source: Du kejere icare, Jesus ure turemo Cafarnaum bakurireuto pugeje, icare boe eerduware mugui tuwai kejeduji.

b: Kodi icare boe ere tudo pui du makaguragare ae, kodi icare boe eroiwakare pu kujiagi nowu baiporoto. Icare uwadodure ewiegai.
source: Kodi icare boe ere tudo pui du makaguragare ae, kodi icare boe eroiwakare pu kujiagi nowu baiporoto. Icare uwadodure ewiegai.

b: Icare boere ia meru bokwareu imedu arego nono ae, oredure apowu ime ere pobe puibiji.
source: Icare boere ia meru bokwareu imedu arego nono ae, oredure apowu ime ere pobe puibiji.

b: Mare eroiwakare boe ekujiagi apo jice ae. Boekarema ere ia tugoda pawuje jice bai aoji, Jesus bukajeje. Ere bai ao jado, du poro jire ere nowu kogodureu pa kamoreu rawuje apo baito.
source: Mare eroiwakare boe ekujiagi apo jice ae. Boekarema ere ia tugoda pawuje jice bai aoji, Jesus bukajeje. Ere bai ao jado, du poro jire ere nowu kogodureu pa kamoreu rawuje apo baito.

b: Icare Jesus, tuiordui nowu emeartorae rakareu jitu keje, makore nowu pogora bokwareuji, akore: - Itonaregedu, iwudugugodure ai aro pegareu jamedu boeji.
source: Icare Jesus, tuiordui nowu emeartorae rakareu jitu keje, makore nowu pogora bokwareuji, akore: - Itonaregedu, iwudugugodure ai aro pegareu jamedu boeji.

b: Boekarema, ia escribadoge emugure nonodu egore pui: -
source: Boekarema, ia escribadoge emugure nonodu egore pui: -

b: Kodiba awu imedu akomode oino? Mako pega nure! Ioguduba umode boe ero pegareu okwado? Pao baru tadawu tu je karega?
source: Kodiba awu imedu akomode oino? Mako pega nure! Ioguduba umode boe ero pegareu okwado? Pao baru tadawu tu je karega?

b: Mare Jesus, tui emeardae pawuje du keje, akore ei: - Kodiba tameardaere oino tawabo tada?
source: Mare Jesus, tui emeardae pawuje du keje, akore ei: - Kodiba tameardaere oino tawabo tada?

b: Inoba ureuba biamodukare: imagowo awu pogora pegareuji: Iwudugugodure aro pegareu jamedu boeji, oino ji, iarema inagowo ji: Aragojedo, akeragu apa komoreuji, amerudo, oino ji?
source: Inoba ureuba biamodukare: imagowo awu pogora pegareuji: Iwudugugodure aro pegareu jamedu boeji, oino ji, iarema inagowo ji: Aragojedo, akeragu apa komoreuji, amerudo, oino ji?

b: Aro, kode, taerduwawo Imedu Onaregedu ro rakareu makudui aiduji (akore nowu pogora pegareuji). -
source: Aro, kode, taerduwawo Imedu Onaregedu ro rakareu makudui aiduji (akore nowu pogora pegareuji). -

b: Imire inagoino: Aragojedo! Akeragu apa kamoreuji, toro awai kae!
source: Imire inagoino: Aragojedo! Akeragu apa kamoreuji, toro awai kae!

b:
Icare ure turagojedo kuri je, ure tugeragu tuba kamoreuji, uture boe eegai rugadu. Nowu boe eiamedu boe eebogodure, ere Pao akaru kurido tuiegare tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Paerdu kigodukare awu inodu reoreboeji.
Jesus mare Levi.
source:
Icare ure turagojedo kuri je, ure tugeragu tuba kamoreuji, uture boe eegai rugadu. Nowu boe eiamedu boe eebogodure, ere Pao akaru kurido tuiegare tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Paerdu kigodukare awu inodu reoreboeji.
Jesus mare Levi.

b: Icare uture pugeje pobo maereu okwa kae pugeje. Nowu boe makareuge ere tudo pui ae, ure eerduwado.
source: Icare uture pugeje pobo maereu okwa kae pugeje. Nowu boe makareuge ere tudo pui ae, ure eerduwado.

b: Boekarema, tumerui nono du tabore icere jordure Levi, Alfeu onaregedu, mugui braei toe moridodu ja ira kejeduji. Icare akore ji: - Ako itabo! Icare ure turagojedo taci je, kodure apo.
source: Boekarema, tumerui nono du tabore icere jordure Levi, Alfeu onaregedu, mugui braei toe moridodu ja ira kejeduji. Icare akore ji: - Ako itabo! Icare ure turagojedo taci je, kodure apo.

b: Du kejere icare, ia meri keje, Jesus ure tumugudo togwagewo nowu Levi uwai tada. Boere toe mori maku aiwu makareuge, mare ro pegareuge makareuge ere tumugudo apo, mugui nowu tudugarege ebodu apo, paga karega, kodure pudabowuge emagaguragare.
source: Du kejere icare, ia meri keje, Jesus ure tumugudo togwagewo nowu Levi uwai tada. Boere toe mori maku aiwu makareuge, mare ro pegareuge makareuge ere tumugudo apo, mugui nowu tudugarege ebodu apo, paga karega, kodure pudabowuge emagaguragare.

b: Icare fariseudoge eno escribadoge, tuiordui okwagei ro pegareuge ebo, ure tugeragu brae emori jiwuge ebo duji du keje, egore ure jorduwadowuge ei: - Kodi icare, okwage nure ropegareuge ebo, publicanodoge ebo!
source: Icare fariseudoge eno escribadoge, tuiordui okwagei ro pegareuge ebo, ure tugeragu brae emori jiwuge ebo duji du keje, egore ure jorduwadowuge ei: - Kodi icare, okwage nure ropegareuge ebo, publicanodoge ebo!

b: Icare Jesus tumerdui egoinodu jitu du keje, akore: - Pemegareuge ewiapagakare jorubo kuru epa bogai mare kogodureuge u. Paga karega, itaregodure, mare imagowo pemegareuge ewogai karega, mare pegareuge ewogai.
source: Icare Jesus tumerdui egoinodu jitu du keje, akore: - Pemegareuge ewiapagakare jorubo kuru epa bogai mare kogodureuge u. Paga karega, itaregodure, mare imagowo pemegareuge ewogai karega, mare pegareuge ewogai.

b: Ia meri keje pugeje, João ure jorduwadowuge mare fariseudoge etodoroga nure pudui. Du kodire boe etaregodure ae tunorawo ji, egore: - Kodiba João ure jorduwadowuge mare fariseudoge etodorogare pudui, are jorduwadowuge rema, etodorogakare pudui?
source: Ia meri keje pugeje, João ure jorduwadowuge mare fariseudoge etodoroga nure pudui. Du kodire boe etaregodure ae tunorawo ji, egore: - Kodiba João ure jorduwadowuge mare fariseudoge etodorogare pudui, are jorduwadowuge rema, etodorogakare pudui?

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, kodiba bakaru makudure aiwuge etodorogamode pudui, tugodui nowu iera makudure toreduje aiwu apo du tonaji? Nowu tugodui apo du tonaji etodorogamodukare pudui.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, kodiba bakaru makudure aiwuge etodorogamode pudui, tugodui nowu iera makudure toreduje aiwu apo du tonaji? Nowu tugodui apo du tonaji etodorogamodukare pudui.

b: Ia meri aregodumode nowu tawujedumode epiji du kae, du keje etodorogamode pudui.
source: Ia meri aregodumode nowu tawujedumode epiji du kae, du keje etodorogamode pudui.

b: Boe emodukare aroia maiwu kobo bu aroia codureu poro keje; paga karega, aroia kobo maiwu umode aroia codureu ia okwa rawuje piji, du keje nowu mega pega jokodumode.
source: Boe emodukare aroia maiwu kobo bu aroia codureu poro keje; paga karega, aroia kobo maiwu umode aroia codureu ia okwa rawuje piji, du keje nowu mega pega jokodumode.

b:
Boe emodukare parera kuru maiwu tugu pori codureuto. Boe eromode ino ma, nowu kuru umode nowu pori bowuje ma, rugadu okwamode. Mare parera kuru maiwu jamode pori maiwuce.
Jesus ore Sábado rema.
source:
Boe emodukare parera kuru maiwu tugu pori codureuto. Boe eromode ino ma, nowu kuru umode nowu pori bowuje ma, rugadu okwamode. Mare parera kuru maiwu jamode pori maiwuce.
Jesus ore Sábado rema.

b: Sabadore jiwu meriji, Pagimejera meru nure boepadoge ekao, du tabore, kodure apowu ure jorduwadowuge ere tugeragu ia trigo enari boeji.
source: Sabadore jiwu meriji, Pagimejera meru nure boepadoge ekao, du tabore, kodure apowu ure jorduwadowuge ere tugeragu ia trigo enari boeji.

b: Icare fariseudoge egore ji: - Akaiwodo! Kodiba erore oinono sabadore jiwu meriji, boe eromodukare ino jiwu meriji?
source: Icare fariseudoge egore ji: - Akaiwodo! Kodiba erore oinono sabadore jiwu meriji, boe eromodukare ino jiwu meriji?

b: Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Tamagokare Davi jiwu bapera atugoji, cewu tuge boire puduidu kodiboe keje, ema mare nowu metage?
source: Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Tamagokare Davi jiwu bapera atugoji, cewu tuge boire puduidu kodiboe keje, ema mare nowu metage?

b: Kode, ure turemo Pao uwaito, Pao bure joiage eimejera iei Abiatar cedu kodiwu keje, ure enogwa kuridodure tabowu amireu kowuje, du tu Pao burejoiage emode kowuje, ure maku tumedage etai jamedu?
source: Kode, ure turemo Pao uwaito, Pao bure joiage eimejera iei Abiatar cedu kodiwu keje, ure enogwa kuridodure tabowu amireu kowuje, du tu Pao burejoiage emode kowuje, ure maku tumedage etai jamedu?

b: Icare akore ei pugeje: - Du kodire Imedu Onaregedu ore Sábado rema jamedu.
source: Icare akore ei pugeje: - Du kodire Imedu Onaregedu ore Sábado rema jamedu.

b: Jesus ui ia iera bireu imedu pemegagodu.
source: Jesus ui ia iera bireu imedu pemegagodu.

b: Ia kodiboe keje pugeje, Jesus ure turemo sinagogato pugeje; nonore ia imedu iera bireu muguradu nono.
source: Ia kodiboe keje pugeje, Jesus ure turemo sinagogato pugeje; nonore ia imedu iera bireu muguradu nono.

b: Icare (onare jiwuge) enoebatodure ji tuiorduwo iogomode ji sabadore jiwu meri keje du bogai, togiru pegawo jitu bogai.
source: Icare (onare jiwuge) enoebatodure ji tuiorduwo iogomode ji sabadore jiwu meri keje du bogai, togiru pegawo jitu bogai.

b: Icare akore nowu iera bireuji: - Mato boiado.
source: Icare akore nowu iera bireuji: - Mato boiado.

b: Icare unoragodure ei, akore: - Boe ero pemegamodukana, iarema boe ero pegamodukana sabadore jiwu meri keje? Boekana umode pu inorudo, iarema boekana umode pu bito?  Mare emagokare.
source: Icare unoragodure ei, akore: - Boe ero pemegamodukana, iarema boe ero pegamodukana sabadore jiwu meri keje? Boekana umode pu inorudo, iarema boekana umode pu bito?  Mare emagokare.

b: Du koiare ure tuioku okorido jice eiogi, kiarigodure tuiordui ewabo kugudukaduji, du keje icare akore nowu imeduji: - Akera inogido. Ure tugera inogido, du tonaji, iera pemegagodure.
source: Du koiare ure tuioku okorido jice eiogi, kiarigodure tuiordui ewabo kugudukaduji, du keje icare akore nowu imeduji: - Akera inogido. Ure tugera inogido, du tonaji, iera pemegagodure.

b:
Icare fariseudoge ere tudawuje nowu piji tumagowo herodianodogoei inoba turomode tuwo bito.
Jesus uwadodui ika tadadu pijidu.
source:
Icare fariseudoge ere tudawuje nowu piji tumagowo herodianodogoei inoba turomode tuwo bito.
Jesus uwadodui ika tadadu pijidu.

b: Jesus ure tudawuje ture jorduwadowuge ebo nowu kuruga kae. Ia boe makareuge etaregodui Galiléia pijidu ekodure apo.
source: Jesus ure tudawuje ture jorduwadowuge ebo nowu kuruga kae. Ia boe makareuge etaregodui Galiléia pijidu ekodure apo.

b: Judéia piji, Jerusalém piji, Idumeia piji, Jordão okwa bakoboe piji, Tiro, Sidão oieiboe piji, ia boe makareuge etaregodure ae, tumeardui roboe jitu koia.
source: Judéia piji, Jerusalém piji, Idumeia piji, Jordão okwa bakoboe piji, Tiro, Sidão oieiboe piji, ia boe makareuge etaregodure ae, tumeardui roboe jitu koia.

b: Icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiagu ika kurireu udo turugadu, nowu boe makareuge eiokawo tu tuwugeje.
source: Icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiagu ika kurireu udo turugadu, nowu boe makareuge eiokawo tu tuwugeje.

b: Ure iage epemegagodu makaguragado, du kodire kogodureuge eiamedu boe ere tuburedo jice ji, tugera jetuwo ji.
source: Ure iage epemegagodu makaguragado, du kodire kogodureuge eiamedu boe ere tuburedo jice ji, tugera jetuwo ji.

b: Aror pegareudoge eerdui jitu du keje ere tubujodo jokorai toiogwari tabo: - Aroe Eimejera Onaregedu nure aki.
source: Aror pegareudoge eerdui jitu du keje ere tubujodo jokorai toiogwari tabo: - Aroe Eimejera Onaregedu nure aki.

b:
Mako maere ei tumago okori tabo, ekawo boedo boe pa pudui.
Jesus ui tugeragu ture jorduwadowuge ei pagera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekoto duji pudaedu.
source:
Mako maere ei tumago okori tabo, ekawo boedo boe pa pudui.
Jesus ui tugeragu ture jorduwadowuge ei pagera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekoto duji pudaedu.

b: Du kejere Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae, makore taidure jiwuge ewogai. Eture ae.
source: Du kejere Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae, makore taidure jiwuge ewogai. Eture ae.

b: Ure togiegi etoiado jetumode pudabowugei, du ere ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekoto.
source: Ure togiegi etoiado jetumode pudabowugei, du ere ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekoto.

b: Umode etudo boe etae, ewadoduwo boei, tui ero raka maku etai ewo  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu du bogai.
source: Umode etudo boe etae, ewadoduwo boei, tui ero raka maku etai ewo  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu du bogai.

b: Ure togiegi awugei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotowugei: Simão iei Pedro cedu.
source: Ure togiegi awugei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotowugei: Simão iei Pedro cedu.

b:
Nowu Zebedeu onaregedu iei Tiago cedu, mare uwie João, duwugere ure eiedo 
Boiaruru Ore oino ei.
source:
Nowu Zebedeu onaregedu iei Tiago cedu, mare uwie João, duwugere ure eiedo 
Boiaruru Ore oino ei.

b: André, Filipe, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago nowu Alfeu onaregedu, Tadeu, Simão Aiworeu.
source: André, Filipe, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago nowu Alfeu onaregedu, Tadeu, Simão Aiworeu.

b: Mare Judas Iscariote, duwu koiare ure maku.
source: Mare Judas Iscariote, duwu koiare ure maku.

b: Du kejere, ere tuiodo tuwugeje taci tuwai kae. Du kaere ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui ae pugeje, du koiare eroiwakare tuwo boe kowuje jamedu.
source: Du kejere, ere tuiodo tuwugeje taci tuwai kae. Du kaere ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui ae pugeje, du koiare eroiwakare tuwo boe kowuje jamedu.

b: Icare uwobe emeardui nowu inoduji du keje, eture jice ae, tuwo tugeragu ji, paga karega, egore: - Aora bai bai nure.
source: Icare uwobe emeardui nowu inoduji du keje, eture jice ae, tuwo tugeragu ji, paga karega, egore: - Aora bai bai nure.

b: Jamedu, cewu ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu escribadoge egore: - Aroe pegareu  meture tada.  Aroe pegareuge eimejera koiare ure  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu.
source: Jamedu, cewu ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu escribadoge egore: - Aroe pegareu  meture tada.  Aroe pegareuge eimejera koiare ure  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu.

b: Jesus rema, ure edo tudo pui puae, icare makore ei awu bakaru tabo: - Inoba Aroe pegareu  romode tuwo Aroe pegareu  barigu?
source: Jesus rema, ure edo tudo pui puae, icare makore ei awu bakaru tabo: - Inoba Aroe pegareu  romode tuwo Aroe pegareu  barigu?

b: Kode, ia jeture to moto kejewuge emode tudo tuginoi ma, eragoje raimodukare.
source: Kode, ia jeture to moto kejewuge emode tudo tuginoi ma, eragoje raimodukare.

b: Jamedu, ia boe etuwobe emode tudo tuginoi ma, umode tudo pubiji, eragoje raimodukare jamedu.
source: Jamedu, ia boe etuwobe emode tudo tuginoi ma, umode tudo pubiji, eragoje raimodukare jamedu.

b: Aror pegareu umode tawogado pudui ma, umode tudo puibiji, du utumodukare todobiji, mare akedu rumode.
source: Aror pegareu umode tawogado pudui ma, umode tudo puibiji, du utumodukare todobiji, mare akedu rumode.

b: Iaboe iaboe eroiwamodukare tuwo turemo ia ro rakare imedu uwaito ciwoguwo ia oroeji tukai kogudo du keje. Mare tui kogudo du kejere, eiwogumode oroeji uwai piji.
source: Iaboe iaboe eroiwamodukare tuwo turemo ia ro rakare imedu uwaito ciwoguwo ia oroeji tukai kogudo du keje. Mare tui kogudo du kejere, eiwogumode oroeji uwai piji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ime ero pegareu jamedu boe butugugodaemode, jamedu ewadaru pegareu jamedu boe jamedu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ime ero pegareu jamedu boe butugugodaemode, jamedu ewadaru pegareu jamedu boe jamedu.

b: Mare cewu bataru pegare Aroe Pemegareu jiwuge, butugugodaemodukare ji jii je, mare nowu ero pegareu okwamodukare epiji jii je.
source: Mare cewu bataru pegare Aroe Pemegareu jiwuge, butugugodaemodukare ji jii je, mare nowu ero pegareu okwamodukare epiji jii je.

b:
Jesus akore oino, mare paga tu je karega, egore: - Aroe pegareu  meture tada. oino ji, du koiare akoino.
Jesus uwobe remawuge.
source:
Jesus akore oino, mare paga tu je karega, egore: - Aroe pegareu  meture tada. oino ji, du koiare akoino.
Jesus uwobe remawuge.

b: Uce aregodure uwiemage ebo, eedure toro baawadu keje, du pijire ere boe emagodo bogai.
source: Uce aregodure uwiemage ebo, eedure toro baawadu keje, du pijire ere boe emagodo bogai.

b: Boekarema, boe makareuge eedure nono tumago tabo oiei du egore ji: - Ace rakojere nono baawadu keje awiemage ebo, eemaru nure awogai.
source: Boekarema, boe makareuge eedure nono tumago tabo oiei du egore ji: - Ace rakojere nono baawadu keje awiemage ebo, eemaru nure awogai.

b: Icare akore ei: - Ioguduba imuga rema, ioguduba mageba iwiemagere emage?
source: Icare akore ei: - Ioguduba imuga rema, ioguduba mageba iwiemagere emage?

b: Icare tui tuioku maedo nowu jeture pudabowuge eiogi du keje, akore: - Imuga reo, iwiemage reo.
source: Icare tui tuioku maedo nowu jeture pudabowuge eiogi du keje, akore: - Imuga reo, iwiemage reo.

b: Cewu rore nono Pao aidu reoreu, nowu iwie nure ema, ituie nure ema, imuga nure ema.
source: Cewu rore nono Pao aidu reoreu, nowu iwie nure ema, ituie nure ema, imuga nure ema.

b: Ure boe a tuguwu jiwu bakaru.
source: Ure boe a tuguwu jiwu bakaru.

b: Jesus ure boe eerduwado pugeje kuruga kurireu jipa keje. Boe makareuge ere tudo pui apo pugeje, du koia ure taredo ika kurireuto, nowu pobo maereu tada. Nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe eedure nono moto keje pobo okwai.
source: Jesus ure boe eerduwado pugeje kuruga kurireu jipa keje. Boe makareuge ere tudo pui apo pugeje, du koia ure taredo ika kurireuto, nowu pobo maereu tada. Nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe eedure nono moto keje pobo okwai.

b: Ure kogado ewiegaiboe kuricigo, bakaru tabo.
source: Ure kogado ewiegaiboe kuricigo, bakaru tabo.

b: Akore: - Tawiapagado. Ure boe a tuguwu uture to boepato tuwu boe a tugu.
source: Akore: - Tawiapagado. Ure boe a tuguwu uture to boepato tuwu boe a tugu.

b: Ui boe a tugu du tonaji, ia boe a buture awara okwai; kiege barege etaregodure, ere kowuje.
source: Ui boe a tugu du tonaji, ia boe a buture awara okwai; kiege barege etaregodure, ere kowuje.

b: Ia a buture toripegato, moto okwatorukareu keje. Du a boture kuri je, paga karega, moto okwatorukare jitu kodi.
source: Ia a buture toripegato, moto okwatorukareu keje. Du a boture kuri je, paga karega, moto okwatorukare jitu kodi.

b: Mare meri joku aregodure kuri je, kowudure, kidure kuri je ukwa bokware du kodi.
source: Mare meri joku aregodure kuri je, kowudure, kidure kuri je ukwa bokware du kodi.

b: Ia a buture botoguru, du botoguruto boture, ure cewu a boturedu bito, du enari bokware.
source: Ia a buture botoguru, du botoguruto boture, ure cewu a boturedu bito, du enari bokware.

b: Ia a buture moto pemegareuto. Ricodure, ure turugadu, enari boture, du ia aregodure trinta kae, ia aregodure sessenta kae, ia aregodure cem kae.
source: Ia a buture moto pemegareuto. Ricodure, ure turugadu, enari boture, du ia aregodure trinta kae, ia aregodure sessenta kae, ia aregodure cem kae.

b: Icare akore: - Biajareu, meardumode.
source: Icare akore: - Biajareu, meardumode.

b: Du keje icare, tuiedui tuginoi du keje, nowu jeture oieiwuge, mare ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji inoba nowu bakaru jiba akoino.
source: Du keje icare, tuiedui tuginoi du keje, nowu jeture oieiwuge, mare ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji inoba nowu bakaru jiba akoino.

b: Icare akore ei: - Taire boe biareu Pao o boe pemegareu kogadodure, mare okwacere awu inodu pijiwuge eire boe emagore awu inodu jameduji bakaru tabo.
source: Icare akore ei: - Taire boe biareu Pao o boe pemegareu kogadodure, mare okwacere awu inodu pijiwuge eire boe emagore awu inodu jameduji bakaru tabo.

b: Awu inodu tabo, etaiwore tuiorduka du tabo, emeardure tukai pawuje du tabo, tukai tubemegado, du koiare ero pegareu butugugodae bokware.
source: Awu inodu tabo, etaiwore tuiorduka du tabo, emeardure tukai pawuje du tabo, tukai tubemegado, du koiare ero pegareu butugugodae bokware.

b: Icare akore ei pugeje: - Takare awu bakaru pawuje?
source: Icare akore ei pugeje: - Takare awu bakaru pawuje?

b: Ure boe a tuguwu ure nono ure Pao bataru aododureu rema.
source: Ure boe a tuguwu ure nono ure Pao bataru aododureu rema.

b: Cewu ia a buture awara kejedu ure nono cewu meardure Pao bataru jiwu, mare meardui jitu keje kuri je, Aroe pegareu  aregodure, ure tawuje piji.
source: Cewu ia a buture awara kejedu ure nono cewu meardure Pao bataru jiwu, mare meardui jitu keje kuri je, Aroe pegareu  aregodure, ure tawuje piji.

b: Iage ere nono cewu a buture toripegatowu reore, tumeardui jitu keje ere tugeragu ji tuiegare tabo.
source: Iage ere nono cewu a buture toripegatowu reore, tumeardui jitu keje ere tugeragu ji tuiegare tabo.

b: Mare ukwa bokware du koia, ukwa rekare kao du koiare, eroiwakare pudabo, icare ia boe pegareu, boe etonare puiwu aregodure nowu bakaru koia ma, erore domi domi je.
source: Mare ukwa bokware du koia, ukwa rekare kao du koiare, eroiwakare pudabo, icare ia boe pegareu, boe etonare puiwu aregodure nowu bakaru koia ma, erore domi domi je.

b: Iage pugeje, a makudure etai botoguru tada: emeardure Pao bataruji.
source: Iage pugeje, a makudure etai botoguru tada: emeardure Pao bataruji.

b: Mare awu moto kejewu boe ero boe ego boe, boe ewiapagai toroe kurireu bogaidu, boe emeardae pegareu boe, ure inodu okwadu, du koia otojiwu boe pemegareu bokware.
source: Mare awu moto kejewu boe ero boe ego boe, boe ewiapagai toroe kurireu bogaidu, boe emeardae pegareu boe, ure inodu okwadu, du koia otojiwu boe pemegareu bokware.

b:
Cewu a buture moto pemegareu kejewu ure nono meardure bataru jiwuge, ere tugeragu ji, duwu otojiwu boe pemegareu ure trinta, ure sessenta, ure cem tubemega tabo.
Jorugu jiwu bakaru.
source:
Cewu a buture moto pemegareu kejewu ure nono meardure bataru jiwuge, ere tugeragu ji, duwu otojiwu boe pemegareu ure trinta, ure sessenta, ure cem tubemega tabo.
Jorugu jiwu bakaru.

b: Akore ei jamedu: - Boe emodukana jorugu mugudo ruwobo kuda, iarema kamoreu kuda? Kode mugudodumodukare jorugu tumuga keje karega?
source: Akore ei jamedu: - Boe emodukana jorugu mugudo ruwobo kuda, iarema kamoreu kuda? Kode mugudodumodukare jorugu tumuga keje karega?

b: Ia jetu biadodureu jamedu boe, jetu biadodumodukare. Nowu boe enogwa podure jiboe jamedu boe, awadudodumode jamedu.
source: Ia jetu biadodureu jamedu boe, jetu biadodumodukare. Nowu boe enogwa podure jiboe jamedu boe, awadudodumode jamedu.

b: Biajareu meardumode.
source: Biajareu meardumode.

b: Akore pugeje: - Tameardu awadudo tai nowu tameardure jiboeji. Tago boe remagudu reorere taremagudodumode jamedu, du kodumode gu tugori.
source: Akore pugeje: - Tameardu awadudo tai nowu tameardure jiboeji. Tago boe remagudu reorere taremagudodumode jamedu, du kodumode gu tugori.

b:
Oroereu, ia makudumode pemega ai pugeje; ia boekare apowu, ure tu apoboe arudumode piji.
Boe a boturedu jiwu bakaru.
source:
Oroereu, ia makudumode pemega ai pugeje; ia boekare apowu, ure tu apoboe arudumode piji.
Boe a boturedu jiwu bakaru.

b: Akore jamedu: - Pao o boe pemegareu ure nono cewu imedu magai boe a roto ja ja toro moto joki reore.
source: Akore jamedu: - Pao o boe pemegareu ure nono cewu imedu magai boe a roto ja ja toro moto joki reore.

b: Boecodure, undure, barogwa kododu tabore ure turagojedo. Nowu inodu tonaji, cewu ure tuguboe boture, ukadui boe pa du tabo.
source: Boecodure, undure, barogwa kododu tabore ure turagojedo. Nowu inodu tonaji, cewu ure tuguboe boture, ukadui boe pa du tabo.

b: Paga karega moto taobiji rugadure ure botudo, ure ira botudo, du a makaguragare cirato.
source: Paga karega moto taobiji rugadure ure botudo, ure ira botudo, du a makaguragare cirato.

b:
Icare, kidure du keje, ure jepara to ji, mare paga karega, boe aregodure boewo tugeragu ji du kae du kodi. 
Mostarda a jiwu bakaru.
source:
Icare, kidure du keje, ure jepara to ji, mare paga karega, boe aregodure boewo tugeragu ji du kae du kodi. 
Mostarda a jiwu bakaru.

b: Akore jamedu: Kakoduwuba pamode remagu Pao o boe pemegareuji? Iarema kakoduwu bakaruba pamode jebato nowu inoduji?
source: Akore jamedu: Kakoduwuba pamode remagu Pao o boe pemegareuji? Iarema kakoduwu bakaruba pamode jebato nowu inoduji?

b: Ure nono mostarda a biega reore du, tugudure du keje, a biega rogu remawure areboe jamedu boe kori.
source: Ure nono mostarda a biega reore du, tugudure du keje, a biega rogu remawure areboe jamedu boe kori.

b: Mare a tugudu rekodaji, ricodure, kurire nowu tugudure nono boe jamedu boe kori, iturare tumaedo, du inodu koia, kiege barege ere tamudo utugu tada.
source: Mare a tugudu rekodaji, ricodure, kurire nowu tugudure nono boe jamedu boe kori, iturare tumaedo, du inodu koia, kiege barege ere tamudo utugu tada.

b: Ure Pao bataru kogado ei makareu bakaru tabo, awuge ekodaji rugadu, uwo nono eroiwa reore bogai.
source: Ure Pao bataru kogado ei makareu bakaru tabo, awuge ekodaji rugadu, uwo nono eroiwa reore bogai.

b:
Makore ei, mare tu bakaru tabo. Mare nowu ture jorduwadowuge ei, ure jamedu boe kogadu tu tuginoi.



Jesus ure pobo bakuru maereu butugugo.
source:
Makore ei, mare tu bakaru tabo. Mare nowu ture jorduwadowuge ei, ure jamedu boe kogadu tu tuginoi.



Jesus ure pobo bakuru maereu butugugo.

b: Nowu meri rekodu tabo, akore ei: - Pawo pagado toro bakowuto.
source: Nowu meri rekodu tabo, akore ei: - Pawo pagado toro bakowuto.

b: Boe eedui nono du piji ere Jesus kodudo pudabo, nono tumagai du reorere, ika kurireu tada. Ia ikadoge ekodure meji.
source: Boe eedui nono du piji ere Jesus kodudo pudabo, nono tumagai du reorere, ika kurireu tada. Ia ikadoge ekodure meji.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji, ia boe pegareu ure tudowuje. Du kodiwu koia ure pobo barigu ika kurireuto, du koia okorobadugodure pobo tabo.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji, ia boe pegareu ure tudowuje. Du kodiwu koia ure pobo barigu ika kurireuto, du koia okorobadugodure pobo tabo.

b: Jesusrema padure ika kurireu opo jaogwai, tunu tabo, tao kudawu keje. Ere jetadudo, egore ji: - Cegimejera, aromodukare gara gara cai pawogwagodure duji?
source: Jesusrema padure ika kurireu opo jaogwai, tunu tabo, tao kudawu keje. Ere jetadudo, egore ji: - Cegimejera, aromodukare gara gara cai pawogwagodure duji?

b: Icare ure turagojedo, makore bakuruji, makore pobo maereuji, akore:  - Ieripo! Urugadu!  Icare bakuru akedure, boe motureu nure pugeje.
source: Icare ure turagojedo, makore bakuruji, makore pobo maereuji, akore:  - Ieripo! Urugadu!  Icare bakuru akedure, boe motureu nure pugeje.

b: Icare akore ei: Mure, tabagudu remawu radure. Tameartoru bokwa kimo rabodu!
source: Icare akore ei: Mure, tabagudu remawu radure. Tameartoru bokwa kimo rabodu!

b: Enogorobadure tubagudu koia, egore jice woje pui: - Kakoduwu imedubao? Duwu bakuru, pobo maereu emeartorure bataruji?
source: Enogorobadure tubagudu koia, egore jice woje pui: - Kakoduwu imedubao? Duwu bakuru, pobo maereu emeartorure bataruji?

b: Aroe pegareuge emedure tadawu imedu.
source: Aroe pegareuge emedure tadawu imedu.

b: Ere pagado kuruga okwa bakowu kae, Gerasa kejewuge eno moto kae.
source: Ere pagado kuruga okwa bakowu kae, Gerasa kejewuge eno moto kae.

b: Ei turawuje ika kurireu piji du keje kuri je, ia imedu Aroe pegareu  metui tadadu ure tuiebu bireuge eiao piji, kodure jice Jesus togi.
source: Ei turawuje ika kurireu piji du keje kuri je, ia imedu Aroe pegareu  metui tadadu ure tuiebu bireuge eiao piji, kodure jice Jesus togi.

b: Mugu mugure aroe eiao kao, boe eroiwakare tuwo ieragogudo, jamedu meriri iku tabo karega jamedu.
source: Mugu mugure aroe eiao kao, boe eroiwakare tuwo ieragogudo, jamedu meriri iku tabo karega jamedu.

b: Ica, boe erore ino ji, mare ure rugadu kado kado, iaboe iaboe eroiwakare ji.
source: Ica, boe erore ino ji, mare ure rugadu kado kado, iaboe iaboe eroiwakare ji.

b: Boe jameduji, meri jameduji meru merure bireuge eiao kao, tori raireu boe kao, toiogwari tabo, tui togorido tori boe tabo.
source: Boe jameduji, meri jameduji meru merure bireuge eiao kao, tori raireu boe kao, toiogwari tabo, tui togorido tori boe tabo.

b: Boekarema, tuiordui Jesusji jaegiri du keje, rekodure jice togi, ure tubujodo ji, makore ji toiogwari rakareu tabo.
source: Boekarema, tuiordui Jesusji jaegiri du keje, rekodure jice togi, ure tubujodo ji, makore ji toiogwari rakareu tabo.

b: Akore: - Kaba jiba akaidure ii, Jesus, Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu Onaregedu? Inogwamagudu nure ai Pao ie tabo, arokaba ia aro ii!
source: Akore: - Kaba jiba akaidure ii, Jesus, Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu Onaregedu? Inogwamagudu nure ai Pao ie tabo, arokaba ia aro ii!

b: Paga karega, Jesus akore ji: - Aroe pegareu  pegareu, atawuje nowu imedu piji.
source: Paga karega, Jesus akore ji: - Aroe pegareu  pegareu, atawuje nowu imedu piji.

b: Du kejere Jesus unoragodure ji: - Inoba akiere?  Akore: - Ikiere makareuge, oinodu rema, cemagaguragare kodi.
source: Du kejere Jesus unoragodure ji: - Inoba akiere?  Akore: - Ikiere makareuge, oinodu rema, cemagaguragare kodi.

b: Enogwamagudure ji ukawo tuwarigu nowu tumugurewo piji.
source: Enogwamagudure ji ukawo tuwarigu nowu tumugurewo piji.

b: Boekarema, jugoreuge enogwagere nono torekodu parugajeje.
source: Boekarema, jugoreuge enogwagere nono torekodu parugajeje.

b: Icare nowu  Aroe pegareuge emagore ji, enogwamagudure ji, egore: - Cedudo jewu jugoreuge etae, cewo cedugu eto.
source: Icare nowu  Aroe pegareuge emagore ji, enogwamagudure ji, egore: - Cedudo jewu jugoreuge etae, cewo cedugu eto.

b: Jesus udo ino rugadu. Kodire  Aroe pegareuge ere tudawuje, ere tudugu jugoreuge eto. Nowu makareuge ei 2.000 cedu, ere tuwarigu pobo maereuto, ewogware poboto, ewire.
source: Jesus udo ino rugadu. Kodire  Aroe pegareuge ere tudawuje, ere tudugu jugoreuge eto. Nowu makareuge ei 2.000 cedu, ere tuwarigu pobo maereuto, ewogware poboto, ewire.

b: Icare cewu jeture nowu jugoreuge eiwuge, eregodure, ereadodure nowu boerewoji nowu bakurireu tada, oiei jamedu.
source: Icare cewu jeture nowu jugoreuge eiwuge, eregodure, ereadodure nowu boerewoji nowu bakurireu tada, oiei jamedu.

b: Icare ere tuburedo jice Jesusji, eerdure cewu Aroe pegareu  meture tadawu mugui tu, ukudawu aroia padui kejeduji, du kioroi tu je duji, emaia cewu Aroe pegareu  makareuge emedure tada. Icare epagudugodu ure tubodo ebo.
source: Icare ere tuburedo jice Jesusji, eerdure cewu Aroe pegareu  meture tadawu mugui tu, ukudawu aroia padui kejeduji, du kioroi tu je duji, emaia cewu Aroe pegareu  makareuge emedure tada. Icare epagudugodu ure tubodo ebo.

b: Jordureuge enogwa jeture nowu Aroe pegareu  meture tadawu jiboeji, nowu jugoreuge eiboeji jamedu.
source: Jordureuge enogwa jeture nowu Aroe pegareu  meture tadawu jiboeji, nowu jugoreuge eiboeji jamedu.

b: Kodi icare nowu boe enogwamagudure ji uwo turodo oino nowu eno moto piji.
source: Kodi icare nowu boe enogwamagudure ji uwo turodo oino nowu eno moto piji.

b: Ui taredo ika kurireuto du tonaji, cewu ure  Aroe pegareuge etawuje pijiwu imedu aregodure mato ae, togwamaguduwo ji umode tugodudo apo du bogai.
source: Ui taredo ika kurireuto du tonaji, cewu ure  Aroe pegareuge etawuje pijiwu imedu aregodure mato ae, togwamaguduwo ji umode tugodudo apo du bogai.

b: Mare Jesus akore ji: - Umodukare ino. Atumode awai kae, toro awobe etae, areadoduwo Pao ro pemegareu kurireuji, inoba okudure akabo duji ewiegai.
source: Mare Jesus akore ji: - Umodukare ino. Atumode awai kae, toro awobe etae, areadoduwo Pao ro pemegareu kurireuji, inoba okudure akabo duji ewiegai.

b:
Kodi icare uture, icare readodure nowu bakurireuge etada Jesus ro pemegare puduiboe jamedu boeji. Kodi icare nowu boe erore ta... je.
Jairo okwamagudae.
source:
Kodi icare uture, icare readodure nowu bakurireuge etada Jesus ro pemegare puduiboe jamedu boeji. Kodi icare nowu boe erore ta... je.
Jairo okwamagudae.

b: Jesus ure pagado bakowu kae pugeje, du keje boe makereuge ere tudo pui ae pugeje.
source: Jesus ure pagado bakowu kae pugeje, du keje boe makereuge ere tudo pui ae pugeje.

b: Mugure pobo maereu okwai, du keje, sinagoga kejewuge ia eimejera iei Jairo cedu, kodure ae, ure tuwarigu jice bure paru.
source: Mugure pobo maereu okwai, du keje, sinagoga kejewuge ia eimejera iei Jairo cedu, kodure ae, ure tuwarigu jice bure paru.

b: Okwamagudure ji, akore: - Itonaregedu aredu okwa puredugodu. Mato, awo akera bu keje ma, bi kawo, mare jewo pugeje.
source: Okwamagudure ji, akore: - Itonaregedu aredu okwa puredugodu. Mato, awo akera bu keje ma, bi kawo, mare jewo pugeje.

b: Jesus kodure apo, boe makareuge ekodure apo tuioi tu keje du tabo.
source: Jesus kodure apo, boe makareuge ekodure apo tuioi tu keje du tabo.

b: Kode, arire turopegado ia aredu jitu, jorui ikera pudogidure iwurekoto pobe taci jedu, muguradu nono.
source: Kode, arire turopegado ia aredu jitu, jorui ikera pudogidure iwurekoto pobe taci jedu, muguradu nono.

b: Jiwo kuricigore jorubokuru epage brae ekera keje, tui toroe jamedu maku etai du tabo, tuiordukai tu tugiwaripomodedu bogai, mare tubegagodui gu gu je duji.
source: Jiwo kuricigore jorubokuru epage brae ekera keje, tui toroe jamedu maku etai du tabo, tuiordukai tu tugiwaripomodedu bogai, mare tubegagodui gu gu je duji.

b: Tumeardui Jesus akaru jitu keje, kodure jice rekodaji, boe makareuge ekao, icare iera jeture ukudaeji.
source: Tumeardui Jesus akaru jitu keje, kodure jice rekodaji, boe makareuge ekao, icare iera jeture ukudaeji.

b: Akore pudui taobiji: - Ikera jetumode ukudae okwa roguji ma, ipemegagodumode.
source: Akore pudui taobiji: - Ikera jetumode ukudae okwa roguji ma, ipemegagodumode.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu epae akedure taci je, ure boe pa tuie turugadu duji.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu epae akedure taci je, ure boe pa tuie turugadu duji.

b: Du tabore icare Jesus ure boe pawuje kuri ia turo rakareuie tudawuje tubiji duji. Ure tuie kirimi nowu boei, akore: - Ioguduba iera jeture ikudaeji?
source: Du tabore icare Jesus ure boe pawuje kuri ia turo rakareuie tudawuje tubiji duji. Ure tuie kirimi nowu boei, akore: - Ioguduba iera jeture ikudaeji?

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge egore ji: - Aerudu nure oino awu boe makareuge eioi tu awugeje duji, mare du inodu tabo anorare: - Ioguduba iera jeture ii?
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge egore ji: - Aerudu nure oino awu boe makareuge eioi tu awugeje duji, mare du inodu tabo anorare: - Ioguduba iera jeture ii?

b: Icare ure tuiemaedo toiei tuiorduwo ioguduba roinodu bogai.
source: Icare ure tuiemaedo toiei tuiorduwo ioguduba roinodu bogai.

b: Kode, nowu aredu tamagadui tubagudu koia du tabore, jorduware inoba boeie pudui duji, ure tuwarigu jice bure paru kae, icare readodure biegai boe jokoduboe remawu jameduji.
source: Kode, nowu aredu tamagadui tubagudu koia du tabore, jorduware inoba boeie pudui duji, ure tuwarigu jice bure paru kae, icare readodure biegai boe jokoduboe remawu jameduji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: -Itonaregedu, ameartoraere akinorudo. Toro boe pemegai ai du tabo. Akogodae jamedu boere tuwuredo.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: -Itonaregedu, ameartoraere akinorudo. Toro boe pemegai ai du tabo. Akogodae jamedu boere tuwuredo.

b: Mako kimo oinodu otoi, ia aregodure sinagoga kejewuge eimejera uwai piji, tagoi: - Akonaregedu nogwaredu rogu bire; kode kodiba amagomode pagimejeraji kimo?
source: Mako kimo oinodu otoi, ia aregodure sinagoga kejewuge eimejera uwai piji, tagoi: - Akonaregedu nogwaredu rogu bire; kode kodiba amagomode pagimejeraji kimo?

b: Jesus, tumeardui inodu jitu keje, makore sinagoga kejewuge eimejeraji, akore: - Apagudu kaba, mare ameartorudo tu je.
source: Jesus, tumeardui inodu jitu keje, makore sinagoga kejewuge eimejeraji, akore: - Apagudu kaba, mare ameartorudo tu je.

b: Ukare iaboe iaboe ekodudo pudabo, mare Pedro, Tiago, uwie João, tu je.
source: Ukare iaboe iaboe ekodudo pudabo, mare Pedro, Tiago, uwie João, tu je.

b: Taregodui sinagoga kejewuge eimejera uwai kae du keje, jordure boe ekodui jice woje, jice woje, toragudu tabo, tui maidodu tabo duji.
source: Taregodui sinagoga kejewuge eimejera uwai kae du keje, jordure boe ekodui jice woje, jice woje, toragudu tabo, tui maidodu tabo duji.

b: Icare ure tuiodo eto, akore ei: - Kodiba awu boe enoiogwarire oino? Etoragudure oino? Nogwaredu rogu bika, unudu nure.
source: Icare ure tuiodo eto, akore ei: - Kodiba awu boe enoiogwarire oino? Etoragudure oino? Nogwaredu rogu bika, unudu nure.

b: Mare enogwarigodure ji. Icare ure boe eiamedu boedo tudawuje nowu piji, ure tugeragu uoji, uceji, ure tugeragu cewu pudabowugei, ure turemo ebo.
source: Mare enogwarigodure ji. Icare ure boe eiamedu boedo tudawuje nowu piji, ure tugeragu uoji, uceji, ure tugeragu cewu pudabowugei, ure turemo ebo.

b: Ure tugera kogudo nowu nogwaredu rogu iera kajeje, akore ji: - Talita kum. Nowu akoinodu ure oino: - Nogwaredu rogu, inagore ai: Aragojedo.
source: Ure tugera kogudo nowu nogwaredu rogu iera kajeje, akore ji: - Talita kum. Nowu akoinodu ure oino: - Nogwaredu rogu, inagore ai: Aragojedo.

b: Nowu inodu keje kuri je, nowu nogwaredu rogure turagojedo, icare merure (O joru buture ikera pudogidure iwure awubowuto pobe). Nowu jeture apowu boe epagudugodu kuricigore.
source: Nowu inodu keje kuri je, nowu nogwaredu rogure turagojedo, icare merure (O joru buture ikera pudogidure iwure awubowuto pobe). Nowu jeture apowu boe epagudugodu kuricigore.

b: Ure tumago okorido nowu boei akore ei emago kaiagu iaboe iaboe ewiegai. Icare akore eiagu okwagedo.
source: Ure tumago okorido nowu boei akore ei emago kaiagu iaboe iaboe ewiegai. Icare akore eiagu okwagedo.

b: Jesus rakojei Nazaré kejedu.
source: Jesus rakojei Nazaré kejedu.

b: Du kejere uture nowu piji to moto kae, ure jorduwadowuge ekodure apo.
source: Du kejere uture nowu piji to moto kae, ure jorduwadowuge ekodure apo.

b: Sabadore jiwu meri aregodure du keje, ure sinagoga kejewuge eerduwado pugeje. Makareuge ewiapagare du eebogodu kurire tuieroi ta je du tabo, egore: - Kaiba awu inoduboe aregodure ae? Inoba kodiba awu ro pemegareu kurireu padure iera keje?
source: Sabadore jiwu meri aregodure du keje, ure sinagoga kejewuge eerduwado pugeje. Makareuge ewiapagare du eebogodu kurire tuieroi ta je du tabo, egore: - Kaiba awu inoduboe aregodure ae? Inoba kodiba awu ro pemegareu kurireu padure iera keje?

b: Cewu ira epa onaregedu karega? Uce karega Maria rema? Tiago, José, Judas, Simão etuwie karegao? Utuiemage emugukare woe cedabo?  Ekare boe pawuje kakoduwuba.
source: Cewu ira epa onaregedu karega? Uce karega Maria rema? Tiago, José, Judas, Simão etuwie karegao? Utuiemage emugukare woe cedabo?  Ekare boe pawuje kakoduwuba.

b: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ia bakaru pemegareu epa, barigudure pudui to moto keje, tuwobe etada, tuwai keje tu rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ia bakaru pemegareu epa, barigudure pudui to moto keje, tuwobe etada, tuwai keje tu rugadu.

b: Roiwakare tuwo ia turo pemegareu kurireu kuo nono. Ure ia kogodureuge enowaroi tu je du epemegago, tui tugera bu ewugeje du tabo.
source: Roiwakare tuwo ia turo pemegareu kurireu kuo nono. Ure ia kogodureuge enowaroi tu je du epemegago, tui tugera bu ewugeje du tabo.

b:
Jerore ta, emeartoru bokware duji. Kodure jice, kodure woje, tui boe eerduwado du tabo.
Apostolodoge emaragodae.
source:
Jerore ta, emeartoru bokware duji. Kodure jice, kodure woje, tui boe eerduwado du tabo.
Apostolodoge emaragodae.

b: Nowu kodi, makore ture jorduwadowugei, ure edo pobe tu tu tu, ure ero raka maku etai Aroe pegareu dogei.
source: Nowu kodi, makore ture jorduwadowugei, ure edo pobe tu tu tu, ure ero raka maku etai Aroe pegareu dogei.

b: Akore ekaiagu iaboe iaboe reko awaraji, mare tu ioto rugadu. Amireu karega, kodorabo karega, diiero metui tugajejewu tadadu karega jamedu.
source: Akore ekaiagu iaboe iaboe reko awaraji, mare tu ioto rugadu. Amireu karega, kodorabo karega, diiero metui tugajejewu tadadu karega jamedu.

b: Ewure tadawu kaiagu jamedu, mare ewurekia kejewu tu rugadu. Ekaiagu tugudaedo pobe pudui.
source: Ewure tadawu kaiagu jamedu, mare ewurekia kejewu tu rugadu. Ekaiagu tugudaedo pobe pudui.

b: Akore ei jamedu: - Tamode taremo ia baito du keje, taedu rugadu tu nono jii tadu kae.
source: Akore ei jamedu: - Tamode taremo ia baito du keje, taedu rugadu tu nono jii tadu kae.

b: Ia boe eeda keje boe emodukare tugeragu tai, ewiapagamodukare tai ma, tadudo nowu piji, tawure jukodo moto uruguduji, uwo nono inodu padui eporu kejedu kodiwore.
source: Ia boe eeda keje boe emodukare tugeragu tai, ewiapagamodukare tai ma, tadudo nowu piji, tawure jukodo moto uruguduji, uwo nono inodu padui eporu kejedu kodiwore.

b: Icare eture, enogituware boei boe etodorogawo pudui.
source: Icare eture, enogituware boei boe etodorogawo pudui.

b:
Ere makareu  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu, ewarigu, eiogore makareu kogodureugei boe kaguru tabo, du ere epemegago.
João Batista biredu.
source:
Ere makareu  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu, ewarigu, eiogore makareu kogodureugei boe kaguru tabo, du ere epemegago.
João Batista biredu.

b: Brae eimejera Herodes meardure boe emagoi Jesus jituji, du ie kurigoduie ure duji. Icare akore pudui: - João Batista jewodure bireuge epiji, nowu inodu koia, ure turo pemegareu kurireu towuje.
source: Brae eimejera Herodes meardure boe emagoi Jesus jituji, du ie kurigoduie ure duji. Icare akore pudui: - João Batista jewodure bireuge epiji, nowu inodu koia, ure turo pemegareu kurireu towuje.

b: Iage egore: -Elias reno. Iage egore: - Ia tumedage ereoreo profeta reno.
source: Iage egore: -Elias reno. Iage egore: - Ia tumedage ereoreo profeta reno.

b: Herodes, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, akore pugeje: - João, cewu ire itoru kadowu reno, duwu jewodure.
source: Herodes, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, akore pugeje: - João, cewu ire itoru kadowu reno, duwu jewodure.

b: Paga karega, emare ure João ieragogudo meriri tabo baicoreu tada, Herodiades tuwie Filipe oreduje, du apore mugure, du koia.
source: Paga karega, emare ure João ieragogudo meriri tabo baicoreu tada, Herodiades tuwie Filipe oreduje, du apore mugure, du koia.

b: João makore Herodeji: - Ukare turugadu amuguwo awie oreduje apo.
source: João makore Herodeji: - Ukare turugadu amuguwo awie oreduje apo.

b: Du kodire Herodades kodu kagirire ji, aidure tuwo bito, mare roiwakare.
source: Du kodire Herodades kodu kagirire ji, aidure tuwo bito, mare roiwakare.

b: Paga karega, Herodes meartorure Joãoji kodi, jordure imedu pemegareuie ure ema duji, iera brarere ji, meardui mako jitu keje uredugodure pudui, mare du inodu tabo biapagare ji taidu tabo.
source: Paga karega, Herodes meartorure Joãoji kodi, jordure imedu pemegareuie ure ema duji, iera brarere ji, meardui mako jitu keje uredugodure pudui, mare du inodu tabo biapagare ji taidu tabo.

b: Mare ia meriji o joru buture jiwu aregodure du jire Herodes ure tuwai kejewu brae eimejerage, mare Galiléia kejewu brae kurireuge enogwagedo tuwai tada.
source: Mare ia meriji o joru buture jiwu aregodure du jire Herodes ure tuwai kejewu brae eimejerage, mare Galiléia kejewu brae kurireuge enogwagedo tuwai tada.

b: Herodíades onaregedu aredu aregodure mato turerui nono du kae. Herodes mare metage eegare kuricigore roinoduji. Icare nowu brae eimejera akore: - Akogwamagududo ii akaidumode jiboe bogai, imode maku akai rugadu.
source: Herodíades onaregedu aredu aregodure mato turerui nono du kae. Herodes mare metage eegare kuricigore roinoduji. Icare nowu brae eimejera akore: - Akogwamagududo ii akaidumode jiboe bogai, imode maku akai rugadu.

b: Ure tuwadaru maku oino: - Akogwamagudumode ii bogaiboe jamedu imode makai, ino moto umode jamedu du keje, imode kado oiado akai.
source: Ure tuwadaru maku oino: - Akogwamagudumode ii bogaiboe jamedu imode makai, ino moto umode jamedu du keje, imode kado oiado akai.

b: Ure tudawuje tunorawo tujeji: - Kaba bogaiba inogwamagudumode?  Uce akore: - Akogwamagududo João Batista aora bogai.
source: Ure tudawuje tunorawo tujeji: - Kaba bogaiba inogwamagudumode?  Uce akore: - Akogwamagududo João Batista aora bogai.

b: Tui turemo kuri je du keje, ure bie taidure jiboeji, akore: - Itaidure kuri je awo João Batista aora makinai.
source: Tui turemo kuri je du keje, ure bie taidure jiboeji, akore: - Itaidure kuri je awo João Batista aora makinai.

b: Icare brae eimejera kiarigodure tu je, mare tui tuwadaru maku du koia, jamedu nowu tumedage eigoia, aidukare tuwo turodo oino nowu inodu piji.
source: Icare brae eimejera kiarigodure tu je, mare tui tuwadaru maku du koia, jamedu nowu tumedage eigoia, aidukare tuwo turodo oino nowu inodu piji.

b: Kuri je ure ia utugare torigarai utudo toro João Batista aora bogai. Du uture tui João Batista itoru kado baicoreu tada du kae.
source: Kuri je ure ia utugare torigarai utudo toro João Batista aora bogai. Du uture tui João Batista itoru kado baicoreu tada du kae.

b: Ure aora reko mato upe eworeu tabo, ure jodo tuku nowu aredu rogu keje.
source: Ure aora reko mato upe eworeu tabo, ure jodo tuku nowu aredu rogu keje.

b:
Nowu Joãore jorduwadowuge emeardure inodu akaruji, du kejere eture toro bogai. Ere tugu ia aroe eiaoto.
	Jesus ui boe makareuge enogwagedo.
source:
Nowu Joãore jorduwadowuge emeardure inodu akaruji, du kejere eture toro bogai. Ere tugu ia aroe eiaoto.
	Jesus ui boe makareuge enogwagedo.

b: Apostolodoge ere tugirimi jice Jesus ae, ereadodure biegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boejei, ture boe eerduwado jiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Apostolodoge ere tugirimi jice Jesus ae, ereadodure biegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boejei, ture boe eerduwado jiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Akore ei: - Mato, nowu boe epiji, tagamudo tu jao. Mare paga karega, boe eture toro, ekodure mato du emagaguragare, du koia apostolodoge eroiwakare tuwo iaboe rogu boe kowuje.
source: Akore ei: - Mato, nowu boe epiji, tagamudo tu jao. Mare paga karega, boe eture toro, ekodure mato du emagaguragare, du koia apostolodoge eroiwakare tuwo iaboe rogu boe kowuje.

b: Icare eture ika kurireu tabo ia boe biareu kae epiji.
source: Icare eture ika kurireu tabo ia boe biareu kae epiji.

b: Mare boe eerdure etuieduji, du koiare ia makereugere boe pawuje kaiba ekodumodewoji, du kodi icare bakurireu jamedu boe piji boe eture tuwure tabo cewu ekodurewo kae, etaregodure boetoji etododai.
source: Mare boe eerdure etuieduji, du koiare ia makereugere boe pawuje kaiba ekodumodewoji, du kodi icare bakurireu jamedu boe piji boe eture tuwure tabo cewu ekodurewo kae, etaregodure boetoji etododai.

b: Icare, tui tudawuje ika kurireu piji du keje, Jesus jordure nowu boe makareugei, okudugodure tu ebo, mare paga karega, ere nono boe eetukare jiwu ovelhadogere kodi. Ure eerduwa makaguragado.
source: Icare, tui tudawuje ika kurireu piji du keje, Jesus jordure nowu boe makareugei, okudugodure tu ebo, mare paga karega, ere nono boe eetukare jiwu ovelhadogere kodi. Ure eerduwa makaguragado.

b:
Meri jogodu remawu kejere, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure ae, egore ji: 
Boe eedukare woe, meri rekodu nure.
source:
Meri jogodu remawu kejere, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure ae, egore ji: 
Boe eedukare woe, meri rekodu nure.

b: Akimadudo ebo, etuwo, ewo iaboe rogu aru tugeje, ia boe emugu puredure boe kae, ia bakurireu mugu puredure boe kae.
source: Akimadudo ebo, etuwo, ewo iaboe rogu aru tugeje, ia boe emugu puredure boe kae, ia bakurireu mugu puredure boe kae.

b: Emarema, akore ei: - Tagi rugadure tamode enogwagedo. Icare egore ji: - Kode, kakoduwu meriri tabo cemode akirodo amireuji ekeje?
source: Emarema, akore ei: - Tagi rugadure tamode enogwagedo. Icare egore ji: - Kode, kakoduwu meriri tabo cemode akirodo amireuji ekeje?

b: Icare unoragodure ei: - Inoba amireure tagabo? tagado bogai. Eerdure ia roguji dukeje egore ji: - Ure ikera awubodure, kare kugure ere pobe tu je jamedu.
source: Icare unoragodure ei: - Inoba amireure tagabo? tagado bogai. Eerdure ia roguji dukeje egore ji: - Ure ikera awubodure, kare kugure ere pobe tu je jamedu.

b: Makore emagoiagu boei ewo tumugudo boebutu keje etodui pui tu tu tu je du tabo.
source: Makore emagoiagu boei ewo tumugudo boebutu keje etodui pui tu tu tu je du tabo.

b: Etodure pui, epadure cem keje, cinquenta keje tu tu tu je.
source: Etodure pui, epadure cem keje, cinquenta keje tu tu tu je.

b: Icare ure tugeragu cewu amireu rogui ikera awubodure tu je duji, mare cewu kare kugurei pobe tu je duji, icare tui tuioku awogado baruto, ure togwa kurido tabo, ure tugera bu taci keje, ure maku nowu ture jorduwadowuge etai ewo pedo toro boe etai, ure kare kugure ei pobe tu je du pedo boe eiamedu boe etai jamedu.
source: Icare ure tugeragu cewu amireu rogui ikera awubodure tu je duji, mare cewu kare kugurei pobe tu je duji, icare tui tuioku awogado baruto, ure togwa kurido tabo, ure tugera bu taci keje, ure maku nowu ture jorduwadowuge etai ewo pedo toro boe etai, ure kare kugure ei pobe tu je du pedo boe eiamedu boe etai jamedu.

b: Eiamedu boe enogwagere, enogwa amogodure.
source: Eiamedu boe enogwagere, enogwa amogodure.

b: Jetu ona kimore amireu kobo, kare kobo, ure kododoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu enogorobadudo.
source: Jetu ona kimore amireu kobo, kare kobo, ure kododoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu enogorobadudo.

b:
Ure nowu amireu kowujewu ime ere cinco mil.
Jesus merui pobo aoji.
source:
Ure nowu amireu kowujewu ime ere cinco mil.
Jesus merui pobo aoji.

b: Nowu inodu akedu keje kuri je, ure cewu ture jorduwadowuge edo taredo kuri ika kurireuto etaregoduwo jice pobo bakowu kae tododai, Betsaida jokorai. Eiagejere icare unure cimadudo boe ebo.
source: Nowu inodu akedu keje kuri je, ure cewu ture jorduwadowuge edo taredo kuri ika kurireuto etaregoduwo jice pobo bakowu kae tododai, Betsaida jokorai. Eiagejere icare unure cimadudo boe ebo.

b: Cimadui boe ebodu akedu keje kuri je, ure turodo oino ia torekodu ao kae, nonowo ture togwakurido.
source: Cimadui boe ebodu akedu keje kuri je, ure turodo oino ia torekodu ao kae, nonowo ture togwakurido.

b: Boecoji ika kurireu mugure kuruga oiadoda, ema mugure tuginoigodu woje moto keje.
source: Boecoji ika kurireu mugure kuruga oiadoda, ema mugure tuginoigodu woje moto keje.

b: Tuiordui icai emedugodui traiga tabo, bakuru okwace pega du koia, utue etae boeco oia keje, tumerui pobo maereu aoji du tabo. Ure turodo nono ure tugodumodedudo jice emegi jice ekori.
source: Tuiordui icai emedugodui traiga tabo, bakuru okwace pega du koia, utue etae boeco oia keje, tumerui pobo maereu aoji du tabo. Ure turodo nono ure tugodumodedudo jice emegi jice ekori.

b: Emagerema, tuiordui Jesus merui pobo aoji du keje, emeardaere ia aroeie ure ema duji, icare enoiogwarire.
source: Emagerema, tuiordui Jesus merui pobo aoji du keje, emeardaere ia aroeie ure ema duji, icare enoiogwarire.

b: Paga karega, eiamedu boe eerdure ji, du koia epagudugodure. Mare kuri je makore ei, akore: - Tamorora amagadu kaba, tabagudu kaba, imire iroino.
source: Paga karega, eiamedu boe eerdure ji, du koia epagudugodure. Mare kuri je makore ei, akore: - Tamorora amagadu kaba, tabagudu kaba, imire iroino.

b: Ure taredo etae ika kurireuto. Icare bakuru akedure. Icare jamedu boe epagudugodu rakaguragare.
source: Ure taredo etae ika kurireuto. Icare bakuru akedure. Icare jamedu boe epagudugodu rakaguragare.

b:
Paga karega, ekare boe pa cewu amireu kodiboe jitu koia, ewabo raka remawu nure du kodi.
Jesus ure boe epemegago Genesaré moto keje.
source:
Paga karega, ekare boe pa cewu amireu kodiboe jitu koia, ewabo raka remawu nure du kodi.
Jesus ure boe epemegago Genesaré moto keje.

b: Ere ika kurireu jodo jice bakowuto, etaregodure Genesaré moto kae.
source: Ere ika kurireu jodo jice bakowuto, etaregodure Genesaré moto kae.

b: Ui taredo ika piji du keje kuri je, ere boe pawuje ji.
source: Ui taredo ika piji du keje kuri je, ere boe pawuje ji.

b: Kodure nowu moto jamedu boeji, du tonaji, boe ere kogodureuge erego erego jice boe egore rakojemodewo kae.
source: Kodure nowu moto jamedu boeji, du tonaji, boe ere kogodureuge erego erego jice boe egore rakojemodewo kae.

b: Cewu kodumodewu jamedu boe kae, baboturogu rabodu, bakurireuge kugure rabodu, bakurireuge rabodu, boe ere kogodureuge ewu ewu toro ba oiagi, enogwamagudure ji uwo tudo tugera jeto toi ukudae okwaji tu je. Kode, nowu iera jeture Jesus ukudae okwajiwuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure.
source: Cewu kodumodewu jamedu boe kae, baboturogu rabodu, bakurireuge kugure rabodu, bakurireuge rabodu, boe ere kogodureuge ewu ewu toro ba oiagi, enogwamagudure ji uwo tudo tugera jeto toi ukudae okwaji tu je. Kode, nowu iera jeture Jesus ukudae okwajiwuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure.

b: Judeudoge ero.
source: Judeudoge ero.

b: Fariseudoge mare ia escribadoge etaregodure mato Jerusalém piji, ere tudo pui Jesus oiei.
source: Fariseudoge mare ia escribadoge etaregodure mato Jerusalém piji, ere tudo pui Jesus oiei.

b: Eerdure ia ure jorduwadowuge ei amireu kowuje tukai tugera kabi du tabo duji.
source: Eerdure ia ure jorduwadowuge ei amireu kowuje tukai tugera kabi du tabo duji.

b: Paga karega, nowu fariseudoge, judeudoge eiamedu, ekedu kimoi mariguduwuge eroia jitu koia, enogwagemodukare tukai tugera kabidu pemegado du keje.
