b: Kodi icare Jesus ure boe makareuge edo tumugudo moto keje.
source: Kodi icare Jesus ure boe makareuge edo tumugudo moto keje.

b: Du kejere ure tugeragu nowu amireuji, nowu kare kugurei, makore ia tuwadaru pemegareuji ewugeje. Icare ure tugera bu kajeje toku je, ure maku ture jorduwadowuge etai, emagere icare ere maku toro nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe ai.
source: Du kejere ure tugeragu nowu amireuji, nowu kare kugurei, makore ia tuwadaru pemegareuji ewugeje. Icare ure tugera bu kajeje toku je, ure maku ture jorduwadowuge etai, emagere icare ere maku toro nowu boe makareuge eiamedu boe ai.

b: Eiamedu boe okwagere ji, enogwa amogodure. Jeture tuiagejewu tabo, ure jorduwadowugere kododoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu enogorobadudo.
source: Eiamedu boe okwagere ji, enogwa amogodure. Jeture tuiagejewu tabo, ure jorduwadowugere kododoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu enogorobadudo.

b: Aró, kode, okwagereu ime ere 4.000, areme eremagudu ka du tabo, etore eremagudu ka du tabo jamedu.
source: Aró, kode, okwagereu ime ere 4.000, areme eremagudu ka du tabo, etore eremagudu ka du tabo jamedu.

b: Du kejere icare Jesus ure nowu boe etudo, icare ruture ika kurireuto, ure tugirimi Magadan kejewu boe eeda kae.
source: Du kejere icare Jesus ure nowu boe etudo, icare ruture ika kurireuto, ure tugirimi Magadan kejewu boe eeda kae.

b: Boe emagoi Jesusji ia ro kurireu bogaidu.
source: Boe emagoi Jesusji ia ro kurireu bogaidu.

b: Ia fariseudoge, ia saduceudoge ere tugirimi Jesus ae, toebatodu pegareu tabo ji, enogwamagudure ji, egore uiagu baru tadawu ia turo kurireu towuje tuiegai.
source: Ia fariseudoge, ia saduceudoge ere tugirimi Jesus ae, toebatodu pegareu tabo ji, enogwamagudure ji, egore uiagu baru tadawu ia turo kurireu towuje tuiegai.

b: Kodi icare Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Meri rekodu tabore tagagore: Nonore boe motumode, baru kujagure kodi.
source: Kodi icare Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Meri rekodu tabore tagagore: Nonore boe motumode, baru kujagure kodi.

b: Meri togire tagagore: Awujire bubutu pegareu butumode, baru kujagu tugure kodi.
source: Meri togire tagagore: Awujire bubutu pegareu butumode, baru kujagu tugure kodi.

b:
Ro biadodureuge! Taerduware ure tudo baru tadawu boeji. Kodiba taerduwakare awu meri jiwu ia koiaboeji? Awu ro, ako, pegareuge enogwamagudure ia boe kurireu toduwo tuiegai. Ia kodiboe makudumodukare etai, mare cewu ure tudo Jonas kodiboe tu rugadu. Awu tuwadaru rekodajire icare Jesus uture nowu piji.
Fariseudoge mare saduceudoge ewadaru.
source:
Ro biadodureuge! Taerduware ure tudo baru tadawu boeji. Kodiba taerduwakare awu meri jiwu ia koiaboeji? Awu ro, ako, pegareuge enogwamagudure ia boe kurireu toduwo tuiegai. Ia kodiboe makudumodukare etai, mare cewu ure tudo Jonas kodiboe tu rugadu. Awu tuwadaru rekodajire icare Jesus uture nowu piji.
Fariseudoge mare saduceudoge ewadaru.

b: Tui pagado kuruga kurireu okwa bakowuto du keje, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiagodurade amireu piji.
source: Tui pagado kuruga kurireu okwa bakowuto du keje, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ewiagodurade amireu piji.

b:
Jesus akore ei: -
Taeto tai, tameardu awadudo tai nowu fariseudoge, nowu saduceudoge eno boe barodudoboeji.
source:
Jesus akore ei: -
Taeto tai, tameardu awadudo tai nowu fariseudoge, nowu saduceudoge eno boe barodudoboeji.

b: Emeardaere tu kae amireu to du kodie akoino.
source: Emeardaere tu kae amireu to du kodie akoino.

b: Mare Jesus, tuiordui emeardaeji du keje, akore ei: - Marenarure ema tumeartoru bogaiwu ime, kodiba tameardaere amireu bokwai du koiaie inagoino?
source: Mare Jesus, tuiordui emeardaeji du keje, akore ei: - Marenarure ema tumeartoru bogaiwu ime, kodiba tameardaere amireu bokwai du koiaie inagoino?

b: Takaradu boe pawuje roga? Tawia jetukare ikera awubodure tu jedu amireuji, tai kododoge enogorao duji?
source: Takaradu boe pawuje roga? Tawia jetukare ikera awubodure tu jedu amireuji, tai kododoge enogorao duji?

b: Tawia jetukare jamedu amireuge ei ikera awubodure ikerakoi pobe ikera awubowuto du mare imei 4.000 ce duji, tai kododoge enogorao duji?
source: Tawia jetukare jamedu amireuge ei ikera awubodure ikerakoi pobe ikera awubowuto du mare imei 4.000 ce duji, tai kododoge enogorao duji?

b: Kodiba takare boe pa amireuji kaegae inagoino tai cewu inagoi tai: Taeto tai, tameardu awadudo tai nowu fariseudoge, nowu saduceudoge eno fermentoji, oino?
source: Kodiba takare boe pa amireuji kaegae inagoino tai cewu inagoi tai: Taeto tai, tameardu awadudo tai nowu fariseudoge, nowu saduceudoge eno fermentoji, oino?

b:
Du kejere ere boe pa nowu inoduji karadega akoino, mare fariseudoge, saduceudoge ewadaruji raboduie akoino.
Pedro meartorae.
source:
Du kejere ere boe pa nowu inoduji karadega akoino, mare fariseudoge, saduceudoge ewadaruji raboduie akoino.
Pedro meartorae.

b: Etaregodui Filipe o moto iei Cesaria cedu kae du keje, Jesus unorare nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore ei: - Nowu boe egoino du kodi, ioguduba Imedu Onaregedu ure ema?
source: Etaregodui Filipe o moto iei Cesaria cedu kae du keje, Jesus unorare nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore ei: - Nowu boe egoino du kodi, ioguduba Imedu Onaregedu ure ema?

b: Egore: - Iage egore João Batistaie, iage egore Eliaie, iage egore Jeremiaie, iarema ia profetaie.
source: Egore: - Iage egore João Batistaie, iage egore Eliaie, iage egore Jeremiaie, iarema ia profetaie.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, tagi, inoba tagagore ii?
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, tagi, inoba tagagore ii?

b: Icare Simão Pedro akore: - Akire Cristore aki. Bi bokwareu Pao Onaregedure aki.
source: Icare Simão Pedro akore: - Akire Cristore aki. Bi bokwareu Pao Onaregedure aki.

b: Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - Aiwo aidugiri pemega remawu nure, Simão, Jonas onaregedu, mare paga karega, moto kejeboe koia karega ure akagodo oino, mare Ioga baru tadawu koiare ure akagodo oino.
source: Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - Aiwo aidugiri pemega remawu nure, Simão, Jonas onaregedu, mare paga karega, moto kejeboe koia karega ure akagodo oino, mare Ioga baru tadawu koiare ure akagodo oino.

b: Kode iwo awadudo awiegai. Ica, akire tori rema. Awu tori aogejere imode ino Igreja mugudo. Ica, Aroe pegareu  ro jerimagamodukare ji.
source: Kode iwo awadudo awiegai. Ica, akire tori rema. Awu tori aogejere imode ino Igreja mugudo. Ica, Aroe pegareu  ro jerimagamodukare ji.

b: Imode Pao o boe pemegareu o baiporo epa maku akai. Are kogudo woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kogudodumode baru tada jamedu; are kiwuje woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kiwujedumode baru tada jamedu.
source: Imode Pao o boe pemegareu o baiporo epa maku akai. Are kogudo woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kogudodumode baru tada jamedu; are kiwuje woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kiwujedumode baru tada jamedu.

b:
Du keje, makore ture jorduwadowugei, enogwajetukawo boe ewiegai Cristoie ure pudumiduji.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tuiewodu jidu.
source:
Du keje, makore ture jorduwadowugei, enogwajetukawo boe ewiegai Cristoie ure pudumiduji.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tuiewodu jidu.

b: Kode, nowu piji matore icare Jesus ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge eerduwado akeie pudui tuduwo Jerusalém kae, tuiwo kuricigomoduie, boe codudoge, baire eimejerage, escribadoge, eigoia; tuwimodeduie, du keje, merimode pobe ma awu metuia bokware dukejere tuiewodumodeduie.
source: Kode, nowu piji matore icare Jesus ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge eerduwado akeie pudui tuduwo Jerusalém kae, tuiwo kuricigomoduie, boe codudoge, baire eimejerage, escribadoge, eigoia; tuwimodeduie, du keje, merimode pobe ma awu metuia bokware dukejere tuiewodumodeduie.

b:
Icare Pedro makore ji: 
- Aroe Eimejera kaiagu nowu inodudo oino, cegimejera, nowu inodu umodukare tudowuje ai.
source:
Icare Pedro makore ji: 
- Aroe Eimejera kaiagu nowu inodudo oino, cegimejera, nowu inodu umodukare tudowuje ai.

b: Mare Jesus ure tugirimi pai ji, akore ji: - Aiaedo ii, Aroe pegareu , awo iwogwado boetodu nure aki. Pao meardaere karega ameardae rema, mare ime emeardae.
source: Mare Jesus ure tugirimi pai ji, akore ji: - Aiaedo ii, Aroe pegareu , awo iwogwado boetodu nure aki. Pao meardaere karega ameardae rema, mare ime emeardae.

b: Inodu otobiji, Jesus akore nowu ture jorduwadowuge ei: - Ia aidure tugoduwo itabowu, umode tuwia ra tubiji, umode tugeragu to cruzji tugoduwo itabo.
source: Inodu otobiji, Jesus akore nowu ture jorduwadowuge ei: - Ia aidure tugoduwo itabowu, umode tuwia ra tubiji, umode tugeragu to cruzji tugoduwo itabo.

b: Mare paga karega, cewu aidure tuwo cinorudo tuwimodedu pijiwu, bimode rugadu; mare cewu ure tuwidodudo inaiwu, jordumode pudui.
source: Mare paga karega, cewu aidure tuwo cinorudo tuwimodedu pijiwu, bimode rugadu; mare cewu ure tuwidodudo inaiwu, jordumode pudui.

b: Kode, inoba imedu romode toi moto jamedu boe keje, mare tuwo tudaroe okwado? Kode ica, kaboba imedu umode maku tudaroe morice?
source: Kode, inoba imedu romode toi moto jamedu boe keje, mare tuwo tudaroe okwado? Kode ica, kaboba imedu umode maku tudaroe morice?

b: Mare paga karega, Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode Tuo reoredu tada du tabo, to tupadoge ebo, du kejere umode boe ero mori maku boe etai.
source: Mare paga karega, Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode Tuo reoredu tada du tabo, to tupadoge ebo, du kejere umode boe ero mori maku boe etai.

b: Boe jokodu remawure imode awadudo tai: awu jeture oino woewuge makareuge eerdumodukare tuwiji, tuiordukai Imedu Onaregedu ui tugirimi tuguricigo tabo, to boe pemegareu tabo pugeje du kae.
source: Boe jokodu remawure imode awadudo tai: awu jeture oino woewuge makareuge eerdumodukare tuwiji, tuiordukai Imedu Onaregedu ui tugirimi tuguricigo tabo, to boe pemegareu tabo pugeje du kae.

b: Jesus ui tudo tuginoidu.
source: Jesus ui tudo tuginoidu.

b: Meri ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto du keje Jesus ure Pedro, Tiago, João, ekodudo pudabo, ure eko tuginoi pudabo paci ia tori raireu kae.
source: Meri ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto du keje Jesus ure Pedro, Tiago, João, ekodudo pudabo, ure eko tuginoi pudabo paci ia tori raireu kae.

b: Du kejere icare ure tudo tuginoi taci. Je urugure nono meri urugure, ukudae kigadu kurukurure eegai.
source: Du kejere icare ure tudo tuginoi taci. Je urugure nono meri urugure, ukudae kigadu kurukurure eegai.

b: Du kejere icare Moisés, Elias ere tuguo Jesus jaogwai pudogi, tumagoi jitu tabo.
source: Du kejere icare Moisés, Elias ere tuguo Jesus jaogwai pudogi, tumagoi jitu tabo.

b: Du kodi icare Pedro makore ji, akore: - Cegimejera, pemegare paeduwo woe. Akaidu keje, imode baido pobe ma awu metuia bokware: awaimode ia, Moisés uwaimode ia, Elias uwaimode ia.
source: Du kodi icare Pedro makore ji, akore: - Cegimejera, pemegare paeduwo woe. Akaidu keje, imode baido pobe ma awu metuia bokware: awaimode ia, Moisés uwaimode ia, Elias uwaimode ia.

b: Akoinodu tonajire, ia boetugu urugureu ure tubodo ebo taci je. Nowu boetugu pijire ia mako padure, akore: - Awure imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu rema. Kejere imeardu kuriae jamedu boe bu keje. Tawiapagado bataruji.
source: Akoinodu tonajire, ia boetugu urugureu ure tubodo ebo taci je. Nowu boetugu pijire ia mako padure, akore: - Awure imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu rema. Kejere imeardu kuriae jamedu boe bu keje. Tawiapagado bataruji.

b: Tumeardui nowu inodu bataru jitu kejere, ure jorduwadowuge ewudure, ee jore mototo tuku je, ewire tubagudu koia.
source: Tumeardui nowu inodu bataru jitu kejere, ure jorduwadowuge ewudure, ee jore mototo tuku je, ewire tubagudu koia.

b: Mare Jesus ure tuburedo ei, ure tugera jodo ewugeje, akore ei: - Taragojedo, tabagudu kaba.
source: Mare Jesus ure tuburedo ei, ure tugera jodo ewugeje, akore ei: - Taragojedo, tabagudu kaba.

b: Etaiwore ceboje, eerdukare boeji, mare Jesus jire eerdure tu je.
source: Etaiwore ceboje, eerdukare boeji, mare Jesus jire eerdure tu je.

b: Tui turawuje nowu tori raireu joki du tonajire, Jesus akore ei: - Tamago kaba boe ewiegai taerdure jiboeji jii Imedu Onaregedu jewodui bireuge epiji du kae.
source: Tui turawuje nowu tori raireu joki du tonajire, Jesus akore ei: - Tamago kaba boe ewiegai taerdure jiboeji jii Imedu Onaregedu jewodui bireuge epiji du kae.

b: Du inodu otobiji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji, egore: - Kodiba escribadoge egore Elia aregodumoduie boetoji?
source: Du inodu otobiji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji, egore: - Kodiba escribadoge egore Elia aregodumoduie boetoji?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodure Elias aregodumode rugadu tuwo boe jamedu boe udo turugadu.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodure Elias aregodumode rugadu tuwo boe jamedu boe udo turugadu.

b: Mare inagomode tai: Elias aregodure mare boe emeartorukare ji, mare ere barigodudo pudui taidu reore. Nowu inodu reorere erorerumode Imedu Onaregeduji.
source: Mare inagomode tai: Elias aregodure mare boe emeartorukare ji, mare ere barigodudo pudui taidu reore. Nowu inodu reorere erorerumode Imedu Onaregeduji.

b:
Kode, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere boe pawuje João Batista ji raboduie akoino duji.
Jesus ui ia iparedu pemegagodu.
source:
Kode, nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere boe pawuje João Batista ji raboduie akoino duji.
Jesus ui ia iparedu pemegagodu.

b: Ei tudo pui ia boe makareuge ebo pugeje du kejere icare ia imedu ure tuburedo Jesusji, ure tubujodo jokorai, akore ji: -
source: Ei tudo pui ia boe makareuge ebo pugeje du kejere icare ia imedu ure tuburedo Jesusji, ure tubujodo jokorai, akore ji: -

b: Ikimejera, akogududo itonaregedu apo, meardae bokware du ure ro pega remawu nure ji, iadure buture joruto, iadure buture poboto; oinore ure.
source: Ikimejera, akogududo itonaregedu apo, meardae bokware du ure ro pega remawu nure ji, iadure buture joruto, iadure buture poboto; oinore ure.

b: Ica, iture mato apo nowu are jorduwadowuge etae, mare eroiwakare tuwo pemegago.
source: Ica, iture mato apo nowu are jorduwadowuge etae, mare eroiwakare tuwo pemegago.

b: Jesus akore: - Mure, tameartoru bokwa remawu nure! Tabega remawu nure! Jii inoba du kejeba ikiwa rakamode tagabo? Mato apo!
source: Jesus akore: - Mure, tameartoru bokwa remawu nure! Tabega remawu nure! Jii inoba du kejeba ikiwa rakamode tagabo? Mato apo!

b: Icare Jesus makore Aroe pegareu ji du ure tudawuje nowu negedurogu piji, du kodiwu tonaji pemegagodure kuri je.
source: Icare Jesus makore Aroe pegareu ji du ure tudawuje nowu negedurogu piji, du kodiwu tonaji pemegagodure kuri je.

b: Du kodire nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Kodiba ceroiwakare cewo cewu Aroe pegareu  barigu?
source: Du kodire nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Kodiba ceroiwakare cewo cewu Aroe pegareu  barigu?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Tameartoru bokwa koia. Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Tameartoru rogu umode nono mostarda i a rogu reore tu je ma, tamagomode awu tori raireuji: Akorodo oino toro!, oino du keje, romode ino rugadu, iaboe iaboe upewumodukare pudui tagai pugeje.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Tameartoru bokwa koia. Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Tameartoru rogu umode nono mostarda i a rogu reore tu je ma, tamagomode awu tori raireuji: Akorodo oino toro!, oino du keje, romode ino rugadu, iaboe iaboe upewumodukare pudui tagai pugeje.

b:
Awu ure oinowu Aroe pegareu  barigudumode, mare boe enogwamagudui Paoji, boe etodorogai pudui du tabo tu rugadu.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tuiewoduji pugejedu.
source:
Awu ure oinowu Aroe pegareu  barigudumode, mare boe enogwamagudui Paoji, boe etodorogai pudui du tabo tu rugadu.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tuiewoduji pugejedu.

b: Jesus meru nure Galiléia oiagi, du tonajire makore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode ime ekera kai.
source: Jesus meru nure Galiléia oiagi, du tonajire makore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode ime ekera kai.

b:
Emode bito, mare meri pobe ma awu metuia bokware du kejere jewodumode. Nowu inodu kejere icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge erore toku je, ekiarigodu kuricigore.
Imposto makudui Pao uwai kaedu.
source:
Emode bito, mare meri pobe ma awu metuia bokware du kejere jewodumode. Nowu inodu kejere icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge erore toku je, ekiarigodu kuricigore.
Imposto makudui Pao uwai kaedu.

b: Etaregodui Cafarnaum kae du keje, ia imposto epage ere tuburedo Pedroji, enoragodure ji: - Ure taerduwadowu umodukare imposto morido?
source: Etaregodui Cafarnaum kae du keje, ia imposto epage ere tuburedo Pedroji, enoragodure ji: - Ure taerduwadowu umodukare imposto morido?

b: Pedro akore ei: - U! Umode morido. Mare etaregodui tuwai kae du keje, Jesus ure tuwu taci otogajeje tagoi oino du tabo: - Simão, inoba ure aegai? Moto kejewu brae eimejerage, ioguduba umode imposto morido etai: etore na? iarema ia tuginoiwuge na?  Pedro akore: - Ia boe tuginoiwuge.
source: Pedro akore ei: - U! Umode morido. Mare etaregodui tuwai kae du keje, Jesus ure tuwu taci otogajeje tagoi oino du tabo: - Simão, inoba ure aegai? Moto kejewu brae eimejerage, ioguduba umode imposto morido etai: etore na? iarema ia tuginoiwuge na?  Pedro akore: - Ia boe tuginoiwuge.

b: Du kodi icare Jesus akore pugeje: - Kode, ore emodukare morido.
source: Du kodi icare Jesus akore pugeje: - Kode, ore emodukare morido.

b: Mare pemegamodukare boewo eerduwa pegado. Kodi icare, toro pobo maereuto, amode akeragu jiwu boetojiwu karo, amode ja barido, nono aerdumode meriri mito tu je duji, akeragu ji, maku etai pagai.
source: Mare pemegamodukare boewo eerduwa pegado. Kodi icare, toro pobo maereuto, amode akeragu jiwu boetojiwu karo, amode ja barido, nono aerdumode meriri mito tu je duji, akeragu ji, maku etai pagai.

b: Kurireboe ema emawu.
source: Kurireboe ema emawu.

b: Du keje kuri je, nowu Jesus ure jorduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji, enorare ji: - Kakoduwuba kuri remawure Pao o boe pemegareu tada?
source: Du keje kuri je, nowu Jesus ure jorduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji, enorare ji: - Kakoduwuba kuri remawure Pao o boe pemegareu tada?

b: Jesus makore ia negedurogu ae, ure rakojedo tu etoiadoda,
source: Jesus makore ia negedurogu ae, ure rakojedo tu etoiadoda,

b: Akore: - Boe rugadu jire inagomode oino tai: tamodukare tado nono boe etore kugure ereore ma, tamodukare taremo Pao o boe pemegareuto rugadu.
source: Akore: - Boe rugadu jire inagomode oino tai: tamodukare tado nono boe etore kugure ereore ma, tamodukare taremo Pao o boe pemegareuto rugadu.

b: Cewu ure tuwiegado nono awu boe etonaregedu rogu reoreure kurimode Pao o boe pemegareu keje.
source: Cewu ure tuwiegado nono awu boe etonaregedu rogu reoreure kurimode Pao o boe pemegareu keje.

b:
Ia ure tugeragu ia negeduroguji ikie tabodu, dure ii rugadure ure tugeragu.
Boe ewarigududodui Pao Aroe Eimejera pijidu.
source:
Ia ure tugeragu ia negeduroguji ikie tabodu, dure ii rugadure ure tugeragu.
Boe ewarigududodui Pao Aroe Eimejera pijidu.

b: Mare iaboe umode awu ia negedurogu meartorui iidu ro pegado ma, ema remawu umode boewo ia tori kurireu bararedo ruwoji ewo barigu tabo pobo maereuto du rema.
source: Mare iaboe umode awu ia negedurogu meartorui iidu ro pegado ma, ema remawu umode boewo ia tori kurireu bararedo ruwoji ewo barigu tabo pobo maereuto du rema.

b: Boei jorduwa bokwareuge eerduwado boe pegareu jitu koia, moto jiwomode boe ebo. Boe emodukare tuwo awu inodu bokwado, mare ia imedu romode akomode inowu jiwomode.
source: Boei jorduwa bokwareuge eerduwado boe pegareu jitu koia, moto jiwomode boe ebo. Boe emodukare tuwo awu inodu bokwado, mare ia imedu romode akomode inowu jiwomode.

b: Kode ica, akera, awure, koiare umode awududo aro pegareuto ma, kode, kado, barigudu jaedo apiji. Ema remawure atumode baruto apogorai awubowu tu je du tabo, akanai awubowu tu je du tabo du rema, mare awarigudumode joru pegareuto apogorai pudogi du tabo du rema, ema karega.
source: Kode ica, akera, awure, koiare umode awududo aro pegareuto ma, kode, kado, barigudu jaedo apiji. Ema remawure atumode baruto apogorai awubowu tu je du tabo, akanai awubowu tu je du tabo du rema, mare awarigudumode joru pegareuto apogorai pudogi du tabo du rema, ema karega.

b:
Aeku koiare umode aro pegado ma, kode, tawuje, barigudu jaedo apiji. Ema remawure atumode baruto aekui mito tu je du tabo du rema, mare awarigudumode joru pegareuto aekui pudogi du tabo du rema, ema karega.
Ovelha okwai boetodu.
source:
Aeku koiare umode aro pegado ma, kode, tawuje, barigudu jaedo apiji. Ema remawure atumode baruto aekui mito tu je du tabo du rema, mare awarigudumode joru pegareuto aekui pudogi du tabo du rema, ema karega.
Ovelha okwai boetodu.

b: Tameardu awadudo tai, tagaba awu biegareuge kugure ewarigududo pudui, mare paga karega, inagomode oino tai: eno tupadoge etaiwo nure Ioga jeto baru tada jii je.
source: Tameardu awadudo tai, tagaba awu biegareuge kugure ewarigududo pudui, mare paga karega, inagomode oino tai: eno tupadoge etaiwo nure Ioga jeto baru tada jii je.

b: Ica, Imedu Onaregedu aregodure tuwo okware boetowuge einorudo du bogai.
source: Ica, Imedu Onaregedu aregodure tuwo okware boetowuge einorudo du bogai.

b: Inoba ure taegai? Ia imedu aku ovelhadoge emode 100, duwugere ia okwamode boeto mito ma, inoba romode? Umode iage eedo toro tori aogeje, turegoduwo cewu okware boeto rogu bogai.
source: Inoba ure taegai? Ia imedu aku ovelhadoge emode 100, duwugere ia okwamode boeto mito ma, inoba romode? Umode iage eedo toro tori aogeje, turegoduwo cewu okware boeto rogu bogai.

b: Jordumode roguji ma, jekare kodumode tugori cewu okwakare boetowuge ei 99 cedu koia du kori.
source: Jordumode roguji ma, jekare kodumode tugori cewu okwakare boetowuge ei 99 cedu koia du kori.

b:
Oinore Tao baru tadawu aidure awu ia biegareuge ewogwa kawo boeto.
Boe enogituwai tumeduia jidu.
source:
Oinore Tao baru tadawu aidure awu ia biegareuge ewogwa kawo boeto.
Boe enogituwai tumeduia jidu.

b: Amana ro pegamode ai ma, amagodo ji, aki, ema, tu rugadu. Meartorumode awadaruji ma, aiwo aidugirire amanaji.
source: Amana ro pegamode ai ma, amagodo ji, aki, ema, tu rugadu. Meartorumode awadaruji ma, aiwo aidugirire amanaji.

b: Biapagamodukare ai ma, akeragu iaboe ei mito rakudu, pobe rakudu, du kejewo cewu tagorigodaere tubemegado nowu pobe tu je du rabodu, iarema boei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware tu je du rabodu ewadaru koia.
source: Biapagamodukare ai ma, akeragu iaboe ei mito rakudu, pobe rakudu, du kejewo cewu tagorigodaere tubemegado nowu pobe tu je du rabodu, iarema boei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware tu je du rabodu ewadaru koia.

b:
Kiarimode tuwiapagawo ma, kode, amagodo Igrejaji. Kiarimode tuwiapagawo Igrejaji jamedu ma, aopegokare emawu reoreu umode ema, ro pegareu nure ema.
 Jesus ui ture jorduwadowuge ero raka maku etaidu.
source:
Kiarimode tuwiapagawo ma, kode, amagodo Igrejaji. Kiarimode tuwiapagawo Igrejaji jamedu ma, aopegokare emawu reoreu umode ema, ro pegareu nure ema.
 Jesus ui ture jorduwadowuge ero raka maku etaidu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: tare kogudo woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kogudodumode baru tada jamedu. Tare kiwuje woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kiwujedumode baru tada jamedu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: tare kogudo woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kogudodumode baru tada jamedu. Tare kiwuje woe moto kejeboe jamedu boe, kiwujedumode baru tada jamedu.

b: Inagomode tai awu inoduji kimo: ia tagi tamode tado pobe tu tagogwamagudu tabo iaboe boe bogai ma, Ioga baru tadawu umode maku tagai.
source: Inagomode tai awu inoduji kimo: ia tagi tamode tado pobe tu tagogwamagudu tabo iaboe boe bogai ma, Ioga baru tadawu umode maku tagai.

b:
Mare paga karega, iaboe emode tudo pobe tu je rakudu, pobe ma awu metuia bokware rakudu ikie tabo ma, nono iragojemode ebo.
Boe etugare pegareu.
source:
Mare paga karega, iaboe emode tudo pobe tu je rakudu, pobe ma awu metuia bokware rakudu ikie tabo ma, nono iragojemode ebo.
Boe etugare pegareu.

b: Du kodi icare, Pedro ure tuburedo ji, akore ji: - Cegimejera, inoba iwudugugodumode imana ro pegai iiwu keje? Jii ikera awubodure pobe taci ikea awubowuto du reore na?
source: Du kodi icare, Pedro ure tuburedo ji, akore ji: - Cegimejera, inoba iwudugugodumode imana ro pegai iiwu keje? Jii ikera awubodure pobe taci ikea awubowuto du reore na?

b: Jesus akore: - Imagomodukare tu oinono tu rugaduie, mare jii je rugadu.
source: Jesus akore: - Imagomodukare tu oinono tu rugaduie, mare jii je rugadu.

b: Mare paga karega, Pao o boe pemegareu remagudure moto kejewu ia brae eimejera ui tuiagu tudugarege edo mori maku pudai du reore.
source: Mare paga karega, Pao o boe pemegareu remagudure moto kejewu ia brae eimejera ui tuiagu tudugarege edo mori maku pudai du reore.

b: Nowu ui turoiagu inodu jitu kejere, boe etaregodure ia umode morido diiero makaguragareuji du apo.
source: Nowu ui turoiagu inodu jitu kejere, boe etaregodure ia umode morido diiero makaguragareuji du apo.

b: Mare umode morido tu emaboe bokware apo, du koia nowu brae eimejera akore makuduiagu toreduje apo, tore ebo, toroe jamedu tabo, du tabowo ure nowu umode moridoboe morido.
source: Mare umode morido tu emaboe bokware apo, du koia nowu brae eimejera akore makuduiagu toreduje apo, tore ebo, toroe jamedu tabo, du tabowo ure nowu umode moridoboe morido.

b: Du kodi icare nowu utugare ure tubujodo moto keje jokorai, okwamagudure ji, akore: - Awudugugo ii jao, du kejere imode jamedu boe morido akai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu utugare ure tubujodo moto keje jokorai, okwamagudure ji, akore: - Awudugugo ii jao, du kejere imode jamedu boe morido akai.

b: Nowu brae eimejera, togudu kuricigoi apo du tabore, akore ji: Atudo! Boe jamedu boe moridodure.
source: Nowu brae eimejera, togudu kuricigoi apo du tabore, akore ji: Atudo! Boe jamedu boe moridodure.

b: Kuri tudui piji du kejere, nowu utugare jordure ia tumeduia umode morido biega tu pudaiwuji, ure tugera kogudo ruwo kajeje, boce kodi umodukare okwado ake koia, akore ji: - Cewu amode morido inaiboe makinai.
source: Kuri tudui piji du kejere, nowu utugare jordure ia tumeduia umode morido biega tu pudaiwuji, ure tugera kogudo ruwo kajeje, boce kodi umodukare okwado ake koia, akore ji: - Cewu amode morido inaiboe makinai.

b: Nowuia buture bure paru, okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ado oino ia jao tu je. Imode jamedu boe morido akai.
source: Nowuia buture bure paru, okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ado oino ia jao tu je. Imode jamedu boe morido akai.

b: Mare biapagakare akoinoduji. Ure boedo cewu tumeduia barigu baicoreuto jii ui nowu tumode maku pudaiboe morido du kae.
source: Mare biapagakare akoinoduji. Ure boedo cewu tumeduia barigu baicoreuto jii ui nowu tumode maku pudaiboe morido du kae.

b: Metage, tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ekiarigodu kuricigore, icare eture nowu cimejera ae ereadodure biegai nowu inoduji.
source: Metage, tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ekiarigodu kuricigore, icare eture nowu cimejera ae ereadodure biegai nowu inoduji.

b: Icare cewu eimejera makore bogai, akore ji: - Itugare pegareu! Iwudugugodure ai, akogwamagudure ii du koia.
source: Icare cewu eimejera makore bogai, akore ji: - Itugare pegareu! Iwudugugodure ai, akogwamagudure ii du koia.

b: Kodiba awudugugodukare nowu ameduiaji nono iwudugugodu magai ai du reore?
source: Kodiba awudugugodukare nowu ameduiaji nono iwudugugodu magai ai du reore?

b: Kodire nowu brae eimejera korigodure, ure maku rorerure boeiwuge etai jii, ui nowu tumode moridoboe jamedu boe maku pudai du kae.
source: Kodire nowu brae eimejera korigodure, ure maku rorerure boeiwuge etai jii, ui nowu tumode moridoboe jamedu boe maku pudai du kae.

b: Oinore Ioga baru tadawu romode tai, tawudugugodu kai tamanaji, tawieji, tawabo jamedu boe tabo du keje.
source: Oinore Ioga baru tadawu romode tai, tawudugugodu kai tamanaji, tawieji, tawabo jamedu boe tabo du keje.

b: Jesus makoi divórcio jiboeji.
source: Jesus makoi divórcio jiboeji.

b: Jesus, tumagoi nowu bataru jitu rekodaji, uture Galiléia piji, Judéia kae, Jordão kujebiji.
source: Jesus, tumagoi nowu bataru jitu rekodaji, uture Galiléia piji, Judéia kae, Jordão kujebiji.

b: Ia boe makareuge ekodure apo, ure kogodureuge emedui etodadu epemegago.
source: Ia boe makareuge ekodure apo, ure kogodureuge emedui etodadu epemegago.

b: Ia fariseudoge ekodure ae tunorawo ji, tui tagokogado jitu tabo, egore ji: - Umode turugadu ia imeduji tuwo toreduje barigu tubiji iaboe boe koia?
source: Ia fariseudoge ekodure ae tunorawo ji, tui tagokogado jitu tabo, egore ji: - Umode turugadu ia imeduji tuwo toreduje barigu tubiji iaboe boe koia?

b: Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Taerduwakare bapera atugo inoduji: Ure boe jamedu boe towujewu boe paruto ure imedu towuje, ure aredu towuje,
source: Jesus akore ewadaru jipagi: - Taerduwakare bapera atugo inoduji: Ure boe jamedu boe towujewu boe paruto ure imedu towuje, ure aredu towuje,

b: Akore: Kodire imedu umode tugera ra tuo piji, tuje piji, mugumode toreduje apo, icare ei pobedu emode nono tui mito tu je du kodiwore?
source: Akore: Kodire imedu umode tugera ra tuo piji, tuje piji, mugumode toreduje apo, icare ei pobedu emode nono tui mito tu je du kodiwore?

b: Nowu inodu tabo ekare pobe pugeje, mare ere mito tu je. Kode, imedu umodukare Paore mugudo puapowuge ewarigu pubiji.
source: Nowu inodu tabo ekare pobe pugeje, mare ere mito tu je. Kode, imedu umodukare Paore mugudo puapowuge ewarigu pubiji.

b: Icare Fariseudoge egore: - Kode, kodiboe Moisés ure boedo bapera maku barigudureu aredu ai, barigudumodedu otodai?
source: Icare Fariseudoge egore: - Kode, kodiboe Moisés ure boedo bapera maku barigudureu aredu ai, barigudumodedu otodai?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Mare paga karega, ewabo pegareu koiare Moisés rore oino. Mare boe paru keje, ukare ino.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Mare paga karega, ewabo pegareu koiare Moisés rore oino. Mare boe paru keje, ukare ino.

b: Boe jokodu jire imode inodu awadudo tai: cewu ure tuwire ewariguwuge, ei tugoge pemegado du rekodaji, tumuguwo iarodo apo pugejewuge eiamedu boe, ero pega nure.
source: Boe jokodu jire imode inodu awadudo tai: cewu ure tuwire ewariguwuge, ei tugoge pemegado du rekodaji, tumuguwo iarodo apo pugejewuge eiamedu boe, ero pega nure.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge egore ji: - Oinono umode imeduji, areduji ma, kode, inodu keje, pemegamode emugukawo puapo.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge egore ji: - Oinono umode imeduji, areduji ma, kode, inodu keje, pemegamode emugukawo puapo.

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Boe eiamedu karega emode awu bakaru kodiboe pawuje, mare makudure aiwuge tu rugadu.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Boe eiamedu karega emode awu bakaru kodiboe pawuje, mare makudure aiwuge tu rugadu.

b:
Mare paga karega, iage eroiwakare tuwirewo turedu koia, iagere ino mare ia etumedage eigoia, iagerema, ere tudo oinono taidu koia, Pao o boe pemegareu koia. Roiware tuwo pawujewuge emode pawuje.


Jesus mare boe etore kugure.
source:
Mare paga karega, iage eroiwakare tuwirewo turedu koia, iagere ino mare ia etumedage eigoia, iagerema, ere tudo oinono taidu koia, Pao o boe pemegareu koia. Roiware tuwo pawujewuge emode pawuje.


Jesus mare boe etore kugure.

b: Boe ere ia boe etore kugure ecedo ae uwo tugera bu ewugeje, okwamaguduwo eparu tabo, mare ure jorduwadowuge ere erodo boku ji.
source: Boe ere ia boe etore kugure ecedo ae uwo tugera bu ewugeje, okwamaguduwo eparu tabo, mare ure jorduwadowuge ere erodo boku ji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boro! Ekugure etudo itae, tagaba erodo boku ii, mare paga karega, Pao o boe pemegareu jetumode tu ure tudo nono awuge kugure ereoreuge ebo tu je.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boro! Ekugure etudo itae, tagaba erodo boku ii, mare paga karega, Pao o boe pemegareu jetumode tu ure tudo nono awuge kugure ereoreuge ebo tu je.

b:
Du kejere ure tugera bu ewugeje. Du keje uture nowu piji.
Iparedu oroe kurireu.
source:
Du kejere ure tugera bu ewugeje. Du keje uture nowu piji.
Iparedu oroe kurireu.

b: Ia boe kajeje, ia iparedu ure tuburedo Jesusji, unoragodure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, kakoduwu boe pemegareu jiba ikodumode, ikoduwo baruto?
source: Ia boe kajeje, ia iparedu ure tuburedo Jesusji, unoragodure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, kakoduwu boe pemegareu jiba ikodumode, ikoduwo baruto?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Kodiba anorare ii boe pemegareu bogai? Paore pemegare tu je. Akaidumode akoduwo baruto du keje arodo nono Pao Aroe Eimejera ui boe eroiagudu reore.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Kodiba anorare ii boe pemegareu bogai? Paore pemegare tu je. Akaidumode akoduwo baruto du keje arodo nono Pao Aroe Eimejera ui boe eroiagudu reore.

b: Akore: - Inoba? Kakoduwuba?  Jesus akore: - Amodukare boe ewido, akera keadu kaba, akiwogu kaba, akaba boe ewadaraodo.
source: Akore: - Inoba? Kakoduwuba?  Jesus akore: - Amodukare boe ewido, akera keadu kaba, akiwogu kaba, akaba boe ewadaraodo.

b: Ameartorudo aoji, aceji, ameardu kurimode amedagei areore.
source: Ameartorudo aoji, aceji, ameardu kurimode amedagei areore.

b: Icare nowu iparedu akore: - Irore ino nowu jamedu boeji jii je. Kaboba okwa kimore inai?
source: Icare nowu iparedu akore: - Irore ino nowu jamedu boeji jii je. Kaboba okwa kimore inai?

b: Jesus akore: -Akaidumode apemega remawuwo du keje, toro, akirodo akoroe jamedu boe tabo, maku marenarue etai, nowu inodu koia boe pemegareu kurireu mugumode atogi baru tada. Du kejere, mato itabo! +Tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, nowu iparedu uture tugiarigodu kuricigo tabo, mare paga karega, oroe kuricigore kodi.
source: Jesus akore: -Akaidumode apemega remawuwo du keje, toro, akirodo akoroe jamedu boe tabo, maku marenarue etai, nowu inodu koia boe pemegareu kurireu mugumode atogi baru tada. Du kejere, mato itabo! +Tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, nowu iparedu uture tugiarigodu kuricigo tabo, mare paga karega, oroe kuricigore kodi.

b: Nowu inodu keje, Jesus akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Raka remawu nure ia oroe kurireu uwo turemo baruto.
source: Nowu inodu keje, Jesus akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Raka remawu nure ia oroe kurireu uwo turemo baruto.

b: Inagomode tai pugeje: ure turugadu ia camelo tuwo tuie bu meriricira pororogu kajeje, mare ia oroe kurireu rema uwo turemo baruto dure, ema karega.
source: Inagomode tai pugeje: ure turugadu ia camelo tuwo tuie bu meriricira pororogu kajeje, mare ia oroe kurireu rema uwo turemo baruto dure, ema karega.

b: Awu bakaru keje, nowu ure jorduwadowuge erore toku, epagudugodure, du tabore enoragodure: - Kode, ioguduba umode cinorudo?
source: Awu bakaru keje, nowu ure jorduwadowuge erore toku, epagudugodure, du tabore enoragodure: - Kode, ioguduba umode cinorudo?

b: Jesus aiwore ei tu je, akore: - Nowu inodu ime eroiwamodukare ji; mare Paorema ia roiwamodukare jiboe bokwa.
source: Jesus aiwore ei tu je, akore: - Nowu inodu ime eroiwamodukare ji; mare Paorema ia roiwamodukare jiboe bokwa.

b: Du kejere Pedro akore: - U! Kode, cere cegera ra boe jamedu boe piji. Kaboba morimode ema cenai?
source: Du kejere Pedro akore: - U! Kode, cere cegera ra boe jamedu boe piji. Kaboba morimode ema cenai?

b: Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire imode awadudo tai: Ia kodiwu maiwu pemegareu keje, Imedu Onaregedu umode tumugudo tumuga pemegareu keje, du keje, tagire tagodure itabodu, tamode tamugudo ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutowu boe emuga keje, tawo tagogado ure nono ikera pudogidure ikerako umode pobe turegodajiwu reoreu Israeldoge etuwobei.
source: Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire imode awadudo tai: Ia kodiwu maiwu pemegareu keje, Imedu Onaregedu umode tumugudo tumuga pemegareu keje, du keje, tagire tagodure itabodu, tamode tamugudo ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutowu boe emuga keje, tawo tagogado ure nono ikera pudogidure ikerako umode pobe turegodajiwu reoreu Israeldoge etuwobei.

b: Cewu tumeardu kuri koia iiwuge emode tugera ra tumanamage, tuwiemage, tuo, tuje, tore, epiji, tuwai pijiwuge, duwuge nowu inodu makudumode etai pugeje du makaguragamode, eemode jii je jamedu.
source: Cewu tumeardu kuri koia iiwuge emode tugera ra tumanamage, tuwiemage, tuo, tuje, tore, epiji, tuwai pijiwuge, duwuge nowu inodu makudumode etai pugeje du makaguragamode, eemode jii je jamedu.

b: Boetojiwu makaguragareuge ekodumode boi; boiwu makaguragareuge ekodumode boetoji.
source: Boetojiwu makaguragareuge ekodumode boi; boiwu makaguragareuge ekodumode boetoji.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera ui boe emaragodae moridodu.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera ui boe emaragodae moridodu.

b: Jesus akore pugeje: - Pao o boe pemegareu ure nono ia boe etuo utui barogwa kododu tabo, tuiorduwo iaboei ma, tumagowo ei etuwo to boepa kae du reore.
source: Jesus akore pugeje: - Pao o boe pemegareu ure nono ia boe etuo utui barogwa kododu tabo, tuiorduwo iaboei ma, tumagowo ei etuwo to boepa kae du reore.

b: Akore tumoduie morido diieroji mito tu tu meriji, ure etudo to boepato.
source: Akore tumoduie morido diieroji mito tu tu meriji, ure etudo to boepato.

b: Meri akurui gu baruto du keje, uture pugeje, du tabore jordure iaboe eedui ba oiagi paga tu je duji.
source: Meri akurui gu baruto du keje, uture pugeje, du tabore jordure iaboe eedui ba oiagi paga tu je duji.

b: Akore ei: Tadudo ino boepato jamedu, imode mori pemegado tagai.
source: Akore ei: Tadudo ino boepato jamedu, imode mori pemegado tagai.

b: Eture rugadu. Meri jetui baru oia keje du keje, uture pugeje. Meri jogodu tabo pugeje, rore nono turomagai iagei du reore.
source: Eture rugadu. Meri jetui baru oia keje du keje, uture pugeje. Meri jogodu tabo pugeje, rore nono turomagai iagei du reore.

b: Boekarema, meri rekodugodu tabo, jordure iagei ba oiagi pugeje, unoragodure ei: - Kodiba taedu pagare jii meriji taro kai ia taroji du tabo?
source: Boekarema, meri rekodugodu tabo, jordure iagei ba oiagi pugeje, unoragodure ei: - Kodiba taedu pagare jii meriji taro kai ia taroji du tabo?

b: Egore: - Mare paga karega, boe emagokare cei kodi. Kodi icare akore ei: - Tadudo ino boepato jamedu.
source: Egore: - Mare paga karega, boe emagokare cei kodi. Kodi icare akore ei: - Tadudo ino boepato jamedu.

b: Icai meri buture du keje, cewu ore boepa cewu akore ture jetu boepa jiwuji: - Amagodo maragodureuge ewogai, awo mori maku etai, paru bu kodure boiwuge ewugeje jii boetojiwuge etae.
source: Icai meri buture du keje, cewu ore boepa cewu akore ture jetu boepa jiwuji: - Amagodo maragodureuge ewogai, awo mori maku etai, paru bu kodure boiwuge ewugeje jii boetojiwuge etae.

b: Cewu meri butu kejewuge etaregodure; eiamedu boe enore diiero mito tu tu pureore.
source: Cewu meri butu kejewuge etaregodure; eiamedu boe enore diiero mito tu tu pureore.

b: Aregodure cewu boetojiwuge etae du keje, emeardaere mori kurimoduie pudaiduji. Mare eno diierore mito tu tu pureore jamedu.
source: Aregodure cewu boetojiwuge etae du keje, emeardaere mori kurimoduie pudaiduji. Mare eno diierore mito tu tu pureore jamedu.

b: Makudui etai du keje, emago pegare nowu ore boepacewuji tagoi: -
source: Makudui etai du keje, emago pegare nowu ore boepacewuji tagoi: -

b: Boigoduwuge emaragodae rogu biegare tu je, macare enore nono pago reore; pagire pabewure pai meriji boe eruji jii je!
source: Boigoduwuge emaragodae rogu biegare tu je, macare enore nono pago reore; pagire pabewure pai meriji boe eruji jii je!

b: Du kodi icare eimejera makore ia ei: - Imeduia, ikarega ure aekuri pagado. Imagokare imoduie morido diiero mito tu tu je duji?
source: Du kodi icare eimejera makore ia ei: - Imeduia, ikarega ure aekuri pagado. Imagokare imoduie morido diiero mito tu tu je duji?

b: Makudure akaiwu, toro tabo. Imire itaidure iwo kodure boigoduwu odo nono ako reore, 15kode, iromodukare nono itaidu reore inoroeji? Kode, akaiwomode ii aeku pegareu tabo ipemega bogai?
source: Makudure akaiwu, toro tabo. Imire itaidure iwo kodure boigoduwu odo nono ako reore, 15kode, iromodukare nono itaidu reore inoroeji? Kode, akaiwomode ii aeku pegareu tabo ipemega bogai?

b:
Nowu inodu reore, kodure boiwuge boetojiwugemode emage, boetojiwuge boiwugemode emage. Pao makore bogaiwuge emagaguragare, mare ure tugeragu jiwuge enowarore tu je.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tujewoduji, metuia bokware pugejedu.
source:
Nowu inodu reore, kodure boiwuge boetojiwugemode emage, boetojiwuge boiwugemode emage. Pao makore bogaiwuge emagaguragare, mare ure tugeragu jiwuge enowarore tu je.
Jesus makoi tuwiji, tujewoduji, metuia bokware pugejedu.

b: Erudu nure Jerusalém kae du tonajire icare Jesus ure tugeragu ture jorduwadowugei paci woje pudabo, akore ei: -
source: Erudu nure Jerusalém kae du tonajire icare Jesus ure tugeragu ture jorduwadowugei paci woje pudabo, akore ei: -

b: Icare parudu nure Jerusalém kae. Nono Imedu Onaregedu makudumode baire eimejerage etai, escribadoge etai, emode boedo bito.
source: Icare parudu nure Jerusalém kae. Nono Imedu Onaregedu makudumode baire eimejerage etai, escribadoge etai, emode boedo bito.

b:
Emode maku ao pegokareuge etai ewadaru keadu pegawo ji, ewo pogurudo, ewo barigodudo, ewo redugodudo pudui, ewo boe to ji, ewo bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, jewodumode.
Zebedeu ore.
source:
Emode maku ao pegokareuge etai ewadaru keadu pegawo ji, ewo pogurudo, ewo barigodudo, ewo redugodudo pudui, ewo boe to ji, ewo bu i padui pugajejedu keje. Mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, jewodumode.
Zebedeu ore.

b: Nowu inodu keje, Zebedeu ore etuje ure tuburedo tu tore ebo, ure tubujodo tuku Jesus jokorai togwamaguduwo ji.
source: Nowu inodu keje, Zebedeu ore etuje ure tuburedo tu tore ebo, ure tubujodo tuku Jesus jokorai togwamaguduwo ji.

b: Icare Jesus unoragdure ji: - Kaba jiba akaidure?  Du tabore nowu aredu akore. - Awo awu itore ei pobedu edo tumugudo ako boe pemegareu keje akabo: ia mugudo akana pemegareu jaogwai, ia mugudo akana koboreu jaogwai.
source: Icare Jesus unoragdure ji: - Kaba jiba akaidure?  Du tabore nowu aredu akore. - Awo awu itore ei pobedu edo tumugudo ako boe pemegareu keje akabo: ia mugudo akana pemegareu jaogwai, ia mugudo akana koboreu jaogwai.

b: Jesus akore ji: - Taerduwakare kaboba bogaiba tagogwamagudure. Tagudumode ikudumode ce calice to boece? Egore: - U!
source: Jesus akore ji: - Taerduwakare kaboba bogaiba tagogwamagudure. Tagudumode ikudumode ce calice to boece? Egore: - U!

b: Akore: - Boe jokodu, tagudumode ino calice to rugadu. Mare tamugui ikana pemegareu jaogwai, iarema ikana koboreu jaogwai, nowu inodu imi karega; nowu boe emugare tu Ioga ure jeonaiagu jiwuge ewogai.
source: Akore: - Boe jokodu, tagudumode ino calice to rugadu. Mare tamugui ikana pemegareu jaogwai, iarema ikana koboreu jaogwai, nowu inodu imi karega; nowu boe emugare tu Ioga ure jeonaiagu jiwuge ewogai.

b: Ia ure jorduwadowuge ei ikera pudogidure emeardure nowu inodu jamedu boeji, dukoia ekorigodure nowu tumedage ei pobeduji.
source: Ia ure jorduwadowuge ei ikera pudogidure emeardure nowu inodu jamedu boeji, dukoia ekorigodure nowu tumedage ei pobeduji.

b: Mare Jesus makore eiamedu bogai, akore ei: - Taerduware awu moto kejewu brae eimejerage emugui tudugarege ewugejeduji, kurireuge ei tumugudo ewugeje turo rakareu tabo duji.
source: Mare Jesus makore eiamedu bogai, akore ei: - Taerduware awu moto kejewu brae eimejerage emugui tudugarege ewugejeduji, kurireuge ei tumugudo ewugeje turo rakareu tabo duji.

b: Mare tagaba oino pudada. Mare paci oino: cewu aidure tuwo tugurido, u rumode boe etugaredo pudumi.
source: Mare tagaba oino pudada. Mare paci oino: cewu aidure tuwo tugurido, u rumode boe etugaredo pudumi.

b: Aidure tuwo boetojiwudo pudumi tadodawu, umode tadugaregedo pudumi.
source: Aidure tuwo boetojiwudo pudumi tadodawu, umode tadugaregedo pudumi.

b:
Oinore Imedu Onaregedu rore: aregodure, mare tudugaregewo boece karega, mare boe etugarewo pudumi. Jamedu tuwo tumagu tuwo makareuge einorudo.
Jesus ui ia joku bukwareu ime ei pobedu pemegagodu.
source:
Oinore Imedu Onaregedu rore: aregodure, mare tudugaregewo boece karega, mare boe etugarewo pudumi. Jamedu tuwo tumagu tuwo makareuge einorudo.
Jesus ui ia joku bukwareu ime ei pobedu pemegagodu.

b: Jesus unure tudawuje ia bakurireu iei Jericó cedu piji, du tonajire icare ia boe makareuge ekodure apo.
source: Jesus unure tudawuje ia bakurireu iei Jericó cedu piji, du tonajire icare ia boe makareuge ekodure apo.

b: Du tabore ia joku bokwareuge ere pobe tu tumugui awara okwai, tumeardui Jesus kodui nono du keje, ekudugodure, egore: - Cegimejera, Davi onaregedu, akogududo cedabo!
source: Du tabore ia joku bokwareuge ere pobe tu tumugui awara okwai, tumeardui Jesus kodui nono du keje, ekudugodure, egore: - Cegimejera, Davi onaregedu, akogududo cedabo!

b: Mare nowu boe makareuge emago okorire ei emago kaiagu. Du tabore icare ere tugudu raka remawudo: - Cegimejera, Davi Onaregedu, akogududo cedabo!
source: Mare nowu boe makareuge emago okorire ei emago kaiagu. Du tabore icare ere tugudu raka remawudo: - Cegimejera, Davi Onaregedu, akogududo cedabo!

b: Icare Jesu ure tuwuredo, makore etae, unoragodure ei, akore: - Kaboba tagaidure irowo ji tagai?
source: Icare Jesu ure tuwuredo, makore etae, unoragodure ei, akore: - Kaboba tagaidure irowo ji tagai?

b: Egore: - Cegimejera, ceeku uwo tuiado du bogai.
source: Egore: - Cegimejera, ceeku uwo tuiado du bogai.

b: Icare Jesus okudure ebo, ure tugera jetudo eeku kajeje. Du inodu tonaji kuri je, eeku ure tuiado poku, du kejere ekodure apo.
source: Icare Jesus okudure ebo, ure tugera jetudo eeku kajeje. Du inodu tonaji kuri je, eeku ure tuiado poku, du kejere ekodure apo.

b: Jesus ui turemo Jerusalém bakurireu todu.
source: Jesus ui turemo Jerusalém bakurireu todu.

b: Jesus ure tuburedo Jerusalemji nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo. Icai taregodui babuturogu iei Betfajé mugui Oliveira kejewu aoporu puredu tu je du kae du keje, Jesus makore ia ture jorduwadoge ei pobe tu je duji, akore ei: -
source: Jesus ure tuburedo Jerusalemji nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo. Icai taregodui babuturogu iei Betfajé mugui Oliveira kejewu aoporu puredu tu je du kae du keje, Jesus makore ia ture jorduwadoge ei pobe tu je duji, akore ei: -

b: Tadudo bakurireu rogu mugui tu padogi du kae. Nono taerdumode ia jumento rogu okwa iku kogui tu nono duji, onaregedurogu rakojere tu apo. Okwa iku kiwuje, mato ebo itae.
source: Tadudo bakurireu rogu mugui tu padogi du kae. Nono taerdumode ia jumento rogu okwa iku kogui tu nono duji, onaregedurogu rakojere tu apo. Okwa iku kiwuje, mato ebo itae.

b: Iaboe emagomode tai du keje, tamagodo ei: - Cegimejera aidure ei jao; raimodukare umode emagu tu tuibagi pugeje.
source: Iaboe emagomode tai du keje, tamagodo ei: - Cegimejera aidure ei jao; raimodukare umode emagu tu tuibagi pugeje.

b: Oino du tabore boe kodure profeta bataru reore:
source: Oino du tabore boe kodure profeta bataru reore:

b: "Tamagomode Sião tadawu areduji: Ica, icare akimejera aregodumode akae tubemega tabo, tumugui ia jumento rogu, jumenta onaregedu keje du tabo” (Zaq 9,9).
source: "Tamagomode Sião tadawu areduji: Ica, icare akimejera aregodumode akae tubemega tabo, tumugui ia jumento rogu, jumenta onaregedu keje du tabo” (Zaq 9,9).

b: Cewu Jesus ure jorduwadowuge eture, erore nono ui turoiagudu reore rugadu.
source: Cewu Jesus ure jorduwadowuge eture, erore nono ui turoiagudu reore rugadu.

b: Etaregodure jumenta apo, onaregedu rogu apo, ere tugudae bu bukeje, ere Jesus udo tumugudo keje.
source: Etaregodure jumenta apo, onaregedu rogu apo, ere tugudae bu bukeje, ere Jesus udo tumugudo keje.

b: Du kodi icare makareu boe ere tugudae baado awaraji otodai, ere ipo, iwara, itura boe kado, ere roto ja ja awaraji jamedu.
source: Du kodi icare makareu boe ere tugudae baado awaraji otodai, ere ipo, iwara, itura boe kado, ere roto ja ja awaraji jamedu.

b: Cewu boe makareuge ekodure otodaiwuge, ekodure rekodajiwuge enoiogwarire, egore: -Hosanado Davi Onaregeduji, cewu akaru meririreu aregodui Pao ie tabodu, paegarewo ji toro baruto.
source: Cewu boe makareuge ekodure otodaiwuge, ekodure rekodajiwuge enoiogwarire, egore: -Hosanado Davi Onaregeduji, cewu akaru meririreu aregodui Pao ie tabodu, paegarewo ji toro baruto.

b: Jesus ui turemo Jerusalém to du keje, nowu bakurireu tadawuge erore toku, ekodo jice, ekodo woje, tunora tabo pui: - Kakoduwubao?
source: Jesus ui turemo Jerusalém to du keje, nowu bakurireu tadawuge erore toku, ekodo jice, ekodo woje, tunora tabo pui: - Kakoduwubao?

b:
Makareuge egore: - Jesus reno! Galiléia kejewu bakurireu rogu iei Nazaré cedu pijiwu profeta reno.
Jesus ui ure akirodo Pao uwai tadawuge ewarigu baawadu kaedu.
source:
Makareuge egore: - Jesus reno! Galiléia kejewu bakurireu rogu iei Nazaré cedu pijiwu profeta reno.
Jesus ui ure akirodo Pao uwai tadawuge ewarigu baawadu kaedu.

b: Jesus ure turemo Pao uwai kurireuto, du kejere jeture pa! boe eroi akiró tabo puai Pao uwai tada duji. Kodi icare ure ewarigu baawadu kae; kodi icare ure nowu roinowuge emuga ira boe butudo.
source: Jesus ure turemo Pao uwai kurireuto, du kejere jeture pa! boe eroi akiró tabo puai Pao uwai tada duji. Kodi icare ure ewarigu baawadu kae; kodi icare ure nowu roinowuge emuga ira boe butudo.

b: Akore ei: - Bapera atugo batarure oino tabaru tabodu: “Iwaire boe enogwamagudu epa rema, dure icare tare arodureuge, okwarigudureuge eiarido ema“ (Jer 7,11).
source: Akore ei: - Bapera atugo batarure oino tabaru tabodu: “Iwaire boe enogwamagudu epa rema, dure icare tare arodureuge, okwarigudureuge eiarido ema“ (Jer 7,11).

b: Du keje icare, joku bokwareuge, pogora meioreuge etaregodure ae, ure epemegago.
source: Du keje icare, joku bokwareuge, pogora meioreuge etaregodure ae, ure epemegago.

b: Du tabore icare baire eimejerage, escribadoge, ekorigodu kuricigore, taiwoi nowu ro pemegareu kurireu boeji, tumeardui boe etore enoiogwarii Pao uwai tada eegoi: “Paegarewo Davi Onaregeduji” inoduji du tabo.
source: Du tabore icare baire eimejerage, escribadoge, ekorigodu kuricigore, taiwoi nowu ro pemegareu kurireu boeji, tumeardui boe etore enoiogwarii Pao uwai tada eegoi: “Paegarewo Davi Onaregeduji” inoduji du tabo.

b: Icare egore Jesusji: - Ameardure egoinoduji? Jesus akore: - U! Imeardu pemegare. Tamago tamagokare bapera atugo akoi: “Nege kugure, boe etore kugure eedui tujemage etodojiwuge eiabijiwuge eigoiare ere akurido” (Sl 8,3) inodu jituji?
source: Icare egore Jesusji: - Ameardure egoinoduji? Jesus akore: - U! Imeardu pemegare. Tamago tamagokare bapera atugo akoi: “Nege kugure, boe etore kugure eedui tujemage etodojiwuge eiabijiwuge eigoiare ere akurido” (Sl 8,3) inodu jituji?

b:
Nowu inodu kjere icare uture epiji, uture bakurireu piji, turagojewo ia bakurireu rogu iei Betânia cedu keje.
Jesus jordui ia figueira i jidu.
source:
Nowu inodu kjere icare uture epiji, uture bakurireu piji, turagojewo ia bakurireu rogu iei Betânia cedu keje.
Jesus jordui ia figueira i jidu.

b: Barogwato, meri togi, tui tugirimi bakurireuto pugeje du keje, Jesus uke boire ji.
source: Barogwato, meri togi, tui tugirimi bakurireuto pugeje du keje, Jesus uke boire ji.

b: Tuiordui ia figueira iji awara okwai du keje, ure tuburedo ji, mare jordukare tuduji: aru rugadure ure tu je. Du kodi icare akore nowu figueira iji: - Atudumodukare jii rugadu.
source: Tuiordui ia figueira iji awara okwai du keje, ure tuburedo ji, mare jordukare tuduji: aru rugadure ure tu je. Du kodi icare akore nowu figueira iji: - Atudumodukare jii rugadu.

b: Kuri je, nowu figueira i bire. Tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ure jorduwadowuge epagudugodure, egore: - U! Icare awu figueira bire taci je!
source: Kuri je, nowu figueira i bire. Tuiordui nowu inodu jitu keje, ure jorduwadowuge epagudugodure, egore: - U! Icare awu figueira bire taci je!

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire imode awadudo tai: Tameartoru remawumode ma, taromodukare awu inoduji tu je, mare jamedu tagagomode awu toriraireuji: akorodo oino toro pobo maereuto, du kejere nowu inodu umode ino rugadu.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire imode awadudo tai: Tameartoru remawumode ma, taromodukare awu inoduji tu je, mare jamedu tagagomode awu toriraireuji: akorodo oino toro pobo maereuto, du kejere nowu inodu umode ino rugadu.

b:
Tagogwamagudumode du keje, tagogwamagudure bogaiboe jamedu boe makudumode tagai.
Jesus ro raka.
source:
Tagogwamagudumode du keje, tagogwamagudure bogaiboe jamedu boe makudumode tagai.
Jesus ro raka.

b:
Jesus uture jice Pao uwai kae pugeje. Tui boe eerduwado nowu Pao uwai tada du tonaji, baire eimejerage, boe kuridoge, codudoge, ere tuburedo ji, egore ji: -
Kakoduboe koiaba ure arodo ino? Ioguduba koiaba ure aroiagu ino?
source:
Jesus uture jice Pao uwai kae pugeje. Tui boe eerduwado nowu Pao uwai tada du tonaji, baire eimejerage, boe kuridoge, codudoge, ere tuburedo ji, egore ji: -
Kakoduboe koiaba ure arodo ino? Ioguduba koiaba ure aroiagu ino?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Inorawo tai jamedu ka: Tamode tagogiegi ji ma, du kejere imode tawie kakoduboe koiaba ure irojino.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Inorawo tai jamedu ka: Tamode tagogiegi ji ma, du kejere imode tawie kakoduboe koiaba ure irojino.

b: Tamagodo ii: Kaba ro raka koiaba João Batista ure boe etaopegodo? Pao Aroe Eimejera ro raka koia kana? Iarema ime ero raka koia na?  Du kejere ere tumeardae kado kado boeji, egore: - Pamagomode Pao Aroe Eimejera ro raka koiaie, ino ma, akomode: Kode kodiba tameartorukare ji?
source: Tamagodo ii: Kaba ro raka koiaba João Batista ure boe etaopegodo? Pao Aroe Eimejera ro raka koia kana? Iarema ime ero raka koia na?  Du kejere ere tumeardae kado kado boeji, egore: - Pamagomode Pao Aroe Eimejera ro raka koiaie, ino ma, akomode: Kode kodiba tameartorukare ji?

b: Pagagomode ime eigoiaie, ino ma, pabagudumode boe makareugece, mare paga karega, boe eiamedu boere emeartorure profetaie ure Joãoce duji.
source: Pagagomode ime eigoiaie, ino ma, pabagudumode boe makareugece, mare paga karega, boe eiamedu boere emeartorure profetaie ure Joãoce duji.

b:
Du icare egore Jesusji: - Ceerduwakare!  Icare Jesus akore: - Kode, imi jamedu imodukare tawie kaba koiaba ure irodo inoduji jamedu.
Boe etore ei pobedu.
source:
Du icare egore Jesusji: - Ceerduwakare!  Icare Jesus akore: - Kode, imi jamedu imodukare tawie kaba koiaba ure irodo inoduji jamedu.
Boe etore ei pobedu.

b: Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Inoba tameardaemode? Ia imedu orere pobe. Tumagoi boetojiwu ae du tabo, akore ji: Imedu, toro, amaragoduwo ino boepa tada awuji.
source: Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Inoba tameardaemode? Ia imedu orere pobe. Tumagoi boetojiwu ae du tabo, akore ji: Imedu, toro, amaragoduwo ino boepa tada awuji.

b: Du tabore cewu onaregedu akore ji: Boro. Itaiduka. Mare kuri je inodu korire ji, kodi icare uture rugadu, tumaragoduwo tuo boepa tada.
source: Du tabore cewu onaregedu akore ji: Boro. Itaiduka. Mare kuri je inodu korire ji, kodi icare uture rugadu, tumaragoduwo tuo boepa tada.

b: Du tabore icare cewu ipare etuo makore ia tonaregedu ae, akore ji nono tago magai ia jitu reore. Icare nowu onaregedu rekodajiwu akore: U, ioga. Mare utukare rugadu.
source: Du tabore icare cewu ipare etuo makore ia tonaregedu ae, akore ji nono tago magai ia jitu reore. Icare nowu onaregedu rekodajiwu akore: U, ioga. Mare utukare rugadu.

b: Kakoduwu ia emageba rore nono tuo aidu reore?. Egore: - Boetojiwu. Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe remawu jire inagomode oino tai: Ropegareuge, ropegareu areme etaregodumode baruto tagoda piji.
source: Kakoduwu ia emageba rore nono tuo aidu reore?. Egore: - Boetojiwu. Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe remawu jire inagomode oino tai: Ropegareuge, ropegareu areme etaregodumode baruto tagoda piji.

b:
Paga karega, João aregodure tagae awara jetororeu tabo, mare tameartorukare ji. Mare ro pegareuge, ropegareu areme emeartorure ji. Tagi taerdure inoduji, mare takare tabemegado tameartoruwo ji.
,,Boepa tadawu ime pegareuge.
source:
Paga karega, João aregodure tagae awara jetororeu tabo, mare tameartorukare ji. Mare ro pegareuge, ropegareu areme emeartorure ji. Tagi taerdure inoduji, mare takare tabemegado tameartoruwo ji.
,,Boepa tadawu ime pegareuge.

b: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Tawiapagado ia bakaruji pugeje ka: ia boe etuo ure ia boepa bu, ure tori aiado tabo, ure ia pobo aia mugudo tada, ure ia bairaireu towuje keje. Tui maku ia jetumode jiwuge etai, du kejere, uture nowu moto piji.
source: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Tawiapagado ia bakaruji pugeje ka: ia boe etuo ure ia boepa bu, ure tori aiado tabo, ure ia pobo aia mugudo tada, ure ia bairaireu towuje keje. Tui maku ia jetumode jiwuge etai, du kejere, uture nowu moto piji.

b: Icai boe aregodui boewo tugeragu nowu boepa tadaboe jitu du keje, ure ia tudugarege etudo toro nowu jeture boepa jiwuge etae, ewo tugeragu nowu boepa tadaboeji.
source: Icai boe aregodui boewo tugeragu nowu boepa tadaboe jitu du keje, ure ia tudugarege etudo toro nowu jeture boepa jiwuge etae, ewo tugeragu nowu boepa tadaboeji.

b: Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge, ere tubodo nowu utugarege ebo, ere boe to iato, ere ia bito, iage ere tori to ei.
source: Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge, ere tubodo nowu utugarege ebo, ere boe to iato, ere ia bito, iage ere tori to ei.

b: Boekare, ure iage emagodo toro cewuge ekori pugeje. Erore nono turo magai cewuiage ei du reore jamedu.
source: Boekare, ure iage emagodo toro cewuge ekori pugeje. Erore nono turo magai cewuiage ei du reore jamedu.

b: Icarema, tonaregedu remawure icare ure utudo toro pugeje, tagoi: Awu itonaregedu jire eromodukare ia turo.
source: Icarema, tonaregedu remawure icare ure utudo toro pugeje, tagoi: Awu itonaregedu jire eromodukare ia turo.

b: Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge, tuiordui onaregedu jitu keje, egore pui: Ica, awu aire uo oe makudumode ai; pawo bito, pagiwo pagoere nowu oemode emaboece.
source: Mare nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwuge, tuiordui onaregedu jitu keje, egore pui: Ica, awu aire uo oe makudumode ai; pawo bito, pagiwo pagoere nowu oemode emaboece.

b: Icare ere tubodo apo, ere tawuje boepa piji, icare ere bito.
source: Icare ere tubodo apo, ere tawuje boepa piji, icare ere bito.

b: Kode, nowu ore nowu boepa cewu, ui tugirimi du keje, inoba romode nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwugei?
source: Kode, nowu ore nowu boepa cewu, ui tugirimi du keje, inoba romode nowu jeture nowu boepa jiwugei?

b: Egore: - Umode nowu meridoge  Aroe pegareuge ewidodudo togudu bokwa tabo, du keje umode iage eto ji pugeje, duwuge emode nowu boepa tadaboe makai boe aregodui pudae du keje.
source: Egore: - Umode nowu meridoge  Aroe pegareuge ewidodudo togudu bokwa tabo, du keje umode iage eto ji pugeje, duwuge emode nowu boepa tadaboe makai boe aregodui pudae du keje.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tamagokare bapera atugo akoi: “Ure bai mugudo tori tabowuge ere pijidowu tori icare ema remawure ema pugeje. Pagimejera maragodae rema du jire paebogodure ji”?
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tamagokare bapera atugo akoi: “Ure bai mugudo tori tabowuge ere pijidowu tori icare ema remawure ema pugeje. Pagimejera maragodae rema du jire paebogodure ji”?

b: Du kodire imagomode oino tai: boe pemegareu baru tadawu arududodumode tabiji, makudumode iaboe etai, nowuge eigoiare emode kurodureboe tawuje piji pugeje du koia.
source: Du kodire imagomode oino tai: boe pemegareu baru tadawu arududodumode tabiji, makudumode iaboe etai, nowuge eigoiare emode kurodureboe tawuje piji pugeje du koia.

b: Buture awu tori kejewu romode ja... rito nowu ri buture kejewu begugwamode ri kuda.
source: Buture awu tori kejewu romode ja... rito nowu ri buture kejewu begugwamode ri kuda.

b: Baire eimejerage, fariseudoge emeardure nowu inoduji, ere boe pawuje pudui raboduie Jesus akoinoduji.
source: Baire eimejerage, fariseudoge emeardure nowu inoduji, ere boe pawuje pudui raboduie Jesus akoinoduji.

b: Eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare epagudure boece, emeardure profetaie ema kodi.
source: Eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare epagudure boece, emeardure profetaie ema kodi.

b: Boe ekera makudui puaidu kodiwu boe enogwage.
source: Boe ekera makudui puaidu kodiwu boe enogwage.

b: Jesus makore boei pugeje ia bakaru tabo pugeje, akore: -
source: Jesus makore boei pugeje ia bakaru tabo pugeje, akore: -

b: Boe pemegareu kejeboe ure nono ia brae eimejera awu moto kejewu ui tonaregedu uwiredo du reore.
source: Boe pemegareu kejeboe ure nono ia brae eimejera awu moto kejewu ui tonaregedu uwiredo du reore.

b: Du makore tudugaregei emagowo ture bakarudo jiwuge ewogai. Mare etaidukare tuduwo bataru jipagi.
source: Du makore tudugaregei emagowo ture bakarudo jiwuge ewogai. Mare etaidukare tuduwo bataru jipagi.

b: Du kejere, ure iage etudo pugeje, tagoi ei oino du tabo: Tamagodo ire bakarudo jiwugei: inagu tapiradoge, inagu jugoreuge ewararu kuricigoi dure ire ewido. Boe jamedu boere turugadu, mato peta kae.
source: Du kejere, ure iage etudo pugeje, tagoi ei oino du tabo: Tamagodo ire bakarudo jiwugei: inagu tapiradoge, inagu jugoreuge ewararu kuricigoi dure ire ewido. Boe jamedu boere turugadu, mato peta kae.

b: Mare boekare, ekare tuwiapagado nowu akoinoduji. Iage eture to boepato, iage eture ia turo kae.
source: Mare boekare, ekare tuwiapagado nowu akoinoduji. Iage eture to boepato, iage eture ia turo kae.

b: Iage ere tubodo nowu utugarege ebo, emago pegare ei, etokire ei, ere ewido.
source: Iage ere tubodo nowu utugarege ebo, emago pegare ei, etokire ei, ere ewido.

b: Nowu brae eimejera, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, korigodu kuricigore, ure to tugobaigarege etudo toro ewo cewu pegareuge ewido, ewo joru tugu nowu eno bakurireuto.
source: Nowu brae eimejera, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, korigodu kuricigore, ure to tugobaigarege etudo toro ewo cewu pegareuge ewido, ewo joru tugu nowu eno bakurireuto.

b: Du kejere makore nowu tudugaregei, akore: Petare turugadu, mare ire bakarudo jiwuge ekare turugadu ji.
source: Du kejere makore nowu tudugaregei, akore: Petare turugadu, mare ire bakarudo jiwuge ekare turugadu ji.

b: Tadudo awara padui pugajejedu boe kae, bakarudo tu tu taerdumode jiwuge eiameduji etuwo mato peta kae.
source: Tadudo awara padui pugajejedu boe kae, bakarudo tu tu taerdumode jiwuge eiameduji etuwo mato peta kae.

b: Ere taodo toro awara boeji, ere tuiordure jiwuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui, pegareuge, pemegareuge. Du kodi icare boe enogwagemode tadawu bai kurireu okorobadure bakarudodure jiwuge ebo.
source: Ere taodo toro awara boeji, ere tuiordure jiwuge eiamedu boe ere tudo pui, pegareuge, pemegareuge. Du kodi icare boe enogwagemode tadawu bai kurireu okorobadure bakarudodure jiwuge ebo.

b: Nowu brae eimejera ure turemo tuiorduwo ei. Du tabore icare jordure ia imedu ukai tugudae pemegareu tugu pudui duji.
source: Nowu brae eimejera ure turemo tuiorduwo ei. Du tabore icare jordure ia imedu ukai tugudae pemegareu tugu pudui duji.

b: Icare unoragodure ji: Imedu, kodiba are aremo woe akadui peta kejewu akudae tugu ai du tabo? Boekare, nowu imedu akokare ia tago.
source: Icare unoragodure ji: Imedu, kodiba are aremo woe akadui peta kejewu akudae tugu ai du tabo? Boekare, nowu imedu akokare ia tago.

b: Icare nowu brae eimejera makore tudugaregei, akore ei: Tageragu ji, buregogudo, ieragogudo, barigu toro baawadu kae, boecoreuto, nono boe eto akomode do do do do do pui nono.
source: Icare nowu brae eimejera makore tudugaregei, akore ei: Tageragu ji, buregogudo, ieragogudo, barigu toro baawadu kae, boecoreuto, nono boe eto akomode do do do do do pui nono.

b:
Mare paga karega, bakarudodure jiwuge emagaguragare, mare tawujedure epijiwuge enowarore tu je.
Boe enoroe mori makudui César aidu.
source:
Mare paga karega, bakarudodure jiwuge emagaguragare, mare tawujedure epijiwuge enowarore tu je.
Boe enoroe mori makudui César aidu.

b: Du kejere icare fariseudoge ere tudo pui emagore pui inoba turomode tuwo tugeragu Jesusji jepaga inoduji ia bataru boe keje.
source: Du kejere icare fariseudoge ere tudo pui emagore pui inoba turomode tuwo tugeragu Jesusji jepaga inoduji ia bataru boe keje.

b: Du kejere icare ere ture jorduwadowuge etudo toro, Herodes jaogwaiwuge ebo, enorawo Jesusji, emagowo ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduware akie amagore boe rikireuji, akie are boe eerduwado Pao aewu awaraji boe jokodu, boe remawu tabo, apagudu kai boece du tabo. Mare paga karega, akaiwokare boe eeji du kodi.
source: Du kejere icare ere ture jorduwadowuge etudo toro, Herodes jaogwaiwuge ebo, enorawo Jesusji, emagowo ji: - Cegimejera, ceerduware akie amagore boe rikireuji, akie are boe eerduwado Pao aewu awaraji boe jokodu, boe remawu tabo, apagudu kai boece du tabo. Mare paga karega, akaiwokare boe eeji du kodi.

b: Kode, amagodo cei ka: Inoba ure aegai: umode turugadu boewo toroe mori maku César ai, iarema umodukare turugadu?
source: Kode, amagodo cei ka: Inoba ure aegai: umode turugadu boewo toroe mori maku César ai, iarema umodukare turugadu?

b: Icare Jesus, tui emeardae pawuje du keje, akore: - Kodiba tagago kogadodure ii, ro biadodureuge?
source: Icare Jesus, tui emeardae pawuje du keje, akore: - Kodiba tagago kogadodure ii, ro biadodureuge?

b: Iordudo tare maku maku César aiwu meririji ka!  Icare ere iado mito tu je ai.
source: Iordudo tare maku maku César aiwu meririji ka!  Icare ere iado mito tu je ai.

b: Icare Jesus unorare ei: - Ioguduba padure awu meriri keje, awu tuwadaru tabo?
source: Icare Jesus unorare ei: - Ioguduba padure awu meriri keje, awu tuwadaru tabo?

b: Egore: - César reno! Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, César jeonare jiboe maku César ai. Pao jeonare jiboe maku Pao ai jamedu.
source: Egore: - César reno! Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Kode, César jeonare jiboe maku César ai. Pao jeonare jiboe maku Pao ai jamedu.

b:
Eebogodure nowu akoinoduji, ekare tagokogado ji pugeje, eture piji.
Boe enorai Jesusji boe eewodu jiboe jitu.
source:
Eebogodure nowu akoinoduji, ekare tagokogado ji pugeje, eture piji.
Boe enorai Jesusji boe eewodu jiboe jitu.

b: Nowu meri mitoduji, saduceudoge, duwugere egore boe eewodumodukae, enoragodure Jesusji.
source: Nowu meri mitoduji, saduceudoge, duwugere egore boe eewodumodukae, enoragodure Jesusji.

b: Egore: - Cegimejera, Moisés akore: “Ia imedu bimode tore bokwa tabo du keje, oreduje mugumode uwie apo, oinodu tabo oremode” (Deut 25,5).
source: Egore: - Cegimejera, Moisés akore: “Ia imedu bimode tore bokwa tabo du keje, oreduje mugumode uwie apo, oinodu tabo oremode” (Deut 25,5).

b: Aro! Umanamagere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu reore. Boetojiwu uwiredodure, icarema bokware. Mare ore bokware, ure toreduje muguiagu tuwie apo.
source: Aro! Umanamagere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu reore. Boetojiwu uwiredodure, icarema bokware. Mare ore bokware, ure toreduje muguiagu tuwie apo.

b: Rekodajiwu ure ino jamedu; ia rekodajiwu ure ino pugeje jamedu. Oinore ure ino jii eiamedu boeji.
source: Rekodajiwu ure ino jamedu; ia rekodajiwu ure ino pugeje jamedu. Oinore ure ino jii eiamedu boeji.

b: Du kejere icare cewu aredu bokware jamedu.
source: Du kejere icare cewu aredu bokware jamedu.

b: Ica, eewodu keje, kakoduwuba oredujemode cewu aredu? Mare paga karega, eiamedu mugure apo.
source: Ica, eewodu keje, kakoduwuba oredujemode cewu aredu? Mare paga karega, eiamedu mugure apo.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Tawogware boeto, takare bapera atugo pawuje. Takare Pao ro raka pawuje jamedu.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Tawogware boeto, takare bapera atugo pawuje. Takare Pao ro raka pawuje jamedu.

b: Ica: Boe eewodu keje, ime etuwiremoduka, areme etugogemodukare jamedu, mare erumode nono Pao o tupadoge pemegareugere baru tada.
source: Ica: Boe eewodu keje, ime etuwiremoduka, areme etugogemodukare jamedu, mare erumode nono Pao o tupadoge pemegareugere baru tada.

b: Kode, nowu boe eewodumodedu, tamagokare bapera atugoji: 32”Abração aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Isaac aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Jacó aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi” (Ex 3,6)? Aró, kode, bireuge etaiwu Aroe Eimejera karega, mare jereuge etaiwu Aroe Eimejera nure ema.
source: Kode, nowu boe eewodumodedu, tamagokare bapera atugoji: 32”Abração aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Isaac aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Jacó aiwu Aroe Eimejera nure imi” (Ex 3,6)? Aró, kode, bireuge etaiwu Aroe Eimejera karega, mare jereuge etaiwu Aroe Eimejera nure ema.

b:
Tumeardui awu bataru jitu keje, boe eebogodu kuricigore.
Boe eroiagudu ema remawu.
source:
Tumeardui awu bataru jitu keje, boe eebogodu kuricigore.
Boe eroiagudu ema remawu.

b: Fariseudog ei boe pa Jesus ui saduceudoge ekeru kadodu jitu keje, ere tudo pui.
source: Fariseudog ei boe pa Jesus ui saduceudoge ekeru kadodu jitu keje, ere tudo pui.

b: Du kejere ia emage ia jorduwareu unoragodure Jesusji toebato du tabo ji, akore: -
source: Du kejere ia emage ia jorduwareu unoragodure Jesusji toebato du tabo ji, akore: -

b: Cegimejera, Kakoduwu Pao o boe eroiagudu ema remawu rema?
source: Cegimejera, Kakoduwu Pao o boe eroiagudu ema remawu rema?

b: Jesus akore: - Ameardu kurido Pao Aroe Eimejeraji awabo jamedu tabo, akaroe jamedu tabo, ameardae jamedu tabo” (Deut 6,5).
source: Jesus akore: - Ameardu kurido Pao Aroe Eimejeraji awabo jamedu tabo, akaroe jamedu tabo, ameardae jamedu tabo” (Deut 6,5).

b: Awure Pao o boe eroiagudu ema remawu boetojiwu rema.
source: Awure Pao o boe eroiagudu ema remawu boetojiwu rema.

b: Rekodajiwu ure nono boetojiwu reore: “Ameardu kurimode ameduiaji nono ameardu kuri magai ai du reore” (Lev 19,18).
source: Rekodajiwu ure nono boetojiwu reore: “Ameardu kurimode ameduiaji nono ameardu kuri magai ai du reore” (Lev 19,18).

b:
Awu Pao batarui pobe oinodu boe eroiagudu jamedu boe ure to pui nono.
Jesus unorai boei Messias jiboe jitu.
source:
Awu Pao batarui pobe oinodu boe eroiagudu jamedu boe ure to pui nono.
Jesus unorai boei Messias jiboe jitu.

b: Fariseudoge ere tudo pui. Du kejere icare Jesus unoragodure ei, akore ei: -
source: Fariseudoge ere tudo pui. Du kejere icare Jesus unoragodure ei, akore ei: -

b: Inoba tameardaere Messiasji? Ioguduba onaregeduba? Egore: - Davi Onaregedu.
source: Inoba tameardaere Messiasji? Ioguduba onaregeduba? Egore: - Davi Onaregedu.

b: Jesus makore pugeje, akore: - Kode, kodiba Davi, tumagoi Aroe Pemegareu koia, akore: 44”Pagimejera akore ikimejeraji: Amugudo ikana pemegereu jaogwai jii, ii onare aiwuge ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 109,1)?
source: Jesus makore pugeje, akore: - Kode, kodiba Davi, tumagoi Aroe Pemegareu koia, akore: 44”Pagimejera akore ikimejeraji: Amugudo ikana pemegereu jaogwai jii, ii onare aiwuge ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 109,1)?

b: Kode, Davi akore tugimejeraie, kode, kodiba icare onaregedumode ema?
source: Kode, Davi akore tugimejeraie, kode, kodiba icare onaregedumode ema?

b: Ia emagokare ia pubiji ia pubiji. Nowu inodu piji pugejere icare ekidakare tumagowo ji pugeje.
source: Ia emagokare ia pubiji ia pubiji. Nowu inodu piji pugejere icare ekidakare tumagowo ji pugeje.

b: Jesus okituwai fariseudogei, escribadogei.
source: Jesus okituwai fariseudogei, escribadogei.

b: Jesus ure turodo pai nowu boe makareuge mare nowu ture jorduwadowuge ewugeje, du kejere akore: -
source: Jesus ure turodo pai nowu boe makareuge mare nowu ture jorduwadowuge ewugeje, du kejere akore: -

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge ere tumugudo Moisés muga keje tuwo boe eroiagudu kogado du bogai.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge ere tumugudo Moisés muga keje tuwo boe eroiagudu kogado du bogai.

b: Tarodo nono ewadaru jamedu reore; mare taro kaba nono ero magadu reore; mare paga karega, emagore mare erokare ino.
source: Tarodo nono ewadaru jamedu reore; mare taro kaba nono ero magadu reore; mare paga karega, emagore mare erokare ino.

b: Ere boe motudureu udo turugadu tuwo bu ime eporu keje, mare emagerema etaidukare tuwo tugera amagadudo nowu motudureboeji.
source: Ere boe motudureu udo turugadu tuwo bu ime eporu keje, mare emagerema etaidukare tuwo tugera amagadudo nowu motudureboeji.

b: Ere turodo tagodo boe eerduwo du bogai, ere aroia arudugodureu kuru kurureu bu tuwugeje ia raire, ia boa kurire tugajeje.
source: Ere turodo tagodo boe eerduwo du bogai, ere aroia arudugodureu kuru kurureu bu tuwugeje ia raire, ia boa kurire tugajeje.

b: Etaidure boe emuga boetojiwuji boe enogwage keje, Sinagoga keje jamedu.
source: Etaidure boe emuga boetojiwuji boe enogwage keje, Sinagoga keje jamedu.

b: Etaidure boewo tugurido pudui ba oiagi. Etaidure boe egowo tugimejeraie ure pudumi.
source: Etaidure boewo tugurido pudui ba oiagi. Etaidure boe egowo tugimejeraie ure pudumi.

b: Mare tagi, tagaba boe egodo tugimejeraie ure tagi; mare paga karega, tagimejerare mito tu je; tamanamage, tawiemage nure puje.
source: Mare tagi, tagaba boe egodo tugimejeraie ure tagi; mare paga karega, tagimejerare mito tu je; tamanamage, tawiemage nure puje.

b: Tagaba taomagedo iaboece iaboece woe moto keje, mare paga karega, taore mito tu je: cewu mugure baru tadawu.
source: Tagaba taomagedo iaboece iaboece woe moto keje, mare paga karega, taore mito tu je: cewu mugure baru tadawu.

b: Jamedu, tagaba boe egodo tugimejeraie ure tagi, mare paga karega, tagimejerare mito tu je, dure Cristo rema.
source: Jamedu, tagaba boe egodo tugimejeraie ure tagi, mare paga karega, tagimejerare mito tu je, dure Cristo rema.

b: Cewu kurire tadodawu, romode duku tumedage ekuda.
source: Cewu kurire tadodawu, romode duku tumedage ekuda.

b: Cewu ure tuwiegatoridowu, kurimode tumedage ekori.
source: Cewu ure tuwiegatoridowu, kurimode tumedage ekori.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare baru tadawu boe pemegareu baiporo mi ime etai, tagi rugadure tamodukare taremo to.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare baru tadawu boe pemegareu baiporo mi ime etai, tagi rugadure tamodukare taremo to.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tagire tare ukoge okware pijiwuge enoroe akedudo, tai tagogwa kuridodu raicigodo taiaki du tabo, kodire awu taro mori pega kuricigomode tagai.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tagire tare ukoge okware pijiwuge enoroe akedudo, tai tagogwa kuridodu raicigodo taiaki du tabo, kodire awu taro mori pega kuricigomode tagai.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare tagaiwodo motoji, pobo maereuji, tawo ia boe etaru tagai du bogai, du kejere tare jeonare joru jiwudo ema pobe tagori.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare tagaiwodo motoji, pobo maereuji, tawo ia boe etaru tagai du bogai, du kejere tare jeonare joru jiwudo ema pobe tagori.

b: Joku bokwareuge etododaiwuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tagagore: Iaboe emode togwa tugu Pao uwai ie tabo ma, nowu inodu boe karega, mare umode togwatugu Pao uwai tadaboe tabo ma, nowu akoinowu romode ino rugadu.
source: Joku bokwareuge etododaiwuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tagagore: Iaboe emode togwa tugu Pao uwai ie tabo ma, nowu inodu boe karega, mare umode togwatugu Pao uwai tadaboe tabo ma, nowu akoinowu romode ino rugadu.

b: Matadure turo towuge, joku bokwareuge! Kode, kakoduwuba ema remawu: meriri ekureuna? iarema Pao uwai, koiare ure meriri ekureu motududo pudui du rema?
source: Matadure turo towuge, joku bokwareuge! Kode, kakoduwuba ema remawu: meriri ekureuna? iarema Pao uwai, koiare ure meriri ekureu motududo pudui du rema?

b: Tagagore jamedu: - Iaboe emode togwatugu altar ie tabo, nowu inodu boe karega, mare iaboe emode togwatugu ia mori padui keje du tabo ma, romode ino rugadu.
source: Tagagore jamedu: - Iaboe emode togwatugu altar ie tabo, nowu inodu boe karega, mare iaboe emode togwatugu ia mori padui keje du tabo ma, romode ino rugadu.

b: Joku bokwareuge! Kode, kakoduwuba emaremawu rema: boei mori makudu na? iarema altar koiare ure mori motududo pudui du rema?
source: Joku bokwareuge! Kode, kakoduwuba emaremawu rema: boei mori makudu na? iarema altar koiare ure mori motududo pudui du rema?

b: Cewu ure togwatugu altar ie tabowu, jamedu unure togwatugu padure bukajejeboe jamedu boe tabo jamedu.
source: Cewu ure togwatugu altar ie tabowu, jamedu unure togwatugu padure bukajejeboe jamedu boe tabo jamedu.

b: Cewu ure togwatugu Pao uwai ie tabowu, unure togwatugu nowu mugure tadaboe ie tabo jamedu.
source: Cewu ure togwatugu Pao uwai ie tabowu, unure togwatugu nowu mugure tadaboe ie tabo jamedu.

b: Cewu ure togwatugu baru towu, unure togwatugu Pao muga kae, mugure kejeboeji jamedu.
source: Cewu ure togwatugu baru towu, unure togwatugu Pao muga kae, mugure kejeboeji jamedu.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tanure tawiapagado barigodureu bakaruji, mare tanure bakaru kurireu barigududo pudui du jire taroino. Boe jetororeu, boe enogudureu, boe eroi tuwadaru jitudu, oinore taromode boetoji, mare takai nowu ia barigududo pudui du tabo.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tanure tawiapagado barigodureu bakaruji, mare tanure bakaru kurireu barigududo pudui du jire taroino. Boe jetororeu, boe enogudureu, boe eroi tuwadaru jitudu, oinore taromode boetoji, mare takai nowu ia barigududo pudui du tabo.

b: Kodure joku bokwareuge etododaiwuge, tare migimigidoge ewarigu tagogwa piji, icarema tawo camelo remo rabodu.
source: Kodure joku bokwareuge etododaiwuge, tare migimigidoge ewarigu tagogwa piji, icarema tawo camelo remo rabodu.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare ariarogu uporu kabi, tare prato uporu kabi, tagirema tagogorobadure tagiwogae tabo, tagarodudae tabo, tagogwarigodae tabo.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba pado tadogi. Tare ariarogu uporu kabi, tare prato uporu kabi, tagirema tagogorobadure tagiwogae tabo, tagarodudae tabo, tagogwarigodae tabo.

b: Fariseu joku bokwareu, aria, prato oto kabi boetoji duwo uporu kabidure jamedu.
source: Fariseu joku bokwareu, aria, prato oto kabi boetoji duwo uporu kabidure jamedu.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba padure tadogi. Tare nono bireboe eiaro uporu kigadu reore. Uporu moture mare toro tada korobadure boe era tabo, boe ewi tabo, boe padui pumekejedu boe tabo.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba padure tadogi. Tare nono bireboe eiaro uporu kigadu reore. Uporu moture mare toro tada korobadure boe era tabo, boe ewi tabo, boe padui pumekejedu boe tabo.

b: Oinore tare jamedu. Tabemegareu padure tu tawiri uporu keje boe eegai mare tadoda tagogorobadure tai boe pagadodudo tagi du tabo, tabegareu tabo.
source: Oinore tare jamedu. Tabemegareu padure tu tawiri uporu keje boe eegai mare tadoda tagogorobadure tai boe pagadodudo tagi du tabo, tabegareu tabo.

b: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba padure tadogi. Tare profetadoge eiari to, tare jetororeuge eiaro motudo.
source: Escribadoge, fariseudoge, ro biadodureuge, tajeba padure tadogi. Tare profetadoge eiari to, tare jetororeuge eiaro motudo.

b: Tagagore: - Paeia tu paomage etonaji, pamodukare pagera rorogodudo profetadoge eku tabo nono ereore.
source: Tagagore: - Paeia tu paomage etonaji, pamodukare pagera rorogodudo profetadoge eku tabo nono ereore.

b: Nowu inodu tabo tanure tagogiegi tai tagaobiji tagagoi nowu ure biodo profetadoge eiwuge etoreie ure tagiduji.
source: Nowu inodu tabo tanure tagogiegi tai tagaobiji tagagoi nowu ure biodo profetadoge eiwuge etoreie ure tagiduji.

b: Kode, tagogorawo taomage ero reore du tabo.
source: Kode, tagogorawo taomage ero reore du tabo.

b: Okorireu awague etore. Inoba taromode tawo taginorudo joru piji?
source: Okorireu awague etore. Inoba taromode tawo taginorudo joru piji?

b: Tagado, imode profetadoge, jorduareuge etarego tawogai. Tamode ewido. Tamode iage ewu i keje, tamode boe to iagei tago sinagoga keje. Tabadumode ewugeje jice woje jice woje bakurireu boe kao.
source: Tagado, imode profetadoge, jorduareuge etarego tawogai. Tamode ewido. Tamode iage ewu i keje, tamode boe to iagei tago sinagoga keje. Tabadumode ewugeje jice woje jice woje bakurireu boe kao.

b: Kodire bitodure paga tu jewu boe eku butumode tawugeje, paru padure Abel ku keje jii Barakia onaregedu iei Zacaria cedu kae, cewu tare bito Pao uwai, altar enoiei.
source: Kodire bitodure paga tu jewu boe eku butumode tawugeje, paru padure Abel ku keje jii Barakia onaregedu iei Zacaria cedu kae, cewu tare bito Pao uwai, altar enoiei.

b:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: nowu boe pegareu jamedu boe aregodumode awu boe etuwoboe oinowuto.
Jesus meardu kurii Jerusalém jitu.
source:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: nowu boe pegareu jamedu boe aregodumode awu boe etuwoboe oinowuto.
Jesus meardu kurii Jerusalém jitu.
